title: International Roaming Network Support Specialist - VOIS
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFutur
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an International Roaming Network Support Specialist to join Group Technology within TSSI Networks in Pune or Bengaluru. You will act as a subject matter expert for international roaming platforms and services, helping maintain their availability, security and performance.
  
  
The role covers second-line operational support for 4G and 5G standalone and non-standalone networks, signalling platforms, roaming firewalls and value-added roaming services. You will resolve complex incidents, implement technical changes, improve network performance, support security remediation and contribute to the operational acceptance of new platforms.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Own operational support for international roaming platforms, including services, applications, hardware, operating systems, databases, configurations and routing
* Investigate and resolve complex incidents within agreed service levels, complete root-cause analysis and implement permanent corrective actions
* Review, schedule and implement controlled changes, including software upgrades, capacity expansions, certificate renewals, security patches and hardware modifications
* Review changes proposed by external teams and suppliers, evaluating technical risks and protecting service continuity
* Monitor and optimise core network performance indicators, identify deviations and coordinate corrective action
* Troubleshoot protocol and signalling flows across 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G standalone and non-standalone networks
* Operate technologies such as Tekelec Diameter Routing Agent and Diameter Signalling Router, Oracle Eagle Signalling Transfer Point, Titanium Firewall and 5G Security Edge Protection Proxy, F5 DNS and TOMIA roaming services
* Coordinate with technology suppliers on complex incidents, defects, investigations and technical remediation
* Implement vulnerability remediation and platform hardening in line with applicable cyber security standards
* Review high-level and low-level designs for new projects, conduct operational design validation and support functional and non-functional testing
* Identify and implement improvements to operational tools, processes and workflows
* Share technical knowledge through workshops, documentation and team training

**Who You Are**

* You have at least 12 years of experience in core telecommunications operations, including advanced configuration, incident and operational management of international roaming services
* You have practical experience with 4G and 5G technologies, including the 5G Security Edge Protection Proxy and N32 signalling
* You understand roaming and interconnect architectures and protocols, including Diameter, SS7, GTP control and user plane, Gx, Gy, packet core, HSS, STP, DRA, DNS, online charging and value-added roaming services
* You have experience operating Tekelec DRA/DSR, Oracle Eagle STP, Titanium Firewall, number portability databases, F5 DNS, Titanium 5G-SEPP or TOMIA platforms
* You understand Platform as a Service and Container as a Service environments, virtualisation, clustering and Kubernetes-based container orchestration
* You have at least five years of hands-on Linux administration experience across Red Hat Enterprise Linux, CentOS or Ubuntu, with confident use of Linux and Unix command-line tools
* You have practical knowledge of database administration, database troubleshooting, vulnerability management, certificate lifecycle activities and security hardening
* You apply structured analytical judgement to unfamiliar technical problems and can make risk-informed decisions during incidents and changes
* You communicate effectively across operational teams, engineering functions, external suppliers and stakeholders in different markets
* You are able to act as a subject matter expert while supporting collaborative learning and continuous service improvement

**Not a Perfect Fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* The opportunity to support business-critical international roaming services with a direct impact on network reliability and customer experience
* Exposure to complex, multi-generation telecommunications environments covering 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G technologies
* Collaboration with engineering teams, operational specialists, suppliers and stakeholders across international markets
* Opportunities to shape service improvements, strengthen cyber security controls and contribute to new technology transitions
* A specialist role that combines hands-on technical ownership, operational decision-making and knowledge sharing

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced troubleshooting of international roaming signalling, routing and service flows
* Operational management of 5G standalone and non-standalone roaming technologies
* Security operations involving roaming firewalls, 5G-SEPP, platform hardening and vulnerability remediation
* Kubernetes-based platform operations within virtualised and containerised telecommunications environments
* Operational validation of technical designs, change procedures and new platform transitions
* Cross-market supplier management, incident coordination and root-cause analysis
* Development and delivery of technical training for specialist operational teams

The
**L2 Application Support Engineer**
(Technical Support Analyst) is a critical role within the Production Support and Operations team. This individual is responsible for providing high-quality technical support, troubleshooting, and incident resolution for complex enterprise applications and platforms. Acting as the bridge between L1 Helpdesk/Monitoring teams and L3 Development/Engineering groups, the L2 Engineer ensures system availability, stability, and adherence to strict Service Level Agreements (SLAs) in a fast-paced, enterprise technology environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Incident & Problem Management
* Escalation Handling: Acknowledge and own incidents escalated by the L1 support team or monitoring alerts.
* Troubleshooting & Diagnosis: Perform in-depth technical analysis and root cause investigation of application, database, middleware, and infrastructure failures.
* Workaround Implementation: Apply approved temporary workarounds or permanent hotfixes to restore services quickly and minimize business impact.
* Collaboration: Partner with L3 developers, database administrators (DBAs), network engineers, and system administrators to resolve complex, multi-tiered issues.
* Incident Lifecycle Management: Track and document all incident progression within the ITSM platform (e.g., ServiceNow) from creation through to resolution.
* Monitoring, Observability & Preventive Maintenance
* System Monitoring: Actively monitor application health, batch jobs, integration feeds, and system performance using enterprise observability suites.
* Proactive Interventions: Identify recurring patterns, error trends, or capacity bottlenecks and initiate preventative actions.
* Health Checks: Perform daily health checks, start-of-day (SOD) and end-of-day (EOD) verifications, and batch processing runs.
* Release, Deployment & Configuration Management
* Deployment Validation: Support the verification of application deployments, system patches, and infrastructure upgrades during maintenance windows.
* Configuration Controls: Maintain and update application configuration files, environment variables, and parameter settings under strict change management processes.
* Environment Management: Assist in maintaining non-production (UAT/Staging) and production environments to ensure consistency.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management
* Status Updates: Provide clear, timely, and precise communications to business stakeholders, product owners, and technology leadership during critical (Sev-1/Sev-2) incidents.
* Bridges & War Rooms: Participate in or lead technical incident bridges to coordinate restoration efforts.
* Post-Incident Reviews: Contribute technical inputs to Post-Incident Reviews (PIRs) and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documentation.
* Documentation & Knowledge Management
* Runbooks & SOPs: Document and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), application architecture maps, and troubleshooting runbooks.
* Knowledge Sharing: Train L1 teams on common issue resolution paths to shift-left workloads and improve first-contact resolution rates.

* Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

* Automate routine admin work.

* Deliver a professional, empathetic and customer-focused support experience, keeping users informed on progress.
* Adhere to security, compliance and acceptable use policies.
* Identify recurring issues and suggest process or tooling improvements.
* Work with vendors and partners on implementations and escalations.

  

### **What We’re Looking For:**

* Good working knowledge of macOS and Windows operating systems.
* Hands-on experience with Jamf and/or Microsoft Intune.

title: ServiceNow - System Administrator
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

**ServiceNow System Administrator**

**Experience:** 6+ Years | **Certification:** ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

**Role Summary**

The ServiceNow System Administrator will be responsible for the day-to-day administration, operational support, security, stability, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow platform. **Experience & Qualifications**

Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

We are seeking an International Roaming Network Support Specialist to join Group Technology within TSSI Networks in Pune or Bengaluru. You will act as a subject matter expert for international roaming platforms and services, helping maintain their availability, security and performance.

The role covers second-line operational support for 4G and 5G standalone and non-standalone networks, signalling platforms, roaming firewalls and value-added roaming services. You will resolve complex incidents, implement technical changes, improve network performance, support security remediation and contribute to the operational acceptance of new platforms.

**What you will do**

* Review high-level and low-level designs for new projects, conduct operational design validation and support functional and non-functional testing.
* Identify and implement improvements to operational tools, processes and workflows.
* Share technical knowledge through workshops, documentation and team training.

**Who you are**

* You have at least 12 years of experience in core telecommunications operations, including advanced configuration, incident and operational management of international roaming services.

* You understand roaming and interconnect architectures and protocols, including Diameter, SS7, GTP control and user plane, Gx, Gy, packet core, HSS, STP, DRA, DNS, online charging and value-added roaming services.

* You understand Platform as a Service and Container as a Service environments, virtualisation, clustering and Kubernetes-based container orchestration.

* Exposure to complex, multi-generation telecommunications environments covering 2G, 3G, 4G and 5G technologies.
* Collaboration with engineering teams, operational specialists, suppliers and stakeholders across international markets.
* Opportunities to shape service improvements, strengthen cyber security controls and contribute to new technology transitions.

------------------------------

* Operational management of 5G standalone and non-standalone roaming technologies.
* Security operations involving roaming firewalls, 5G-SEPP, platform hardening and vulnerability remediation.
* Kubernetes-based platform operations within virtualised and containerised telecommunications environments.
* Operational validation of technical designs, change procedures and new platform transitions.
* Cross-market supplier management, incident coordination and root-cause analysis.
* Development and delivery of technical training for specialist operational teams.

title: Senior Technical Account Manager
description:

* Lead complex technical troubleshooting and problem resolution efforts for critical customer issues.

* Proactively identify and address technical risks and opportunities within customer environments.
* Collaborate with sales and product management teams to develop and support the implementation of customer solutions.

* Lead internal initiatives to improve team performance and customer satisfaction.
* Identify and drive initiatives to improve service delivery processes.

**What You'll Do**

* Perform technical reviews & share knowledge to proactively identify & prevent issues
* Understand your customers' technical infrastructures, hardware, processes, and offerings
* Perform initial or secondary investigations and respond to online and phone support requests
* Deliver key portfolio updates and assist customers with upgrades
* Manage customer cases and maintain clear and concise case documentation
* Create customer engagement plans & keep documentation on customer environments updated
* Ensure a high level of customer satisfaction with each qualified engagement through the complete adoption life cycle of our offerings
* Engage with Red Hat's field teams, customers to ensure a positive platform & cloud technology experience and a successful outcome resulting in long-term enterprise success
* Communicate how specific Red Hat platform & cloud solutions and our cloud road-map align to customer use cases
* Capture Red Hat product capabilities and identify gaps as related to customer use cases through a closed-loop process for each step of the engagement life cycle
* Engage with Red Hat's product engineering teams to help develop solution patterns based on customer engagements and personal experience that guide platform adoption
* Establish and maintain parity with Red Hat’s platform & cloud technologies strategy
* Contribute internally to the Red Hat team, share knowledge and best practices with team members, contribute to internal projects and initiatives, and serve as a subject matter expert (SME) and mentor for specific technical or process areas or process areas
* Travel to visit customers, partners, conferences, and other events as needed

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in science or a technical field; engineering or computer science
* Competent reading and writing skills in English
* Ability to convey information to customers in a clear and concise manner
* Ability to effectively manage and grow existing enterprise customer and partner relationships by delivering best-in-class support
* Advanced troubleshooting and debugging skills, with a passion for problem solving and investigation
* Upstream involvement in open source projects (patches submitted for upstream) is a plus
* Indian citizenship or authorisation to work in India
* Red Hat OpenStack Platform - RHOSP

+ Fundamental understanding of OpenStack, Container architecture, and administration experience across all working components
+ Deep understanding and troubleshooting skills on OpenStack core components.
+ Deployment and troubleshooting experience of OpenStack clusters on bare metal or non-bare metal environments.
+ Planning, Designing, and implementation of OpenStack products on various hardware.
+ Technical and Deep understanding of Ceph cluster storage and its functionalities.
+ Experience with Linux operating system installation, configuration, upgrade, and maintenance.

* Red Hat OpenShift Platform - RHOCP

+ Experience in Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform (RHOCP) or Kubernetes or Docker cluster management
+ Understanding of RHOCP Architecture & different types of RHOCP installations Experience in RHOCP Troubleshooting and data/logs collection
+ Strong working knowledge of Prometheus and Grafana open source monitoring solutions will be considered a plus
+ Administration experience of Red Hat OpenShift v4.x will be considered a plus
+ Competent comprehension of enterprise architecture and strategic business drivers

* Direct experience with a variety of hardware vendors

**About Red Hat**
Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. description:

* Operational KPIs such as order fulfilment speed & accuracy greater than 99% and Inventory Management

* Customer satisfaction and NPS scores

* Accuracy and timeliness of reporting and dashboard updates
* Customer Happiness Index (CHI) score greater than 7 across personal account portfolio
* At least one shared template or playbook improvement contributed per year
* Successful coordination of peak readiness across personal portfolio and at least one peer account

* A proven track record managing enterprise-level clients with high-stakes, 24/7 operational requirements, or deep warehouse-operations management experience

* Proficiency in data visualization tools to turn raw logs into executive-level performance stories
* Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS/Azure), database management, and API-driven integrations.

* Familiarity with SQL and analytics platforms (e.g., Grafana, Power BI)

title: Senior Server & Infrastructure Security Administrator
description:
**Company:**
ReBrand Gurus

**Location:**
Noida

**Experience:**
3–5+ years

**Employment:**
Full-time

**Join ReBrand Gurus**

ReBrand Gurus is a boutique creative technology agency working with businesses across website development, mobile applications, digital marketing, SEO and other digital solutions.

We manage multiple client websites and digital platforms, and we are looking for an experienced
**Senior Server & Infrastructure Security Administrator**
to take ownership of our hosting environments, server infrastructure, website security, and technical troubleshooting.

About the Role

We are looking for a technically strong professional who can keep our web infrastructure secure, stable, monitored, and recoverable.

This is not a regular WordPress developer or basic Server Administrator role. We need someone who understands server-level security, can investigate complex technical problems, and knows how to protect multiple websites from vulnerabilities, malware, server failures, and unauthorized access.

The ideal candidate will take responsibility for identifying potential risks, preventing avoidable downtime, investigating security incidents, and restoring services safely when unexpected problems occur.

**Your primary responsibility will be to protect ReBrand Gurus' web infrastructure and ensure that our websites remain secure, stable, and recoverable.**

Key Responsibilities1. Linux Server and Hosting Management

* Manage and maintain Linux servers, VPS environments, and website hosting platforms such as Hostinger, hPanel, cPanel, and similar services.
* Monitor server health, CPU/RAM usage, disk space, uptime, resource consumption, and website performance.
* Investigate and resolve server-level problems affecting one or multiple websites.
* Manage PHP versions, MySQL/MariaDB databases, cron jobs, file permissions, and server configurations.
* Work confidently with SSH and the Linux command line for server administration and troubleshooting.
* Perform routine server maintenance, software updates, security patches, and configuration reviews.
* Handle website migrations, hosting migrations, and server configuration changes safely.
* Identify infrastructure weaknesses and recommend improvements to server stability and security.

2. Website and WordPress Administration

* Manage and troubleshoot multiple WordPress websites hosted across different environments.
* Diagnose plugin, theme, PHP, database, and compatibility issues.
* Resolve website downtime, HTTP 500/502/503 errors, database connection failures, and other server-related website problems.
* Perform WordPress core, plugin, and theme updates safely.
* Troubleshoot WooCommerce websites and related technical issues.
* Maintain staging and production environments.
* Investigate website performance issues and implement appropriate solutions.
* Work with developers to resolve application-level problems when required.

3. Server Security and Malware Prevention

This is one of the most important responsibilities of the role.

* Monitor websites and servers for malware, suspicious activity, unauthorized access, and security vulnerabilities.
* Investigate malware infections, compromised websites, suspicious PHP files, malicious scripts, and hidden backdoors.
* Identify possible entry points and determine how a security compromise occurred.
* Investigate compromised administrator accounts, vulnerable plugins, outdated software, and insecure server configurations.
* Implement server hardening, firewall rules, access controls, security patches, and other appropriate protective measures.
* Configure and manage Cloudflare security features, WAF, and other relevant security tools.
* Review server and website logs to identify suspicious activity and potential threats.
* Check related websites and accounts when a shared server or hosting environment may have been compromised.
* Verify that security incidents have been properly resolved and monitor for signs of reinfection.
* Maintain practical security procedures to reduce the risk of future incidents.

**Important:**
Removing infected files alone is not sufficient to resolve every malware incident. The candidate must understand how to investigate the original entry point, identify possible backdoors, assess the wider hosting environment, and prevent the same vulnerability from being exploited again.

4. Backup and Disaster Recovery

* Configure and maintain automated website, database, and server backups.
* Maintain appropriate backup retention and access controls.
* Ensure backups are stored securely and independently of the primary environment wherever practical.
* Regularly verify backup integrity and test website and database restoration.
* Develop and maintain recovery procedures for server failures, malware incidents, accidental deletions, and data loss.
* Restore affected websites and services from trusted backups when required.
* Identify recovery risks and recommend measures to minimize downtime and data loss.

The goal is to ensure that a website or server failure does not automatically require rebuilding websites from scratch.

5. Domains, DNS, SSL, and Cloudflare

* Manage domain configurations, nameservers, DNS records, and domain transfers.
* Troubleshoot A records, CNAME, MX, and TXT records.
* Configure and troubleshoot SPF, DKIM, and DMARC records.
* Manage SSL certificates, HTTPS configuration, and renewals.
* Resolve DNS propagation, incorrect domain pointing, and website connectivity issues.
* Manage Cloudflare DNS, CDN settings, and security configurations.
* Monitor domain, hosting, and SSL expiry dates to prevent avoidable service disruptions.

6. Business Email Administration

Manage and troubleshoot business email services, including:

* Google Workspace
* Microsoft 365
* Hostinger Email
* Zoho Mail
* SMTP configurations

The candidate should be able to diagnose and resolve:

* Emails not being sent or received.
* Emails bouncing or being delivered to spam.
* Incorrect MX, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC configurations.
* SMTP authentication and connection failures.
* Domain-related email delivery issues.
* Email account configuration and security problems.

7. Shopify and Third-Party Integrations

* Troubleshoot Shopify stores, themes, apps, and integrations.
* Manage domain connections and DNS configurations.
* Investigate website connectivity, email, and third-party integration issues.
* Coordinate with developers or platform support when specialized assistance is required.

8. Proactive Monitoring and Technical Maintenance

* Set up and maintain website uptime, server performance, and security monitoring.
* Configure alerts for downtime, unusual resource consumption, suspicious activity, and backup failures.
* Identify potential issues before they develop into major disruptions.
* Conduct routine reviews of server configurations, access permissions, software updates, and security settings.
* Maintain documentation of servers, hosting accounts, websites, domains, and technical configurations.
* Document incidents, root causes, resolutions, and preventive measures.
* Recommend practical improvements to infrastructure security, reliability, and performance.

**Required Technical Skills**

Candidates must have practical, hands-on experience with:

* Linux server administration and command-line troubleshooting.
* Hostinger/hPanel, cPanel, or equivalent hosting environments.
* VPS and shared hosting management.
* WordPress administration and technical troubleshooting.
* PHP and MySQL/MariaDB.
* SSH, FTP/SFTP, and server access management.
* DNS management, nameservers, and DNS records.
* SSL certificates and HTTPS troubleshooting.
* Cloudflare and website security.
* Malware investigation, backdoor detection, and remediation.
* Server hardening, vulnerability remediation, and security monitoring.
* Automated backups, restoration, and disaster recovery.
* Business email administration and email authentication protocols.
* Root-cause analysis and incident resolution.

**Good-to-Have Skills**

* Nginx and Apache configuration.
* cPanel/WHM and CloudLinux.
* WP-CLI and Git.
* AWS, DigitalOcean, or similar cloud platforms.
* Redis and website caching systems.
* Bash or Python scripting for automation.
* Security scanning tools and server monitoring solutions.
* DDoS protection, CDN management, and advanced firewall configurations.

**What We Expect From You**

We are looking for someone who:

* Thinks like a system administrator and security professional, not just a website developer.
* Can independently investigate and resolve infrastructure-related problems.
* Understands how server-level vulnerabilities can affect multiple websites.
* Takes ownership of technical issues from investigation to resolution.
* Follows a systematic troubleshooting process instead of making random changes.
* Prioritizes preventive maintenance and long-term solutions.
* Understands the importance of secure backups and tested recovery procedures.
* Communicates technical problems clearly to management and non-technical team members.
* Documents important changes, incidents, and resolutions.
* Takes responsibility for protecting client websites, business emails, and digital assets.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will become the
**technical guardian of ReBrand Gurus' web infrastructure**
.

When a website goes down, an email stops working, a domain develops DNS issues, a server becomes unstable, or malware is detected, you will investigate the problem, identify its root cause, and take ownership of the resolution.

You will also be responsible for strengthening our infrastructure, identifying risks before they cause disruption, maintaining reliable recovery options, and reducing the likelihood and impact of future security incidents.

Our expectation is not simply to fix problems when they occur, but to build and maintain an infrastructure that is secure, resilient, and prepared for unexpected failures.

**Apply Now**

If you have strong hands-on experience in Linux server administration, website security, WordPress troubleshooting, and infrastructure management, we would love to hear from you.

**Send your resume to:**
hr@rebrandgurus.us.

Application for Senior Server & Infrastructure Security Administrator

title: FTE Helpdesk Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
Iron Systems is an innovative, customer-focused provider of custom-built computing infrastructure platforms such as network servers, storage, OEM/ODM appliances & embedded systems. For more than 15 years, customer have trusted us for our innovative problem solving combined with holistic design, engineering, manufacturing, logistic and global support services.
**B. Field Engineer Lifecycle & Operational Readiness**
**C. Serviceo Portal & Workforce Process Support**
**D. Team Leadership & Performance Management**
**E. SLA, Quality & Compliance Management**
**F. Stakeholder & Cross-Functional Coordination**
**G. Reporting, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**
**3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Position Summary The Manager – FTE Helpdesk is responsible for leading the global FTE Helpdesk operations supporting Field Engineers and other designated workforce categories across Iron Systems' customer programs.
* Key Responsibilities
* FTE Helpdesk Operations & Service Delivery
* Lead and manage day-to-day FTE Helpdesk operations supporting Field Engineers across multiple geographies, customer programs, and employment categories.
* Ensure timely resolution of worker queries related to onboarding readiness, access and credentials, Serviceo usage, timesheets, attendance, work assignments, shift-related concerns, and workforce administration.
* Manage the Helpdesk's shared mailbox, ticket queues, communication channels, and other designated support platforms.
* Ensure consistent, professional, and documented communication with Field Engineers, Program Managers, and internal stakeholders.
* Monitor open, pending, overdue, and escalated cases to ensure timely closure and prevent operational bottlenecks.
* Coordinate with Internal and Recruitment teams to ensure Field Engineers are appropriately onboarded and operationally ready before deployment, as applicable to the program.
* Support the creation and activation of Internal Service Contracts and coordinate the provisioning of required credentials, accounts, and access with relevant IT and operations teams.
* Ensure required worker information, program details, payroll or employment category, job order references, and other mandatory details are accurately communicated to the appropriate teams.
* Support workforce transitions, program changes, worker transfers, and offboarding activities through defined processes.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve deployment blockers, missing information, access issues, and other readiness gaps.
* Maintain appropriate records of support requests and lifecycle-related actions to support operational visibility and auditability.
* Oversee Helpdesk support for the Serviceo portal and related workforce management workflows.
* Ensure Field Engineers receive appropriate assistance with check-in/check-out, timesheet submissions, deliverable uploads, messaging, and other portal-related activities.
* Coordinate resolution of portal access, technical, data, and workflow issues with the relevant technical or application support teams.
* Promote correct portal usage and adherence to prescribed operational procedures.
* Identify recurring issues and collaborate with IT, and Program Management teams to improve user experience and reduce avoidable support requests.
* Monitor portal-related compliance and adoption indicators, including Portal Collaboration Rating (PCR), where applicable.
* Lead, coach, and develop the FTE Helpdesk team, ensuring clear accountability, appropriate workload distribution, and consistent service quality.
* Define individual and team performance goals aligned with operational requirements and departmental objectives.
* Establish shift coverage, work allocation, backup arrangements, and escalation ownership to ensure business continuity across supported time zones.
* Conduct regular performance reviews, quality checks, coaching sessions, and team meetings.
* Develop team capability through training on internal systems, workforce policies, customer-specific processes, communication standards, and escalation protocols.
* Foster a service-oriented culture focused on ownership, responsiveness, accuracy, and continuous improvement.
* Define, monitor, and report on Helpdesk SLAs, including first response time, resolution time, ticket backlog, escalation turnaround, and case quality.
* Ensure all cases are recorded, categorized, tracked, and closed with appropriate documentation.
* Conduct periodic audits of tickets, worker records, communications, and process adherence.
* Ensure support activities follow company policies, customer-specific requirements, data privacy standards, information security controls, and applicable local regulations.
* Act as the primary operational escalation point for complex FTE Helpdesk issues.
* Work closely with Internal Team, Recruitment, Program Management, FTE Shift Managers/Leads, IT, Finance, Payroll, and other relevant functions.
* Coordinate with Program Managers and Project Owners to resolve worker assignment, shift, attendance, service delivery, and administrative issues.
* Ensure relevant stakeholders receive timely updates on critical issues, recurring blockers, and cases requiring management intervention.
* Facilitate effective handoffs between teams and ensure clear ownership of actions until resolution.
* Support customer-specific operational requirements through coordination with internal stakeholders, following established authorization and communication protocols.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly operational reports covering ticket volumes, resolution performance, backlog, escalations, SLA adherence, quality, and recurring issue categories.
* Analyse trends to identify root causes, recurring process gaps, and opportunities to reduce ticket volumes and resolution times.
* Develop and maintain SOPs, knowledge-base articles, FAQs, communication templates, and escalation matrices.
* Drive process standardization and automation of repetitive support activities wherever feasible.
* Provide data-driven recommendations to Team leadership for improved service delivery, workforce experience, productivity, and operational scalability.
* Support internal reviews, compliance audits, management reporting, and other departmental initiatives as required.

Performance will be measured against agreed targets, supported by accurate reporting and periodic.
**5. Required Skills & Competencies**

* Qualifications & Experience
* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Information Technology, Operations Management, or a related discipline.
* Typically, 6–10 years of experience in Helpdesk Operations, HR Operations, Workforce Operations, Service Delivery, or related support functions.
* At least 2–4 years of experience in a team leadership or people management role.
* Experience managing support operations for a distributed, deskless, mobile, or field-based workforce is strongly preferred.
* Experience supporting global teams, multiple time zones, customer programs, or geographically distributed operations is an advantage.
* Prior experience with ticketing systems, workforce management platforms, HRIS applications, service portals, and operational reporting tools is desirable.
* Strong operational management, team leadership, and people development skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication.
* Strong problem-solving, analytical thinking, and root-cause analysis skills.
* Ability to manage competing priorities in a high-volume, SLA-driven support environment.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and reporting tools; familiarity with dashboards and data analysis is preferred.
* Working knowledge of ticketing systems, HRIS platforms, workforce management tools, and service delivery processes.
* Strong process documentation, SOP development, and quality assurance capabilities.
* High standards of confidentiality, data accuracy, accountability, and professional conduct.
* Ability to work with global stakeholders and support operational requirements across different time zones.

title: Systems Engineer III
description:
Tower Research Capital is a leading quantitative trading firm founded in 1998. Tower has built its business on a high-performance platform and independent trading teams. We have a 25+ year track record of innovation and a reputation for discovering unique market opportunities.
  
  
Tower is home to some of the world’s best systematic trading and engineering talent. We empower portfolio managers to build their teams and strategies independently while providing the economies of scale that come from a large, global organization.
  
  
Engineers thrive at Tower while developing electronic trading infrastructure at a world class level. Our engineers solve challenging problems in the realms of low-latency programming, FPGA technology, hardware acceleration and machine learning. Our ongoing investment in top engineering talent and technology ensures our platform remains unmatched in terms of functionality, scalability and performance.
  
  
At Tower, every employee plays a role in our success. Our Business Support teams are essential to building and maintaining the platform that powers everything we do — combining market access, data, compute, and research infrastructure with risk management, compliance, and a full suite of business services. Our Business Support teams enable our trading and engineering teams to perform at their best
  
  
At Tower, employees will find a stimulating, results-oriented environment where highly intelligent and motivated colleagues inspire each other to reach their greatest potential.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Designing, architecting, and maintaining Tower’s growing infrastructure to ensure a reliable, scalable environment that supports rapid deployment, automation, and innovation across teams.
* Implementing and managing Windows Server operating systems, Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and related services, along with virtualization technologies including VMware ESXi, vCenter, Hyper-V, and Citrix (XenDesktop, App Layering, and DaaS), and wireless network management.
* Managing and optimizing day-to-day infrastructure operations, including physical server installation, racking, and configuration (e.g., Dell PowerEdge), configuration management, and administration of Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions such as Workspace ONE and Jamf.
* Troubleshooting and resolving complex incidents and service requests using network and system analysis tools such as Wireshark, NetMon, and Sysinternals, while participating in off-hours, weekend, and holiday on-call rotations to ensure 24/7 support coverage.
* Developing and implementing automation scripts using PowerShell, Python, or similar languages to streamline deployments, eliminate repetitive tasks, and improve operational efficiency, while creating and maintaining system configuration documentation, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and contingency plans.
* Collaborating with cross-functional teams on IT security, vulnerability assessment, and threat management initiatives, leveraging tools such as Qualys to strengthen infrastructure security and operational resilience.

**Qualifications**

* A bachelor’s degree in computer science, systems engineering, or a related technical field.
* At least 2–6 years of experience designing, implementing, and supporting reliable, scalable Windows-based and mixed operating system infrastructures, with strong knowledge of Windows Server (2016/2019/2022), Active Directory, Group Policy, SCCM, DFS, DNS, DHCP, and Kerberos.
* Experience with server and desktop management, deployment, OS imaging, and automation using SCCM, along with familiarity with virtualization platforms such as VMware ESXi, vCenter, Hyper-V, and Citrix XenDesktop/App Layering, and knowledge of storage technologies including EMC Unity, NetApp FAS, and related best practices.
* Experience with Linux administration and Windows interoperability, including LDAP, NFS, file sharing, and Salt, with proficiency in Linux command-line administration and troubleshooting; knowledge of networking fundamentals such as TCP/IP, DNS, and SSL, and experience using diagnostic tools including Wireshark and NetMon.
* Experience managing collaboration platforms such as Google Workspace and Slack, with proficiency in at least one scripting language, such as PowerShell or Python; experience administering Atlassian products, including Confluence, Jira, and Statuspage, is an advantage.
* Strong communication and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose technical issues and collaborate effectively across teams.

**Benefits**
Tower’s headquarters are in the historic Equitable Building, right in the heart of NYC’s Financial District and our impact is global, with over a dozen offices around the world.
  
  
At Tower, we believe work should be both challenging and enjoyable. That is why we foster a culture where smart, driven people thrive – without the egos. Our open concept workplace, casual dress code, and well-stocked kitchens reflect the value we place on a friendly, collaborative environment where everyone is respected, and great ideas win.
  
  
Our benefits include:
  
  

* Generous paid time off policies
* Savings plans and other financial wellness tools available in each region
* Hybrid working opportunities
* Free breakfast, lunch, and snacks daily
* In-office wellness experiences and reimbursement for select wellness expenses (e.g., gym, personal training and more)
* Company-sponsored sports teams and fitness events (JPM Corporate Challenge, Cycle for Survival, Wall Street Rides FAR and more)
* Volunteer opportunities and charitable giving
* Social events, happy hours, treats, and celebrations throughout the year
* Workshops and continuous learning opportunities

At Tower, you’ll find a collaborative and welcoming culture, a diverse team and a workplace that values both performance and enjoyment. No unnecessary hierarchy. No ego. Just great people doing great work – together.
  
  
Tower Research Capital is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Field Service Representative
description:
**Field Service Representative at unspun**
We’re looking for a hands-on, technically experienced Field Service Representative to support our OneWeave™ 3D weaving systems at our manufacturing partner in India. You will serve as unspun’s primary onsite technical representative at our manufacturing partner in Ahmedabad, Gujarat, near Naroda Road.
  
  
This role is ideal for someone who started closer to the equipment and has grown into broader project or technical leadership. You still have the hands-on mechanical experience to troubleshoot a machine, but you’re equally comfortable coordinating across teams, assessing priorities and risks, and giving leadership a clear picture of what’s happening.
  
  
When applying, use the word shark in your cover letter.
  
  
**Why This Role Matters**
As we scale OneWeave™ into production, we need someone onsite who can understand what’s happening in real time and communicate it clearly to teams thousands of miles away.
  
  
When something goes wrong, you’ll determine what’s happening, how urgent it is, what can be resolved locally, and when additional support is needed. You’ll gather the right information before escalating and keep teams aligned as issues evolve.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Serve as the first line of technical support for OneWeave™ factory operations
* Troubleshoot and perform mechanical and electromechanical repairs, adjustments, and recovery procedures
* Assess and prioritize issues based on severity, production impact, available workarounds, and urgency
* Investigate failures using machine logs, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), production and quality data, operator observations, photos, video, and other evidence
* Coordinate troubleshooting and resolution across factory operations, engineering, and other teams
* Provide clear daily updates to US teams on factory status, open issues, risks, and next steps
* Lead weekly leadership updates covering factory health, trends, priorities, and potential issues
* Support training, SOPs, troubleshooting procedures, and new processes on the factory floor
* Identify recurring problems and opportunities to improve equipment, processes, documentation, and training

**Who You Are**
You have a strong hands-on technical foundation and have progressed into broader project, operations, or technical leadership responsibilities.
  
  
You’ve built, maintained, repaired, commissioned, or supported complex mechanical or electromechanical systems and know enough to recognize when something isn't behaving the way it should.
  
  
Since then, your responsibilities have grown. You may be a technical project manager, manufacturing engineer, field service engineer, technical program manager, or something similar. Whatever your title, you're now as comfortable leading a technical discussion and reporting to leadership as you are standing next to a machine figuring out why it stopped.
  
  
You don't create unnecessary noise when something goes wrong. You gather information, listen to the people closest to the problem, establish what you know, assess urgency, and communicate deliberately. As circumstances change, you adjust.
  
  
You know that good technical leadership isn't having the fastest answer in the room. It's helping the right people understand the problem, work through it together, and reach the right answer.
  
  
**What Makes You a Great Fit?**

* 5+ years of experience in field service, manufacturing engineering, equipment engineering, automation, robotics, or a related technical environment

Recent hands-on experience troubleshooting and repairing mechanical or electromechanical equipment in manufacturing, automation, robotics, or a similar environment
  
  

* Experience that has grown into project, program, operations, or cross-functional leadership
* Strong project management skills, including prioritization, issue and risk management, follow-through, and leadership reporting
* Strong technical judgment and the ability to determine when to investigate, monitor, mitigate, or escalate
* Experience using manufacturing data and metrics such as OEE to understand equipment performance and investigate issues
* Ability to read technical drawings, diagrams, schematics, SOPs, and troubleshooting documentation
* Strong written and verbal communication skills and the ability to facilitate productive technical discussions
* Composure and sound judgment during high-pressure production issues
* Ability to communicate effectively in English and Gujarati or Hindi; proficiency in both local languages is strongly preferred

**Education**
Diploma, BE/B.Tech or equivalent practical experience in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, Automation, Manufacturing, or a related discipline
  
  
Strong practical experience is more important than a specific degree.
  
  
**Language Requirements**

* Professional working English required
* Professional working proficiency in Gujarati or Hindi required for effective factory-floor communication
* Proficiency in both Gujarati and Hindi is strongly preferred

**Preferred Experience**

* New Product Introduction (NPI) or production ramp experience
* Lean Manufacturing, Lean Six Sigma, root cause analysis, or continuous improvement experience
* Experience with industrial automation, controls, sensors, motors, drives, or PLCs
* Basic Python, Linux, machine logs, diagnostic tools, or data analysis experience
* Experience supporting technical teams across countries and time zones

**Schedule**
During initial training and production ramp, onsite days may be approximately 10 hours. Over time, onsite hours will vary based on production needs.
  
  
The factory operates across three shifts. You'll primarily support the first and second shifts and participate in on-call coverage. Because the US engineering team will sometimes need to collaborate directly on active issues, some US working hours will also be working hours for this role.
  
  
**International Travel**
You’ll travel to unspun's headquarters and micro-factory in Emeryville, California for approximately two weeks per quarter.
  
  
These visits will include training, technical collaboration, production development, and direct work with unspun’s engineering and leadership teams.
  
  
**Why unspun?**
We're not just another tech company - we're a team revolutionizing a trillion-dollar industry. Here's what makes us special:
  
  

* Mission-Driven: This role keeps the OneWeave™ machines running — and uptime is the whole bet. Carbon reduction only works if on-demand weaving can actually compete with bulk overproduction on cost and speed. No uptime, no on-demand model, no carbon case.
* Innovation at Scale: We're backed by top climate-tech VCs and working with major brands like Walmart
* Amazing Team: Work with passionate experts who care about impact
* Growth Opportunity: This is a ground-floor seat on OneWeave's production ramp — the path runs from factory-floor troubleshooting into broader technical leadership as the line scales, with direct visibility into both India operations and US engineering/leadership.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Details below, but we take care of our team

**Our Culture**
We're relentless in pursuing our mission, intentional in our decisions, and fundamentally human in how we work together. We celebrate small wins, speak up to benefit many, and aren't afraid to make mistakes along the way.
  
  
**Our Philosophy**
We won't roll our eyes if your socks don't match. We get it. But then, if you spend those extra few minutes in the morning matching your socks and shirt, we get that too. Our workspaces are sometimes spotless and sometimes chaotic, and we celebrate messy exploration. We work through complex problems but generate simple and elegant solutions. We strive to look at things differently, and never do anything solely because "that's the way it's always been done."
  
  
We're a team of designers and engineers, industry-veterans and serial entrepreneurs, artists and developers. We're aspiring chess masters and climbers, bakers and photographers. Originally spun out of Stanford and the University of Colorado, we now call the SF Bay Area home, with strong ties to Hong Kong. We are looking for teammates who share our desire to work on ambitious problems and leave the world better than we found it.
  
  
*unspun is an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to being a diverse team that reflects a broad range of background, thought, and experience. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, national origin, status as an individual with a disability, status as protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristics. Women, minorities, and people from underrepresented backgrounds are strongly encouraged to apply.*
Location
  
  
This role is based near our partner factory in Ahmedabad, India near Naroda Road and requires regular onsite presence.
  
  
The world's first 3D weaving technology for apparel and the key to fashion's waste problem.

Communication and Stakeholder Management

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate project updates, requirements, risks, issues, and decisions to internal and external stakeholders.
* Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across departments and organizational levels.

Analytical and Problem-Solving Skills

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail.

Personal Competencies

* Proactive, energetic, and self-motivated approach, with a willingness to learn, adapt to new processes, and accept new challenges.

* Monitor implementation progress and escalate issues that require stakeholder intervention or management decisions.

description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Title: GDS Alliances Systems Integrator (SI) Ops Coordinator**
**Job Summary:**
The GDS Systems Integrator (SI) Ops Coordinator will function out of the GDS Alliances Delivery Center and will be responsible for providing ongoing operations support for one or more Systems Integrator alliances as part of the broader Ecosystem Relationship Enablement function. The incumbent will help co-develop and thereafter operationalize the operations support delivery model for a single SI relationship or a combination of SI relationships, ensuring seamless service delivery for ongoing initiatives, governance, reporting, stakeholder coordination and special projects assigned from time to time. The role will partner with onshore alliance operations contacts, SI relationship leaders and cross-functional teams on strategic projects and initiatives as required.
  
  
**Essential Functions of the Job:**

* Provide operational support for strategic Systems Integrator alliances and ecosystem programs across planning, governance, reporting and execution activities.
* Provide SI alliance leadership with effective dashboard reporting and business insights, including revenue, wins, pipeline, opportunities, investments, benefits utilization and ad-hoc data reporting requests.
* Support recurring alliance governance forums, including pre-meeting, in-meeting and post-meeting support such as agenda formation, meeting deck collation, storyboarding, content curation/design, summary notes and action tracking.
* Coordinate SI alliance business reviews, leadership meetings, workshops and operating reviews by managing logistics, content development, stakeholder follow-ups and closure of actions.
* Support SI alliance annual planning, revenue planning, investment planning and benefits utilization tracking across area/region and global stakeholders.
* Coordinate with client-serving teams and global alliance supporting teams on sales, pipeline tagging, reporting hygiene and opportunity tracking.
* Maintain SI alliance reference material, playbooks, process documents and SharePoint repositories; facilitate and track access to key materials and tools.
* Coordinate with Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) teams to develop, review and refresh relevant SI alliance content as required.
* Support contracts initiation, tracking, supplier onboarding and operational workflows by coordinating with global alliance teams and relevant enabling teams.
* Drive continuous process improvement by identifying opportunities for automation, standardization, simplification and improved operating rhythm across SI alliance operations.
* Support executive leadership requests, special projects and strategic operational initiatives as assigned from time to time.

**Knowledge and Skill Requirements:**

* Strong understanding of alliance operations, ecosystem relationships, business operations and executive reporting processes.
* Exposure to sales and pipeline reporting, opportunity life cycle concepts, revenue planning and alliance performance reporting.
* Excellent MS Excel and PowerPoint skills; Power BI skills would be an added advantage.
* Ability to create executive-ready dashboards, presentations, meeting materials and leadership summaries with limited guidance.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work with senior onshore stakeholders and build trusted business advisor relationships.

**Job Requirements:**

* Academics: MBA, Business Administration, Commerce, Finance or related discipline; equivalent operational management experience may be considered.
* Experience: 8-10 years of relevant work experience in alliance operations, business operations, program management, reporting, sales operations or strategic operations.
* Working Hours: Flexibility to support global stakeholders and US/APAC business requirements.

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Azure and Network Engineer
description:
**Job title: Azure & Network Engineer**

**Location: Kochi (Onsite)**

**Contract: Permanent, full-time**

**About us:**

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,800+ employees and 70,000+ customers across 100+ countries and 46+ offices. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end-to-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen & Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass & Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North & South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.

Cyncly offers over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end-to-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.

Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specializing in technology.

**About the Role**

The Azure & Network Engineer is a hands-on role responsible for implementing, managing, securing, and supporting Azure infrastructure and network services across Cyncly’s global environment.

The role combines infrastructure project delivery with ongoing operations, with a strong focus on Azure virtual machines, storage, networking, secure connectivity, monitoring, backup, and disaster recovery. The Engineer will translate approved designs into reliable production environments and provide advanced troubleshooting for cloud and network issues.

Experience with Cisco Meraki, Check Point firewalls, and Microsoft Hyper-V will be an added advantage.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Azure Infrastructure Deployment and Operations**

* Deploy, configure, and administer Azure virtual machines, managed disks, availability configurations, and supporting Windows and Linux workloads.
* Manage Azure Storage accounts, including Blob Storage and Azure Files, covering access controls, redundancy, lifecycle management, and data protection.
* Deploy and support infrastructure-related Azure services, including Azure App Service, Key Vault, Azure Backup, and Azure Site Recovery.
* Manage subscriptions, resource groups, resource naming, tagging, and resource lifecycle activities according to organizational standards.
* Configure Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, alerts, and diagnostic settings to support availability, troubleshooting, and operational visibility.
* Support capacity planning, resource sizing, performance tuning, and cost optimization.

**Azure Networking and Secure Connectivity**

* Deploy and manage Azure Virtual Networks, subnets, network interfaces, IP addressing, and Network Security Groups.
* Configure and troubleshoot virtual network peering, route tables, user-defined routes, and traffic flows between Azure, on-premises environments, and remote locations.
* Implement and support Azure VPN Gateway, site-to-site and point-to-site VPNs, and hybrid connectivity.
* Configure and administer Azure Bastion for secure administrative access to virtual machines.
* Manage Azure DNS, Private DNS zones, Private Endpoints, and connectivity to Azure services.
* Deploy and support Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Web Application Firewall, Azure Firewall, and NAT Gateway, as required.
* Troubleshoot routing, DNS resolution, VPN connectivity, latency, packet loss, and firewall-related issues.
* Collaborate with security teams to implement network segmentation, access restrictions, and secure connectivity standards.

**Automation, Security, and Operational Improvement**

* Develop and maintain automation using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Terraform, Bicep, or similar tools.
* Apply Infrastructure as Code practices to improve deployment consistency and configuration management.
* Implement role-based access control, managed identities, Azure Policy, and secure secret management in line with approved standards.
* Support patching, vulnerability remediation, infrastructure hardening, and backup and recovery validation.
* Use approved AI tools to assist with scripting, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational improvement, while protecting company information and validating outputs.

**Project Delivery, Support, and Documentation**

* Deliver Azure and network infrastructure projects according to approved designs, schedules, budgets, and change management procedures.
* Plan and execute infrastructure migrations, upgrades, and connectivity changes, including testing, rollback planning, and post-change validation.
* Provide L3/L4 troubleshooting for escalated Azure and network incidents, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain infrastructure diagrams, configuration records, deployment procedures, runbooks, and troubleshooting guides.
* Coordinate operational handovers and knowledge transfer to support teams.
* Participate in on-call support and planned maintenance outside standard working hours, as required.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Minimum of 6 years of hands-on infrastructure engineering experience, preferably 6–8+ years, with substantial experience in Azure administration and networking.
* Strong practical experience deploying and supporting Azure virtual machines, storage accounts, Blob Storage, managed disks, monitoring, and backup services.
* Hands-on experience with Azure networking, including VNets, subnets, NSGs, peering, routing, VPN Gateway, Bastion, DNS, and Private Endpoints.
* Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, switching, NAT, VPNs, firewalls, and network troubleshooting.
* Experience administering Windows Server and Linux systems, including their networking and security configurations.
* Proficiency in PowerShell or Azure CLI, with practical experience using an Infrastructure as Code tool.
* Understanding of Microsoft Entra ID, Azure RBAC, managed identities, and least-privilege access.
* Experience supporting production environments through incident management, change management, and structured troubleshooting.
* Strong communication, documentation, and coordination skills, with the ability to work across global teams.

**Preferred Skills and Certifications**

* **Cisco Meraki (Nice to have):**
  Experience managing MX security appliances, MS switches, MR wireless access points, Auto VPN, and dashboard-based troubleshooting.
* **Check Point Firewalls (Nice to have):**
  Experience with security policies, NAT, VPN configuration, logging, and troubleshooting.
* **Microsoft Hyper-V (Nice to have):**
  Experience administering virtual machines, virtual switches, failover clusters, and host maintenance.
* Experience with ExpressRoute, BGP, and network virtual appliances.
* Experience with infrastructure migrations and backup and disaster recovery testing.
* Familiarity with ITIL practices and ITSM platforms such as FreshService.
* Relevant certifications such as Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Network Engineer Associate, Cisco CCNA/CCNP, or Check Point CCSA/CCSE.

**Working for us:**

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills - and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.

Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.

We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone - from every background - to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.

If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in - come join us.

title: Technical Support Lead- Infrastructure & Cloud
description:

title: Cluster Manager
description:

title: Cluster Manager
description:
**Cluster Manager – Cloud Kitchen Operations**

Oct 21, 2026 · @Dilfoods

The Cluster Manager runs day-to-day operations for a group of Dil Foods cloud kitchens and owns their food quality, hygiene, cost and on-time delivery.

Role

Cluster Manager – Cloud Kitchen Operations

Reports to

City Head

Location

[City] – field role, daily kitchen visits

Cluster size

[5–8] cloud kitchens

Direct reports

Kitchen Managers; indirectly all kitchen staff, including KSTs, in the cluster

Employment

Full-time

**About the role**

Dil Foods runs a multi-brand cloud kitchen network across Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, Mumbai and Delhi, including brands such as Bhole Ke Chole, Bihari Bowl, Dil Daily, House of Andhra, Khichdi Bar and Thali Culture, plus FreshMenu.

As Cluster Manager, you are the single point of ownership for every kitchen in your cluster. You make sure each kitchen opens on time, cooks to SOP, passes hygiene checks, controls food cost and wastage, and keeps delivery-platform ratings high. You spend most of your day on the kitchen floor, not at a desk.

**Key responsibilities**

**Kitchen operations**

* Visit every kitchen in the cluster on a set schedule, and run opening and closing checks.
* Make sure kitchens are live on Swiggy and Zomato through all operating hours, with no unplanned downtime or item switch-offs.
* Plan manpower and shifts for lunch and dinner peaks, including second-shift cleaning cover.
* Fix equipment, gas, power and water issues quickly, working with maintenance vendors.

**Food quality and SOP compliance**

* Make sure every brand's recipes, portion sizes and plating SOPs are followed.
* Run regular taste and portion audits, and close gaps with retraining.
* Track customer complaints and low ratings by item, and fix the root cause.

**Hygiene and food safety**

* Hold kitchens to FSSAI and Dil Foods hygiene standards every day: stations, floors, drains, wash area, cold storage and waste.
* Run unannounced hygiene audits, and check closing photos every day.
* Keep FSSAI licences, pest-control records and medical certificates up to date.

**Inventory and cost control**

* Own food cost, wastage and stock accuracy for each kitchen.
* Review daily indents, FIFO, expiry and storage.
* Run weekly stock counts and explain any variance.

**People**

* Hire, onboard and train Kitchen Managers, chefs, helpers and KSTs, working with HR.
* Manage rosters, attendance, leave and staff-room provisions.
* Coach Kitchen Managers, review their performance, and build a bench for new kitchens.

**Reporting and launches**

* Send daily and weekly reports to the City Head on sales, ratings, food cost, hygiene and manpower.
* Support new kitchen and brand launches in the cluster, from setup and trials to go-live.

**How success is measured**

KPI

What it covers

Platform ratings

Average Swiggy and Zomato rating per brand and kitchen

Kitchen uptime

Share of operating hours each kitchen is live, with no item switch-offs

Food cost and wastage

Actual vs. standard food cost %, and wastage % of sales

Hygiene audit score

Monthly audit score, and the number of failed checks

Complaints

Order complaints per 1,000 orders: quality, missing items, delays

Kitchen prep time

Average time from order acceptance to handover

People

Attendance, attrition and open positions filled on time

Targets for each KPI are set with the City Head at joining.

**What we're looking for**

**Must have**

* 4–7 years in QSR, cloud kitchen or restaurant operations, with at least 2 years managing several outlets.
* Hands-on knowledge of kitchen SOPs, FSSAI hygiene norms, and inventory and food-cost control.
* Experience running kitchens on Swiggy and Zomato, including ratings, menu availability and complaint handling.
* A track record of leading teams of 30+ staff, including hiring and training.
* Comfortable with Excel or Google Sheets and daily reporting.
* Willing to be on the floor during peak hours, and to work weekends and festivals when needed.
* Has a two-wheeler and can travel across the city every day.
* Speaks Hindi and English; the local language is a plus.

**Good to have**

* Experience with multi-brand or central-kitchen models.
* Experience opening new kitchens or outlets.
* A degree or diploma in Hotel Management.

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a multi-brand cluster in one of India's fastest-growing cloud kitchen networks.
* Competitive salary , plus a performance incentive linked to the cluster's KPIs.
* A travel allowance for daily kitchen visits.
* A clear path to City Head as the network expands into new cities and brands.

title: Cluster Manager
description:
**Role: Customer Experience Manager (CEM) – Coliving**

**Zolo | Coliving**

**Own the cluster. Drive performance. Deliver consistent experience.**

**Why this role exists**

Zolo’s coliving business operates at scale across multiple properties in each city.

While individual properties are managed by on-ground teams, consistent performance across occupancy, customer experience, and profitability depends on strong cluster-level ownership.

Each cluster needs a leader who ensures:

* Properties are full and revenue targets are met
* Customer experience is consistent and NPS remains high
* Teams are trained, disciplined, and aligned
* Issues are identified early and resolved quickly

This role exists to ensure that a cluster of 10–20 properties runs with control, consistency, and accountability — delivering both strong business outcomes and great customer experience.

If the CEM is strong, the cluster performs predictably and improves continuously.

If the CEM is weak, performance drops, issues repeat, and teams lose direction.

**Your mandate is clear**

* Own occupancy, NPS, and profitability across your cluster
* Drive execution discipline and SOP adherence across all properties
* Build, train, and manage a strong on-ground team
* Identify and solve operational and customer experience issues
* Use data and numbers to drive decisions and improvements
* Ensure properties are audit-ready and consistently maintained

This is not a coordination role.

It is full ownership of cluster performance and outcomes.

**About Zolo**

Finding dependable accommodation has historically been fragmented and inconsistent.

People settled for compromises because the system offered few trustworthy options.

Zolo reimagined living and hospitality as a connected journey.

Zolo Coliving simplifies urban living.

Z Vacations enables meaningful travel experiences.

Z Hotels serves the modern traveler with consistency, warmth, and operational discipline.

Today, over 100,000 people trust Zolo across different phases of life.

Our ambition is to build the most trusted living and hospitality ecosystem for the new generation by partnering deeply with property owners who think long term.

**What you will be responsible for**

1. Own Cluster Performance & Business Outcomes

* Take full accountability for occupancy, revenue, and margins
* Track property-level performance metrics regularly
* Identify underperforming properties and drive improvement
* Ensure consistent achievement of targets across cluster

2. Drive Execution Discipline & SOP Adherence

* Ensure all properties follow defined SOPs and checklists
* Conduct regular reviews with ACEMs and property teams
* Build structured routines for daily, weekly, and monthly tracking
* Ensure consistency in execution across all properties

3. Lead & Develop On-Ground Teams

* Manage ACEMs, property managers, and housekeeping teams
* Train teams on customer experience, processes, and standards
* Identify performance gaps and take corrective actions
* Build a motivated, disciplined, and accountable team

4. Ensure Customer Experience & Manage Escalations

* Track NPS and customer feedback across properties
* Handle escalations and ensure quick resolution
* Drive root cause analysis and prevent repeat issues
* Ensure consistent guest/resident experience across cluster

5. Use Data & Numbers to Drive Decisions

* Track key metrics like occupancy, revenue, and cost
* Use data to identify trends and problem areas
* Take action based on numbers, not assumptions
* Drive performance improvements through data-led decisions

6. Audit Properties & Maintain Control

* Conduct regular property audits (hygiene, operations, processes)
* Identify gaps and ensure timely closure
* Maintain high standards across all properties
* Ensure properties are always audit-ready

**What success looks like after 6–12 months**

* Cluster consistently meets occupancy and revenue targets
* High and stable NPS across all properties
* Strong SOP adherence and execution consistency
* Reduced escalations and faster issue resolution
* Well-trained, motivated, and accountable team
* Clear visibility and control over all properties

The cluster runs with discipline, predictability, and strong performance.

**Who this role is for**

You will likely thrive here if:

* You take ownership of outcomes across multiple locations
* You enjoy managing teams and driving performance
* You are disciplined and believe in structured execution
* You are comfortable working with numbers and targets
* You can handle pressure and make decisions on-ground
* You want to grow into larger operational leadership roles

**Experience we value**

* 1–3 years of experience in operations / multi-unit environments
* Experience managing teams (directly or indirectly)
* Exposure to customer-facing environments
* Basic understanding of business metrics (occupancy, revenue, cost)
* Strong execution and follow-up discipline

Hospitality experience is not mandatory. Ownership, leadership, and execution discipline are critical.

**The impact you will have**

* You directly influence revenue, occupancy, and profitability
* You shape customer experience across multiple properties
* You build and develop on-ground teams
* You ensure operational consistency at scale

**Why join now**

Zolo is scaling its coliving business aggressively across cities.

Cluster-level execution and leadership will define success.

This role is a critical stepping stone to larger city and business leadership roles.

If you believe in ownership, discipline, and driving outcomes at scale — this is the right role.

description:

* Strong working knowledge of HR operations, case management, service performance, audit and compliance controls, together with practical experience using Workday, ServiceNow or comparable HR platforms.
