title: Leather Sourcing / Production Manager (IN)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**
Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.
  
  
What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.
  
  
**OUR CULTURE**
Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.
  
  

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.
  
  
**JOB TITLE:**
**Manager. Material Production - Leather**
RESPONSIBILITIES:
  
  
Leather Inventory & Quality Control
  
  

* Oversee leather inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for tanning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock.
* Inspect and verify that only quality leather—meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards—is released into the tanning process.
* Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming leather before production begins, preventing downstream defects.
* Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw leather.

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management
  
  

* Own leather OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to tanneries and flagging potential delays.
* Proleatherly manage production schedules to ensure leather is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners.
* Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability.

Tanning & Production Support
  
  

* Partner with tanneries to ensure leather lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations.
* Monitor leather consumption during tanning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations.
* Work upstream with suppliers to align leather bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother tannery integration.
* Maintain clear documentation of leather lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Coordinate with planners and production team to align leather availability with production demand and tanning schedules.
* Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs.
* Provide input on leather purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history.
* Escalate production blockers (e.g., leather shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals.

**Qualifications**

* Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with leather or other luxury leathers.
* Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess leather quality and enforce standards before tanning.
* Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor leather usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow.
* Collaboration: Experience working with tanneries, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with leather leather grading, testing, or lot management.
* Knowledge of tannery operations and leather-to-yarn conversion.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools.
* Understanding of sustainable leather sourcing and production practices.

All posted ranges are reflective of base salary and may vary depending upon experience level and location. Bonus and equity may also be provided for eligible roles.
  
  
Pay Range: $1 USD - $2 USD
  
  
**WHY QUINCE?**
Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.
  
  
**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**
Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.
  
  
Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

title: Customer Operations - Lead
description:
**About Ethos**
**Ethos (Nasdaq: $LIFE)**
is a leading life insurance technology company on a mission to protect families by democratizing access to life insurance and empowering agents at scale. With its robust three-sided technology platform, Ethos is transforming the life insurance experience for consumers, agents, and carriers alike. Ethos offers instant, accessible products and a seamless online process that requires no medical exams and just a few health questions; it eliminates traditional barriers, making it easier than ever for everyone to protect their families. Ethos is redefining how life insurance is bought, sold, and underwritten.
  
  
**About The Role**
As the Customer Operations Lead at Ethos, you will lead a team of up to 10 -12 Associates, ensuring they deliver an exceptional experience to new and existing customers and the insurance agents who refer business to Ethos. You will combine hands-on customer support leadership with team management, coaching, and process improvement to drive team performance and customer satisfaction.This role requires strong people-leadership skills alongside the deep product, systems, and communication expertise expected of frontline associates.Creating a positive customer and agent experience is critical to Ethos's success in the life insurance industry, and this role is central to scaling that experience through a high-performing team.
  
  
**Duties And Responsibilities**
Team Leadership & People Management
  
  

* Directly manage, coach, and develop a team of up to 10 Customer Operations Associates
* Conduct regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and career development conversations
* Set individual and team goals aligned with broader Customer Operations objectives, and track progress against defined service levels (SLAs)
* Manage team scheduling, staffing coverage, and workload distribution across email, live chat, SMS, and phone channels
* Recruit, onboard, and train new team members; build and maintain onboarding/training materials
* Foster a positive, accountable, and high-performance team culture

Operational Excellence
  
  

* Ensure the team maintains accuracy in all communications with customers/agents on policy /agent comp related queries
* Own team-level quality assurance — audit interactions, provide feedback, and drive continuous improvement in service quality
* Monitor team metrics (response times, resolution rates, CSAT/agent satisfaction, SLA adherence) and report performance to management

Process & Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Identify opportunities for process improvements across the team's functions and lead implementation of agreed-upon solutions
* Partner with other cross-functional teams to resolve systemic issues and represent the voice of the customer/agent
* Develop and maintain team knowledge base, playbooks, and SOPs to ensure consistency and scalability
* Support hiring, capacity planning, and resource forecasting as the team grows

Subject Matter Expertise
  
  

* Maintain and deepen expert-level understanding of Ethos products, consumer policy systems, and partner agent systems
* Serve as the team's go-to resource for complex queries/scenarios

**Qualifications And Skills**

* 3-5+ years of experience in customer support, customer success, or operations, including at least 1-2 years in a team lead, supervisor, or people management role
* Proven experience managing and developing a team of 5+ direct reports
* Experience in life insurance or a related industry strongly preferred
* Bachelor's degree preferred
* Proficiency with Salesforce or equivalent support/help desk software; experience with reporting/dashboarding tools a plus
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret team performance data and translate it into action
* Excellent coaching, feedback delivery, and conflict-resolution skills
* Adaptable and resilient, able to lead a team through change while maintaining quality and morale
* Excellent phone presence, written communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills

Don’t meet every single requirement? If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. At Ethos we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace.
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the SF Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with arrests and conviction records.
  
  
To learn more about what information we collect and how it may be used, please refer to our California Candidate Privacy Notice.
  
  
***Recruitment Notice: Please be aware of recruitment scams. All legitimate communication from our team will only come from email addresses ending in @ethos.com or @getethos.com.***
***We will never ask for payment, banking details, or sensitive personal information during the hiring process. If you are contacted by someone claiming to represent us from a different email address, please treat it as fraudulent.***

title: Manager II, Program Management, Global Catalog Operations, Amazon
description:
**Description**
The Global Catalog Operations (GCO) team in Amazon is part of Amazon Selection & Catalog Systems (ASCS), with a focus on leveraging human intelligence, to measure and improve the quality of the catalog. Our charter is to make Catalog quality programs more effective by providing expert human judgment.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced people leader to join our rapidly growing team as a Manager II, Program Management. In this role you will build and lead a team of SMEs, auditors and Program Managers responsible for developing insights and eliminating quality defects that affect business metrics. You will own a portfolio of catalog quality programs rather than a single workstream, set the direction and mechanisms your team operates by, and be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business outcomes of the programs under you. As part of this role, you will 1) hire, develop, and lead a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, growing the bench and the capability of the function, 2) own a portfolio of quality programs, prioritizing across competing initiatives and allocating capacity to the highest impact opportunities, 3) set the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that make your team's programs measurable and repeatable, and 4) work collaboratively across partner teams (Science, PMs, Engineering, Business, etc.) and represent catalog quality program management to senior leadership across GCO and partner orgs.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**As a Manager II, Program Management You Will**

* Build, lead, and develop a team of auditors, SMEs and program managers, owning hiring, performance management, coaching, and career growth
* Own catalog quality programs, setting priorities across competing initiatives and allocating team capacity to the highest impact work
* Establish the operating mechanisms, standards, and roadmap that ensure your team's programs deliver measurable business and operational outcomes
* Be accountable for the aggregate delivery and business/operational metrics of the programs under your team

* Identify systemic gaps across process areas and mobilize your team and stakeholders to resolve them
* Serve as an escalation point and senior partner for in-house and customer teams across Science, Engineering, Product, and Business

title: Department Manager
description:
**Job Description**

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**
**​**
  
As a Department Manager, you’ll be the leader supporting and encouraging your whole team. By fostering an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and an entrepreneurial spirit, you’ll create an environment where everyone can thrive. Acting in line with our values, you’ll contribute to both your own success and the success of the company.

You will:

* Lead your team to deliver an outstanding customer experience by ensuring excellent operational and visual standards, while actively promoting and selling our products.
* Take responsibility for your store and department’s strengths, analyse sales performance, identify commercial opportunities, set goals, and create plans to optimize results, profits, and stock levels.
* Manage team planning, scheduling, and ensure seamless opening and closing routines.
* Recruit, onboard, and develop your team while fostering an inclusive and collaborative culture that promotes growth and innovation.
* Stay updated on fashion trends, customer preferences, and competitors to maintain a competitive edge.
* Represent yourself and the brand positively during all customer interactions.

​

**WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH**
**​**

Our stores are the heart of our company, where customers experience our brand firsthand. As part of the dynamic Store Team, every role—from Sales Advisors, Department Managers, Store Managers and Visual Merchandisers to Assistant Store Managers, Cash Office Responsible, and Delivery Responsible in larger stores—contributes to creating an inspiring and welcoming environment. You’ll also connect with the wider Area Team, collaborating across stores to share insights and drive success together. Alongside your team, you'll play a vital role in helping customers feel confident and express their individuality with the latest trends and timeless styles. By building meaningful connections with customers in our stores, we make fashion accessible and sustainable for all.

​

**WHO YOU ARE**
**​**

*We are looking for people with…*
​

* Experience in retail management and operations.
* Strong leadership skills, with a passion for coaching and developing teams while exemplifying company values and culture.
* Expertise in sales planning, analysis, and follow-up, using customer-centric tools and reporting.

*And people who are…*
​

* Strong and confident leaders who inspire, coach, and develop their teams with integrity.
* Thriving in collaborative, dynamic environments, with a solution-focused mindset.
* Motivated to create great customers experiences while promoting and selling our products.
* A keen interest in fashion trends, commerciality, and competitor insights to drive sales.
* Effective communicators, creative, and curious.
* Flexible, analytical, and achievement-oriented, with the ability to manage statistics and work with numbers.

​

**WHO WE ARE**
**​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​

We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

​

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE**
**​**

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe.

· We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.

· We pride ourselves on being a values-driven organization, guided by our 7 unique values that have been part of our success story for over 75 years.

· We are an inclusive company where you’re encouraged to be yourself at work

· You will have access to a large global talent community, where career growth and aspirations have no limits.

· We believe in supporting your overall wellbeing and offer comprehensive benefits inclusive of health insurance, wellness for self and family.

· You’ll be able to express your personal style with our employee discount at H&M group.

· We offer 5 days of working in a week to have great work life balance.

**JOIN US**
**​**

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

​

*\*We are committed to a recruitment process that is fair, equitable, and based on competency. We therefore kindly ask you to not attach a cover letter in your application.*

**Additional Information**

This is a full-time position for our stores in Bangalore. The position reports to the Store Manager.

To manage the high volume of applications for roles with leadership responsibilities, we use an online assessment method. You will need to complete it as part of the application and screening process. Your responses will be scored by an assessment tool that applies to predefined criteria set by H&M Group.
  
  
After completing the assessment, you’ll have the opportunity to share feedback and ask questions.
  
  
If you experience any difficulties or prefer an alternative assessment method, please contact recruitment\_support@hm.com. Choosing an alternative will not impact your application. For more information on how we process your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice.

title: EAFS IS Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**EisnerAmper | Fund Services**
**Investor Services Manager**
**Position Overview**
Investors judge a fund by the quality of every interaction they have with it: how quickly a subscription is processed, how clearly a capital call is explained, and how accurately a quarterly statement reflects their position. The Investor Services Manager owns that experience.
  
  
In this role, you lead the team responsible for investor onboarding, anti-money laundering and know-your-customer (AML/KYC) review, capital activity processing, and investor reporting across a portfolio of private equity, credit, real estate, venture, and hedge fund clients. You act as the day-to-day escalation point for fund managers and their limited partners, and you work with fund accounting, compliance, and technology colleagues to keep investor records accurate and investor communications timely.
  
  
This is a client-facing middle management role, you will be expected to set service standards and take responsibility for the accuracy of the investor register.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Investor Onboarding and Due Diligence**

* Oversee end-to-end investor onboarding, including subscription document review, side letter tracking, and entry of investor data into the fund administration platform.
* Review AML/KYC and Customer Identification Program files for completeness and escalate exceptions to compliance, including politically exposed person and sanctions screening results.
* Confirm accredited investor, qualified purchaser, and qualified client status is documented in line with each fund's offering terms.
* Coordinate FATCA and Common Reporting Standard (CRS) self-certification collection and maintain supporting tax documentation such as Forms W-8 and W-9.
* Maintain the investor register and legal entity data so that ownership, commitments, and contact records stay accurate across systems.

**Capital Activity and Transaction Processing**

* Prepare, review, and release capital call and distribution notices.
* Track funding status, follow up on late contributions, and support the default and remedy process when a limited partner fails to fund.
* Review subscriptions, redemptions, transfers, rebalances, and equalization calculations for open-ended and closed-ended structures.
* Verify bank instructions through callback and other fraud prevention controls before any payment is released.
* Reconcile investor-level capital account balances against fund accounting records and resolve differences before reporting deadlines.

**Investor Reporting and Communications**

* Administer the investor portal: user provisioning, document posting, entitlement review, and access certification.
* Perform AMLCO, FATCA/CRS and other periodic reporting.
* Respond to limited partner inquiries and due diligence questionnaires within agreed service levels, and coordinate responses with the client where judgment is required.
* Support the annual Schedule K-1 and K-3 distribution process in coordination with the tax team.

**Client Service and Relationship Management**

* Serve as the primary investor services contact for an assigned group of fund clients and their investor relations teams.
* Assist leadership and clients on onboarding of new funds and new clients, including data migration, review of governing documents, and design of the service delivery model.
* Track service level agreement performance, prepare service review materials, and present results in client meetings.
* Identify recurring pain points and propose changes that reduce turnaround time or manual effort.

**Team Leadership and Development**

* Assist the leadership in workload allocation, capacity planning, and coverage across reporting and capital activity peaks.
* Support the leadership in team members’ career development and training plans.

**Controls, Technology, and Process Improvement**

title: Finance Manager – Investor Relations and Fund Operations
description:
**About Prana Ventures**

Prana Ventures is an early-stage venture capital firm investing through SEBI-registered Alternative Investment Funds. We back founders at the earliest stages and work closely with them through the life of the company. Behind every investment is a finance function that has to be accurate, on time and fully compliant, and that is the team you would be joining.

**The Role**

We are hiring a Finance Manager to manage investor relations and run the fund accounting & operations engine across our funds and the management company. Reporting to the Head of Finance, you will own investor reporting, day-to-day delivery of fund accounting, capital calls and distributions, investment fund flows, regulatory and tax compliance, management company finance, working with our fund administrator, auditors, tax advisors and legal counsel.

This is a hands-on ownership role, not a review-only one. You will prepare, reconcile and run the processes yourself, bring them to the Head of Finance for sign-off, and be the person the partners, LPs, administrator and auditors rely on for the numbers. It suits a Chartered Accountant/ Commerce graduate who already understands how a fund works end to end and wants to build depth in venture capital.

**Key responsibilities**

**Investor reporting and relations**

* Own the end-to-end quarterly and annual investor reporting cycle, including LP reports, capital account statements, portfolio updates and fund performance metrics (IRR, TVPI, DPI and MOIC), bringing together inputs from the investment team and the fund administrator.
* Act as the day-to-day point of contact for LPs on queries relating to capital accounts, drawdowns, distributions, tax statements and fund performance, and ensure every response is accurate, consistent and timely.
* Manage LP onboarding and investor records, including subscription and contribution documents, KYC/AML and FATCA/CRS documentation, the investor register and the LP portal or data room.
* Prepare financial packs and materials for LP meetings, annual investor meetings and Investment/Advisory Committee meetings, and track follow-up actions to closure.
* Respond to LP due diligence questionnaires (DDQs) and other ad-hoc reporting requests, and maintain a tracker of side-letter obligations to ensure they are consistently honoured.
* Support the partners in fundraising for new funds by preparing track-record data, financial information and data room materials, and by responding to prospective investors’ queries.

  

**Fund accounting and reporting**

* Run fund accounting and NAV computation for each fund in coordination with the fund administrator, and review the administrator’s output for accuracy before it goes to the Head of Finance.
* Prepare quarterly and annual financial statements, LP reports, capital account statements and portfolio valuation summaries within agreed timelines.
* Maintain the master record of investments, follow-on rounds, exits and write-offs, and reconcile it to the administrator’s books every quarter.
* Support portfolio valuation exercises in line with the applicable valuation guidelines (including IPEV) and the fund’s valuation policy, and prepare materials for valuation review.

  

**Capital calls and distributions**

* Prepare and issue capital call and distribution notices; track LP commitments, contributions, unfunded amounts and recallable capital.
* Reconcile LP receipts, follow up on delayed contributions and escalate any potential default to the Head of Finance and partners in line with the fund documents.
* Compute management fees, fund expenses, carried interest and waterfall distributions in accordance with the fund documents, and maintain the supporting workings for audit.

  

**Investment operations**

* Coordinate fund flows for new investments, follow-ons and exits, including wire instructions, KYC, FEMA compliance and closing documentation, working with the investment team and legal counsel.
* Maintain the fund’s shareholding and investment tracker for each portfolio company, including instrument terms, conversion events and liquidation preferences.
* Support the investment team with financial diligence inputs and post-investment monitoring data where required.

  

**Compliance and regulatory**

* Ensure timely and accurate regulatory filings and reporting, including SEBI AIF filings, FEMA/RBI reporting for foreign LPs and investments, and any other statutory returns applicable to the funds and management company.
* Manage tax compliance for the funds and management company, including withholding tax, advance tax, tax returns and LP tax documentation, in coordination with tax advisors.
* Lead the annual statutory and tax audits for the funds and management company: plan the timeline, prepare schedules, respond to auditor queries and close out findings.
* Maintain the compliance calendar and ensure no filing or payment deadline is missed.

  

**Management company finance**

* Manage bookkeeping, accounts payable, expense management, payroll coordination and budgeting for the management company.
* Track fund expenses against management company expenses and ensure allocation is correct and consistent with the fund documents and LP expectations.
* Prepare monthly management accounts and cash-flow forecasts for the management company.

  

**Process, systems and controls**

* Document and continuously improve finance processes, controls and checklists so that every recurring deliverable is repeatable and audit-ready.
* Own the finance systems and data, including the accounting system, LP records and investment trackers, and drive improvements in reporting and automation.

  

**What success looks like in the first 12 months**

* Quarterly LP reports and capital account statements go out accurately and within the agreed timeline every quarter.
* LPs receive prompt, accurate responses to their queries, and investor onboarding, DDQs and side-letter reporting are handled smoothly without escalation.
* All SEBI, RBI/FEMA and tax filings are made on time with no penalties or notices.
* Statutory and tax audits close on schedule with no material findings.
* Capital calls, distributions and fee computations are issued without errors or restatements.
* Finance processes are documented, controls are in place, and the Head of Finance can rely on your work with light-touch review.

  

**What we are looking for**

**Must-haves**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant/ B.Com
* 4-6 years of experience in investor reporting, fund accounting, fund administration, audit or finance operations in VC, PE or asset management.
* Working knowledge of SEBI AIF Regulations, FEMA and related RBI reporting, and Indian tax provisions applicable to funds and their investors.
* Hands-on experience with capital calls, distributions, management fee and carried interest calculations and waterfall mechanics.
* Experience preparing investor-facing reports and handling LP queries, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Advanced Excel skills and comfort working with accounting software and fund administration platforms.
* Strong attention to detail and a track record of delivering accurate work against fixed deadlines.

  

**Nice-to-haves**

* Prior experience in-house at a VC or PE fund manager, or at a fund administrator serving AIFs.
* Exposure to IPEV valuation guidelines and portfolio valuation processes.
* Experience with offshore fund structures and foreign LP onboarding.
* Familiarity with ILPA reporting templates and LP reporting portals.
* Big 4 or reputed mid-tier audit background with fund or financial services clients.

  

**Who you are**

* An owner. You take a process from start to finish and do not need chasing on deadlines.
* Rigorous and calm under time pressure, especially around quarter-end, audits and capital calls.
* You handle confidential LP, portfolio and compensation data with care.
* Comfortable in a small team where you will work directly with partners, LPs, auditors and advisors, and where the environment is less structured than a large institution.
* A clear communicator who can explain a number, a variance or a regulation in plain language.

  

**Why join Prana**

You will get full-lifecycle exposure to venture investing, from first cheque to exit, and see how the finance function underpins every part of it. You will work directly with the Head of Finance and the partners, own a meaningful part of the firm’s operations, and build a skill set that is in short supply and high demand in India’s fund ecosystem

title: Leather Sourcing / Production Manager (IN)
description:
**ABOUT QUINCE**

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world's finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

**OUR CULTURE**

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren't interested in replicating how others do retail. We're building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that's been done before.

* We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
* Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
* Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you're someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

**JOB TITLE****:**

**Manager. Material Production - Leather**

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leather Inventory & Quality Control

* Oversee leather inventory levels to ensure adequate supply for tanning schedules while minimizing waste and overstock.
* Inspect and verify that only quality leather—meeting specified micron, length, and color consistency standards—is released into the tanning process.
* Implement checkpoints to catch non-conforming leather before production begins, preventing downstream defects.
* Coordinate with sourcing and warehouse teams to maintain accurate inventory records and proper storage conditions for raw leather.

  

On-Time Delivery (OTD) Management

* Own leather OTD performance, tracking delivery timelines from suppliers to tanneries and flagging potential delays.
* Proleatherly manage production schedules to ensure leather is available when needed, communicating risks to cross-functional partners.
* Resolve supply interruptions by expediting shipments or reallocating inventory as necessary to meet production deadlines.
* Establish and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) for supplier lead times and delivery reliability.

  

Tanning & Production Support

* Partner with tanneries to ensure leather lots are processed according to technical specifications and quality expectations.
* Monitor leather consumption during tanning to identify discrepancies, yield loss, or quality deviations.
* Work upstream with suppliers to align leather bale composition, lot sizing, and traceability for smoother tannery integration.
* Maintain clear documentation of leather lots, test results, and production flow to support traceability and continuous improvement.

  

Cross-Functional Collaboration

* Coordinate with planners and production team to align leather availability with production demand and tanning schedules.
* Collaborate with R&D, Product Development, and Sourcing teams to support seamless production handoffs.
* Provide input on leather purchasing decisions based on production capacity, lead times, and quality performance history.
* Escalate production blockers (e.g., leather shortages, quality holds) with recommended solutions to meet OTD goals.

  

QUALIFICATIONS

* Education: Degree in Textile Engineering, Material Science, Supply Chain, or a related field.
* Production Experience: Proven experience managing raw materials in a textile or apparel production environment, preferably with leather or other luxury leathers.
* Quality Focus: Strong ability to assess leather quality and enforce standards before tanning.
* Inventory & OTD Acumen: Demonstrated skill in tracking inventory levels and driving on-time delivery performance.
* Analytical Skills: Ability to use data to monitor leather usage, identify yield issues, and improve production flow.
* Collaboration: Experience working with tanneries, suppliers, planners, and internal production teams to resolve issues quickly.

Preferred:

* Experience with leather leather grading, testing, or lot management.
* Knowledge of tannery operations and leather-to-yarn conversion.
* Familiarity with inventory management systems or ERP tools.
* Understanding of sustainable leather sourcing and production practices.

**WHY QUINCE?**

Joining Quince means being part of a mission-driven team reshaping retail. You will work alongside talented colleagues, tackle meaningful challenges, and contribute to building a more sustainable, accessible future for customers and partners alike.

**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & HIRING INTEGRITY**

Quince provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applications for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran or military status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.

Quince is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation to complete your application or to perform the essential functions of a role at Quince, please let us know by completing this accommodation form. We review all requests individually and will work with you to determine appropriate accommodations on a case-by-case basis.

Employment is contingent upon successful completion of a background check. Quince will conduct background checks in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws.

*Security Advisory: Beware of Frauds*

At Quince, we're dedicated to recruiting top talent who share our drive for innovation. To safeguard candidates, Quince emphasizes legitimate recruitment practices. Initial communication is primarily via official Quince email addresses and LinkedIn; beware of deviations. Personal data and sensitive information will not be solicited during the application phase. Interviews are conducted via phone, in person, or through the approved platforms Google Meets or Zoom—never via messaging apps or other calling services. Offers are merit-based, communicated verbally, and followed up in writing. If personal information is requested to initiate the hiring process, rest assured it will be through secure and protected means.

title: Senior Revenue Operations Manager
description:
**Company Description**

BlueOptima is the global reference for Software Engineering Intelligence. We provide an AI Trust Layer for Enterprise Code, enabling large organizations to prove ROI, reduce risk, and confidently scale AI deployment. Our objective metrics help businesses transform engineering from a cost center to a value creator.

We are a team of around 110 people across the UK, US, India, Mexico, Japan and Canada and we work closely across teams and time zones. People here are given real ownership early and the autonomy to run with it. If you like seeing your work change how a company operates, you will feel at home.

 **Job Description**

BlueOptima is investing in Revenue Operations, and we want an experienced RevOps leader to build the function and own it. The vision is simple: one CRM the whole business trusts, a forecast that calls the quarter early, and a revenue engine designed on purpose. You are a builder who has run forecasting and CRM design before and wants ownership and autonomy. The role is based in London on a hybrid pattern.

As **Senior Revenue Operations Manager** you will work on and develop the systems, data and processes behind BlueOptima’s revenue: the CRM, the forecast, enablement, the deal desk and the planning behind targets and pay. You will report to our Head of Finance & Operations, giving you an independent view of the numbers, and work day to day with our CRO. Our customers rely on BlueOptima for objective measurement of their engineering, and this role brings the same objectivity to how we measure and grow our own business.

**Our Product Portfolio: (Platform Insights, Code Insights, Predictive Assessment, Active Multisite)**

BlueOptima is a multi-product business. Platform Insights gives engineering leaders objective measures of productivity, quality and cost across their teams, vendors and AI tools. Code Insights finds vulnerabilities, exposed secrets and AI-authored code before release. Predictive Assessment helps companies hire developers on measured coding performance. Our Active MultiSite suite (SVN Multisite, Git Multisite, Gerrit Multisite and Access Control Plus) ensures high availability, performance and security for distributed development teams, and is trusted by leading global organizations to manage their critical source code and infrastructure.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Roadmap:** Develop the RevOps roadmap, priorities and team, and run a fixed rhythm with the CRO: weekly forecast, monthly revenue review and quarterly business review.
* **CRM:** Make our CRM the single system of record for customers, pipeline and contracts, and own its data model, integrations, automation and change control.
* **Govern revenue data:** Agree metric definitions with Finance and the CRO, keep data quality high, and reconcile bookings and ARR between the CRM and Finance every month.
* **Run the forecast:** Build a forecast process the CEO, CRO and board rely on, give an independent view alongside the sales call, and improve its accuracy every quarter.
* **Define the revenue process:** Set stage definitions, MEDDPICC qualification, handoffs and a renewals pipeline that opens well before each contract ends, across all product lines.
* **Build the deal desk:** Put pricing and discount rules, quoting and approvals on a written footing with Legal and Finance, so standard deals move fast and exceptions get a quick decision.
* **Support planning and pay:** Build the capacity model behind the bookings plan, support territory and quota setting, and keep commissions accurate and paid on time.
* **Enable the sales team:** Own onboarding, playbooks and our sales hub, and make sure every product, pricing or process change lands with training and the CRM change together.

  
**Qualifications**  

* Proven experience in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations at a B2B SaaS company with an enterprise sales motion.
* A forecasting track record: you have built and run a forecast process that a CRO and CEO relied on, and can show how its accuracy improved.
* Deep hands-on CRM knowledge (Salesforce, HubSpot or similar), covering data model, automation, integrations, administration and change control.
* Strong analytical skills: advanced spreadsheet skills, plus SQL or a BI tool, and the discipline to reconcile revenue data with Finance.
* Working knowledge of enterprise deals: long sales cycles, multi-year contracts, renewals, and a qualification method such as MEDDPICC.
* Experience of quota and commission administration, pricing and discount governance, or running a deal desk.
* The credibility to partner with a CRO and the independence to challenge a forecast or a deal with evidence.
* A builder’s mindset: you are hands-on, comfortable building from the ground up, and have developed people or led a small team.

  
**Additional Information**

**Why Join BlueOptima**

* **What does success in this role generate:** Within a year, the CEO, CRO and board run the business from one set of revenue numbers and a forecast they trust. You will own a function you built, with room to grow your team and your remit into wider commercial operations leadership as BlueOptima scales.
* **Culture:** Join a global, innovative team. We support rapid career growth, providing the freedom to create your own success story in a high-performance environment.
* **Continuous Development:** We prioritize your growth through bespoke training programs and Personal Development Plans (PDPs) for every employee.
* **Impact:** Be a visible contributor to a company that is redefining how the world builds software.

**Benefits:**

* ️33 days of holidays (this includes public and religious holidays)
* Contributions to your Provident Fund which can be matched by the company above the statutory minimum as agreed
* Gratuity payments
* Private Medical Insurance provided by the company (Employee + Spouse + 2 Children + 2 Parents)
* 12 Weeks Paid Paternity Leave, 6 months Maternity leave
* Support with childcare costs (50%)
* Work from Home Equipment allowance
* Flexible Work from Home policy - 2 days home p/w
* Flexible Work from Long Distance - 4 weeks a year
* Sponsored Learning Opportunities
* Team Socials

Stay connected with us on LinkedIn or keep an eye on our career page for future opportunities!

title: Business Operations & Finance Administration Lead
description:
Business Operations & Finance Administration Lead

**Company:** ANEYA  
**Location:** HSR Layout, Bengaluru  
**Salary:** ₹60,000–₹75,000 per month (₹7.2–₹9 LPA)  
**Experience:** 3–6 years  
**Employment Type:** Full-time, primarily office-based  
**Reporting To:** Founder

About ANEYA

ANEYA is an entrepreneurial business building premium, experience-led ventures with a strong focus on customer experience, operational excellence and thoughtful execution.

We are looking for a highly capable, organized and proactive professional to bring structure, accountability and execution discipline across our business initiatives.

This is not a conventional Executive Assistant, accountant or data-entry role.

**We are looking for someone who makes sure things get done.**

You will be the person who keeps track of commitments, coordinates people, follows up on deliverables, ensures meetings translate into action and makes sure our financial administration runs smoothly.

You should enjoy bringing order to a fast-moving environment, be comfortable following up with senior professionals and take pride in ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

Your Two Core Responsibilities1. Finance & Accounts Administration — 40%

You will take end-to-end ownership of financial administration and coordination with our external accountant.

**Your responsibilities include:**

* Collect, verify and organize all vendor invoices, receipts, payment confirmations and supporting documents.
* Maintain accurate records of expenses, advances, reimbursements, vendor payments and client receipts.
* Track outstanding invoices, receivables, payables and pending payment commitments.
* Coordinate with vendors and internal stakeholders to resolve missing documents and payment discrepancies.
* Match transactions against bank statements, invoices and payment records, identifying and escalating unexplained differences.
* Ensure financial documentation is accurately recorded or uploaded into the accounting system.
* Coordinate with the external accountant to ensure transactions are properly accounted for.
* Drive monthly accounting closure by ensuring required documents are complete, exceptions are resolved or escalated, and the accountant confirms closure.
* Maintain organized records that are readily available for management review, audits and statutory requirements.
* Prepare simple monthly financial administration reports showing pending payments, outstanding documentation and unresolved issues.

**What success looks like:** The Founder should not have to chase invoices, locate receipts, follow up with the accountant or personally resolve routine financial documentation issues.

*The external accountant remains responsible for professional accounting treatment, statutory filings and tax compliance. This role owns the coordination, documentation, accuracy checks and closure process.*

2. Project Coordination & Deliverables Tracking — 40%

You will establish and maintain a reliable system to track important projects, milestones, meetings and commitments across the business.

**Your responsibilities include:**

* Maintain one consolidated master tracker covering key projects, deliverables, owners, deadlines, status, dependencies and next actions.
* Coordinate with business leaders and team members to ensure commitments are clearly assigned and understood.
* Actively follow up on deliverables before deadlines are missed.
* Identify overdue tasks, unresolved dependencies and potential bottlenecks.
* Escalate issues early, with clear facts and recommended next steps.
* Coordinate leadership meetings, project reviews and external stakeholder meetings.
* Prepare meeting agendas, capture decisions and document action items.
* Ensure every action item has a clear owner and due date, and follow through until completion.
* Maintain visibility into upcoming milestones across multiple business initiatives.
* Prepare concise weekly progress reports highlighting completed work, upcoming deadlines, delays and decisions required.
* Keep project tracking simple, accurate and useful rather than creating unnecessary processes or meetings.

**What success looks like:** At any point, the Founder and leadership team should be able to see what is on track, what is delayed, who is responsible and what needs attention.

*You will coordinate and track execution, not replace the business leaders responsible for commercial decisions, strategy or project delivery.*

Additional Responsibilities — 20%Meeting & Stakeholder Coordination

* Schedule internal and external meetings efficiently.
* Coordinate calendars, meeting logistics and required materials.
* Communicate professionally with senior executives, vendors, consultants and business partners.
* Ensure meeting decisions are documented and followed through.
* Maintain clear, timely and professional written and verbal communication.

General Business Administration

* Maintain organized contracts, business documents and administrative records.
* Coordinate vendor onboarding and routine documentation.
* Support important administrative assignments across the Founder's business initiatives.
* Handle confidential business information with discretion.

Technology, AI & Productivity

* Use Excel or Google Sheets confidently for tracking, reconciliation and reporting.
* Work with project management tools such as ClickUp, Asana, Trello or equivalent platforms.
* Be comfortable with accounting software such as Zoho Books or Tally.
* Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini to improve productivity.
* Validate information independently and use technology to simplify work.

What We Are Looking For

**Essential Requirements**

* 3–6 years of experience in business operations, executive coordination, project coordination, finance administration or a similar role.
* Hands-on experience coordinating invoices, payments, expenses and accounting documentation.
* Experience working with accountants or finance teams to close outstanding financial items.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets proficiency.
* Demonstrated ability to track multiple projects, deadlines and stakeholders simultaneously.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Strong spoken and written English.
* Confidence following up with senior professionals and external stakeholders.
* Independent problem-solving ability and a proactive, persistent approach.
* Strong sense of ownership, reliability and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience working directly with a Founder, CEO, COO or senior leadership team.
* Experience coordinating monthly accounting closure.
* Familiarity with Zoho Books, Tally or similar accounting platforms.
* Experience with project management software.
* Background in startups, consulting, professional services, hospitality or other coordination-intensive businesses.
* Bachelor's degree in commerce, business administration, finance or a related field.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

**First 30 Days — Establish Visibility**

* Understand existing projects, stakeholders, financial records and administrative processes.
* Establish a consolidated tracker of all important deliverables and deadlines.
* Organize existing invoices, receipts, payments and accounting documentation.
* Identify and document outstanding financial and project-related issues.

**Days 31–60 — Establish Control**

* Run a consistent weekly deliverables review process.
* Ensure meetings have clear agendas, decisions and assigned action items.
* Drive timely resolution of overdue administrative and accounting items.
* Coordinate monthly accounting closure with the external accountant.
* Establish a concise reporting system for leadership.

**Days 61–90 — Operate Independently**

* Independently manage routine financial administration and accounting coordination.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date visibility across key business initiatives.
* Proactively identify delays and ensure timely escalation.
* Reduce the Founder's involvement in routine follow-ups and administrative issues.
* Demonstrate that commitments are being tracked and completed reliably.

The Person Who Will Succeed

You are someone who enjoys bringing order to complexity.

You are comfortable coordinating ten different people, following up persistently, resolving an invoice discrepancy and ensuring a meeting results in completed actions.

You don't wait for someone to ask for a status update. You already know what is pending, who owns it and what needs to happen next.

You combine the accuracy of a finance administrator with the organization of a project coordinator and the initiative of someone who takes genuine ownership.

**Your value is not in creating trackers. Your value is in ensuring that the work tracked actually gets completed.**

Compensation

**₹60,000–₹70,000 per month**, depending on experience and demonstrated capabilities.

This is a high-responsibility role offering direct exposure to the Founder and leadership team, with opportunities to grow as the business expands.

How to Apply

Please submit your resume along with brief answers to the following questions:

* Describe your experience managing invoices, expenses, payment records and coordinating with accountants. Have you independently driven monthly accounting closure?
* Give an example of how you tracked multiple projects or deliverables across different stakeholders and ensured deadlines were met.
* What would you do if five critical deliverables were overdue and their owners were not responding?
* Which accounting software, project management tools and AI tools have you used?

Pay: ₹60,000.00 - ₹75,000.00 per month

Work Location: Hybrid remote in HSR Layout, Bengaluru, Karnataka

title: Manufacturing Engineering Manager
description:
**Senior Manufacturing & Production Quality Lead – LifeBand**

**Location:**
India – predominantly on-site in Chennai

**Engagement:**
Contract, Full Time

**Reporting to:**
Equivital UK Product & Operations Leadership

**Product:**
Equivital LifeBand – first high-volume production run of 2,000 units

**Role purpose**

Equivital is seeking experienced electronics manufacturing professional to provide hands-on leadership and oversight of the first high-volume production run of approximately 2,000 LifeBand devices at our manufacturing partner in India.

This is a critical production-launch role. The successful candidate will act as Equivital's senior on-site manufacturing representative and will be responsible for ensuring that the production process is properly controlled, technically robust and capable of delivering a consistently high-quality product at the required yield.

The individual will work closely with the manufacturing company in Chennai and quality teams, Equivital's UK engineering and product teams, and other technical stakeholders.

The role requires someone who is comfortable working directly on the factory floor, identifying problems, challenging poor processes, implementing corrective actions and communicating clearly with both factory personnel and senior technical teams in the UK.

**Key objectives**

The successful candidate will be accountable for:

* Excellent build quality across the 2,000-unit production run.
* High first-pass yield and minimal rework/scrap.
* Successful integration of the new ATE into the production process.
* Implementation and control of the new final DFT testing process.
* Robust control and verification of the LifeBand welding process.
* Ensuring welded assemblies meet the required mechanical and electrical specifications, particularly those affecting pogo-pin performance.
* Accurate material, component and finished-goods traceability.
* Improved stock control and production material management at Manufacturing plant.
* Rapid identification, containment and resolution of production issues.
* Accurate production reporting to the UK team.
* Establishment of a repeatable production process that Manufacturing company can continue to operate after the launch phase.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Production launch and daily manufacturing oversight**

* Be Equivital's principal technical and operational representative on-site during the production run.
* Work closely with Manufacturing company production, engineering and quality personnel.
* Review and approve production readiness before volume manufacturing begins.
* Establish clear daily production targets and monitor actual performance.
* Monitor production flow from incoming components through assembly, welding, programming, testing, final inspection and packing.
* Identify bottlenecks, recurring defects and process weaknesses.
* Challenge processes that are not producing the required quality or yield.
* Have authority to recommend or initiate a production stop where there is a significant quality or product-risk issue.

**2. ATE implementation**

The successful candidate will:

* Work with Equivital engineering and manufacturing company to embed the ATE into the production process.
* Ensure operators understand the correct test procedure.
* Verify that the ATE is correctly configured and being used consistently.
* Establish appropriate test records and traceability.
* Monitor ATE failure rates and identified abnormal trends.
* Distinguish genuine product failures from test-equipment/operator/process failures.
* Ensure failed units are correctly quarantined and investigated.
* Ensure that production does not bypass required ATE testing.
* Work with engineering to refine the ATE process where necessary.

**3. Final DFT implementation**

Final Design-for-Test / DFT testing is a new element of the LifeBand production process.

The role will be responsible for:

* Implementing the final DFT test process on the production line.
* Ensuring appropriate test fixtures, equipment and procedures are available.
* Training and supervising operators.
* Ensuring 100% of required devices receive the defined final testing.
* Ensuring test results are recorded and traceable to individual units.
* Monitoring DFT failure modes and trends.
* Working with Equivital engineering to investigate recurring failures.
* Preventing units from progressing to final packing without completing the required tests.

**4. Welding process control**

A particularly important responsibility will be oversight of the LifeBand welding process.

The successful candidate must have practical experience of manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies and understand the failure modes associated with welding/joining processes.

They will:

* Establish and document the required welding process parameters.
* Verify that the welding equipment is correctly set up and maintained.
* Ensure operators are trained and following the approved process.
* Establish appropriate first-off and periodic inspection requirements.
* Monitor weld quality throughout production.
* Identify potential weld defects before they become downstream failures.
* Ensure appropriate mechanical/electrical verification of the weld.
* Investigate weld-related failures and implement corrective actions.
* Pay particular attention to the impact of the welding process on the alignment, positioning and reliability of the LifeBand pogo-pin interface.
* Ensure the finished assembly meets the required mechanical tolerances and electrical performance requirements.

Experience with welding or joining of small electronic assemblies, plastics, metals, flexes, contacts or similar precision components would be highly desirable.

**5. Quality and yield management**

Establish and maintain a clear production-quality dashboard covering, at minimum:

* First-pass yield (FPY)
* Overall yield
* Scrap
* Rework
* ATE failures
* DFT failures
* Welding defects
* Pogo-pin/contact failures
* Functional test failures
* Component/assembly defects
* Repeat failure modes
* Units quarantined
* Units released
* Production throughput

The successful candidate will identify trends rather than simply report numbers.

Where yield deteriorates, they will determine the likely root cause and drive corrective action.

**6. Factory process discipline and stock control**

Manufacturing company currently requires improved production discipline and material control.

The role will therefore include:

* Verification of component availability before production starts.
* Physical verification of critical stock where required.
* Improving accuracy between recorded and actual stock.
* Ensuring components are correctly identified and traceable.
* Preventing uncontrolled substitution of components.
* Ensuring rejected/failed components are segregated.
* Establishing appropriate quarantine and disposition processes.
* Identifying shortages before they stop production.
* Ensuring finished and semi-finished units can be reconciled against production records.

**7. Non-conformance and root-cause analysis**

The individual will lead or coordinate investigation of manufacturing defects.

They should be comfortable using appropriate techniques including:

* CAPA
* Non-Conformance
* Process capability analysis where appropriate

The objective is not simply to repair defective units but to prevent recurrence.

**8. Communication with the UK team**

Provide a concise daily/weekly production report to Equivital UK covering:

**Production**

* Units planned, completed, passed, failed, yield, Rework/scrap

**Quality**

* Top defects, ATE failures, DFT failures, Welding defects, Contact/pogo-pin issues, Open NCRs

**Operations**

* Stock/component issues
* Production constraints
* Staffing/process issues
* Risks to schedule

**Actions**

* Corrective actions completed
* Actions in progress
* Decisions required from the UK team

Significant quality issues should be escalated immediately rather than waiting for the weekly report.

**Authority**

The individual must have sufficient authority to:

* Stop or pause production where a significant quality issue is identified.
* Quarantine suspect product.
* Require re-testing or additional inspection.
* Challenge production processes that do not meet the agreed specification.
* Escalate unresolved issues directly to Equivital UK leadership.

The role is not intended to be a passive inspection position.

**Required experience**

**Essential**

* Significant experience in electronics manufacturing.
* Experience managing or overseeing production of electronic devices/products.
* Strong understanding of manufacturing quality systems.
* Hands-on experience with production testing and test equipment.
* Experience implementing or managing ATE or automated production testing.
* Experience with DFT/functional testing.
* Experience with precision manufacturing processes involving small components.
* Practical experience with welding, joining or equivalent manufacturing processes involving small electronic assemblies.
* Strong understanding of process control, yield and defect analysis.
* Strong communication skills in English.
* Ability to work directly with factory operators, engineers and management.
* Comfortable working on the factory floor rather than purely in an office environment.

**Highly desirable**

* Experience with wearables, medical devices, IoT devices, consumer electronics, industrial electronics or similar products.
* Experience with high-volume electronics manufacturing.
* Experience with SMT/PCBA and final assembly.
* Experience with pogo pins, spring contacts, connectors or similar electrical interfaces.
* Experience establishing production test fixtures and traceability systems.
* Experience working with international companies or overseas engineering teams within regulated manufacturing environment.
* Experience with ISO 9001, ISO 13485 or similar quality systems.
* Engineering degree in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Manufacturing or a related discipline.

**Personal characteristics**

The successful candidate will be:

* Technically credible.
* Hands-on and practical.
* Highly organised.
* Detail-oriented without losing sight of production objectives.
* Comfortable challenging poor processes.
* Calm under production pressure.
* Commercially aware.
* Strong enough to represent Equivital's interests with the manufacturing partner.
* Excellent at communicating technical issues simply and clearly to UK-based colleagues.

**Compliance & Reporting:**

* Ensure compliance with agricultural and environmental regulations for bio-fertilizer storage and handling.
* Prepare and submit Daily reports on warehouse stock levels, quality issues, and incident records.

**Education**

Bachelor of Science (B.Sc.) in Agriculture, Agro Products, or related field.

**Experience**

Minimum 2 years of experience in warehouse operations or quality control in the agriculture or bio-fertilizer industry.

**Key Competencies/Skills:**

* Strong understanding of bio-fertilizer composition, shelf life, and safety standards.
* Knowledge of warehouse logistics, stock management systems, and safety protocols.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and basic inventory management.
* Strong communication and team leadership skills.

**Preferred Certifications (Optional but advantageous):**

Salary Range: As per market standards.

This role demands proactive agreement of project objectives with all internal stakeholders, and management of these objectives within agreed production budgets and timelines. title: Partner Success Manager
description:
**About Kinaxis**
Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!
  
  
In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.
  
  
Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.
  
  
Location
  
  
India
  
  
**About The Role**
The
**Partner Success Manager**
is accountable for helping Kinaxis value added reseller (VAR) partners build productive, scalable, and predictable businesses around Kinaxis solutions. The role connects partner enablement, operating discipline, pipeline governance, and alliance management so that partners are equipped to create demand, progress opportunities, close business, and deliver a consistent customer experience.
  
  
This is a hands-on orchestration role. The Partner Success Manager works across VAR leadership, partner sellers and solution consultants, Kinaxis sales, pre-sales, marketing, services, customer success, operations, and legal teams. The successful candidate combines strong partner relationships with rigorous execution and uses data to identify risks, remove barriers, and improve partner performance.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Develop and manage role-based partner enablement, onboarding, certification, product training, and ongoing knowledge programs.
* Assess partner capabilities, identify readiness gaps, and drive remediation plans with clear milestones and ownership.
* Ensure partners can effectively position Kinaxis solutions, qualify opportunities, and leverage Kinaxis resources.
* Drive adoption of approved tools, processes, programs, and new product/solution launches.
* Establish and improve partner delivery readiness and standards to ensure consistent implementation quality and customer outcomes.
* Manage partner operations, governance, business reviews, pipeline cadence, scorecards, records, approvals, and action tracking.
* Partner with VAR sales leaders to build account plans, campaigns, qualified pipeline, and revenue opportunities.
* Lead pipeline reviews, monitor opportunity progression and CRM hygiene, and coordinate internal resources to advance priority deals.
* Analyze pipeline and sales performance metrics to identify risks and drive corrective actions.
* Build strong executive and functional relationships and develop joint business plans with partners.
* Align Kinaxis and partner stakeholders on priorities, responsibilities, investments, and execution.
* Identify opportunities to expand partner capabilities, market coverage, industry reach, and geographic presence.
* Represent partner needs internally while balancing customer outcomes and Kinaxis business priorities.

**Education Qualification**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant professional experience.

What we are looking for
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales or partner operations.
* Experience working with VARs, system integrators, software partners, or indirect go-to-market models.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software sales cycles, pipeline management, forecasting, account planning, and partner economics.
* Ability to translate strategy into actionable plans, measurable milestones, and effective execution across stakeholders.
* Strong relationship management, communication, presentation, facilitation, and executive engagement skills.
* Strong analytical capabilities with proficiency in CRM, reporting, collaboration, and productivity tools.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities across regions and functions with sound judgment and attention to detail.
* Preferred: Experience in supply chain planning, SaaS, enterprise applications, or digital transformation.
* Preferred: Experience managing global/multi-regional partner portfolios, partner enablement, certifications, demand generation, channel programs, or complex co-sell models.

**#Intermediate, #Senior**
**Work With Impact:**
Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.
  
  
**Work with Fortune 500 Brands:**
Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.
  
  
**Social Responsibility at Kinaxis:**
Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.
  
  
People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:
  
  

* Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
* Flexible work options
* Physical and mental well-being programs
* Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
* Mentorship programs, training, and career development
* Recognition programs and referral rewards
* Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at http://blog.kinaxis.com .
  
  
Kinaxis welcomes candidates to apply to our inclusive community. We provide accommodations upon request to ensure fairness and accessibility throughout our recruitment process for all candidates, including those with specific needs or disabilities. If you require an accommodation, please reach out to us at recruitmentprograms@kinaxis.com. This contact information is for accessibility requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.
  
  
Kinaxis is committed to ensuring a fair and transparent recruitment process. We use artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the initial step of the recruitment process to compare submitted resumes against the job description to identify candidates whose education, experience, and skills most closely match the requirements of the role. After the initial screening, all subsequent decisions regarding your application, including final selection, are made by our human recruitment team. AI does not make any final hiring decisions.

title: Senior Design Manager
description:
**The Team**
**Join a Global Leader in Data Centre Engineering**
Are you ready to shape the future of mission-critical infrastructure?
  
  
At Cundall, we don’t just design buildings, we design change. As a multi-award-winning global consultancy, named UK Building’s Engineering Consultant of the Year in 2024, 2022, and 2021, we’re proud to be at the forefront of innovative, sustainable design.
  
  
Our dedicated Data Centre team is leading the way in making these essential buildings more energy-efficient, sustainable, and cost-effective. If you’re passionate about decarbonising the built environment and want to make a real impact, we want to hear from you.

Ready to make a difference?

**The Role**
This role offers the opportunity to take a senior leadership position within our Data Centre team, overseeing the design management of major projects while contributing to team development, client relationships, and wider business growth.
  
  
Alongside project leadership, you will play a key role in shaping delivery approaches, supporting the development of Design Management capability, and strengthening our position with key clients.

* Leading the design management of major data centre projects or programmes

* Supporting commercial performance, including risk management and project delivery outcomes

You’ll be part of a collaborative, expert team with a strong pipeline of exciting projects. It’s a fantastic environment to grow your skills and make a meaningful contribution.
  
  
**The Skills**
You are a senior professional with a strong track record of delivering complex, multidisciplinary projects and building trusted client relationships. You are comfortable leading teams, influencing delivery strategy, and contributing to business growth.

* Degree in Engineering, or a related discipline

Your career at Cundall

That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**
