title: Director - Functional Systems & Technology
description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.
  
  
**Job Summary**
Comcast’s Residential Billing Strategy & Operations team is taking the next step in expanding its leadership structure by hiring a Director 1 to lead our full India offshore team. All current India based people managers and professionals supporting Comcast Residential Billing Strategy & Operations will report to this role. This role is accountable for CIEC operational performance, talent management, controls, delivery quality, and execution outcomes, while also being the on-the-ground leader responsible for US based counterparts who own functional strategy and product/process decisions. As the Director of Residential Billing Strategy & Operations, this role will lead teams accountable for the performance, reliability, and operations of Comcast’s end-to-end billing ecosystem. This environment processes tens of billions in annual revenue, supports millions of customers, and underpins financial integrity, digital experiences, and the company’s ability to compete and grow. This leader will be accountable to manage teams ensuring enterprise pricing, promotional, and go-to-market (GTM) strategies are accurately delivered, highly governed, and operationally scaled across every billing platform and customer segment. This role will oversee biller related data flows, operational processes, and configuration quality, that translate enterprise decisions into accurate, trusted customer bills, while advancing automation, data intelligence, and AI-enabled capabilities that improve precision, speed, and adaptability. As the senior people leader in the CIEC this role will also be responsible for talent management and strategy inclusive of succession planning, eNPS scores, employee engagement, and hiring processes. The CIEC director will be a senior leader of the Billing Operations team reporting directly to the SVP of the Residential Billing Strategy & Operations team alongside other US based senior leaders. This leader will be expected to own the end to end activities of the team inclusive of capabilities, risks, capacity, talent and execution performance at the enterprise level and be able to own both operations and the transformational change across the org. The ideal candidate is a strong people and operations leader with experience in a global or matrixed environment, ideally within billing, revenue, or other large-scale operational environments. The candidate will be expected to collaborate on a global scale with leaders in the both the US and CIEC.
  
  
**Job Description**
People Leadership & CIEC Operations
  
  

* Lead the full CIEC (India offshore) team supporting Residential Billing Strategy & Operations.
* Collaborate with US based leaders to oversee billing operations teams inclusive of configuration management, pricing and GTM enablement, testing and validation, data governance, analytics and reporting, and operational controls.
* Champion CIEC related continuous improvement efforts inclusive of automation, data intelligence, and AI-enablement initiatives to reduce manual effort, prevent defects, and improve precision, speed, and resiliency across billing processes and revenue-critical systems.
* Develop staff through ongoing training in billing, configuration, revenue assurance, and automation capabilities, as well as operational procedures, policies, communication, and technical skills.
* Create a positive, collaborative, cross-functional atmosphere and process across the CIEC team and with U.S. counterparts.

Billing Operations, Configuration & Execution Quality
  
  

* Ensure CIEC teams deliver accurate, high-quality billing setup, configuration, eligibility logic, rating, taxes, fees, and financial settings.
* Support disciplined execution of rate events, pricing and promotional changes, GTM changes, product launches, migrations, and platform releases.
* Lead CIEC testing, validation, and release-readiness activities to support high-quality, stable, error-free deployments.
* Ensure eligibility rules, offer structures, compatibility logic, and customer pathways are configured and tested to perform as intended for all market-facing offers.
* Work with supervisors and managers to ensure all deliverables meet preset deadlines, specifications, and budgets to achieve financial and business objectives.

Automation, Data Quality & Analytics
  
  

* Improve the efficiency and effectiveness of CIEC operations by establishing and tracking performance metrics, KPIs, dashboards, and reporting that inform operational and financial decisions.
* Lead CIEC automation work as an extension of the broader Billing Operations Continuous Improvement team -- identifying, building, and scaling automation, data intelligence, and AI-enabled solutions that simplify work and improve resiliency across the billing lifecycle.
* Drive continuous improvement of operational workflows, execution consistency, and cost performance through simplification and automation.

Stakeholder Partnership, Delivery & Change Leadership
  
  

* Translate U.S. priorities and enterprise strategies into local operational plans and requirements with measurable outcomes.
* Support prioritization, risk mitigation, and integrated execution of the billing, configuration, pricing-enablement, data, and operational initiatives assigned to CIEC.
* Oversee local planning, communication, readiness, and change adoption for new capabilities and releases of new technology.
* Communicate department strategies and objectives effectively within CIEC and across the broader organization.
* Exercise independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Maintain regular, consistent, and punctual attendance, and performs other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Employees At All Levels Are Expected To**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience - think and act in ways that put our customers first.
* Know your stuff - be enthusiastic learners, users, and advocates of our game-changing technology, products, and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team - make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System, a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company - by joining huddles, making callbacks, and helping elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Respect and promote inclusion - do what’s right for each other, our customers, investors, and our communities.

Comcast Competencies: Director Level 1
  
  

* Shapes the Future - Embracing Innovation & Change - Drives innovation by encouraging and respecting new ideas and championing change.
* Forward Thinking - Shapes and/or aligns efforts with Comcast’s direction, applying a long-term perspective and external awareness.
* Customer Focus - Delivers on commitments to internal and external customers.
* Personal & Team Leadership - Drives oneself and others, contributing to the performance of a strong, diverse team.
* Selecting & Developing Talent - Attracts, develops, and retains critical talent, helping to get the right talent in place for the organization; strong mentoring skills.
* Building Collaborative Relationships - Operates with a OneComcast mindset, building strong and valued working relationships across the company.
* Embodies Our Values - Demonstrates the courage to take a stand when needed.
* Inspiring Trust - Earns the trust of others through authenticity, humility, respect, and credibility.
* Agility & Adaptability - Adapts to changing conditions and challenges, seeking opportunities to continue learning.
* Execution Excellence - Achieves goals through operational excellence, defining a clear path to accomplish objectives.
* Solution Focus - Effectively analyzes issues, making sound, timely decisions and recommendations.
* Financial & Business Acumen - Applies job knowledge, business experience, and financial understanding to make effective decisions.
* Excellent organizational, collaboration, and negotiation skills.
* Highly self-motivated, self-directed, and attentive to detail, with the ability to effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

**Disclaimer:**

description:

Provides technical leadership and drives effective execution of product development, system integration, validation, production support, and continuous product improvement.

Customer Focus: Knowledge of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and ability to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions.

Problem Solving: Knowledge of approaches, tools, techniques for recognizing, anticipating, and resolving organizational, operational or process problems; ability to apply knowledge of problem solving appropriately to diverse situations.

Technical Excellence: Knowledge of a given technology and various application methods; ability to develop and provide solutions to significant technical challenges.

title: Sr Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis
description:
**Job Description Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Manager - Reliability & Root Cause Analysis to lead a multidisciplinary engineering team within the Fleet Intelligence & Reliability organization. The team is responsible for identifying systemic fleet risks, determining the physical and systemic causes of complex failures, and ensuring that corrective and preventive actions deliver measurable and sustainable reliability improvement across the global Solar and Storage installed fleet.
  
  
This role owns the technical governance of Root Cause Analyses for complex, high-impact, recurring, and fleet-wide issues. The manager will ensure that investigations are evidence-based, technically rigorous, and completed with clear accountability from initial containment through corrective-action validation and fleet-risk closure.
  
  
The leader will manage engineers across relevant disciplines, which may include power electronics, electrical systems, mechanical systems, embedded software, plant controls, and systems engineering. The position requires close partnership with Fleet Performance & Analytics, Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Project Engineering, Field Operations, and commercial teams to convert fleet experience into product and operational improvement.
  
  
**Job Description**
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team responsible for fleet reliability, failure investigation, and Root Cause Analysis.
* Own and continuously improve the RCA governance process, including issue prioritization, ownership assignment, technical reviews, milestones, escalation, corrective-action tracking, validation, and closure criteria.
* Lead investigations of complex, high-impact, systemic, and recurring failures affecting solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, plant controls, power conversion equipment, and associated interfaces.
* Ensure investigations are grounded in verified evidence, operating data, event logs, inspection results, failure reproduction, laboratory analysis, engineering calculations, and appropriate structured problem-solving methods.
* Differentiate failure symptoms, direct physical causes, contributing factors, systemic causes, and organizational causes, ensuring that conclusions are supported by evidence.
* Drive immediate containment, short-term mitigation, and permanent corrective and preventive actions with the relevant engineering and operational owners.
* Prioritize investigations using safety exposure, customer impact, availability loss, recurrence, fleet population, warranty exposure, and financial consequence.
* Maintain a fleet-level view of failure modes and systemic risk across products, projects, regions, configurations, software versions, suppliers, and operating environments.
* Partner with Fleet Performance & Analytics to use fleet data, trends, event signatures, and risk models to detect emerging issues, quantify exposure, and verify corrective-action effectiveness.
* Translate field and fleet learning into recommendations for product requirements, design changes, validation plans, software releases, manufacturing processes, supplier controls, maintenance strategies, and technical documentation.
* Provide technical leadership during critical fleet events, customer escalations, and executive-level issue reviews.
* Ensure customer-facing and internal RCA reports are accurate, evidence-based, clear, and delivered in accordance with committed milestones.
* Develop and maintain reusable engineering knowledge, including RCA standards, failure libraries, lessons learned, troubleshooting guides, technical advisories, and investigation templates.
* Support the definition and deployment of Change, Modification, and Upgrade actions resulting from fleet reliability findings.
* Establish and monitor meaningful metrics such as RCA cycle time, milestone adherence, recurrence rate, corrective-action closure, investigation backlog, and quantified fleet-risk reduction.
* Promote a culture of safety, technical rigor, accountability, collaboration, transparency, and continuous improvement.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Control Systems Engineering, Power Electronics, or a related technical field.
* Demonstratable experience in engineering, reliability, failure analysis, product engineering, installed-base engineering, or a related technical function.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical investigations or RCAs involving multidisciplinary systems.
* Demonstrated experience leading engineers, technical teams, or significant cross-functional engineering programs.
* Experience with power generation, renewable energy, battery energy storage, power conversion, industrial automation, or comparable complex industrial equipment.
* Ability and willingness to travel internationally as required.

Desired Characteristics
  
  

* Advanced degree in engineering, reliability, systems engineering, or a related discipline.
* Previous people-leadership experience within a global engineering or technical organization.
* Strong knowledge of solar inverters, battery energy storage systems, power electronics, plant controls, electrical protection, thermal management, and industrial communication networks.
* Experience applying structured investigation methodologies such as Fault Tree Analysis, 5 Whys, Ishikawa analysis, 8D, Kepner-Tregoe, or Failure Mode and Effects Analysis.
* Knowledge of reliability engineering, failure mechanisms, accelerated testing, design validation, reliability growth, and corrective-action effectiveness assessment.
* Experience analyzing operational data, waveforms, alarms, event logs, failed components, inspection evidence, and intervention history.
* Strong systems thinking, technical judgment, and ability to make risk-based decisions with incomplete or evolving information.
* Proven ability to influence Product Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sourcing, Operations, and commercial teams in a matrixed environment.
* Strong customer-facing skills and the ability to communicate sensitive technical findings with clarity, credibility, and appropriate transparency.
* Ability to manage multiple high-priority investigations across a global fleet.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Self-starting attitude with the ability to establish structure, set priorities, develop people, and drive issues through sustainable closure.

******Additional Information******
**Relocation Assistance Provided:**
Yes

title: Vulnerability and Patch Manager
description:
Expleo is a trusted partner for end-to-end, integrated engineering, quality services, and management consulting for digital transformation. We help businesses harness technological change to deliver innovation, improve resilience, and support the secure delivery of complex products, platforms, and systems.
  
  
As part of the Expleo UK Cybersecurity Practice, you will join a managed Cyber Operations service for a major UK energy network operator that forms part of the UK's Critical National Infrastructure (CNI). The service is governed by Expleo in the UK, with a 24/7 UK Security Operations Centre delivered by a specialist partner and an Expleo consultancy team in India providing design, engineering and assurance expertise across the client's security tooling estate.
  
  
As
**Vulnerability and Patch Manager**
, you will lead the vulnerability intelligence, prioritisation and patch advisory service across the client's server, end-user, network and security device estate, coordinating remediation through the client's operational teams and suppliers.
  
  
**This is a design, review and advisory role.**
You will work within Expleo's offshore consultancy team, outside the client's operational environment. You will not have access to the client's operational systems or data and will not make live changes. Operational changes are implemented by UK-based, security-cleared personnel; your work provides the designs, analysis, recommendations and assurance that those changes depend on. You will work from information released to the team through Expleo's controlled UK service boundary.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Responsibilities**

* Lead a continuous vulnerability assessment programme, using outputs from the client's vulnerability management platform released through the UK service boundary.
* Prioritise vulnerabilities using threat-informed criteria (CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV, NCSC advisories and vendor PSIRTs) and produce monthly remediation recommendations.
* Issue critical patch advisories, typically within 24 hours, based on client guidance and credible threat intelligence, to enable expedited remediation by UK-based personnel and client suppliers.
* Produce a monthly report on vendor patch and firmware releases across the server, end-user, mobile, network and security estate.
* Produce OS patch and device firmware compliance reports.
* Consolidate patch and upgrade status reporting for firewalls, intrusion prevention, email gateway, secure web gateway and application control platforms.
* Track intrusion prevention signature (digital vaccine) compliance against the 48-hour target, working with the Security Engineer | Network.
* Maintain the vulnerability exception and risk acceptance register and present items for decision through service governance.
* Prepare and co-facilitate the monthly vulnerability and patch review with the UK Head of Service, client teams and third-party suppliers.
* Carry out targeted vulnerability analysis in support of incidents and investigations when directed.
* Apply safe practice for operational technology (OT) assets, where scanning and patching are constrained.
* Support the growth of Expleo's Cybersecurity Practice through knowledge sharing and technical contribution.

**Qualifications**

* Degree in computer science, cybersecurity or a related discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
* Vulnerability management vendor certification, e.g. Rapid7, Tenable or Qualys (at least one required).
* CompTIA CySA+, PenTest+, GIAC GEVA, or ITIL 4 Foundation would be advantageous.

**Essential Skills**

* Vulnerability management platforms (e.g. Rapid7 InsightVM, Tenable, Qualys) and interpretation of their outputs.
* Patch management processes and tooling (e.g. Intune/MECM, Ivanti, Tanium, BigFix).
* Threat-informed prioritisation using CVSS, EPSS, CISA KEV and vendor advisories.
* Coordinating remediation across internal teams and third-party suppliers.
* Strong reporting and data analysis (Excel, Power BI).
* Clear, concise written advisories for technical and non-technical audiences.

**Desired Skills**

* OT vulnerability management and safe scanning practice.
* Energy, utilities or other CNI sector experience.
* Experience supporting NIS or CAF-aligned assurance reporting.

**Experience**

* 8-12 years in IT security or infrastructure, including 4+ years managing vulnerability and patch management programmes.
* Experience running risk exception and acceptance processes through governance.

**What Do I Need Before I Apply**

* Have the right to work in India.
* Be based in, or willing to relocate to, Chennai.
* Be willing to complete Expleo enhanced pre-employment background screening (equivalent in standard to the UK Baseline Personnel Security Standard) and any additional vetting the client requires.
* Be able to work hours that overlap with the UK business day, with occasional out-of-hours advisory support during major incidents.
* Have excellent written and spoken English, suitable for engagement with senior UK stakeholders.
* Be comfortable working within a strict security boundary, with no access to the client's operational systems or data.

**Benefits**

* Collaborative working environment: we stand shoulder to shoulder with our clients and our peers through good times and challenges.
* We empower all passionate, technology-loving professionals to expand their skills and take part in inspiring projects.
* Expleo Academy enables you to acquire and develop the right skills by delivering a suite of accredited training courses.
* Competitive local company benefits [India HR to confirm the benefits package].
* Always working as one team, our people are not afraid to think big and challenge the status quo.

“We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of their race, sex, disability, religion/belief, sexual orientation or age.”
  
  
If you are an experienced vulnerability management professional who can turn vulnerability data into clear, prioritised action, we encourage you to apply today.

title: Sourcing Business Partner - Crushing
description:

At FLS, we are passionate about creating a sustainable future for the mining industry. As the world's leading full flowsheet technology and service supplier, we partner with customers to improve productivity, reduce operating costs, and minimise environmental impact.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced Strategic Sourcing Manager to lead global sourcing initiatives for our Horizontal Mills product portfolio. This is an exciting opportunity to influence sourcing strategy, build world-class supplier partnerships, and deliver cost, quality, and supply chain improvements across a global business.
  
  
Your Responsibilities
  
  
**Reporting To The Global Supply Chain Team, You Will**

* Develop and execute global sourcing strategies across key commodity categories including castings, forgings, fabricated components, hydraulics, gearboxes, and motors.
* Drive cost optimisation initiatives through spend analysis, supplier consolidation, benchmarking, should-cost modelling, and strategic negotiations.
* Identify, evaluate, qualify, and develop suppliers to ensure best-in-class quality, delivery, cost, and risk management.
* Lead commercial negotiations, including long-term agreements, pricing models, and supplier performance improvements.
* Partner with Engineering, Product Line Management, Manufacturing, Operations, and Quality teams to align sourcing strategies with business objectives.
* Lead value engineering initiatives with suppliers to improve manufacturability, product performance, and overall lifecycle cost.
* Monitor supplier performance through KPIs while developing strong, collaborative supplier relationships.
* Support New Product Introduction (NPI) projects by ensuring sourcing readiness and supplier capability.
* Proactively manage supply chain risks related to commodity markets, logistics, geopolitical events, and supplier capacity.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve supply chain resilience, operational efficiency, and sustainability.

What You Bring
  
  
You are a commercially minded procurement professional who enjoys solving complex supply chain challenges and influencing business outcomes.
  
  
**You Will Also Have**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, or supply chain management within heavy industry, mining equipment, manufacturing, or industrial technology.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in supplier negotiations, cost modelling, spend analysis, and strategic sourcing.
* Excellent analytical, negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience working within a global, cross-functional organisation.
* A collaborative mindset with the ability to build strong relationships across internal teams and supplier networks.

**Preferred Experience**
Experience with horizontal mill components or similar heavy industrial equipment will be highly regarded, along with knowledge of manufacturing processes such as casting, machining, fabrication, and assembly. Professional procurement certifications (CPSM, CSCP or equivalent) and experience with supplier ESG and responsible sourcing practices are advantageous.
  
  
Why Join FLS?
  
  
At FLS, you'll work alongside talented colleagues who are committed to making a meaningful impact on the mining industry while advancing your own career.
  
  
**We Offer**

* Competitive salary and comprehensive employee benefits.
* Health Insurance, Personal Accident & Disability Insurance, Group Life Insurance, annual health checks, and voluntary insurance options.
* 30 days annual leave with the ability to carry forward up to 10 days.
* Flexible working arrangements that support work-life balance.
* Financial support for professional development and continuing education.
* Employee Assistance Program for you and your family.
* Opportunities to work on global projects and collaborate with international teams.
* A culture built on innovation, inclusion, safety, and continuous improvement.

At FLS, we believe diverse teams drive better outcomes. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives.
  
  
To support an inclusive recruitment process, we kindly ask that you exclude personal information such as age, ethnicity, marital status, number of children, and photographs from your application.
  
  
Join FLS and help shape the future of mining through smarter sourcing, stronger supplier partnerships, and sustainable innovation.
  
  
We offer all employees access to a dedicated recognition platform, empowering you to celebrate achievements, share appreciation and stay connected globally.

title: Supervisor, Accounts Receivable
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets.
* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.
* Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows.
* Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members.
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.
* Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.
* Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus.
* Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities.

**Who We Are**
Colgate-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
  
  
Join Colgate-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
  
  
**Role Summary & Purpose**
Championing product integrity and consumer trust, you will architect and deploy the site Quality Master Plan and Quality Manual across Colgate-Palmolive’s high-speed Sri City manufacturing plant. You will drive a rigorous 'Right First Time' operational culture by auditing manufacturing systems, resolving Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) through CAPA, and leading technical bundle validations. Partnering directly with shop-floor operations and global audit teams, you eliminate process variation and customer complaints. Based on-site in Sri City, you ensure every toothbrush manufactured meets world-class quality and safety standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, document, and maintain the site Quality Master Plan, Quality Manual, and Global Quality standards compliance.
* Conduct internal audit programs and participate in Divisional and Corporate Quality Audits to evaluate site quality effectiveness.
* Lead root cause analysis and CAPA closures for all Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) in coordination with plant leadership.
* Manage the online Customer Response System (CRS), analyzing consumer complaints to drive continuous improvement.
* Monitor shop-floor quality KPIs and process capability to ensure all finished products fulfill KRSs (Key Release Specification) prior to market release.
* Deliver structured technical training and coaching to Quality Technicians, Operators, and plant line teams.

**Required Qualifications**

* Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Science or Technical stream (B.Sc / M.Sc / B.Tech) from a recognized university.
* Experience: 3 to 5 years of core experience in the FMCG industry with Quality & Production management responsibility.
* Quality Methodologies: Proven expertise in developing Quality Manuals, executing CAPA, NCR resolution, and process capability monitoring.
* Systems: Working knowledge of SAP (QM module), online CRS complaint management, and quality audit frameworks.

**Preferred Qualification & Experience**

* Industry: Experience in high-volume consumer goods (CPG/FMCG), oral care, or precision plastics manufacturing.
* Audit Expertise: Familiarity with international subsidiary benchmarking, cGMP, and EOHS site standards.
* Soft Skills: Exceptional training, coaching, and people facilitation capabilities with a strong decision-making mindset.
* Commercial Mindset: Understanding of plant financials, product commercialization bundles, and target cost delivery.

• Accuracy and quality of accounting work

• Timely month-end and year-end closure

• Tax and compliance support

• Timely completion of client deliverables

• Process improvement and operational efficiency.

title: Head of Finance
description:
Key Responsibilities
  
A. Financial Planning, MIS & Business Performance
  

· Own the Company's overall financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and performance management process.

· Prepare and present monthly/quarterly MIS, P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow reports to Management.

· Establish appropriate financial KPIs and dashboards for the refining/recycling and real-estate businesses.

· Analyse actual performance against budget, forecast and previous periods and highlight significant variances.

· Provide management with actionable insights on profitability, margins, cash flows and financial risks.

· Develop business-unit-wise profitability analysis.

· Support management in evaluating new business opportunities, investments and expansion plans.

· Establish robust financial controls and reporting systems as the Company scales.

B. P&L, Balance Sheet & Financial Control
  

· Take complete ownership of the Company's P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow.

· Ensure accuracy, completeness and timely closure of monthly and annual accounts.

· Review provisions, accruals, depreciation, inventory valuation, receivables, payables and other balance-sheet items.

· Strengthen balance-sheet controls and ensure appropriate reconciliation of all major accounts.

· Monitor financial health and identify potential risks/issues before they impact the business.

· Ensure adequate internal controls over financial transactions and accounting processes.

C. Precious Metal Refining / E-Waste & Industrial Waste Business
  

· Monitor metal recovery yields, refining costs and processing costs.

· Monitor precious-metal inventory and metal movement.

· Monitor inventory valuation and reconciliation of physical quantities with accounting records.

· Analyse margins based on input material, recovery rates, refining costs and realised metal values.

· Monitor purchase and processing economics for e-waste and industrial waste.

· Work closely with Operations and Procurement to identify cost leakages, process inefficiencies and margin improvement opportunities.

· Establish appropriate controls over high-value inventory and precious metals.

· Monitor exposure arising from fluctuations in precious-metal prices and foreign exchange, wherever applicable.

· Develop MIS covering material input → recovery → refining → sale → margin.

D. Working Capital & Cash Flow Management
  

· Drive effective management of working capital and cash flows.

· Monitor receivables, payables, inventory and cash conversion cycle.

· Establish robust cash-flow forecasting and liquidity planning.

· Closely monitor customer collections and outstanding receivables.

· Develop appropriate credit-control mechanisms and customer exposure limits.

· Optimise vendor payment cycles while maintaining supplier relationships.

· Ensure adequate liquidity for operational and strategic requirements.

· Provide regular cash-flow updates to Management.

E. Accounts Receivable & Payable
  

· Establish strong processes for receivables and collections.

· Monitor ageing and overdue receivables and ensure timely follow-up.

· Review customer credit limits and commercial terms from a financial-risk perspective.

· Ensure timely and accurate processing of vendor invoices and payments.

· Monitor ageing of payables and optimise payment planning.

· Strengthen controls around vendor onboarding, approvals and payments.

F. Direct & Indirect Taxation
  

· Oversee all Income Tax matters, including tax planning, assessments, returns and compliance.

· Coordinate with external tax advisors and consultants where required.

· Ensure timely completion of tax audits, assessments and related proceedings.

· Identify legitimate tax-planning opportunities while maintaining full compliance.

· Ensure complete and timely GST compliance, including returns, reconciliations and related statutory requirements.

· Monitor GST input-credit eligibility and utilisation.

· Ensure appropriate GST treatment of transactions across the refining/recycling and real-estate businesses.

· Coordinate GST audits, notices and assessments.

· Ensure proper reconciliation between books, GST returns and relevant transaction data.

G. FEMA, FDI & International Transactions
  

· Ensure compliance with applicable FEMA and RBI regulations relating to the Company's foreign exchange transactions.

· Oversee compliance relating to FDI, foreign investments, foreign remittances and related reporting, wherever applicable.

· Coordinate with authorised dealer banks, legal/tax advisors and other professionals for FEMA-related matters.

· Ensure timely filing of applicable statutory/regulatory returns and documentation.

· Advise Management on financial and regulatory implications of cross-border transactions.

H. Budgeting & Cost Control
  

· Lead the annual budgeting process across all business verticals.

· Establish departmental and business-unit budgets.

· Monitor actual expenditure against approved budgets.

· Identify cost overruns and implement corrective measures.

· Develop systems for cost monitoring and cost optimisation.

· Analyse manufacturing/refining and administrative costs and identify opportunities for efficiency improvement.

· Ensure appropriate approval mechanisms for capital expenditure and operating expenditure.

I. Audit, Governance & Compliance
  

· Coordinate with Statutory Auditors, Internal Auditors, Tax Auditors and other professional advisors.

· Ensure timely completion of statutory audits and financial reporting.

· Strengthen internal financial controls and processes.

· Ensure compliance with applicable provisions of the Companies Act, Income Tax, GST, FEMA and other relevant laws/regulations.

· Establish appropriate delegation of authority and financial approval controls.

· Ensure proper documentation and audit trails for significant transactions.

J. Real Estate Business
  

· Provide financial oversight for the Company's real-estate activities.

· Monitor project-wise costs, budgets, cash flows and profitability.

· Review project feasibility and financial viability.

· Monitor receivables, project expenditure, vendor payments and financing requirements.

· Analyse project-level profitability and return on investment.

· Ensure appropriate accounting and tax treatment of real-estate transactions.

· Provide Management with regular project-wise financial MIS.

K. Banking & Treasury
  

· Manage the Company's banking relationships.

· Monitor banking facilities, working-capital requirements and financing costs.

· Evaluate funding requirements and optimise the Company's financing structure.

· Monitor interest costs, bank charges and utilisation of credit facilities.

· Maintain adequate liquidity while optimising deployment of surplus funds.

· Support negotiations with banks and financial institutions.

L. Strategic Business Partner to Management
  

· Act as a key financial advisor to the Promoters, MD and senior management.

· Provide financial analysis for strategic and commercial decisions.

· Evaluate business proposals, investments, capex and expansion plans.

· Identify financial and operational risks and recommend mitigation measures.

· Develop financial models for new projects and business initiatives.

· Challenge commercial decisions constructively from a profitability, cash-flow and risk perspective.

· Bring financial discipline and data-driven decision-making across the organisation.

M. Team Leadership
  

· Lead and develop the Finance & Accounts team.

· Define responsibilities, processes and performance metrics for the finance function.

· Build a strong culture of accuracy, accountability, compliance and financial discipline.

· Improve finance processes through technology, automation and appropriate ERP/MIS systems.

· Mentor team members and build a strong second line within the finance function.

N. Key Deliverables / Success Measures
  

· Accurate and timely monthly financial closure and MIS.

· Strong control over P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow.

· Improved working-capital cycle.

· Better receivable collections and payable management.

· Effective budgetary control and reduction of unnecessary costs.

· Zero/low compliance slippages and strong tax governance.

· Robust controls over precious-metal inventory and recovery economics.

· Clear visibility of business-unit-wise profitability.

· Strong financial controls and audit readiness.

· Effective FEMA/FDI and regulatory compliance.

· Improved financial planning and forecasting.

· High-quality financial insights for Management and Promoters.

Requirements
  
  
Candidate Profile
  

· CA (Chartered Accountant) preferred.

· Candidates with CA qualification and strong industry experience will be preferred.

· Additional qualifications such as MBA/Finance, CFA or equivalent would be an advantage.

· Approximately 12–18+ years of relevant experience, preferably with significant experience in a mid-sized or growing organisation.

· Experience in manufacturing, recycling, metals, refining, commodities, e-waste, mining or similar high-value inventory business would be highly desirable.

· Experience managing multiple business verticals, including real estate, will be an advantage.

· Strong exposure to taxation, GST, FEMA/FDI, treasury and financial controls is essential.

Key Competencies
  

· Strong accounting and financial-control fundamentals.

· Excellent understanding of P&L, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow.

· Strong taxation and regulatory knowledge.

· Good understanding of GST, Income Tax, FEMA and FDI regulations.

· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

· Commercial and business-oriented mindset.

· Strong working-capital and cash-flow management skills.

· Ability to understand operational processes and translate them into financial impact.

· Experience in cost control and performance management.

· Strong communication and presentation skills.

· Ability to work closely with Promoters, MD/CEO and business heads.

· High integrity and strong ownership mindset.

· Ability to operate effectively in a hands-on, entrepreneurial mid-sized organisation.

Preferred Background
  

· Precious metals / metal refining

· E-waste recycling

· Industrial waste recycling

· Metals & commodities

· Manufacturing / process industries

· Mining / mineral processing

· Chemicals / refining

· High-value inventory businesses

· Real estate / property development

· Diversified mid-sized private companies

Ideal Candidate Profile
  

· The ideal candidate should be a hands-on Finance Leader rather than a purely accounting-oriented professional.

· The candidate should be capable of moving seamlessly between Accounting → Tax → Compliance → Treasury → Cost Control → Business MIS → Working Capital → Commercial Analysis → Strategic Decision Support.

· The person should have the maturity to work directly with the Promoters/MD, the analytical ability to understand the economics of a precious-metal refining business, and the execution capability to establish strong financial discipline across the organisation.

· The role carries significant responsibility for financial control, profitability, cash generation, regulatory compliance and supporting the Company's next phase of growth.

title: KYC Operations Team Lead
description:
As a KYC Operations Team Lead you will oversee the daily operations of a team of KYC Analysts. Your team is responsible for conducting thorough customer due diligence reviews, analyzing various customer and business activities, and ensuring that our KYC records are kept up to date according to our internal policies. The KYC Operations Team Lead is a people lead with a mindset focused on building processes that put our customers first while being aware of the risks surrounding the industry and the wider regulatory environment.

**Job Responsibilities**

**Team Leadership**

Lead by example and drive a customer focused mindset across your team. Promote a culture of ownership and accountability. Build high-performing teams that value knowledge sharing and continuous learning

**People management:**
Coach and develop a strong team of KYC Analysts. Come up with initiatives to help your team to grow their skills, behaviors, and competencies. Design and manage development plans on identified opportunities. Conducts career map check-ins and makes recommendations for promotions, salary raises, and other decisions

**Operational management**

Identify and propose opportunities for process improvements. Collaborate with central functions and other operational teams as needed to increase operational efficiency. Provide guidance and support on complex, high-risk cases and escalations, which may include acting as a direct point of contact for customers via email, phone, or video call during sensitive inquiries, interviews, or escalations

**Performance management**

Measure team KPIs and ensure performance targets and quality standards are met while maintaining focus on customer experience. Conduct regular one on one coaching sessions, usually on a weekly or biweekly basis. Run team meetings to ensure that your team is kept up to date with the latest information, share best practices and enhance overall team spirit

**Expertise Sharing**

Be a subject matter expert in your area with the ability to train and coach your team on operational topics. Maintain a good understanding of our regulatory obligations, internal policies, and applying a risk-based approach to deterring and preventing money laundering and financial crime. Able to perform deep dives, understand root causes of problematic cases and propose solutions to senior leadership

**Planning and execution**

Ensure key performance indicators are being met and provide insights to other stakeholders. Take full accountability in delivering your own initiatives and making sure your team is making progress on their goals

**Stakeholder management and communication**

Collaborate closely with your stakeholders ensuring clear communication and coordination of actions. You communicate mindfully and professionally while choosing the right formats and platforms to convey your message to a wider audience in a timely manner. Your initiatives and reports are well documented and it has a clear scope that includes potential impact in different areas

**Quality assurance and control**

Implement and maintain a robust quality assurance framework for your team. Conduct regular checks and reviews of your team’s casework to ensure accuracy, consistency, and adherence to the highest standards of our policies and regulatory obligations. Provide targeted coaching and constructive feedback based on quality findings to drive continuous improvement. Analyse quality metrics to identify trends, address root causes of errors, and develop initiatives that enhance the team's overall performance and mitigate risk

**Qualifications**

* Excellent verbal and written English skills (additional language skills are a plus) with the ability to clearly articulate your thoughts
* A minimum of 2+ years of experience in Operations (preferably in CDD/EDD/AML or Risk Assessment domain)
* Good understanding of the regulatory framework surrounding KYC/AML
* You are punctual, independent, proactive and willing to get things done.
* You are a fast learner, willing to become a Subject Matter Expert for your team and support them in their problem solving.
* You have excellent communication and interpersonal skills, strong organisational skills, great time management, and ability to work in a fast paced and high pressure environment.
* Ability to multi-task and take responsibility in challenging situations.
* You are capable of identifying gaps in policies and processes and providing detailed feedback, including examples when possible, through the established communication channels.
* Proven track record of taking individual ownership and responsibilities as well as being a great team-player.
* Ability to analyze and move the team's metrics.

**Nice to have:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Law, or related field.
* Certifications: ICA, CAMS, or equivalent certification (EDD/AML focused)
* 1-2 years experience in KYC/AML, financial crime, compliance, or a related field within the financial services industry
* 1-2 years experience of leading small to medium sized teams.
* Ability to use analytics tools like, looker, superset, or other.

title: Manager, Corporate Administration
description:
**Company Description**
**ABOUT IQ-EQ**
We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide.  We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms.
  
  
Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.
  
  
Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.
  
  
We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.
  
  
**Job Description**
**This Role**
Provides operational leadership, governance oversight, and stakeholder management for the GCD Client Administration Team, ensuring high-quality service delivery, regulatory compliance, risk management, resource optimisation, and continuous team development in support of Jersey FAM's outsourced administration function.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* You'll support the Director in overseeing the GCD Client Administration Team, ensuring high-quality, accurate, and timely administration services, maintaining strong relationships with Jersey stakeholders, and providing governance, KPI, CRB, capacity, and management reporting in line with agreed service standards.
* You'll monitor service delivery, team performance, utilisation, capacity, risks, incidents, complaints, breaches, and operational issues, providing analysis, escalation, corrective actions, and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance efficiency, quality, consistency, and control effectiveness.
* You'll provide leadership, coaching, technical guidance, and people development support, including workload allocation, performance management, recruitment, onboarding, training, CPD compliance, career development, succession planning, and fostering a collaborative, high-performing team culture.
* You'll maintain strong working knowledge of fund and company administration activities, including banking and payments, CDD, onboarding, investor transactions, drawdowns and distributions, financing arrangements, company secretarial matters, statutory records, and regulatory filing requirements to effectively support and guide the team.
* You'll promote compliance, risk awareness, and adherence to policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices; support Jersey outsourcing due diligence and risk assessments; coordinate governance actions; and deputise for the Director in operational, stakeholder, and governance discussions when required.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive Total Rewards Package: Comprehensive annual compensation including basic salary, HRA, special allowance, provident fund, gratuity, internet allowance, and food allowance.
* Health & Insurance Coverage: Medical insurance, group term life insurance, and personal accident insurance.
* Allowances & Support: Transportation/transport allowance and shift allowance.
* Paid Time Off: Generous leave policy to support work–life balance.

**Qualifications**
**About You**

* You hold a Corporate Secretarial qualification, ICSA, STEP Diploma, or another relevant professional qualification, with a strong understanding of fiduciary responsibilities and the regulatory framework governing Fund Services Business.
* You possess a sound understanding of industry best practices relating to fund and company administration, including fiduciary operations and governance standards.
* You have a minimum of 7 years' relevant industry experience, preferably within Private Equity, Real Estate, or other related asset classes.
* You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, including Excel, Outlook, and Word, and can effectively utilise these tools for reporting, analysis, and communication.
* You have a proven ability to work effectively under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet tight deadlines while consistently delivering high-quality outcomes for teams, service lines, and clients.

**Additional Information**
**OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU AND THE ENVIRONMENT**
Sustainability is integral to our strategy and operations. Our sustainability depends on us building and maintaining long-term relationships with all our stakeholders – including our employees, clients, and local communities – while also reducing our impact on our natural environment.
  
  
There is always more we can, and should do, to improve – whether in relation to our people, our clients, our planet, or our governance. Our ongoing success as a business depends on our sustainability and agility in a changing and challenging global landscape. We’re committed to fostering an inclusive, equitable and diverse culture for our people, led by our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion steering committee.
  
  
Our learning and development programmes and systems (including PowerU and MyCampus) enable us to invest in growing our employees’ careers, while our hybrid working approach supports our employees in achieving balance and flexibility while remaining connected to their colleagues. We want to empower our 6,500+ employees - from 94 nationalities, across 24 countries - to each achieve their potential. Through IQ-EQ Launchpad we support women managers launching their first fund, in an environment where only 15% of all private equity and venture capital firms are gender balanced.
  
  
We’re committed to growing relationships with our clients and supporting them in achieving their objectives. We understand that our clients’ sustainability and success lead to our sustainability and success. We’re emotionally invested in our clients right from the beginning.

title: Senior Manager, Technical Services
description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high-quality medicines worldwide.
  
  
At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
  
  
USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
  
  
**Brief Job Overview**
The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support (India) is a strategic people leadership role responsible for overseeing the India-based Technical Services team and supporting the continued growth and evolution of USP's global Technical Services function. This position plays a critical role in ensuring the delivery of high-quality scientific product/service inquiry support, operational excellence, and an exceptional customer experience while fostering a high-performing, customer-centric culture.
  
  
The role operates within a matrixed leadership structure, functionally reporting to the Senior Director, Customer Success & Operations (US-based) and administratively reporting to the Director, Scientific Affairs (India-based). The incumbent will provide direct people leadership and administrative oversight for the India-based Technical Services team while partnering closely with the US-based Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides functional direction related to service delivery processes, performance standards, and inquiry management activities.
  
  
As USP continues to expand its global service delivery capabilities, this role is expected to evolve in scope and strategic impact, contributing to organizational scaling efforts, talent development, operational excellence initiatives, knowledge management, process optimization, workforce planning, and the advancement of global scientific and product/service support capabilities.
  
  
The Sr. Manager will collaborate extensively with stakeholders across Customer Success & Operations, Strategic Customer Development, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Reference Material Support, Reference Standards Technical Operations, Reference Standards Production, Distribution, Reference Standards Evaluation, Legal, Documentary Standards and Compendial Policy, Global Biologics, and other cross-functional teams located in both the United States and India.
  
  
The primary working shift for this position is 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST.
  
  
**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence-based decision-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
  
  
Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results-driven work environments.
  
  
The Sr. Manager, Technical Services Support role has the following responsibilities:
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**People Leadership & Team Management**

* Provide leadership, guidance, direction, and administrative oversight to the India-based Technical Services team, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, continuous improvement, and customer-centricity.
* Integrate employee engagement principles into daily leadership practices to cultivate a high-performing, motivated, and inclusive team environment, led by example through visible leadership and active coaching.
* Manage all aspects of employee performance, including goal setting, communicating job expectations, performance evaluations, coaching, mentoring, career development, recognition, corrective action, and succession planning.
* Partner with the Customer Success and Operations leadership team to support workforce planning, talent acquisition, onboarding, employee retention, and capability development initiatives as the Technical Services organization continues to evolve and expand.
* Ensure team members have access to the appropriate resources, tools, training, and support required to effectively perform their responsibilities.

**Service Delivery & Operational Excellence**

* Partner closely with the Senior Manager, Technical Services Operations, who provides the functional strategy and strategic direction for the Global Technical Services, to effectively execute and operationalize the Technical Services operating model within India.
* Translate established strategies, processes, policies, procedures, training programs, and service delivery standards into consistent day-to-day execution, ensuring high-quality, efficient, and scalable service delivery.
* Provide local operational leadership, monitor performance and adherence to standards, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement that strengthen team effectiveness, service quality, and overall customer experience.
* Ensure adherence to applicable USP Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), Department Controlled Documents, Operational Manuals, quality requirements such as audit readiness, and regulatory expectations.
* Monitor team performance against established service levels, quality standards, productivity goals, and customer experience objectives, implementing corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives as needed.
* Utilize operational data, performance metrics, and customer feedback to identify trends, opportunities, and risks that support ongoing optimization of the Technical Services function.
* Support organizational initiatives focused on operational scalability, process harmonization, knowledge management, and service excellence.

**Scientific Inquiry Management & Quality Oversight**

* Maintain a strong understanding of USP products, services, scientific resources, and customer support processes to effectively lead and support the team.
* Remain proficient in the functionality and use of Salesforce, including the Case Management Module and related service technologies.
* Conduct case quality reviews and quality assurance assessments for both US- and India-based Technical Services team members to ensure consistency, accuracy, and compliance with established standards.
* Support the development and maintenance of knowledge assets, best practices, training materials, and quality improvement initiatives that enhance inquiry resolution effectiveness.
* Serve as a first point of escalation and directly manage customer inquiries as needed based on business demands, inquiry complexity, volume fluctuations, or resource requirements.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Support**

* Collaborate with Customer Success & Operations, Scientific Affairs, Quality Assurance, Customer Service, Legal, Distribution, Global Science teams, and other cross-functional stakeholders to support customer and organizational objectives.
* Facilitate effective communication and alignment between India-based team members and global stakeholders, helping to ensure consistency in service delivery and execution.
* Contribute to the continued evolution of USP's global Technical Services operating model by identifying opportunities to enhance team capabilities, operational effectiveness, and customer outcomes.
* Participate in special projects, strategic initiatives, organizational transformation efforts, and other duties as assigned, supporting the long-term growth and maturity of the Technical Services function.

**Who is USP Looking For?**
The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
  
  

* Master's degree in chemistry or relevant scientific field
* Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in the pharmaceutical field, which includes hands-on experience and expertise in chromatography, spectroscopy, and other analytical testing methods.
* Minimum of 2 years of management experience.
* Must demonstrate a strong customer-centric mindset with a consistent focus on delivering high-quality service, responsiveness, and customer satisfaction in a regulated or technical environment.
* Must have experience translating scientific or technical expertise into effective customer support, issue resolution, and service excellence outcomes within cross-functional teams.
* Must be willing to work in 2:00 PM – 10:30 PM IST shift.

**Additional Desired Preferences**

* Willingness to travel to USP–Rockville for initial training purposes for approximately 2–4 weeks
* Knowledge of USP standards-setting processes, compendial terminology, USP Documentary Standards, and USP reference materials
* Familiarity with laboratory workflows and ability to interpret customer issues related to reference materials and analytical testing to support effective resolution
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and manage a high volume of work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail
* Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage competing priorities effectively
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively within a matrixed, global team environment
* Ability to maintain composure, professionalism, and positive engagement in high-pressure or time-sensitive situations
* Willingness and ability to work flexible and/or extended hours when required to support global operations and customer needs
* Sufficient typing skills to support efficient case documentation and system usage
* Preferred but not required: experience using Salesforce CRM or similar case management systems

**Supervisory Responsibilities**
Will lead a team of 5 scientists responsible for managing customer inquiries related to USP Documentary Standards and USP Physical Materials.
  
  
**Benefits**
USP provides the benefits to protect yourself and your family today and tomorrow. From company-paid time off and comprehensive healthcare options to retirement savings, you can have peace of mind that your personal and financial well-being is protected.
  
  
Note: USP does not accept unsolicited resumes from 3rd party recruitment agencies and is not responsible for fees from recruiters or other agencies except under specific written agreement with USP.
  
  
**Job Category**
Chemistry & Scientific Standards
  
  
**Job Type**
Full-Time

title: Vice President, Project Management Lead
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
15
  
  
**The Team**
The Portfolio Management team drives enterprise-wide strategic agendas with cross-functional authority and visibility. The team partners closely with senior business leaders to bring structure, rigor, strategic clarity, and integrated oversight to the organization’s most critical decisions and initiatives. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, financial performance, and operational execution, the team shapes prioritization, resource allocation, governance, and delivery across a complex global organization.
  
  
**The Role**
The Vice President, Project Management Lead is a senior enterprise leader accountable for the end-to-end governance and execution of a portfolio of complex strategic programs, with a particular focus on M&A, integrations, separations, and enterprise transformation. The role establishes the delivery architecture, decision forums, operating cadence, and performance transparency required to move initiatives from strategy through execution and value realization.
  
  
Working across business units, corporate functions, workstream leaders, transaction owners, external advisors, and suppliers, the Vice President creates alignment where authority is distributed, anticipates enterprise-level risks, and enables timely executive decisions. The role is expected to combine strategic judgment, financial and commercial acumen, rigorous program leadership, and the presence to influence C-suite and Executive Committee stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Enterprise Portfolio and Program Leadership

+ Own enterprise portfolio and project management for priority M&A and strategic transformation initiatives, from initial mobilization and planning through execution, Day 1 readiness, stabilization, and value realization.
+ Design the end-to-end program structure, including scope, outcomes, workstreams, governance, decision rights, integrated plans, milestones, deliverables, critical paths, dependencies, resourcing assumptions, and escalation protocols.
+ Translate enterprise strategy and transaction objectives into executable roadmaps with clear accountabilities, measurable outcomes, and transparent progress against commitments.
+ Lead multiple interconnected initiatives as an integrated portfolio, balancing strategic value, capacity, risk, timing, cost, and organizational readiness.
+ Provide direct leadership and strategic support to the applicable Project Management Office lead, workstream PMs, and functional delivery teams, establishing consistent standards and ways of working.

* Governance and Executive Decision Support

+ Establish and chair effective governance routines, including executive steering committees, portfolio reviews, transaction management forums, workstream reviews, and risk and readiness sessions.
+ Clarify decision rights and escalation paths; maintain a disciplined record of critical decisions, assumptions, dependencies, open issues, and executive actions.
+ Prepare concise, decision-oriented materials for C-suite and Executive Committee audiences, including portfolio dashboards, investment scorecards, readiness views, risk and dependency analyses, and recommendations.
+ Synthesize complex inputs across functions and workstreams into a coherent enterprise narrative that highlights choices, trade-offs, implications, and required decisions.
+ Ensure governance is proportionate to program complexity and enables pace without compromising control, accountability, or quality.

* M&A, Integration and Separation Execution

+ Develop and manage the integrated transaction plan, including milestones, deliverables, critical paths, Day 1 readiness, integration or separation priorities, transition activities, and post-close stabilization.
+ Coordinate critical cross-functional workstreams, which may include Transition Service Agreements, operating model design, technology and data separation, revenue reconciliation, finance, people, legal, compliance, communications, commercial readiness, and customer continuity.
+ Drive scope clarity across each workstream, explicitly defining what is in scope, out of scope, deferred, dependent on another decision, or subject to transitional arrangements.
+ Connect transaction strategy to operational execution, ensuring interdependencies are visible and that functional plans converge into an integrated enterprise outcome.
+ Partner with transaction owners and external advisors to maintain pace, resolve ambiguity, and adapt plans as deal assumptions or business conditions evolve.

* Financial Oversight and Value Realization

+ Partner with Finance and business leaders to build and maintain the integrated financial view of the portfolio, including approved investment, transaction-related costs, synergies, dis-synergies, ongoing run-rate impacts, and value capture.
+ Establish benefit-realization disciplines that connect business cases to named owners, baselines, timing, milestones, performance measures, and executive reporting.
+ Challenge financial assumptions and delivery forecasts, identify variance drivers, and ensure corrective actions are defined when value, cost, or timing moves off plan.
+ Enable prioritization and resource-allocation decisions through transparent analysis of strategic value, financial return, capacity constraints, execution risk, and opportunity cost.

* Risk, Dependency and Readiness Management

+ Own the enterprise view of program risk, issues, assumptions, and dependencies, with particular focus on cross-workstream impacts that may not be visible within individual functions.
+ Anticipate execution barriers and decision bottlenecks; develop practical mitigation, contingency, and recovery plans before they threaten critical milestones.
+ Define readiness criteria and evidence-based assessments for major milestones, including Day 1, cutover, launch, close, transition exit, and stabilization.
+ Escalate material risks with clear context, business implications, options, and recommendations rather than reporting status alone.
+ Ensure lessons learned are translated into stronger portfolio standards, reusable playbooks, and improved enterprise delivery capability.

* Stakeholder, Supplier and Team Leadership

+ Influence and integrate senior leaders and delivery teams across a highly matrixed, global environment, frequently without direct or formal authority.
+ Build trusted relationships with workstream leads, transaction owners, functional executives, external advisors, and suppliers while maintaining constructive challenge and accountability.
+ Set clear expectations for delivery quality, communication, issue resolution, and executive engagement across internal teams and third parties.
+ Lead, coach, and develop project and portfolio management talent; create clarity of roles, delegate effectively, and build a high-performing culture focused on outcomes and enterprise value.
+ Model inclusive leadership, sound judgment, resilience, and calm execution in high-pressure and confidential environments.

* Portfolio Management Standards and Continuous Improvement

+ Design and embed scalable portfolio-management standards, stage gates, prioritization models, templates, reporting disciplines, and benefit-realization practices.
+ Use appropriate delivery methods, including predictive, Agile, SAFe, and hybrid approaches, based on the nature and risk profile of the initiative.
+ Promote high-quality portfolio data and practical use of tools and analytics to improve transparency, forecasting, scenario planning, and executive decision-making.
+ Act as an enterprise subject matter expert, applying external practices and internal lessons to strengthen the organization’s ability to execute complex change.

**Compensation/Benefits Information:**
(This section is only applicable to US candidates)
  
  
S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $176,300 to $314,600. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses and certifications.
  
  
In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible for an annual incentive plan.
  
  
This role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**
**Basic Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Economics, Engineering, Technology, or another relevant discipline.
