title: Manager, Technical Services
description:
At MongoDB, we are transforming industries and empowering developers to build amazing applications that people use every day. We are a leading developer data platform, helping organizations build, scale, and operate modern applications.
  
  
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.
  
  
We are looking for a Manager, Technical Services to lead and grow a team in Gurugram. This leader will manage engineers supporting customers across MongoDB’s database, cloud, and emerging application-platform capabilities. The role is well suited to a people leader who can build a high-performing, inclusive team; lead complex customer situations; and partner effectively with Engineering, Product, and go-to-market teams.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
The role
  
  
As a Manager, Technical Services, you will lead a team of highly skilled support engineers. You will create the conditions for excellent customer outcomes, develop technical and people leadership capability within the team, and help scale the support model for evolving customer workloads.
  
  
Your team will support a broad range of technologies, including MongoDB database and cloud services, distributed applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, observability, and modern AI-enabled application workflows. You will help establish durable operating practices for a fast-growing area while ensuring seamless collaboration with the wider global Technical Services organization.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of Technical Services Engineers, including regular 1:1s, clear goals, performance feedback, career development, and succession planning
* Build an inclusive, accountable, and customer-focused team culture where engineers can do their best work
* Own regional service delivery for your team, balancing customer experience, case health, quality, operational discipline, and team sustainability
* Lead and coordinate high-impact customer escalations, ensuring timely communication, sound technical judgment, clear ownership, and effective follow-through
* Partner with Engineering, Product, Security, Customer Success, Sales, and other Technical Services teams to resolve complex issues and bring customer feedback into product and process improvements
* Work with global peers to maintain consistent follow-the-sun processes, effective handoffs, and high-quality support across regions
* Help scale support for modern application workloads involving APIs, cloud services, distributed systems, containers, observability, data services, and AI-enabled application workflows, including agent orchestration, model and tool integrations, MCP, retrieval, memory, and production reliability considerations
* Establish and improve team operating mechanisms, including incident management, case reviews, root-cause analysis, knowledge management, quality practices, and capacity planning
* Identify recurring customer issues and drive improvements to self-service content, diagnostic tooling, runbooks, and support processes
* Participate in hiring and onboarding, and build a strong local talent pipeline
* Use operational metrics and customer feedback to identify trends, communicate performance, and prioritize improvements
* Contribute to regional and global Technical Services initiatives that improve the customer experience, operational efficiency, and technical capability of the organization

What you’ll bring
  
  
**Required**

* 3+ years of experience leading a technical support, customer engineering, site reliability, operations, or similar customer-facing technical team
* Demonstrated success developing people, managing performance, hiring strong talent, and building inclusive, high-performing teams
* Experience coordinating complex or high-severity customer escalations and working effectively with Engineering and Product organizations
* Strong technical foundation in troubleshooting production systems, with the ability to guide structured investigations across application, infrastructure, network, identity, and data layers
* Experience with one or more of cloud platforms, distributed systems, databases, containerized workloads, APIs, observability, or enterprise software
* Foundational knowledge of AI-enabled applications and agentic workflows, with the ability to assess technical judgment in areas such as agents, model-provider integrations, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), retrieval and memory, orchestration, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop workflows
* Strong customer advocacy and sound judgment under pressure, with the ability to set expectations and drive issues to resolution
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to adapt communication for technical, business, and executive audiences
* Experience translating organizational objectives into clear team priorities, measurable outcomes, and individual goals
* A collaborative, pragmatic leadership style and the ability to operate effectively across global, cross-functional teams

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting MongoDB, MongoDB Atlas, or another database or distributed data platform
* Experience with cloud-native technologies, such as AWS, Azure, or GCP; Docker; Kubernetes; networking; identity and access management; or CI/CD systems
* Familiarity with logs, metrics, traces, alerting, incident response, and root-cause analysis
* Experience supporting developer platforms, platform services, or AI-enabled applications
* Experience using operational metrics, dashboards, or scorecards to improve support performance and customer outcomes

Success in the role
  
  
Within 30 days
  
  

* Complete MongoDB onboarding and build rapport with the team and key partners
* Develop a working understanding of the Technical Services operating model, customer support processes, and product portfolio
* Establish a regular 1:1 cadence and begin assessing team strengths, development opportunities, and operational priorities

Within 60 days
  
  

* Build productive relationships with peer managers and stakeholders in Engineering, Product, Customer Success, Sales, and Escalation Management
* Understand regional and global follow-the-sun workflows, escalation processes, and the team’s current performance measures
* Begin contributing to regional escalations, case reviews, and team operating rhythms

Within 90 days
  
  

* Own the day-to-day leadership of the team, including development planning, performance management, and delivery oversight
* Identify opportunities to improve team efficiency, knowledge sharing, customer experience, or technical readiness
* Define a practical plan for scaling the team’s capability and operational maturity over the following 6–12 months

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.

title: Head of Operations, Voice of India
description:
**Head of Operations, Voice of India**

**Josh Talks · Voice of India · Full-time · Gurgaon**

**About Josh Talks**

Josh Talks helps enterprises, governments and not-for-profits make better decisions about which AI services to buy and deploy, through independent, human-powered evaluation. Voice of India, its evaluation platform, sits at the centre of this work.

Josh Talks began as one of India's largest regional-language storytelling platforms, and the reach it built over a decade now underpins its work in AI.

**About Voice of India**

Voice of India is India's first human-powered multimodal evaluation platform, built by Josh Talks and co-developed with IIT Madras. It measures how well AI models work for the people of India, in their own languages and on the tasks they care about.

Our founding principle is that AI should be judged by people, not by other AI systems. Every ranking is backed by independent human evaluation, a published methodology and transparent evidence, rather than vendor claims or automated judges.

Live leaderboards today cover speech to text, text to speech, speech to speech and text to image, across 15 Indian languages. Leaderboards for language models, translation, legal tasks, document OCR, video and AI agents are in development. What sets the platform apart:

* **Independent human judgment.**

  Evaluations are carried out by people under blind conditions. Model names remain hidden until a judgment is recorded, the order of answers is randomised, and no vendor evaluates its own model.
* **Built for procurement.**

  Results are designed to inform procurement and deployment decisions. Scores are broken down by language, domain, geography and use case.
* **Academically rigorous.**

  Every benchmark follows a published protocol with sound statistics and reproducible experiments.
* **Built from how India speaks.**

  The speech to text benchmark uses 536 hours of unscripted telephone conversations from 36,691 speakers across 139 regional clusters. Its test set is closed, so models cannot be trained on it.
* **Sovereign and global models side by side.**

  Indian and global, open-source and proprietary models are ranked on the same boards.

**Milestones so far**

Since its launch, Voice of India has established itself as an independent reference for AI evaluation in India:

* **Government engagement at launch.**

  Launched in New Delhi on 4 August 2026. Shri S. Krishnan, Secretary, Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology, attended the launch.
* **Financial regulators in attendance.**

  Representatives of the Reserve Bank Innovation Hub (RBIH) and the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) attended the launch.
* **Peer-reviewed research.**

  The speech to text benchmark is described in a paper accepted at Interspeech 2026.
* **Trusted by model providers.**

  Global and Indian model providers submit their models to Voice of India for evaluation and re-evaluation.

Press coverage:
Business Standard, 4 August 2026

**About the role**

Josh Talks is hiring a Head of Operations to own Voice of India end to end. You will decide what Voice of India evaluates, run every evaluation from methodology to publication, make each release widely cited, and build the engine that keeps it rigorous and low-cost to run.

The pace is the defining feature of this role. Voice of India aims to publish a new evaluation almost every week, and to be the first in the world to put numbers on every major new model for India. You will set that cadence and hold it.

This role requires a high agency person who is hands on and not afraid to get their hands dirty. You will work directly with the founders of Josh Talks, our research and engineering teams, and the leads for enterprise partnerships and policy, and you will be accountable for what Voice of India publishes and its influence on AI deployment in the country.

**How we work**

This is a senior role by title, but it does not sit above the work. Our founder is deeply hands-on and involved in every detail of the company, from the wording of a methodology to the timing of a release, and expects the same of you.

* **Know every moving part.**

  You will understand how every evaluation works, from the data and the raters to the leaderboard, and know every word of every methodology document.
* **Own every evaluation.**

  Every evaluation Voice of India publishes is either written by you or thoroughly reviewed by you before it goes out.
* **Stay close to the detail.**

  You will work side by side with the founder on the details that decide whether a release is credible, rather than managing from a distance.

**How this role is measured**

We believe the companies that matter in AI right now will be the ones that move fastest without losing rigour. Speed is therefore the primary measure of this role:

* **Speed of releases.**

  How quickly you ship new evaluations and put numbers on every major new model.
* **Speed of partnerships.**

  How quickly you turn conversations with labs, enterprises and government into working partnerships.
* **Speed of impact.**

  How quickly Voice of India's evaluations come to shape how AI is deployed in India.

If you would rather read the methodology than a summary of it, if a late release keeps you up at night, and if you want to work with a founder who cares about every detail as much as you do, you will feel at home here. If you are looking for a role where you manage from a distance, this is not it.

**In this role, you will**
**Ship a new evaluation almost every week**

* **Decide what to evaluate.**

  Choose the models, tasks, languages and use cases that matter most, and own the evaluation calendar.
* **Design the methodology.**

  Work with our research team to define the protocol, test sets, rater instructions and statistics for each evaluation.
* **Run production.**

  Coordinate raters, vendors, data and engineering so each evaluation is delivered on time and to standard.
* **Publish.**

  Release results, leaderboards and methodology notes that stand up to scrutiny.

**Be first in the world to put numbers on every major new model**

* **Track every major release.**

  Follow new models from global and Indian labs as they launch.
* **Keep evaluations ready to run.**

  Maintain the pipelines, test sets and rater capacity needed to evaluate a new model within days of its release.
* **Publish first.**

  Make Voice of India the first credible source of results for how each major model performs in Indian languages and conditions.

**Make every release widely cited**

* **Plan each release.**

  Give every evaluation a clear headline finding and a release plan, working with our communications team.
* **Reach the people who matter.**

  Ensure labs, researchers and the press see, discuss and cite each release.
* **Build credibility quickly.**

  Respond to questions on methodology openly, establish collaborations across industry and government and publish corrections where needed.

**Get Voice of India adopted by enterprises and government**

* **Make scores part of AI decisions.**

  Work with our Lead - AI Partnerships, India and our VP, Policy Programs & Partnerships so that a Voice of India score becomes part of how Indian enterprises and government choose AI.
* **Shape evaluations around real decisions.**

  Turn what enterprises and government need to know into evaluations Voice of India can deliver.

**Build a low-cost, rigorous evaluation engine**

* **Raters.**

  Build and manage a reliable network of human raters across Indian languages, with clear quality controls.
* **Vendors.**

  Select and manage data, annotation and technology vendors, and get quality work from people you do not fully control.
* **Tooling.**

  Work with engineering to build the tools that make each evaluation faster and cheaper to run.
* **Cost and quality.**

  Track the cost and quality of every evaluation, and reduce cost without losing rigour.

**What success looks like**

We expect the following milestones, which we will refine together in your first month:

* **First 90 days.**

  Own the evaluation calendar, ship 6 evaluations at a regular cadence, and map the raters, vendors and tooling behind each one, with a clear view of its cost.
* **Six months.**

  A new evaluation published almost every week, major new models evaluated within days of release, and a lower cost per evaluation with no loss of rigour.
* **Twelve months.**

  Voice of India regularly cited by labs, researchers and the press, its scores used in enterprise and government AI decisions, and a repeatable engine that runs at low cost.

**Who we are looking for**

* **A builder's track record.**

  A past founder or early operator who shipped something every week.
* **Technical rigour.**

  Semi-technical and rigorous enough to defend a methodology to a researcher at a frontier AI lab.
* **Senior credibility.**

  Credible in conversation with a bank CTO or a ministry official.
* **Ownership.**

  You treat Voice of India as your own, and you hold a weekly cadence without cutting corners.
* **Communication.**

  Excellent writing, and the judgment to turn evaluation results into findings people cite.
* **Quality through others.**

  Experience getting quality work out of freelancers, vendors or contractors you did not fully control.

Experience in AI evaluation, data annotation, research operations or Indian-language AI is an advantage, but not required.

**Why join**

* **Own a national benchmark.**

  Run the platform that shows how AI performs for the people of India.
* **Work at the frontier.**

  Evaluate new models from the world's leading labs as they launch.
* **Shape how India chooses AI.**

  See your work used by enterprises, government and researchers.
* **Build from the ground up.**

  Define how Voice of India operates, its team and its standards.

**Working setup and assessment**

The role reports to the founder and CEO of Josh Talks and works closely with research, engineering, partnerships, policy and communications. It is a full-time position based in Gurgaon.

Assessment will cover something you shipped on a weekly cadence and a tight budget, how you managed people you did not fully control, and a short case exercise on designing and publishing an evaluation of a newly released model within one week.

**How to apply**

Send your CV and a short note to amritansh@voiceofindia.ai. Tell us about something you shipped every week on a tight budget, and what it achieved.

**WHO WE ARE​**

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

**WHY YOU’LL LOVE WORKING HERE ​**
  
At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

* We value diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to race, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, sexual orientation, and disability.

**JOIN US​**

* Experience related to fund controllership, investment books and records, and/or fund

* Understanding of the applications used in the FA or reporting process
* Understanding BRD would be an added advantage.
* Should pay attention to detail, proficient in MS applications (Word, Excel, Power Point), excellent analytical skills and must display effective interaction capabilities with various stakeholders.

**Ideally you will also –**

* Bring a continuous improvement mindset, identifying where manual processes can be automated or enhanced through AI-enabled tooling, and the leadership to embed those improvements across the team.

**What We Look For –**

* A qualified accountant with deep technical expertise in fund accounting & financial reporting, and proven experience in leading teams.

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
  
  
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

Team members work in a collaborative setting alongside medical and non-medical professionals to support efficient hospital operations. The organization values reliability, professional conduct, and a strong commitment to patient well-being. Joining DHS Multispecialty Hospital provides the opportunity to contribute directly to the comfort and care of patients and visitors.

**Role Description**
The Housekeeping Supervisor is responsible for overseeing daily housekeeping operations to ensure all hospital areas are clean, hygienic, and well maintained. This full-time, on-site role is based in Ahmedabad and includes supervising housekeeping staff, assigning tasks, and monitoring performance to meet hospital cleanliness standards. The role involves inspecting patient rooms, corridors, public areas, and clinical spaces, coordinating with the laundry team, and ensuring proper use of cleaning materials and equipment. The Housekeeping Supervisor will handle scheduling, training, and staff guidance, respond to housekeeping-related service requests, and address patient and visitor concerns promptly and professionally. The position also requires maintaining compliance with infection control protocols, safety procedures, and hospital policies, while collaborating with nursing and administrative teams to support smooth daily operations.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Supervisory Skills to manage housekeeping teams, allocate duties, monitor quality, and support staff training and development.
* Candidates should possess Housekeeping experience, including knowledge of hospital cleaning standards, infection control practices, and use of cleaning equipment and supplies.
* Candidates should possess Laundry-related skills to oversee linen handling, cleaning processes, and timely distribution of fresh linens to various hospital departments.
* Candidates should possess Customer Service and Communication skills to interact effectively with patients, visitors, and staff, handle feedback, and resolve service-related issues professionally.
* Additional beneficial qualifications include prior experience in a hospital or healthcare environment, understanding of safety and hygiene regulations, basic computer literacy for reporting and scheduling, and the ability to work flexible hours when required.
* A high school diploma or equivalent is preferred; a diploma or certificate in hospitality, facility management, or a related field is an advantage.

In recent years, we have evolved from a new player in power generation to India’s largest private thermal power producer, with a capacity of 15,250 MW and a 40 MW solar project in Gujarat. It has created a world-class logistics and utility infrastructure portfolio that has a pan-India presence. Adani Group is headquartered in Ahmedabad, in the state of Gujarat, India. With four IG-rated businesses, it is the only Infrastructure Investment Grade issuer in India.
  
  
**Business Excellence:**
Our Business Excellence Department drives operational transformation across Adani’s portfolio by integrating process optimization, digitalization, and best practices. Using cutting-edge analytics and lean methodologies, we streamline operations to boost efficiency, quality, and sustainable growth. By fostering a culture of continuous improvement and collaborating with internal teams and external partners, we implement strategic initiatives that maximize resource utilization and set new standards in operational excellence.

The BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead is responsible for driving the adoption and execution of process assurance and operational excellence solutions across the organization. This role focuses on ensuring the business optimizes its processes and reduces inefficiencies through solutions like CWS, SPS, and BPR. The BEx Process Assurance and Operational Excellence Lead will track performance metrics, standardize processes, and implement best practices that improve quality, compliance, and overall business performance. The role requires a strong focus on project management, stakeholder coordination, risk management, sustainability, and regulatory compliance.
  
  

* Key Responsibilities of Role

**Site Delivery & Front Management**

* Own delivery of the site against the baseline — cost, schedule, quality and safety — and the recovery plan when it slips.
* Integrate civil, mechanical, electrical, commissioning and enabling works into one sequenced, de-conflicted front.
* Keep work fronts open and productive — sequence fronts, balance resources and break the daily bottlenecks that stall progress.

**Drive contractor performance and productivity;**

* hold them to programmed, manpower and method commitments.

**Safety, Quality & Statutory Ownership On The Ground**

* Be visibly, personally accountable for zero harm — set the tone, walk the site, and back every stop-work made for the right reason.
* Own built quality — ensure hold-points, inspections and build-right-first-time discipline are real, not paperwork.
* Ensure statutory, environmental and labor compliance is live on site — permits, consents, hold-points and conditions are met before and during work.
* Make sure execution never runs ahead of land, ROW and statutory clearance for a given front.

**Cost, Commercial & Resource Control**

* Own site cost and productivity — manpower, plant, material and cash deployed for output, not just activity.
* Govern measurement, billing and certification with the Project Controller so paid work equals built work.
* Control change at source — flag scope creep and field changes early, with cost and time impact, before they become claims.
* Optimize the deployment of shared resources across contractors and fronts.

**Stakeholder, Land & Community Peace**

* Hold day-to-day peace with the local community, land owners, labor and local administration — the relationships that keep fronts open.
* Own escalation and resolution of land, ROW, R&R and statutory blockers that threaten the front, working HO and authorities together.
* Steward CSR, environment, horticulture and local-employment commitments as the project's license to operate.
* Be the project's credible local face when an issue could escalate beyond the gate. Site Organization, Risk & Readiness
* Build and lead an integrated site team across functions and contractors; set clear ownership and a fast escalation path.
* Run a disciplined site governance rhythm — daily fronts, weekly progress, risk and look-ahead — that surfaces problems early.
* Own the top site risks and their mitigation; ensure no single failure can quietly stop the project.
* Drive readiness for testing, commissioning and handover from early in execution, not as an afterthought.
* Deliver site pre-con readiness against the zero-date model - secured land, statutory permissions, pre-con studies, site and staff infrastructure, worker infrastructure and logistics.
* Engage GC partners early for constructability and value-engineering and hold the proposed project start date so actual start matches plan.
* Run execution through the PMC-led alliance model with defined scope and role clarity across owner, PMC and GC, and confirm PMC mobilization and manpower deployment to plan.
* Conduct site project reviews on the Parivartan cost and schedule dashboards.
* Complete and sign off the project closure report for completed site projects.
* Uphold labor-law compliance with timely third-party audits, standardized worker accommodation, colony and central kitchen, effective grievance redressal, and end-to-end workmen lifecycle monitoring.

**Decision Authority & Accountability**

* Final site authority on day-to-day execution, sequencing and resource deployment.
* Sole authority to stop work on safety, quality, statutory or labor-risk grounds, and to back others who do.
* Approves site-level spend, work-front release and contractor instructions within the Delegation of Authority.
* Authority to redeploy site resources across contractors and fronts to protect the critical path.
* Accountable to the CPO for site cost and schedule outturn, statutory compliance, zero fatality and front availability.

**Internal Interactions CPO;**
HO Function Heads (Pre-Construction, Engineering, CFMC, PMO, CAD, Safety, Quality); all Site Leads (Civil / Mechanical / Electrical / Commissioning / Environment / Safety / Security etc.); Project Controller; Capex TC; Project HR & Admin; Stores
  
  
**External Interactions**
Contractors & PMC; District / local administration & police; Statutory, environmental & labor authorities; Land owners & community / R&R representatives; Utilities & service providers; Lender's / owner's engineers (site visits)
  
  
**Qualifications**
**Qualification:**
Bachelor's in Civil / Mechanical / Electrical Engineering;
  
  
MBA / Construction or Project Management preferred
  
  
**Experience**
18+ years in site execution of large infrastructure / EPC projects, including 6+ years as Site / Project Manager owning a full project front

title: Senior Manager, Platform Software Engineering
description:
**Job Description**
Team owns the layer between clients and backend workloads: proxy and L7 services, API Gateway, and inference gateway for AI traffic. Every request to backend services passes through this layer, so latency, availability, and correctness here directly affect everything downstream. You'll build and grow the team, set its technical direction, and own these services end to end, from design through production operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Problems the team works on:**

* Proxy and L7: request routing, TLS termination, connection management, config propagation across a large fleet, and keeping tail latency predictable under load.
* API Gateway: authentication and authorization, rate limiting and quotas, traffic policies, and giving service teams a safe, self-serve way to expose APIs.
* Inference gateway: routing AI inference traffic, which behaves differently from typical web traffic. Requests are long-running and often streamed, cost varies widely by request, and backend GPU capacity is expensive and limited. That makes routing, queuing, fairness, and capacity efficiency hard problems.

**What you'll do:**

* Build and grow the team: hire engineers and tech leads, set expectations, give direct feedback, and develop people over time.
* Define the team's roadmap and priorities with leadership and partner teams.
* Stay close enough to the technical work to review designs, weigh tradeoffs, and make calls when needed.
* Own the operational health of the services: on-call, incident response, postmortems, and follow-through on reliability work.
* Work closely with networking, security, platform, and ML infrastructure teams on problems that cross team boundaries.

**What we're looking for:**

* Experience managing engineers who build and operate distributed systems in production.
* A solid technical background in at least one of: proxies and load balancing, API gateways, service mesh, networking, or high-throughput backend services.
* Experience running latency-sensitive services, including on-call and incident management.
* Experience building something new, such as starting a team, launching a new service, or taking a product from early design to production.
* A track record of hiring well and helping engineers grow.

**Nice to have:**

* Hands-on experience with Envoy, NGINX or similar.
* Familiarity with LLM inference serving (batching, streaming, GPU utilization).
* Experience building internal platforms used by many engineering teams.

**About Us**
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.
  
  
True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.
  
  
We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request\_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

**Job Purpose:**
This role is responsible for maintaining efficient power generation operations by continuous monitoring and real-time management of scheduling adjustments. As a team member in the RMDC, the individual ensures compliance with power sector regulations, minimizes DSM penalties, and ensures the accurate and instantaneous communication of schedule changes between plants, buyers, and regulatory bodies.

**Lead - RMDC**

Regularly receive availability updates from power plants and update schedules accordingly.
  
  
Monitor and ensure compliance with the Deviation Settlement Mechanism (DSM) to minimize penalties.
  
  
Coordinate and communicate effectively with stakeholders to ensure instantaneous reactions to operational changes.
  
  
**Short Term**
Monitor and manage real-time changes in power generation schedules and declarations.
  
  
Ensure compliance with different regulations governing short-term and merchant transactions, including Temporary General Network Access (TGNA) and General Network Access (GNA).
  
  
Collaborate with buyers to facilitate revisions in power schedules as per regulatory requirements.
  
  
Monitor State Load Dispatch Center (SLDC) portals for schedule updates and ensure accurate punching of schedules to avoid billing queries.
  
  
Facilitate and document change requests in the portal for transparent and accurate reporting.
  
  
**Operational Excellence**
Provide real-time coordination and monitoring with power plants and stakeholders to ensure smooth operations.
  
  
Create comprehensive reports on all activities conducted during the night shifts to maintain operational transparency and accountability.

Buyers (in case of Short Term Contracts)

B.E./ B.Tech (Mechanical, Electrical, related field)

Freshers permitted

Background in the power and energy sector with a strong emphasis on power plant knowledge and understanding of power sales, load dispatch procedures, DSM regulation compliance, and power contract frameworks.

title: Regulatory Compliance Manager - DoT / TRAI
description:
**Job Purpose**

To lead telecom regulatory compliance, nodal operations, government liaison, and legal documentation. The role will ensure adherence to applicable DoT/TRAI/TERM Cell requirements, manage authorised Law Enforcement Agency (LEA) requests, strengthen regulatory frameworks, and maintain accurate, timely, and audit-ready compliance records.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Ensure compliance with applicable DoT guidelines, TRAI regulations, telecom licence conditions, TERM Cell requirements, and other relevant regulatory directives.
* Monitor regulatory notifications, circulars, amendments, and policy changes; assess their impact and coordinate timely implementation.
* Coordinate with DoT, TRAI, TERM Cell, and other relevant authorities on regulatory submissions, inspections, audits, and compliance queries.
* Act as a key liaison with authorised Law Enforcement Agencies (LEAs), including police departments, cybercrime units, and intelligence agencies.
* Oversee the receipt, validation, tracking, documentation, and timely processing of lawful interception and data disclosure requests in accordance with applicable law and approved procedures.
* Coordinate with internal technical, network, IT, information security, legal, and business teams to address regulatory requirements and resolve operational issues.
* Prepare, review, and maintain regulatory correspondence, legal documentation, official submissions, evidence-related records, and supporting documents.
* Coordinate with internal and external legal counsel on court matters, legal notices, authorised information requests, and regulatory proceedings.
* Develop and strengthen regulatory policies, standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation matrices, compliance controls, and monitoring frameworks.
* Maintain regulatory calendars, compliance trackers, MIS dashboards, audit trails, and records of LEA requests, deadlines, escalations, and closures.
* Support internal and external audits, regulatory inspections, and compliance reviews; ensure records are complete, accurate, and readily accessible.
* Identify regulatory risks, compliance gaps, and process weaknesses; recommend corrective and preventive actions and track closure.
* Build and maintain professional working relationships with government officials, regulatory authorities, law enforcement stakeholders, and internal leadership.
* Manage sensitive escalations and confidential communications with appropriate discretion, information security, and adherence to approved access controls.
* Provide management updates on regulatory developments, pending matters, compliance status, risks, and improvement initiatives.

**Qualification & Experience**

* Education: Graduate or postgraduate qualification in Law, Public Administration, Management, or a related discipline preferred.
* Experience: 7+ years of overall professional experience, preferably with substantial experience in telecom regulatory compliance, nodal affairs, government relations, or legal operations.
* Industry Exposure: Experience with a telecom operator or telecommunications service provider is strongly preferred.
* Certifications (if any): Relevant certifications or professional development in telecom regulations, legal compliance, public administration, or regulatory affairs will be an added advantage.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

**Technical / Regulatory Skills:**

* DoT / TRAI / TERM Cell compliance and understanding of applicable telecom regulatory requirements.
* Nodal and regulatory operations; LEA coordination and authorised request management.
* Regulatory framework development, SOPs, compliance calendars, trackers, and audit documentation.
* Legal documentation, regulatory correspondence, court coordination, and evidence-related documentation.
* Regulatory audits, MIS reporting, risk identification, confidentiality, and escalation management.
* Knowledge of telecom licence conditions, security requirements, and lawful interception/data disclosure procedures.
* Added advantages: Experience with regulatory portals, compliance systems, and dashboard-based reporting.

**Functional Skills:**

* Interpretation of regulatory requirements and translation into operational processes.
* Regulatory submissions, deadline management, and compliance monitoring.
* Government liaison, LEA coordination, and stakeholder management.
* Legal record management, audit readiness, and corrective action tracking.
* Cross-functional coordination with Legal, Network, IT, Information Security, and business teams.

**Behavioral Competencies:**

* High integrity, discretion, and sound judgment when handling confidential matters.
* Strong ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage time-sensitive requests, escalations, and competing priorities.
* Strong analytical, risk assessment, and problem-solving abilities.
* Stakeholder influence, collaboration, and continuous improvement mindset.

title: Supervisor, Commercial Operations
description:
Company Overview:
  
  
Flowserve is a global manufacturer of pumps, valves, seals, and aftermarket services, delivering comprehensive flow control solutions that support essential industries such as energy, clean water, and pharmaceuticals. If you're looking for a culture built on ingenuity, innovation, and excellence, Flowserve offers the opportunity to put your experience in motion. Whether you're an individual contributor or a people leader, you'll find meaningful opportunities for professional growth, competitive rewards, and a workplace grounded in our core values: People, Safety, Integrity, Ownership and Ingenuity. At Flowserve, we're inspired by what we can achieve together—creating extraordinary flow control solutions that strengthen today's world while building tomorrow.
  
  
**Role Summary:**
The role of the Supervisor is to be a player / coach. This includes driving the responsiveness of their assigned Commercial Operations team to enable us to increase bookings overall. While maintaining responsibility for some quoting activity, this position will be responsible for building a highly responsive and customer driven group. The group will be focused on providing our Flowserve sales organization, customers, distributors, and 3rd party representative channel partners with the most technically sound and competitive quotation solutions for all pertinent inquiries in addition to transferring complete and correct order files for execution to our operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities & Requirements:**

* For pre-defined accounts, the Supervisor will be responsible for the review of RFQs and the issuance of quotes for the products that this person supports.
* Drive timely responsiveness to all viable quotation opportunities. This includes tracking the response time of the Commercial Operations team based on agreed upon standards.
* Manage the review of all valve and actuation orders for completeness and correctness and assist in resolving any issues to ensure proper order entry.
* Proper order entry to include clean Order Transfer files that are provided to Order Management in the agreed upon time frame.
* Coordinate and approve commercial terms of purchase orders and/or contracts including SAP generation and approval along with the resolution of any respective terms and conditions issues, based on Flowserve guidelines.
* Implement and oversee a continual training program to insure.
* Team members are properly applying their technical expertise and commercial knowledge during quotation preparation.
* Are updated on our techniques for utilizing any of the respective configurators / sizing and selection tools required for proposal generation.
* Are learning to apply our best practices in sizing, selecting and quoting the best suited Flowserve FPD products.
* Ensure applicable industry standards are applied correctly.
* Any schools conducted at the operation are well coordinated, informative and beneficial to all attendees (Flowserve direct or 3rd party sales personnel).
* Team Members are being developed to continuously enhance and improve performance.
* Work closely and develop strong business relationships with the key members of our operations, sales and engineering management teams to help drive the success of our FPD organization.
* Continually analyze and track the results of our pricing and quotation practices including the generation of win / loss quotation hit rates to enhance our effectiveness.
* Track, monitor, and review the performance of your individual direct reports through our performance management review process including assigning measurable goals and focused accountabilities. Monitor the progress for each team member throughout the year per our HR guidelines and processes.
* Work closely with our outside sales organization to enhance our communication, project pursuit, collaboration, and overall selling efforts.
* Comply with Flowserve goals, objectives and policies and manage your respective team members to adhere to the same standards.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Preferred Experience / Skills:**

* Successful inside / outside sales experience.
* Knowledge and experience serving the variety of process control markets associated with the assigned products and / or region.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Strong interpersonal and organizational skills.
* Detailed oriented.
* Proven track records of completing assignments as requested and in a timely manner.
* Basic knowledge of commercial issues including payment terms, shipping terms, and contract review.
* Computer skills including Microsoft Office, Internet along with the ability and willingness to learn how to use other or new business software packages as required by the role.
* BE or B.Tech Degree in relevant field and 5-7 years relevant experience.

: R-20944

**Job Family**
: SA Commercial Operations

Project Management and Delivery

* Ensure timely completion of key implementation milestones and deliverables.

* Monitor implementation activities and maintain accountability for project completion.

Stakeholder and Client Management

Risk, Compliance, and Governance

* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to develop and execute appropriate risk mitigation solutions.
* Monitor implementation progress and escalate issues that require stakeholder intervention or management decisions.

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable customer onboarding programs.

* Assist clients with offshore team preparation through remote product and process training, onsite immersion, or on-the-job training, as applicable.

* Coordinate the transition from implementation to Customer Experience and Service Delivery to maintain operational continuity.

* Collaborate with Customer Experience, Customer Engagement, and other business functions to identify opportunities for implementation improvements.
* Recommend process enhancements to improve onboarding efficiency, customer enablement, and service delivery outcomes.

Other Responsibilities

* Perform additional duties aligned with the strategic objectives of the Client Solutions organization, as assigned by executive management.

Join us at Emapta, and let your professional journey flourish in the heart of India's vibrant culture!

Recognized as one of Asia's rising tech and outsourcing destinations, we offer a wealth of opportunities to showcase your talent to the world. At Emapta, we connect you with global clients, giving you international exposure without leaving the comfort of your home country. With

description:

As a global leader in the elevator and escalator industry, it is our mission to improve the flow of urban life.***

**Coimbatore**
team, as an

Site supervision:
  
  

* Accountable for safety, quality, and productivity during installation and handovers, and for raising and actioning corrective actions to any detected non-conformities.
* Responsible for the use of correct KONE installation methods and tools by the installation team, and for proper risk assessment for parts of installation where KONE method is not feasible.

* Responsible for verifying the site execution plan and field cost management as part of the pre-delivery review, assuming site execution responsibility, and thereafter installation activities and handovers.
* Responsible for maintaining realistic MS 3c (material delivery to site) throughout the S-plan, and for confirming of S-plan milestones 3 – 5z.
* Active support to Project Manager and Project Admin for the verification of payment status according to S-plan concept and contract terms
* Responsible for planning and organizing installation activities, site storage and logistics, and needed resources and tools.
* Requests materials to site (MS 3x), confirms arrival of KONE materials to site (MS 3c), receives other materials and services at the site, and performs Goods Receipt.
* Performs handover to installation team (KONE and subcontractors), clarifying the scope of work, completion date and other necessary customer milestone dates, as well as target installation hours for own KONE fitters.
* Organizes continuous huddles with the installation team to empower them and proactively prevent interruptions, ensure smooth, continual flow of work on site, with a focus on efficiency and waste reduction.
* Achieves targets for variation sales and change orders during installation, ensures costs attributable to others are claimed and collected.
* Verifies quality of installation and ensures installation the scope of work is completed. Is accountable for final testing of the equipment and for closing any raised items (tester, customer, third party inspector, as is applicable). Completes a successful handover to maintenance.
* Responsible for quality claims / feedbacks, time sheet approvals, installation documentation, reporting of installation progress, status, cost accumulation, and risks, and managing schedule and other changes.
* Responsible for the management of environmental aspects of the installation (waste and hazardous material handling).

Customer Relationship management:
  
  

* Acts as the primary contact for the customer regarding site management, proactively communicating and using related tools.
* Ensures customer satisfaction with proactive and timely communication, professional installation process, as well as safety and quality of installation.

People leadership and subcontractor relations:
  
  

* Responsible for verifying that installers, testers and other contractors on site are trained, certified, competent, and capable of performing each installation task.
* Accountable for site operatives’ safety, motivation and wellbeing.
* Responsible for identifying Installation operative training needs and communicating these to respective line managers, HR, installation subcontracting companies and procurement.
* Responsible for managing and developing the performance of the team and individuals.
* Responsible for developing and maintaining a proactive and professional relationship with subcontractors’ installation team and ensures they meet their commitments.

Continual improvement:
  
  

* Responsible to follow and continually improve standard ways of working according to LEAN principles.
* Motivates and empowers the installation team to identify waste and make improvements, with a focus on teamwork and collaboration.
* Supports and coaches the installation team to improve their standard ways of working.
* Continually identifies and shares opportunities, root causes and improvement ideas with the team and other collaborators, applying lean tools (Go & See, retrospectives, improvement sessions).
* Promotes success stories of team improvements, recognizing and rewarding efforts to drive continuous improvement.

***What do we offer?***

* Career progression opportunities within a global organization.
* Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work.
* Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills.

*At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.*

title: Operations Manager
description:
**Hotel Mahi’s Gateway | Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu**  
**Job Type:** Full-time, on-site  
**Salary:** Based on experience and suitability  
**Benefits:** Food and accommodation provided

Hotel Mahi’s Gateway, a 39-room hotel with Shooters Bar, is looking for an experienced, hands-on Operations Manager to oversee daily operations and strengthen service standards, staff discipline and accountability.

We need someone who takes ownership, leads by example and follows through until issues are resolved. The role reports directly to management and requires an active presence across departments.  
Key Responsibilities

**Daily Operations and Guest Service**

* Oversee front office, housekeeping, maintenance, security and bar operations.
* Ensure rooms are clean, properly maintained and ready before guest arrival.
* Monitor reservations, check-ins, check-outs, room allocation and shift handovers.
* Handle guest complaints professionally and ensure timely resolution.
* Coordinate guest breakfast and room-service arrangements with the food provider.

**Staff Management and Discipline**

* Plan duty rosters, weekly offs and leave coverage to maintain adequate staffing.
* Monitor attendance, grooming, punctuality and work performance.
* Conduct daily briefings and assign clear responsibilities to each department.
* Train staff, implement practical SOPs and follow up on compliance.
* Support recruitment, onboarding and performance reviews.

**Cash, Billing and Operational Controls**

* Verify that every reservation, occupied room, guest charge and payment is correctly recorded in the PMS.
* Cross-check PMS room status against housekeeping’s physical room-status report.
* Review daily collections and shift handovers with reception and accounts; investigate and report discrepancies promptly.
* Ensure discounts, refunds, cancellations, complimentary stays and credit arrangements follow management approval procedures.
* Maintain individual staff accountability and accurate supporting records.

**Stock, Maintenance and Cost Control**

* Monitor bar stock, linen, housekeeping supplies and operating consumables.
* Coordinate stock checks with stores and accounts, and investigate shortages or unusual consumption.
* Verify purchase requirements and receipt of goods through the approved process.
* Follow up on maintenance complaints and preventive maintenance.
* Control wastage and unnecessary expenditure while maintaining service quality.

**Reporting and Follow-up**

* Submit a concise daily report covering occupancy, collections, pending payments, complaints, maintenance issues and staff concerns.
* Maintain an action list with responsible staff members and completion deadlines.
* Escalate serious incidents promptly and keep management informed.
* Work with reception and marketing to improve occupancy, guest satisfaction and repeat business.

Candidate Requirements

* Minimum **5 years of hotel operations experience**, including at least **2 years in an Operations Manager, Assistant Operations Manager or comparable supervisory role**.
* Experience managing a similar-sized hotel; exposure to bar operations is an advantage.
* Strong working knowledge of front office, housekeeping, maintenance and daily cash controls.
* Comfortable using hotel PMS software, POS systems, Excel and operational reports. Experience with **Microgenn and Petpooja** is an advantage.
* Proven ability to lead teams, train staff and introduce consistent working procedures.
* Clear communication in **Tamil and English**; additional languages are an advantage.
* Diploma or degree in Hotel Management preferred. Candidates with strong relevant experience will also be considered.
* Willingness to work flexible shifts, weekends and public holidays according to operational requirements.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

A trustworthy, organised and firm but fair manager who is comfortable working on the floor, addressing problems directly and maintaining clear records. You should be able to demonstrate improvements you have made in guest service, staff performance, cost control or operational accountability.

How to Apply

Apply through Indeed with your updated CV. Please include your **current location, relevant hotel experience, current and expected salary, and notice period**.

title: General Manager, BibleOn
description:
General Manager, BibleOn

**Location:**
Kochi, Kerala

**Employment:**
Full-time, on-site

**Reporting to:**
Thomson Philip, Co-founder of BibleOn and CEO of Eloit Innovations

**About BibleOn**

BibleOn is a free, ad-free Bible app with a mission to bring the Word of God to people in their own language. Rooted in the Catholic faith and welcoming everyone, BibleOn offers text and audio Scriptures in international, regional and tribal languages, helping individuals and families build a deeper relationship with Jesus through His Word.

Our vision extends beyond an app. We are building a global community of readers, listeners, volunteers, supporters and digital missionaries who help others discover and engage with the Holy Scriptures.

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an exceptional, mission-driven leader to take full responsibility for leading BibleOn into its next stage of growth.

The General Manager, BibleOn will assume day-to-day leadership from the Co-founder and lead the initiative with independence, sound judgement and accountability. Working within the vision, strategic direction and agreed budgets set with the Co-founder, you will translate that vision into clear priorities, build the right team and deliver measurable results.

This role combines ministry leadership with the discipline of running a growing digital platform. You will lead operations, product priorities, language expansion, content, audience growth, Church partnerships, fundraising and campaigns, working with the existing team and recruiting additional talent as required.

We are looking for someone who can take ownership, make decisions and move the mission forward with limited day-to-day supervision.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Lead the Mission and Strategy**

* Translate BibleOn’s vision into an actionable growth plan with clear milestones, budgets and measures of success.
* Take ownership of execution across the entire initiative, resolving challenges and keeping priorities focused.
* Work closely with the Co-founder on strategic direction, major partnerships and decisions requiring his guidance.
* Provide concise, regular updates on progress, finances, opportunities and matters requiring leadership attention.

**2. Lead Operations and Build the Team**

* Assume responsibility for daily operations and coordinate the existing team across technology, content, languages, outreach and user support.
* Recruit, develop and lead employees, volunteers, language coordinators and external collaborators.
* Establish clear responsibilities, practical workflows and a culture of service, accountability and follow-through.
* Manage budgets, resources and delivery schedules to support sustainable growth.

**3. Expand Languages and Content**

* Develop and execute a plan to expand BibleOn’s text and audio Bible offerings, particularly for underserved language communities.
* Build relationships with Bible publishers, rights holders, translators, recording partners and Church organisations.
* Oversee permissions, content sourcing, production, quality review and publication.
* Develop Scripture-centred content and initiatives that encourage regular Bible reading, listening and spiritual growth.
* Maintain fidelity to Catholic teaching in BibleOn’s original faith content, supported by appropriate theological review.

**4. Grow the Audience and Community**

* Lead user acquisition, engagement and retention across countries and language communities.
* Plan and deliver digital campaigns, parish outreach, community programmes and partnerships.
* Build a network of digital missionaries, volunteers and ambassadors who introduce BibleOn to others.
* Use audience insights and performance data to improve campaigns, content and the user experience.

**5. Build Global Church Relationships**

* Develop active partnerships with dioceses, parishes, religious congregations, Catholic institutions, ministries and lay movements.
* Draw on an established global Catholic network to create opportunities for distribution, language expansion, collaboration and support.
* Represent BibleOn professionally at Church gatherings, conferences and partner meetings.
* Build lasting relationships grounded in trust, service and a shared commitment to spreading the Word of God.

**6. Lead Fundraising and Campaigns**

* Develop and execute a fundraising strategy that supports BibleOn’s free, ad-free mission.
* Build relationships with individual donors, Catholic foundations, institutions and other mission-aligned supporters.
* Lead donation campaigns, sponsorship proposals and supporter communications.
* Establish responsible donor stewardship, with clear reporting on the use of funds and the impact achieved.
* Work with finance and professional advisers on donation processes, financial controls and applicable requirements.

**7. Guide Product Development and User Experience**

* Work with the technology team to prioritise improvements based on mission needs, user feedback and growth opportunities.
* Coordinate product releases, content launches and campaigns.
* Champion accessibility, reliability and ease of use across languages and user groups.
* Monitor adoption, engagement, user support and product performance, turning findings into practical improvements.

**Mandatory Requirements**

* **A practising Catholic**
  , with a personal commitment to prayer, Scripture, the sacramental life and the mission of the Church.
* **An established and active global network within the Catholic Church**
  , with the ability to build trusted relationships across clergy, religious communities, institutions, ministries and lay leaders.
* Proven experience leading an organisation, ministry, business unit or substantial initiative, with responsibility for people, budgets, execution and results.
* The ability to function independently, exercise sound judgement and take full ownership while remaining accountable to the Co-founder’s vision and guidance.
* Strong communication and relationship-building skills, including the ability to present BibleOn’s mission convincingly to partners, donors and communities.
* Willingness to work full-time from Kochi and travel within India and internationally when required.

Experience and Capabilities We Value

* Leadership experience in digital products, technology, Catholic ministry, publishing, media, fundraising or the social impact sector.
* A demonstrated record of growing audiences, communities, partnerships or donor support.
* Experience recruiting and leading multidisciplinary teams, including volunteers and external partners.
* Confidence with budgets, performance metrics, digital campaigns and project delivery.
* Experience working across languages, cultures and international networks.
* A relevant degree or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

**What Success Looks Like**

* BibleOn operates effectively under your leadership, with the Co-founder able to focus on strategic guidance.
* The team has clear priorities, defined responsibilities and consistent delivery.
* More people discover BibleOn, return regularly and engage deeply with Scripture.
* New language communities gain access to quality text and audio Bible content.
* Church partnerships generate active collaboration and measurable reach.
* Donations and supporter relationships provide a stronger foundation for the mission.
* BibleOn grows while remaining faithful to its Catholic identity and free, ad-free purpose.

**Who Will Thrive in This Role**

You combine a heart for evangelisation with the ability to build and lead. You are comfortable developing strategy, meeting a bishop, presenting to a donor, guiding a team and following through on practical details.

* You see bringing the Word of God to more people as a personal calling, and you have the leadership ability to turn that commitment into sustained action.

title: Project Lead - Civil
description:
**Job Location: Kochi and Pune**
**Job Summary**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Project Lead - Civil with 10 to 15 years of hands-on experience in Revit-based modeling for civil and infrastructure projects. The ideal candidate must have a strong command of Scan-to-BIM workflows, 3D modeling of civil assets, and coordination across disciplines. This role requires an individual with strong technical capabilities in BIM software and a solid understanding of civil engineering principles.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Ability to handle Project Management activities independently, including managing a team, from project kickoff through successful delivery.
* Develop high-quality 3D BIM models using Autodesk Revit for civil infrastructure projects including drainage, utilities, site development, and external works.
* Work with point cloud data (Scan-to-BIM) to model existing conditions and integrate laser scan outputs into Revit and Civil 3D environments.
* Interpret and process LiDAR scans, photogrammetry, and other survey data to create accurate as-built models.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (architecture, MEP, structural) to ensure accurate model coordination and clash-free design.
* Conduct clash detection and resolution using tools such as Navisworks Manage.
* Produce construction documentation including plans, sections, and details directly from BIM models.
* Adhere to and help enforce BIM execution plans, project standards, and quality checks.
* Maintain model accuracy and version control throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support project delivery using BIM 360 / ACC or similar collaboration platforms.

**Qualifications And Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Civil Engineering or a related field.
* 10 - 15 years of relevant BIM experience in structural / civil projects.
* Proficiency in Autodesk Revit is mandatory.
* Understanding of local and international standards (e.g., AASHTO, BS, Eurocodes).
* Strong experience with Scan-to-BIM workflows, point cloud processing, and as-built modeling.
* Working knowledge of Civil 3D, Navisworks, and reality capture tools such as ReCap, Leica Cyclone, or Faro Scene.
* Familiarity with BIM standards (e.g., ISO 19650, PAS 1192).
* Experience with cloud-based collaboration tools (e.g., BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud) is preferred.
* Excellent attention to detail, communication, and problem-solving skills.

This role combines deep SAP TM expertise with strategic consulting capabilities to design, implement, and optimize end-to-end transportation solutions that drive operational excellence, cost reduction, and supply chain visibility. The consultant participates in pursuing client sales opportunities and working on bid & proposal efforts along with activities including configuration and setting up the SAP TM system, assessment of client business problems, conducting the analysis to solve the problems, administration of engagement activities while contributing to practice growth and innovation.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the successful delivery of the SAP TM module related deliverables in SAP and S4 HANA implementation, support, and upgrade projects to meet engagement objectives and budget
* Lead design workshops with the client and responsible for requirement gathering, solution design, fit-gap analysis, writing functional specification, system configuration, testing and cutover activities for both standalone SAP TM system and embedded SAP TM in S/4 HANA
* Design SAP TM system Integrations with other modules of SAP/S4 HANA (like EWM, SD, MM etc.) and 3rd Party system
* Provide functional and business process expertise to the project team, resolve TM related client s issues and mentor junior team members
* Handle various industry specific complex TM scenarios like shipper, LSP and carriers
* Work with sales team, write proposals, define SAP TM scope and effort estimation for the new opportunities and present SAP TM capability to the potential client

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Technical and Professional Requirements:**

* 8-10 years of experience in implementation, support and upgrade projects in SAP TM
* Must have good functional and business knowledge, worked in multiple E2E implementations, integration, testing and application support in S/4HANA embedded TM and SAP TM (latest versions)
* Ability to interact with other cross functional teams from modules like OTC, EWM for integration scenario
* Excellent written and verbal interpersonal skills for co-ordinating across teams
* Should be able to lead workshop or working sessions with business
* Knowledge in ABAP and debugging would be nice to have

**Core SAP TM Competencies:**

* Comprehensive knowledge in all L3 aspects of SAP TM such as Order Management (Logistics Integration, Freight Unit, Forwarding Order, Freight Order, Freight Booking), Transportation Planning and Execution, Carrier Selection, Charge Calculation and Freight Settlement, Invoice Integration and Carrier Communication methodologies
* Proficiency in Master Data setup such as Resource Management, Locations, Business Partners etc.
* Deep understanding of SAP TM integration with SAP ERP S/4HANA logistics (SD, MM, LE) and embedded TM scenarios
* Expertise in Transportation Planning strategies: manual planning, Transportation Cockpit, optimizer-based planning (VSR), and automated freight unit building
* Proficiency in Freight Order Lifecycle Management, Freight Tendering processes, Subcontracting and Execution monitoring
* Advanced knowledge of Charge calculation, Freight Agreement Management, Rate tables and Transportation cost allocation

**Technical Skills:**

* SAP TM configuration and customizing across all functional areas (master data, organizational structures, profiles setup for Planning, business rules such as BRF+ conditions)
* Data migration methodologies using DRF, LSMW, SAP Data Services, or Migration Cockpit; system landscape design (Development, Quality, Production)
* Understanding of SAP TM on HANA optimization, performance tuning, and analytics capabilities
* Expertise in implementation planning, fit-gap analysis, SAP TM system configuration E2E, testing, rollout and post-implementation support.

**Industry Knowledge:**

* Expertise in logistics and supply chain operations across multiple transportation modes (road, rail, ocean, air, intermodal)
* Knowledge of carrier management practices, freight procurement, contract negotiations, and service level agreements
* Familiarity with industry best practices, benchmarks, and emerging trends (sustainability, real-time visibility, autonomous transportation)

**Consulting Competencies:**
**Client Management**

* Proven ability to engage with client and influence strategic decision-making
* Expertise in requirements gathering through workshops, interviews, and process analysis; translating business needs into technical specifications
* Change management and organizational adoption strategies, including training program design, communication planning, and stakeholder engagement
* Project governance frameworks, steering committee management, and escalation resolution

**Solution Design**

* End-to-end solution architecture spanning SAP TM, ERP or S/4 HANA, EWM, GTS, and third-party logistics systems (TMS, WMS, visibility platforms)
* Business process optimization using Lean Six Sigma or similar methodologies; identification of automation opportunities and efficiency gains
* Integration strategy development including point-to-point, hub-based, and API-led connectivity approaches
* Oversight of custom development (ABAP, SAPUI5, BRF+) ensuring adherence to SAP standards and maintainability

**Leadership & Delivery**

* Project and program management using methodologies such as SAP Activate, Agile, or hybrid approaches.
* Leadership of diverse teams (10-30+ members) including onshore, nearshore, and offshore resources across functional and technical disciplines
* Quality assurance practices including test strategy development, UAT coordination, cutover planning, and post-go-live support

title: Senior MES Delivery Lead
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior MES Delivery Lead will work closely with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Automation, IT, Data Backbone teams, and external technology partners to drive MES adoption and support manufacturing transformation initiatives. Responsibilities include process analysis, requirements engineering, workshop facilitation, solution evaluation, architecture collaboration, implementation support, deployment planning, testing, documentation, and continuous improvement activities.
  
  
The successful candidate will act as a subject matter expert for MES and digital manufacturing systems, helping to define future-state manufacturing processes, support Smart Factory initiatives, and contribute to the long-term development of SPS's manufacturing technology landscape. As the program evolves, the role is expected to progress toward ownership of MES strategy, deployment activities, and future capability development within the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead and support MES implementation, deployment, and scaling activities across SPS manufacturing sites globally.
* Analyse manufacturing processes and identify opportunities for digitalisation, automation, process optimisation, and operational improvements.
* Gather, define, structure, and maintain business, functional, technical, and architectural requirements for MES and related manufacturing systems.
* Develop and maintain manufacturing use cases, business scenarios, process flows, and solution evaluation criteria.
* Facilitate workshops with Operations, Manufacturing Engineering, Quality, Planning, Automation, IT, and business stakeholders to capture requirements and align solution designs.
* Evaluate MES modules and capabilities against business needs, technology architecture, integration requirements, scalability, and long-term sustainability objectives.
* Contribute to solution architecture design involving MES, ERP, PLM, SCADA, PLC, Historian, APS, and related manufacturing systems.
* Support integration planning and coordination between enterprise platforms and manufacturing systems to ensure effective information flow across the manufacturing environment.
* Participate in system testing, validation activities, deployment planning, issue resolution, and implementation support throughout project lifecycles.
* Collaborate closely with Smart Factory, Data Backbone, Automation, Quality, Engineering, Operations, IT teams, and external technology vendors.
* Prepare documentation including requirements specifications, process maps, evaluation reports, implementation plans, testing documentation, and deployment materials.
* Support decision-making processes through technical analysis, solution recommendations, and business case development.
* Promote best practices in digital manufacturing, Industry 4.0, Smart Factory solutions, and manufacturing system governance.
* Take ownership of assigned initiatives and drive activities through completion while effectively communicating progress, risks, dependencies, and recommendations to stakeholders.
* Contribute to the development of future MES capabilities and support the growth of SPS's digital manufacturing competency.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Information Technology, Computer Science, Automation Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Master's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing Systems, Industrial Automation, Information Technology, or a related field is preferred.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES), manufacturing systems, industrial digitalisation, Smart Factory initiatives, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated experience leading or supporting end-to-end MES implementation, deployment, and rollout projects within manufacturing environments.
* Strong understanding of MES integration with ERP, PLC, SCADA, Historian, APS, PLM, Quality Management Systems, and related manufacturing technologies.
* Experience conducting manufacturing process mapping, business analysis, requirements gathering, workshop facilitation, and solution evaluation activities.
* Good understanding of enterprise architecture and manufacturing system architecture principles.
* Ability to work effectively across Operations, Engineering, Quality, IT, and business stakeholder groups.
* Experience working within manufacturing environments and a strong understanding of shopfloor operations and production processes.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.
* Experience with MES platforms such as AVEVA, Critical Manufacturing, Siemens Opcenter, Rockwell FactoryTalk, Proficy, or similar solutions is preferred.
* Experience supporting global or multi-site manufacturing deployments is highly desirable.
* Exposure to Industry 4.0, Industrial Data Backbone, Unified Namespace (UNS), MQTT, Industrial Historian platforms, or related technologies is advantageous.
* Experience within engineer-to-order, project-based, high-mix, batch, continuous, or other complex manufacturing environments is preferred.
* Demonstrates ownership, leadership, and a proactive approach to driving initiatives, managing stakeholders, and delivering business outcomes.
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to work effectively in international and cross-functional teams.
* Willingness to travel internationally, including visits to Denmark, Brazil, the UK, and other SPS manufacturing locations as required.

Every day, the oil and gas industry’s best minds put more than 150 years of experience to work to help our customers achieve lasting success.
