This role is open globally, but location is set in Europe - with a preference for Finland (Helsinki), Italy (Sesto San Giovanni), Netherlands (Rotterdam), Poland (Lodz), Spain (Madrid), Sweden (Vaesteras), UK (Warrington) - and India (Bangalore). The work model is hybrid .
  
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
In this role, you will support business growth by analyzing markets, evaluating strategic opportunities, and contributing to M&A and investment activities. You will work closely with stakeholders to develop business cases, assess potential targets, and help translate strategy into actionable growth initiatives.
  
  
This role reports to Head of Strategy, Motion Services.
  
  
You will be mainly accountable for:
  
  

* Collect market information, conduct financial modelling, and perform competitive analysis.
* Contribute to strategy definition and execution through the analysis and identification of new markets, segments, or solutions.
* Support in translating global strategies into local strategic actions and in identifying local input to global strategies coordinating both internal and external resources in the various competence areas (e.g. business plan development, strategic and financial analysis).
* Identify M&A and investment targets, execute target assessments, determine synergies, and drill down to shortlisting of actionable targets that transition into deal execution.
* Prepare business valuations (including comparable public companies, comparable precedent transactions, discounted cash flow) and financial due diligences especially for smaller transactions.

* Identify improvement opportunities in M&A approach and contribute improving processes and tools.
* Collaborate with all related contacts to ensure alignment, efficiency, and effectiveness in the creation and implementation of the business strategy.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or higher degree in Business Administration, Business Management, Finance or another relevant field
* Additional technical education or experience with service, drives, motors, electrical equipment, automation or power conversion equipment is beneficial but not mandatory.

* Strong analytical abilities and excellent understanding of financial statements analysis.
* Fundamental understanding of financial valuation theory, methodologies, and applications and/or financial due diligence and M&A process
* Good understanding of relevant markets, customers, technology, and competition.
* Clear communication skills in internal and external discussions and executive presentations including Powerpoint and Excel modelling.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Strong work ethic, organizational skills and ability to multitask is crucial.

**What's in it for you?**
We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger. Guide the future. This is where innovation accelerates, industries are reimagined, and your impact powers the world ahead. Run What Runs the World.
  
  
*This opportunity is open to candidates in one or multiple countries that have adopted the European Pay Transparency Directive, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage.*
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

* Develop estimates for quantities, cycle times, resource loading, equipment and tooling requirements, NRE, capex, lead times, and implementation milestones.
* Assess equipment sourcing strategies and evaluate lead-time exposure for both standard and custom-built manufacturing equipment.

Technical Expertise
  
  

* Capital expenditure planning, equipment investment strategy, and manufacturing infrastructure cost modeling.
* Development of bottom-up should-cost models for manufacturing equipment, automation systems, tooling, fixtures, and production assets.
* Financial evaluation techniques including NPV analysis, IRR calculations, payback analysis, return-on-investment assessment, and business case development.
* Scenario modeling, sensitivity analysis, investment trade studies, and make-versus-buy decision frameworks.
* RFQ decomposition, requirements analysis, compliance matrix development, and requirements traceability management.
* Bid strategy development, proposal governance, solution storytelling, executive presentations, and customer clarification management.
* Integrated planning, RAID management, risk assessment, change management, and configuration control.
* Commercial evaluation of cost structures, schedules, contractual obligations, lead-time risks, and investment decisions.
* Equipment sizing, manufacturing capacity planning, resource loading analysis, cycle-time calculations, and implementation scheduling.
* Supplier evaluation, quotation analysis, sourcing strategy development, and technical-commercial recommendation preparation.
* Experience with ERP systems, PLM platforms, BOM management, document repositories, and controlled bid content environments.
* Strong analytical, financial modeling, structured problem-solving, and evidence-based decision-making capabilities.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and customer presentation skills.
* Proven capability to lead multidisciplinary teams across engineering, operations, quality, sourcing, finance, supply chain, and supplier organizations.
* Strong ownership mindset, attention to detail, and ability to consistently deliver high-quality outputs against fixed bid deadlines.

* B.E./B.Tech in Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
* MBA or Postgraduate qualification in Operations Management, Finance, or a related discipline preferred.
* 10-15 years of relevant experience in costing, capital expenditure planning, bid management, manufacturing industrialization, NPI, engineering, or related functions within EMS or complex manufacturing environments.

* Payroll & incentives accounting.
* Prepayments & corporate accruals
* Professional & IT costs
* Advertising & marketing costs
* Facility costs
* Goods received not invoiced accruals

* Ensure performance to targeted Global Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) to align with delivery of desired service level to the business.

title: Senior Engineer - Cost Management Casting
description:
**Position Title:**
Senior Engineer - Cost Management Casting

**Location:**
Oragadam

**Job Description:**

The Senior Engineer - Cost Management (Al Casting) is responsible for driving cost engineering, target costing, and cost-reduction initiatives for high-precision aluminum cast components, specifically Cylinder Heads and Cylinder Blocks. Leveraging deep technical expertise in aluminum casting processes (HPDC, LPDC, GDC) and secondary machining operations, this role works cross-functionally with Sourcing, Current Engineering, NPD, and Quality Assurance. The incumbent validates cost sheets, leads value engineering (VAVE) projects, conducts supplier negotiations, manages commodity inflation/indexed clauses, and ensures strict adherence to vehicle business plan cost targets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Costing Build-Up & Scenario Modeling:**
Develop zero-based cost models, cost cards, and scenario analyses for aluminum cylinder heads, cylinder blocks, and cast parts to support cross-functional strategic decision-making.

**Cost Sheet Validation & NPD Support:**
Validate technical cost sheets prepared by strategic sourcing for critical parts and provide cost-engineering support to NPD teams during vendor selection.

**Supplier Negotiations & Norms:**
Participate in price negotiations, review and sign off on costing norms (cycle times, melt loss, machine rates, tooling cost) with suppliers, and negotiate contract terms.

**Cost Reduction & VAVE:**
Identify, propose, and implement value engineering (VAVE) and alternative sourcing/material initiatives alongside Engineering and QA to achieve annual cost-reduction targets.

**Inflation Management & Variance Analysis:**
Track raw material market trends (e.g., aluminum index updates), manage price adjustment clauses in contracts, analyze cost variances, and execute risk-mitigation plans.

**Desired Skills and Experience:**

**Education:**
B.E. / B.Tech in Mechanical or Automobile Engineering

**Experience:**
6+ years of experience in cost engineering or cost management within the automotive industry (OEMs or Tier-1 casting ancillaries)

**Domain Focus:**
Heavy focus on engine components specifically Aluminum Cylinder Heads, Cylinder Blocks, and complex engine castings.

title: Specialist - Corporate Audit
description:
**Company Profile**
**Lennox (NYSE: LII)**
Driven by 130 years of legacy, HVAC and refrigeration success, Lennox provides our residential and commercial customers with industry-leading climate-control solutions. At Lennox, we win as a team, aiming for excellence and delivering innovative, sustainable products and services. Our culture guides us and creates a workplace where all employees feel heard and welcomed. Lennox is a global community that values each team member’s contributions and offers a supportive environment for career development. Come, stay, and grow with us.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role Objective**
The Data Analytics Specialist will support the Corporate Audit function by developing and executing data analytics solutions to enable risk-based audits, SOX compliance, fraud detection, continuous auditing, and ERM initiatives. The role will focus on
**leveraging analytics-related tools**
(e.g., IDEA, Alteryx, Azure) and
**SAP data**
to deliver actionable insights and scalable audit analytics.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Audit Data Analytics & Automation**

* Design, develop, and maintain models and/or workflows for audit analytics, fraud detection, SOX testing, and continuous auditing.
* Document the processes and procedures for models or workflows developed.
* Build, document, and maintain an inventory of audit analytics and use cases across business processes (e.g., P2P, O2C, Inventory, GL, etc.).
* Automate repetitive audit testing procedures to improve audit coverage and efficiency (e.g., test populations versus samples).
* Perform risk-based data analysis, including exception testing, trend analysis, and anomaly detection.

**Risk Monitoring, Fraud & ERM Support**

* Support fraud desk initiatives through advanced analytics and red flag identification using structured SAP data.
* Enable risk response monitoring aligned with ERM and Internal Audit priorities.
* Develop analytics to support management’s proactive risk identification and control effectiveness assessment.

**Technology & Data Enablement**

* Work directly with SAP source data (e.g., FI, MM, SD, Inventory modules) and ensure accurate data extraction and transformation.
* Leverage Azure or similar data platforms for large-scale risk analysis and enterprise analytics.
* Address data sourcing limitations and improve data reliability for audit consumption.
* Act as a subject-matter expert for analytics tools (e.g., IDEA and Alteryx), including workflow optimization and complexity review.

**Stakeholder Collaboration**

* Partner with Internal Audit, Compliance, IT, Finance, and Supply Chain teams to understand risk areas and data availability.
* Provide clear visibility on analytics deliverables, scope, and outcomes to audit leadership.
* Support follow-up discussions with stakeholders on analytics-driven observations.

**Governance & Capability Building**

* Define standards and governance for audit analytics development and documentation.
* Review and validate complex models and workflows developed by the team to ensure quality and sustainability.
* Support training and mentoring of auditors on the use and interpretation of analytics.

**Qualifications**

* Requires a bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
* 5 - 7 Years of relevant experience in Data Analytics using Alteryx.

title: AVP - Country Regulatory Reporting
description:
**Job Description**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategy**

* Ensuring alignment with country stakeholders on the development and execution of country specific strategic goals regarding Country Financial Regulatory Reporting (FRR).
* Identifying and implementing best practices to enhance reporting efficiency and accuracy
* Drive productivity and achieve cost efficiencies through continuous improvement initiatives.
* Exhibit strategic thinking in driving & managing change
* Manage key stakeholder relationships, including direct & indirect stake partnerships.
* Display Independent and Confident attitude with abiligy to work under pressure and handle multiple assignments.
* Contribute to the Bank’s strategic & operational agenda by accepting & executing assignments over & above functional responsibilities.

**Business**

* Understanding and articulating country specific regulatory requirements, FRR metrics computation and methodologies, and regulatory parameters and key drivers.
* Understanding banking products and country specific business context and correlating these to local regulatory reporting.
* Translating relevant local financial regulatory requirements into business and functional requirements and driving the discussion with country stakeholders across Finance, Treasury, Risk, Data, IT and the Business for ongoing compliance in local regulatory reporting.
* Maintaining effective communication with stakeholders to understand their requirements and queries and provide necessary execution and consultation support.

**Processes**

* Ensuring accurate and timely submission of all required local regulatory returns to relevant senior stakeholders and/or regulatory authorities ( like RBI for India, MAS for Singapore and so on) , where appropriate.
* Provide day-to-day delivery management to the team
* Ensuring all queries for submitted reports are addressed within timelines including any ad hoc requirements in respect to processes managed.
* Ensuring the operational efficiency, accuracy and completeness of the reports are monitored with appropriate KPIs.
* Establishing robust governance and controls for the reporting process including the requirements to manage report quality and operational control. This includes expected data quality monitoring required in the reporting standards for regulatory reporting.
* Continuously striving for process optimization to enhance production efficiency and reduce errors.
* Leveraging technology and automation tools to streamline reporting processes.
* Supporting the transition of changes into BAU effectively that is aligned with the Bank’s regulatory and technology objectives.

**People & Talent**

* Planning and allocating resources effectively to meet reporting deadlines and regulatory requirements.
* Developing the team to build capacity and elevate team capabilities at pace with evolving regulatory and business demand.
* Providing guidance, training and mentorship to the GFS regulatory reporting team on technical knowledge, best practices, and technologies.
* Building relationships to improve collaboration across country and GFS functions to resolve issues and implement changes for local regulatory reporting.

**Risk Management**

* Monitoring and ensuring that appropriate BAU and Change governance and controls are followed across all production and transformation activities.
* Overseeing the maintenance of comprehensive documentation of reporting processes, standards and controls.
* Coordinating with internal and external auditors to facilitate audits and reviews.
* Identifying, monitoring and escalating as and when required key issues in the regulatory reporting process leading to material errors in regulatory returns.

**Governance**

* Monitor and ensure that appropriate Change governance is followed across all transformation initiatives. Represent the function at the governance forums in place for tracking change initiatives and influence decisions in respect of the change backlog, prioritisation, choice of technology tools and the operating model.

**Leadership Qualities & Characteristics**

* Upholding high ethical standards and ensuring all reporting activities are conducted with integrity and transparency.
* Promoting a culture of diversity and inclusivity, compliance and ethical behaviour within the team.
* Inspiring proactive and innovative behaviours in the team to continuously improve performance and strive for excellence.
* Leaders should be hands-on to undertake activities/tasks on their own as the role demands while supporting and managing other members of the team
* Self motivated and able to work independently and to proactively seek guidance from others as needed.
* Strong team player and has the capacity to build good working relationships with cross functional / geographical teams
* Positive outlook and a desire to stretch themselves to achieve both personal and functional success.
* Demonstrate leadership under pressure situations and demonstrate the ability to cope with tight deadlines and constraints.

**Regulatory & Business Conduct**

* Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
* Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
* Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

**Key stakeholders**

* GPO/GPM, Capital & Liquidity & FRR
* Country Regulatory Reporting – CFO, Financial Controller and Country Leads
* Credit and Market Risk functions – Functional Heads and Leads
* Technology and PSS – Head and Leads across PSS and Technology
* Change Management - Head and Leads across Financial Regulatory Reporting Change

**Skills and Experience**
**Specific Skill set:**

* Understanding of the bank’s products and services with specialisation in at least one of FM, CIB, or Treasury products
* Local Financial Regulatory reporting experience
* Financial Reporting skillsets. IFRS accounting & experience
* Fundamental understanding of Financial Statements & Balance Sheet Management
* Robust understanding of the Regulatory Framework & Taxonomy associated with Financial Regulatory Reporting
* Conceptual knowhow of Balance Sheet Management metrics and its calculation methods – Liquidity, IRRBB, Capital may be beneficial.

**Soft Skills**

* Very good written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to engage with senior stakeholders.
* Excellent Interpersonal Communication
* Strong Business Writing skills

**Technology orientation (what will give the candidate an edge)**

* Knowledge of Python
* SQL Platforms
* Knowhow in deploying AI and ML solutions to mechanise processes and achieve scale.

**Leadership**

* Encourage teams to set ambitious goals aligning to Bank’s aspirational vision
* Manage sizeable teams and navigate the matrix; Coach and help the team to develop and grow
* Ability to build trust with team through asking/listening to feedback; partner and influence senior stakeholders in the Businesses and Functions
* Take timely actions and make bold decisions aligning to goals, champion strong conduct.
* Strategic thinking and a mindset to drive continuous improvement.

**Priority Technical Skills**

**Risks & Controls**

* Covers the Group’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) approach and governance infrastructure needed to identify, assess, mitigate and escalate Finance risks. These include accounting principles, policies and procedures around regulatory reporting, balance sheet management, tax, product and valuation control.

**Operational Risk**

* Knowledge of policies and key frameworks to identify, measure, and monitor risks / compliance relating to the potential financial loss from inadequate or failed internal processes, technology events, human error or from the impact of external events

**Balance Sheet Management**

Only required for “Capital & Liquidity Reporting” and is only beneficial for this role
  
  
**Capital Management**

* Understand and apply knowledge pertaining to the external capital markets, regulatory requirements and thresholds, and the Group’s capital structure to support managing capital positions, metrics and capital risks, including stress tetersting, reporting and optimising the Group/Country capital resources and usage.

Only required for “Capital & Liquidity Reporting” and is only beneficial for this role
  
  
**Liquidity Management**

Only required for “Capital & Liquidity Reporting” and is only beneficial for this role
  
  
**Interest Rate Risk (IRR) Management**

Only required for “Capital & Liquidity Reporting” and is only beneficial for this role

* Identifies, measures, manages and monitors risks relating to the lack of ability of organisations to meet financial obligations without making catastrophic losses when selling investments / assets to cover obligations.

Only required for “Capital & Liquidity Reporting” and is only beneficial for this role
  
  
**Credit Risk**

* Identifies, measures, manages and monitors risks relating to borrowers’ failure to repay loans or meet its financial obligations to the Bank.

Understanding of Credit Risk Weighted Assets (RWA) methodologies, critical data elements, calculation and reporting operations and functionalities along with controls.
  
  
Only required for “Capital & Liquidity Reporting” and is only beneficial for this role
  
  
**Market Risk (Advanced ‘Entry’ for IRRBB)**

* Identifies, measures, manages and monitors risks arising from changes to market variables impacting prices and volatility (e.g., interest rate changes, commodity price changes), on a local, regional and global level.

Only required for “Capital & Liquidity Reporting” and is only beneficial for this role
  
  
**Financial Products and Markets**

* Understand and apply knowledge pertaining to SCB customer segments, product groups and the linkages of product vs. capital and liquidity.

**Financial Analysis & Reporting**

* Creates and maintains accuracy of financial reports and statements required for reporting (internal and external) leveraging key processes and tools within the Bank.

Ability to prepare, analyse, and review financial reports to evaluate the Bank's financial performance and/or regulatory compliance.
  
  
**Data Gathering**

* Knowledge of and ability to utilise tools (e.g. SQL), techniques and processes to interrogate and extract data for analysis and reporting purposes.

**Risks & Controls**

* Covers the Group’s Enterprise Risk Management Framework (ERMF) approach and governance infrastructure needed to identify, assess, mitigate and escalate Finance risks. These include accounting principles, policies and procedures around regulatory reporting, balance sheet management, tax, product and valuation control.

**Other Technical Skills**
**Financial and Accounting Systems**

* Knowledge of functions, features and capabilities of financial and accounting systems; ability to use financial and accounting applications specific to the organisation for business and/or regulatory purposes.

**Standard Operating Procedures**

* Knowledge of established standard operating procedures (SOP) and ability to design, implement and evaluate standard operating procedures affecting daily and strategic business operations in order to increase operational efficiency.

**Financial Process Documentation**

* Knowledge of appropriate techniques and ability to accurately and thoroughly document financial processes in accordance with established standards and regulatory requirements, guidelines and expectations (where applicable).

**Product Line (Financial Markets (FM))**

* Understands FM products / services provided by the Bank.
* Develops and manages the Bank’s overall FM products / services strategy and implementation.

**Product Line (Transaction Banking (TB))**

* Understands TB products / services provided by the Bank.
* Develops and manages the Bank’s overall TB products / services strategy and implementation.

**Data Analysis and Visualisation**

* Scopes and shapes business requirements into feasible and specific data analysis tasks.

Interprets data according to defined requirements to obtain business insights, including the use of statistical and predictive modelling techniques and practices for analysis.
  
  

* Communicates data findings and insights through data storytelling to key stakeholders through dynamic visual display of data.

**Business Acumen**

* Understands the Bank’s vision, business and its activities, including organisational and industry-wide matters, and applies such knowledge to business decisions and activities.

**Communication**

* Conveys and exchanges thoughts, ideas and information effectively through various mediums and approaches to a variety of audiences

**Qualifications**

title: Chief of Staff – Investments & Multi-Family Office
description:
#
**Chief of Staff – Investments & Multi-Family Office**

* Location:\*\* Chennai
* Experience:\*\* 10–15+ years; candidates with 8–10 years of highly relevant experience may also be considered
* CTC:\*\* ₹50–75 LPA(847)
* Qualification:\*\* CA / CFA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent
* Work Mode:\*\* 6 Days Work From Office; 2nd and 4th Saturdays off

**Quick Role Details**
**Role:**
Chief of Staff – Investments & MFO
  
  
📍 Chennai | 💰 ₹50–75 LPA | Experience: 10–15 years
  
  
**Non-Negotiables**

* CA / CFA / MBA (Finance)
* Wealth Advisory Firm experience mandatory
* HNI/UHNI portfolio advisory experience
* Strong expertise in asset allocation, portfolio construction, IPS & alternative investments
* No sales-led profiles
* Willingness to relocate to Chennai
* 6 Days WFO (2nd & 4th Saturdays off)

##
**Role Overview in detail:**
We are looking for a senior, entrepreneurial investment professional to work closely with the Founder in establishing and scaling an independent, advisory-led Multi-Family Office (MFO) serving HNI/UHNI individuals, promoter families and entrepreneurs.
  
  
The role combines investment analysis, wealth advisory, portfolio construction, family financial planning, stakeholder management and team leadership. The professional will help build robust investment processes, deliver customised wealth solutions and progressively take ownership of the MFO's investment function, client relationships and growth.
  
  
This is an advisory-led role focused on wealth preservation, long-term growth and intergenerational wealth planning, rather than product distribution or sales-led wealth management.
  
  
## Key Responsibilities
  
  
### 1. Family Financial Analysis & Wealth Advisory
  
  

* Conduct comprehensive financial assessments of families, covering assets, liabilities, investments, business interests, cash flows and liquidity requirements.
* Prepare consolidated net-worth statements, wealth dashboards and periodic portfolio reviews.
* Understand client objectives, risk appetite, investment horizons and wealth preservation requirements to develop customised advisory solutions.

### 2. Investment Strategy & Portfolio Construction
  
  

* Draft and review Investment Policy Statements (IPS), including investment objectives, risk parameters, liquidity needs and strategic asset allocation.
* Design and monitor customised investment portfolios aligned with family-specific financial goals.
* Evaluate portfolio performance, risk exposure, concentration, diversification, costs and suitability.
* Independently assess and challenge investment recommendations from external fund managers and wealth management partners.

### 3. Investment Research & Due Diligence
  
  

* Evaluate opportunities across Mutual Funds, PMS, AIFs, Fixed Income, Global Funds, Private Equity, Venture Capital, Angel Investments, Pre-IPO/Unlisted Investments, Real Estate Funds and other alternative assets.
* Assess investment opportunities based on risk-return profiles, valuation, liquidity, portfolio fit and long-term wealth objectives.
* Maintain strong knowledge of Indian and global fund houses, investment managers and wealth management platforms.
* Develop structured investment research, due-diligence frameworks and portfolio monitoring processes.

### 4. Family Office & Wealth Structuring
  
  

* Coordinate with tax advisors, legal experts, banks and investment managers on taxation, trusts, ownership structures and estate planning.
* Support succession planning, family governance, philanthropy, CSR and legacy planning.
* Coordinate execution of family wealth requirements while maintaining confidentiality and aligning stakeholders.

### 5. Leadership & Business Execution
  
  

* Build, lead and mentor teams across investments, research, analytics, operations and client servicing.
* Establish scalable investment processes, reporting systems and technology-enabled dashboards.
* Drive accountability, decision-making, delegation and execution across internal teams and external partners.
* Build trusted relationships with promoter families and manage complex client interactions with maturity and discretion.

description:
**JD: Planning & Operations Control Engineer**

**Company:**

Sanah Infra Projects Pvt. Ltd. — Architeca Design Build Firm

**Location:**

Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Department:**

Project Operations

**Reports to:**

Operations Head

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**About Architeca**

Architeca Design Build Firm is a residential design-and-build company focused on delivering quality homes through integrated design, construction and project management. We are strengthening our project operations systems to ensure predictable project delivery, effective cost control and consistent execution across our growing portfolio.

**Role Purpose**

We are looking for a technically competent and highly organised Planning & Operations Control Engineer to establish and maintain project planning and monitoring systems across our residential construction projects.

This role combines construction scheduling, progress monitoring, cross-functional coordination and management reporting. The person will ensure that every project has a clear master schedule, that upcoming work is planned in advance, that delays are identified early and that agreed actions are followed through to closure.

The successful candidate will work closely with the Operations Head, Project Leads, Site Engineers, QS/Cost Control and Procurement teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Initiation and Planning**

* Coordinate the handover of newly signed projects from the Sales and Design team to Operations.
* Ensure project scope, contractual milestones, drawings status, client commitments and other essential inputs are documented.
* Prepare and maintain the master project schedule in coordination with the relevant technical and execution teams.
* Establish activity sequencing, durations, dependencies, milestones and target completion dates.
* Coordinate with QS/Cost Control to ensure the project budget, BOQ and BOM are established and approved.
* Identify long-lead materials, critical activities and major execution constraints during the planning stage.

**2. Schedule Monitoring and Project Controls**

* Monitor actual progress against the approved master schedule.
* Track planned versus actual progress, milestone achievement and forecast completion dates.
* Identify schedule deviations, critical-path delays and potential completion risks.
* Obtain progress updates from Project Leads and validate them against site-level information.
* Analyse the reasons for slippage and coordinate the preparation of recovery schedules.
* Maintain a consolidated project portfolio dashboard highlighting project health and critical exceptions.

**3. Look-Ahead Planning and Readiness Coordination**

* Coordinate preparation and weekly updating of the six-week look-ahead schedule.
* Ensure upcoming activities are reviewed for drawing approvals, material availability, manpower, equipment, client decisions and other constraints.
* Coordinate with Project Leads, Procurement and QS/Cost Control to ensure upcoming work is adequately planned and made ready.
* Track material request and procurement milestones against the required site delivery dates.
* Flag unresolved constraints before they affect site execution.

**4. Weekly Operations Review**

* Prepare the weekly project review dashboard before the scheduled review meeting.
* Coordinate with the relevant departments to obtain accurate and timely project updates.
* Highlight delayed activities, cost risks, unresolved constraints and decisions requiring management intervention.
* Record meeting decisions, responsible owners, target dates and corrective actions.
* Track action closure and escalate overdue commitments to the Operations Head.
* Maintain a consistent weekly project management rhythm across all active projects.

**5. Cross-Functional Coordination**

* Act as the central coordination point for project planning information and operational follow-through.
* Facilitate communication between Project Leads, Site Engineers, Procurement, QS/Cost Control and Design teams.
* Follow up on interdepartmental dependencies and ensure unresolved issues reach the appropriate decision-maker.
* Maintain clear records of project milestones, constraints, risks, decisions and commitments in the ERP or designated project tracking system.
* Support the Operations Head in identifying recurring operational bottlenecks and improving project control processes.

**6. Process Development and Reporting**

* Develop standard formats for master schedules, look-ahead plans, progress updates, constraint registers and project dashboards.
* Improve the accuracy, timeliness and consistency of project information.
* Establish clear reporting and escalation procedures for project delays and unresolved dependencies.
* Support implementation of project planning and control SOPs across the organisation.
* Recommend improvements to ERP-based planning, monitoring and reporting workflows.

**Authority and Role Boundaries**

The role is responsible for planning, monitoring, coordination and reporting. It does not replace the accountability of functional owners.

* The Planning & Operations Control Engineer owns the integrity of the schedules, monitoring data, reporting and action-tracking process.
* Project Leads remain accountable for site execution and delivery commitments.
* QS/Cost Control remains accountable for cost estimation, budgets and cost-control inputs.
* Procurement remains accountable for purchasing and vendor coordination.
* The Operations Head retains overall accountability for project delivery, management decisions, priorities and escalation resolution.

**Candidate Profile**

**Education**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Civil Engineering or Construction Management.
* Additional qualifications in project planning or project management are an advantage.

**Experience**

* Approximately 4–8 years of relevant experience in construction planning, project controls or project coordination.
* Experience in residential building construction or other building projects is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience preparing construction schedules, monitoring progress and coordinating multiple departments.
* Experience managing several concurrent projects is desirable.

**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of construction sequences, activity dependencies, critical paths and project milestones.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and project scheduling tools such as MS Project or Primavera P6.
* Familiarity with BOQ, BOM, procurement lead times, construction budgets and project reporting.
* Experience using ERP or construction project management software.
* Ability to interpret construction drawings and communicate effectively with technical teams.

**Behavioural Competencies**

* Strong planning, organisation and follow-up discipline.
* Clear written and verbal communication.
* Confidence in coordinating with multiple departments and following up with senior team members.
* Analytical thinking and proactive identification of risks.
* Attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.
* Ability to work independently, maintain deadlines and escalate issues appropriately.
* A process-oriented mindset with a strong focus on measurable outcomes.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated against measurable indicators, including:

1. Percentage of active projects with approved master schedules and baseline completion dates.
2. Timeliness and accuracy of weekly schedule updates.
3. Timely preparation of the six-week look-ahead schedule.
4. Early identification and escalation of critical schedule deviations.
5. Accuracy of project progress and forecast completion reporting.
6. Timely preparation of weekly operations review dashboards and action trackers.
7. Percentage of assigned coordination actions closed by their agreed deadlines.
8. Timeliness of identifying material and other readiness constraints.
9. Completeness and reliability of project records in the ERP or designated tracking system.

Project completion performance will be a shared outcome with the Operations Head and Project Leads, rather than the sole responsibility of this position.

**What Success Looks Like**

Within the first 90 days, the successful candidate should:

* Establish a consolidated register of all active projects.
* Ensure each project has a documented schedule baseline or a clearly defined plan to establish one.
* Implement a consistent weekly progress-update and six-week look-ahead process.
* Introduce a reliable portfolio dashboard and action-tracking system.
* Establish clear visibility of delayed projects, upcoming constraints and overdue decisions.
* Enable the Operations Head to review project health and take timely action without personally chasing every department for routine updates.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates may submit their updated CV highlighting relevant construction planning experience, scheduling tools used, the number and types of projects handled, and examples of project monitoring or coordination systems implemented.

Application – Planning & Operations Control Engineer

MAARS Design is a Chennai-based architecture and interior design studio known for creating contextual, sustainable, and thoughtful spaces. Founded by architects Mridula and Ammaar Chowdry, the studio focuses on residential architecture and interiors that balance openness and privacy with contemporary yet place-sensitive design. Its portfolio includes notable projects such as The Gully Home, a coastal residence recognized for its layered spatial planning, and The Urban Pause, a multi-unit residential development that reimagines modern urban living in India. MAARS Design combines rigorous design thinking, sustainability principles, and a collaborative approach to deliver spaces that are both functional and visually engaging. The studio offers a dynamic environment for professionals interested in high-quality residential and interior design in Chennai.

**Role Description**
The Interior Quantity Surveyor will be responsible for managing cost-related aspects of interior projects from inception to completion in a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai. Day-to-day tasks include preparing and reviewing Bills of Quantities (BOQ), estimating project costs, monitoring budgets, and ensuring cost-effective use of materials and resources. The role involves supporting the design and project management teams with cost planning, conducting regular cost reporting, and updating stakeholders on financial progress and variances. The Interior Quantity Surveyor will work closely with contractors, vendors, and consultants to obtain quotations, negotiate prices, and verify measurements and invoices. The position also includes assisting with tender documentation, evaluating bids, and contributing to the financial viability and timely delivery of interior projects.

**Qualifications**

* Strong expertise in BOQ preparation and quantity take-offs for interior projects.
* Proficiency in Cost Planning and Cost Management, including budgeting and forecasting.
* Experience in Cost Control and Cost Reporting to track expenditures and support decision-making.
* Knowledge of interior materials, finishes, and construction methods relevant to residential and commercial interiors.
* Ability to read and interpret architectural and interior design drawings accurately.
* Relevant academic background in Quantity Surveying, Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
* Competence in MS Excel and quantity surveying or estimation software; familiarity with project management tools is an advantage.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary design and site teams.
* Good written and verbal communication skills in English; working knowledge of local languages in Chennai is beneficial.
* Prior experience in interior or architectural projects in India is preferred.

description:
**Company Description**
Esse India is an immigration consultancy based in New Delhi, India, supporting individuals and families seeking opportunities abroad. The team provides guidance on immigration pathways, eligibility, documentation, and application processes for destinations such as Canada, Australia, Germany, Austria, and Hong Kong, depending on current service offerings. Esse India focuses on clear communication, personalized counseling, and transparent processes to help clients make informed decisions. Interested applicants can learn more about the company, its services, and updates via the website and contact channels.

**Role Description**
The Senior Finance Manager for Abroad Opportunities is a full-time, on-site role based in Canada. This position is responsible for overseeing financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting related to international services and operations. The Senior Finance Manager will monitor revenue streams, cost structures, and profitability, ensuring compliance with relevant financial regulations and internal policies. Day-to-day tasks include analyzing financial performance, preparing management reports, supporting strategic decisions, and coordinating with operations and leadership teams to optimize financial outcomes. The role also involves improving financial processes, supporting audits, and providing guidance on financial implications of new markets, services, and business initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* Strong finance and accounting expertise, including financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and financial reporting.
* Proficiency in financial analysis, data interpretation, and use of spreadsheets or financial modeling tools.
* Knowledge of relevant financial regulations, compliance standards, and best practices in corporate finance.
* Experience in managing cross-functional financial initiatives and collaborating with senior leadership.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills with attention to detail.
* Strong communication and presentation skills to explain financial insights to non-financial stakeholders.
* Ability to work on-site in Chennai, manage multiple priorities, and meet deadlines in a dynamic environment.
* Relevant academic background, such as a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field; professional certifications (e.g., CA, CMA, CPA, MBA in Finance) are an advantage.
* Prior experience in a senior finance role, preferably in consulting, services, or international business environments.

description:

Assistant Manager
  
  
**Department**
: Banking service operations
  
  
**About Business line/Function:**
The role sits within Banking service operations – Account manager, part of the Chennai hub of BNP Paribas India solutions private limited. We provide end‑to‑end custody, settlement services to institutional investors, fund managers and broker‑dealers across Asia and Europe. The team works closely with clients along with internal partners (operations, compliance, technology) to ensure seamless delivery of the bank’s solutions across asset classes and geographies.
  
  
**Position Purpose:**
Act as the client Single Point of Contact (SPOC) to achieve client delight, coordinate internal teams, adhere to BNP Paribas policies and service‑level agreements (SLAs), and prevent breaches by delivering solutions on time and to the required quality.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Direct Responsibilities
  
  

* Risk‑governance – maintain the BSO and Fund Distribution Services (FDS) risk‑governance framework.
* Program coordination – act as the point of contact for regional programmes that align locations with Group Policy, regulatory reporting and Global Control Plans.
* Credit‑control process ownership – oversee end‑to‑end credit‑control (account set‑up → payments), liaising with all internal stakeholder teams across the Sydney business.
* First‑line defense – perform AML transaction analysis & reporting, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, annual US‑account identification, manual‑entries control, and investigation of non‑compliant alerts.
* Audit liaison – serve as the single point of contact for internal and external audit requests.
* Control execution for Global Custody – deliver quarterly Overdrawn & Dormant Account reports, run manual‑entries control testing, analyse overdraft customers/credit institutions, and review monthly abnormal balances.
* Instruction‑callback oversight – manage callbacks for Investment Communications team (faxed cash‑payment instructions to third parties).
* Business continuity – conduct impact analysis, planning and testing of BSO Business Continuity procedures.
* Incident remediation – lead remedial actions, including good‑value claim payments for all BP2S Sydney incidents.
* Cash‑account interest set‑up – manage the Global Custody cash‑account interest set‑up process.

Contributing Responsibilities
  
  

* Regulatory comprehension – stay current on the regulations governing the business and ensure BP2S obligations are executed and monitored.
* Risk & Control monitoring – deliver and monitor a framework that ensures residual risk is maintained at an acceptable, sustainable level.
* Stakeholder relationship building – establish strong links with second‑line functions, Global Process Owners (GPOs) and first‑line process owners.
* Automation of controls – design and implement progressive solutions to automate manual controls wherever feasible.

**Technical Behavioral Competencies**
**Technical Competencies**

* Proven experience in Operations within Investment Banking and securities services (domestic & global).
* Deep understanding and practical application of Operational Risk – first line methodology.
* Ability to prioritise and deliver multiple projects concurrently while operating independently.
* Strong working knowledge of BNP Paribas Securities Services processes (custody, settlement, fund distribution).
* Proficient in MS Excel, PowerPoint & Word (advanced functions, data analysis, reporting).

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Analytical mindset – rigorous, detail oriented and able to dissect complex issues.
* Team collaboration – works effectively across functions, influences and coordinates stakeholders.
* Client centric attitude – delivers high quality service while adhering to regulatory and risk standards.
* Adaptability – thrives in a fast changing environment, can pivot priorities as needed.
* Result driven – meets deadlines, follows through on commitments, and ensures control execution

**Specific Qualifications**

title: HRIS & Finance Systems Partner
description:
**The Role**

The G&A Systems Business Partner is a manager-level individual contributor embedded within Chargebee's General & Administrative organization. This person serves as the primary GBT technology interface for the CFO, CHRO, and General Counsel, owning the systems roadmap, resolving blockers, and delivering AI-enabled business process improvements across Finance, Human Resources, Legal, and Accounting.

This is not a support role. It is a high-accountability partnership position requiring deep expertise in enterprise G&A systems, NetSuite ERP, a global HCM platform (DarwinBox or Rippling), IronClad CLM, and Coupa,combined with the ability to deploy AI tools across business workflows and act as the connective tissue between G&A leadership and all of GBT's capabilities.

**Responsibilities**

**Stakeholder Relationship & Partnership**

* Build and maintain deep, trusted relationships with G&A sub-leaders across Finance, FP&A, Accounting, HR/People, Legal, and Compliance, understanding their goalss, system pain points, and strategic priorities on a continuous basis.
* Serve as the single named GBT point of contact for CFO, CHRO, and General Counsel organizations, eliminating ticket-queue friction with a 24-hour response commitment on all critical blockers.
* Develop full fluency across all GBT sub-functions, GTM Tech, Q2C Systems, G&A Systems, Corporate Data & AI Enablement, InfoSec, AI CoE, and PMO,and know exactly when and how to mobilize each on behalf of G&A.

**HR & People Systems, DarwinBox or Rippling (Global HCM)**

* Serve as the primary GBT owner for Chargebee's global HCM platform, DarwinBox (India/APAC) or Rippling (US/EMEA), administering employee lifecycle workflows including hire-to-retire, offboarding, payroll integration, leaves, and performance management.
* Configure and maintain HCM modules: Core HR, Payroll, Benefits, Performance, Time & Attendance, and Learning, aligned to Chargebee's global entity structure and local compliance requirements.
* Own the integration between the HCM and NetSuite for payroll journal entries and headcount reporting; ensure HR master data synchronizes accurately with downstream systems including Okta, Slack, and the GBT Data Warehouse.
* Partner with the CHRO's office and HRBPs to design and automate people processes, onboarding workflows, org chart management, compensation review cycles, and attrition analytics.
* Drive AI enablement within the People function, deploying productivity tools for HRBP teams, automating routine HR queries via AI agents, and building adoption of Birthright AI tools across the HR organization.

**Legal Systems, IronClad CLM**

* Serve as the primary GBT owner for IronClad Contract Lifecycle Management, configuring and administering the contract repository, workflow templates, approval chains, counterparty negotiation workflows, and reporting dashboards.
* Design and build CLM business processes end-to-end: contract intake, NDA automation, commercial agreement workflows, renewal management, and obligation tracking, in partnership with the General Counsel and Legal Ops team.
* Configure IronClad integrations with Salesforce (opportunity-to-contract), DocuSign (e-signature), and the GBT Data Warehouse (contract analytics); ensure Legal data flows remain accurate across the stack.
* Identify and deploy AI-assisted contract review and drafting capabilities within IronClad, working with the AI CoE to evaluate, pilot, and scale applicable tools within Legal Ops.

**Procurement Systems, Coupa**

* Own GBT's configuration and administration of Coupa ,covering eProcurement, Purchase Orders, Supplier Management, Invoicing, and Expense Management modules.
* Design procurement business flows in Coupa aligned to Chargebee's purchasing policy: requisition-to-PO, invoice-to-pay, 3-way match, and supplier onboarding, including budget threshold controls and approval routing by cost center and entity.
* Own the Coupa-to-NetSuite integration, ensuring PO, invoice, and payment data flows accurately into the GL with no reconciliation gaps.
* Manage supplier portal configuration, catalog management, and procurement analytics dashboards for the Finance and Procurement leadership team.

**AI Expertise & G&A AI Enablement**

* Champion AI tool adoption within the G&A organization as part of Chargebee's Birthright AI Access program, assigning and enabling Personal Productivity, Builder, and Super Builder personas across Finance, HR, Legal, and Accounting roles.
* Design, prototype, and deploy AI automation workflows across G&A processes: AP invoice processing, contract review assistance, HR query chatbots, payroll reconciliation automation, and financial close analytics.
* Run quarterly AI enablement workshops for G&A teams, in collaboration with the AI Center of Excellence, track adoption metrics and escalate advanced build requirements to Dev AI.
* Maintain hands-on proficiency across relevant AI platforms: Claude (Anthropic), IronClad AI, Workato/Make AI capabilities, and NetSuite AI-native features; stay current with the evolving landscape and bring innovations to G&A proactively.

**Pace, Urgency & Delivery Excellence**

* Operate with extreme bias to action,ship working solutions in days, not sprints; apply 80/20 thinking to deliver immediate value while longer-term builds are in flight.
* Thrive in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment where Finance calendars, audit cycles, and regulatory requirements create hard deadlines; adapt the technology roadmap without compromising governance or controls.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams across Finance, HR, Legal, and Accounting without dropping commitments; use structured intake, prioritization, and status communication to keep G&A leaders informed at all times.
* Define and track delivery KPIs: time-to-first-response on blockers, sprint velocity, G&A satisfaction scores, AI adoption rates by sub-function, and business value delivered per quarter.

**Qualifications**

**Experience & Background**

* 5-7+ years of total experience, with at least 4+ years in a Business Partner, G&A Systems, ERP Administration, or IT Partnership role within a high-growth SaaS or technology company.
* Demonstrated track record of embedding directly within Finance, HR, or Legal organizations and delivering system improvements and AI-enabled automation at high velocity.
* Experience operating in a fast-paced, global SaaS environment with multi-entity, multi-currency requirements; familiarity with subscription billing, revenue recognition, and global payroll complexity is a strong plus.
* Background in or strong familiarity with G&A business processes end-to-end: procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, record-to-report, hire-to-retire, and contract lifecycle management.

**NetSuite ERP Expertise**

* NetSuite Administrator certification required; NetSuite ERP Consultant or SuiteFoundation certification strongly preferred.
* Deep, hands-on NetSuite configuration skills: SuiteFlows, SuiteScripts (working knowledge), custom records and fields, saved searches, financial consolidation, multi-book/multi-subsidiary, and role/permission management.
* Experience configuring NetSuite Revenue Recognition (ASC 606/IFRS 15), Fixed Assets Management, and AP/AR automation is highly valued.
* Ability to direct a NetSuite developer with precision for complex scripting requirements; candidates who can write basic SuiteScript are preferred.

**G&A Platform Expertise**

* DarwinBox or Rippling HCM: hands-on experience administering core HR, payroll integration, and employee lifecycle workflows in a global, multi-entity organization.
* IronClad CLM (or comparable CLM platform, Ironclad, Icertis, Conga): experience configuring contract workflows, approval routing, e-signature integrations, and contract repository management.
* Coupa (or comparable eProcurement, Coupa, Zip, Jaggaer): experience administering PO workflows, 3-way match, invoice automation, and supplier management.
* Proficiency with integration middleware (Workato, MuleSoft, or Make) for connecting G&A systems to each other and to downstream data platforms.

**AI & Agentic AI Expertise**

* Demonstrated hands-on experience deploying AI tools in a Finance, HR, or Legal context, including document intelligence, process automation, and AI-assisted workflows.
* Ability to design and prototype AI automation flows for G&A use cases (AP automation, contract review, HR query bots, financial close analytics) using available platforms.
* Proficiency with the Builder-tier AI tool stack: Claude (Anthropic), Gemini, Notion AI, Cursor, N8N capabilities; not expected to write production code but must be fluent in building with AI tools.
* Proven ability to identify AI automation opportunities in G&A workflows and independently drive them from idea to deployed solution, including change management and user adoption.

title: EH-FY27-Consulting-S&T-Strategy-Senior Consultant-BS-Consumer
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Job Description - Strategy & Transactions – Strategy (Sr. Consultant)**
**At Deloitte Strategy & Transactions (S&T), we don’t just advise — we architect the future. Our team is uniquely positioned at the intersection of strategy and execution, empowering clients to tackle their most pressing challenges and unlock transformative growth.**
**We work with C-suite executives, Boards, and business leaders to answer the questions that matter most — from navigating complex M&A and driving digital transformation, to reshaping operating models and unlocking new market opportunities. We are trusted advisors during our clients' most critical, high-stakes moments.**
**But we don’t stop at client impact — we are equally passionate about investing in our people. At S&T, you’ll be part of a dynamic team culture that accelerates leadership development, fosters curiosity, and delivers hands-on experience at the forefront of strategy and transactions. We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.**
**Our capabilities span the full lifecycle of transformation — from Enterprise and Growth Strategy to Enterprise Technology and Transformation Strategy, end-to-end M&A, valuation and modeling, and performance improvement & restructuring, to infrastructure & real estate advisory and sustainability-driven innovation.**
**If you’re looking to work where bold thinking meets real-world impact — and where your growth matters as much as your clients’ — Strategy & Transactions is your next move.**
**The team**
Our Strategy practice brings together several key capabilities that will allow us to architect integrated programs that transform our clients’ businesses, including Corporate & Business Unit Strategy, Go to Market Strategy, and Capability Transformation.
  
  
Strategy professionals will serve as trusted advisors to our clients, working with them to make clear data-driven choices about where to play and how to win, in order to drive growth and enterprise value.
  
  
**Work you will do:**
Deloitte’s ‘Strategy’ offering helps companies address the entire range of top management challenges including pursuing new growth opportunities, developing go-to-market strategies, channel strategies, and pricing strategies.
  
  

* Identify strategies for growth and value creation
* Develop the appropriate business models, technology operating models, and capabilities to support their strategic vision
* Maximize the ROI on AI and technology investments and leverage technology trends to architect future technology strategies

**Required Experience And Skills**
**Enterprise and Growth Strategy (Consumer)**

* Following experience would be required:
* Background / experience in one or more subsectors, including Retail, Consumer Products, Automotive, Hotels, Restaurants, and/or Airlines
* Sound understanding of topics such as Business Strategy, Operations, Customer Loyalty Management, Pricing & Trade Promotions, Merchandising, Sales & Growth, Category Management, Franchisee Management, and/or Airline Distribution
* Experience working across: Corporate Strategy, Go-to-market (GTM) Strategy, Market Research & Assessment, Commercial Strategy, Launch Readiness Roadmap Development, Business Model & Operating Model Assessment, Business Case Development, Market Access Strategy, Pricing and Promotion Strategy, Loyalty Strategy, Vendor Assessment within the Consumer Industry
* Awareness of and interest in current trends shaping the Consumer sectors
* Demonstrated ability to understand and analyze complex business problems and leverage AI-driven solutions; familiarity with AI/GenAI platforms (e.g., Claude, ChatGPT, Copilot) and their practical applications in a business context is strongly preferred
* Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience in corporate strategy teams and/or cross-functional roles with visibility to senior stakeholders at leading Consumer industry companies
* Exposure to non-India geographies (preferably the US) and/or experience engaging with global stakeholders

**Core Consulting Competencies**

* Communication: Ability to conduct client interviews, facilitate workshops and training sessions, and present findings and recommendations clearly and concisely
* Client Presence: Proven ability to build and maintain strong relationships with clients and cross-functional team members
* Analytical Thinking: Proficiency in quantitative analysis, primary and secondary research, and business case development; ability to synthesize data into actionable insights and recommendations. Strong command of analytical and productivity tools including Microsoft Excel (financial modeling, data analysis) and PowerPoint (storyboarding, executive-level presentations) is a plus
* Structured Problem Solving: Logical, hypothesis-driven approach to problem solving with demonstrated ability to perform root cause analysis
* Delivery Excellence: Deadline-oriented and quality-focused; capable of owning end-to-end delivery of high-quality work products, managing workstreams, developing engagement plans, and mentoring junior team members
* Collaboration: Comfortable working independently and within teams across all levels; able to prioritize effectively, manage scope changes, handle multiple assignments simultaneously, and escalate issues proactively
* Networking: Self-starter with the ability to navigate career growth and build a strong internal and external professional network

**Qualifications**
**Required:**

* MBA or MS from a Tier-1 institution in India or abroad
* 3-7 years of relevant post-MBA/MS experience
* 2-3 years of experience with a focus on the Consumer Industry

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

description:
Join us as an AVP - Product Controller FIF at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unparalleled customer experiences.
  
  
**To Be Successful, In This Role You Should Have**

* Product control experience in Investment bank.
* Qualified Chartered accountant preferred .
* In-depth knowledge of Financial product and markets of the relevant asset class.
* Good understanding of end-to-end processes of an IB (Investment Banking) and associated controls.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills in both formal and informal settings and the ability to interact with the region and London as part of a global team (written and verbal).
* Excellent time management skills and the ability to prioritize.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* CFA / Masters in Finance / Financial Engineering.
* Good control awareness and problem-solving ability.
* Ability to work independently with a spectrum of people from junior finance staff to front office business heads.
* Mature and able to negotiate through difficult situations.
* Good influencing and negotiation skills and excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.
  
  
The role is based out of Chennai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To oversee the financial aspects of trading activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of the bank's trading book, maintenance of compliance with regulatory requirements, and provision of insights into trading performance.
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Reconciliation of daily profit and loss (P&L) figures for trading desks to ensure they align with the valued positions in the trading book, investigating and resolving discrepancies between P&L figures to ensure they reflect the true economic value of the trading portfolio.
* Support the identification, assessment, and mitigation of trading risks, and report on these financial risks to senior colleagues.
* Maintenance and analysis of the bank’s trading data, ensuring its accuracy, completeness and consistency, and provision of insights to traders and senior colleagues on trading performance.
* Preparation and submission of regulatory reports to authorities, and provision of support to external audits including addressing auditor queries and ensuring trading activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements.
* Effective communication of complex financial information to traders, risk professionals, senior colleagues, and external stakeholders.
* Cross functional collaboration to ensure a coordinated approach to trading activities.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

* Must have expertise working with SQL
* Must have experience in leveraging Gen AI in Analytics & Reporting
* Knowledge of Python and Pyspark is a must

**Who we are:**
With Citi’s Analytics & Information Management (AIM) group, you will do meaningful work from Day 1. Our collaborative and respectful culture lets people grow and make a difference in one of the world’s leading Financial Services Organizations. The purpose of the group is to use Citi’s data assets to analyze information and create actionable intelligence for our business leaders. We value what makes you unique so that you have opportunity to shine. You also get the opportunity to work with the best minds and top leaders in the analytics space.
  
  
**What The Role Is**
The role of Officer – Data Management/Information Analyst will be part of AIM team based out of Bengaluru, India supporting the Global Workforce Optimization unit.
  
  
The GWFO team supports capacity planning across the organization. The primary responsibility of the GWFO team is to forecast future demand (Inbound /Outbound Call Volume, back-office process volume, etc.) and the capacity required to fulfill the demand. It also includes forecasting short-term demand (daily/ hourly) and scheduling the agent accordingly. The GWFO team is also responsible for collaborating with multiple stakeholders and coming up with optimal hiring plans to ensure adequate capacity as well as optimize the operational budget.
  
  
In this role, you will work along a highly talented team of analyst to build reporting and monitoring solutions to track key business metrics and support the workforce optimization activities.
  
  
You will be responsible for understanding the business need for reporting and monitoring of their workforce plans and developing intuitive, best in class, data-driven solutions leveraging the best tools for the job. You would work very closely with GWFO’s technology partners in getting these solutions implemented in a compliant environment.
  
  
You would be an SME in the group, supporting and mentoring the team on technical solutioning and should be ready to lend your hand to juniors when needed.

**Data Driven.**
A proven track record of enabling decision making and problem solving with data. Conceptual thinking skills must be complemented by a strong quantitative orientation and data driven approach.
  
  
**Excellent Problem Solver.**
You are a critical thinker, able to ask right questions, make sense of a situation and come up with intelligent solutions.
  
  
**Strong Team Player.**
You build a trusted relationships with your team members. You are ready to offer unconditional assistance, will listen, share knowledge, and are always ready to provide support as needed.
  
  
**Strong Communicator.**
You can communicate verbally and through written communication with clarity and can structure and present your work to your partners & leadership.
  
  
**Clear Results Orientation.**
You display a keen focus on achieving both short and long-term goals and have experience driving and executing an agenda in a demanding and fast-paced environment, with an eye on risks & controls.
  
  
**Innovative.**
You are always challenging yourself and your team to find better and faster ways of doing things.

You develop insightful, visually compelling and engaging dashboards that supports decision making and drive adoption.
  
  
**Flawless Execution.**
You manage and sequence delivery of reporting and data needs by actively managing requests against available bandwidth and identify opportunities for improved productivity.

Understand existing data & reporting by dwelling into multiple platforms scattered across the organization. You do what it takes to gather information by connecting with people across business teams and technology.
  
  
**Process & Controls Orientation.**
You develop strong processes, and indestructible controls to address risk and seek to propagate that culture to become the core value of your team.

You support your team and help them accomplish their goals with empathy. You act as a facilitator and remove blockers and create a positive atmosphere for then to be innovative and productive at work.
