title: Senior SAP FICO Specialist
description:
**Job Title: SAP FICO In-House Specialist**
Location: Chennai, India
  
  
Company: Glencore
  
  
Employment Type: Full-time
  
  
**About Us:**
Glencore is one of the world’s largest globally diversified natural resource companies. Our operations encompass the production, sourcing, processing, and marketing of various commodities. We are committed to sustainable practices and strive to create value for our stakeholders.
  
  
**Position Overview:**
We are looking for a skilled SAP FICO In-House Specialist to join our IT team. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with SAP Financial Accounting (FI) and Controlling (CO) modules. This role will involve ensuring the integrity of financial data and optimizing financial processes across the organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, implement, and support SAP FICO solutions to meet business requirements and enhance financial reporting.
* Manage and optimize complex solutions that are both standard and bespoke, ensuring data accuracy and consistency.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather requirements and translate them into effective SAP solutions.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to financial data and system interfaces.
* Conduct data analysis and prepare financial reports to support management decision-making.
* Stay updated on SAP FICO best practices, new functionalities, and regulatory changes to ensure compliance.
* Provide training and support to end-users and contribute to knowledge sharing within the team.

**Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Technology, or a related field.
* Minimum of 4 years of experience in SAP FICO implementation and support, with a focus on complex interfaces.
* Strong understanding of financial processes and reporting requirements.
* Experience with integration tools and technologies (e.g., IDoc, BAPIs, RFC) is highly desirable.
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

**What We Offer:**

* Competitive salary and benefits package.
* Opportunities for professional development and career advancement.
* A dynamic and inclusive work environment.
* The chance to make a significant impact in a leading global company.

**Who We Are**
Glencore is one of the world’s largest global diversified natural resource companies and a major producer and marketer of more than 60 commodities that advance everyday life. Through a network of assets, customers and suppliers that spans the globe, we produce, process, recycle, source, market and distribute the commodities that support decarbonisation while meeting the energy needs of today.
  
  
With over 150,000 employees and contractors and a strong footprint in over 35 countries in both established and emerging regions for natural resources, our marketing and industrial activities are supported by a global network of more than 50 offices.
  
  
Glencore’s customers are industrial consumers, such as those in the automotive, steel, power generation, battery manufacturing and oil sectors. We also provide financing, logistics and other services to producers and consumers of commodities.
  
  
Glencore is proud to be a member of the Voluntary Principles on Security and Human Rights and the International Council on Mining and Metals. We are an active participant in the Extractive Industries Transparency Initiative.
  
  
We will support the global effort to achieve the goals of the Paris Agreement through our efforts to decarbonise our own operational footprint. We believe that we should take a holistic approach and have considered our commitment through the lens of our global industrial emissions. Against a restated 2019 baseline, we are targeting to reduce our Scope 1, 2 and 3 industrial emissions by 15% by the end of 2026, 25% by the end of 2030, 50% by the end of 2035 and we have an ambition to achieve net zero industrial emissions by the end of 2050, subject to a supportive policy environment. For more information see our 2024-2026 Climate Action Transition Plan and the About our emissions calculation and reporting section in our 2023 Annual Report, available on our website at glencore.com/publications.
  
  
Note\*: All applications will be subject to potential background checks. You will be informed if this will be the case. Further information about the processing of your personal data will be made available during the application process. We'll seek your explicit consent prior to processing the data.

title: Wealth Regulatory Reporting Operations AVP
description:

+ Prepare and submit complex non-financial regulatory reports for various jurisdictions and products, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
+ Act as a primary point of contact for coordination with partner units for exceptions and clarifications pertaining to identified issues.
+ Analyze regulatory reporting processes from front to back to identify gaps and improvement opportunities.

* Process Improvement & Projects:

+ Execute assigned elements of the roadmap to improve regulatory reporting operations by streamlining processes, mitigating risks, and enhancing documentation.
+ Drive projects and process improvements, anticipating future regulatory changes and supporting operational alignment within assigned areas.
+ Develop Business Requirements for system-related enhancements and participate in the end-to-end management of their implementation.

* Control & Documentation:

+ Oversee and enhance the control framework for assigned reports, including MCA, audits, and procedure updates.
+ Ensure the completeness of the reporting inventory for their assigned areas by maintaining up-to-date records.
+ Participate in internal and external audit reviews, providing analysis and documentation as required.
+ Serve as an escalation point for junior analysts and contribute to internal training initiatives.
+ Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

+ Participate in regulatory report design reviews with Product and ICRM stakeholders, providing detailed input on data and process requirements.
+ Collaborate with Risk, Compliance, and Technology partners to support integrated reporting solutions.
+ Prepare materials and participate in governance forums to provide updates on specific reports or issues.
+ Prepare information and draft communications for routine regulatory matters as required.

**Qualifications:**

+ 5-8 years of experience in Operations, preferably in a regulatory reporting space.
+ Solid experience in transactional regulatory reporting and a deep understanding of operational processes and controls.
+ Proven experience working with business stakeholders within a cross-functional matrix environment.
+ Hands-on experience with data automation and analytics tools (e.g., Xceptor, Alteryx) is a significant plus; an understanding of prompt development for AI tools is desirable.
+ Strong analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
+ Proficiency with MS Project, Excel, Visio, PowerPoint, and SharePoint, with experience presenting to stakeholders.
+ Experience working both independently and in a team-oriented, collaborative environment, with experience in coaching junior staff.
+ Proficiency in data automation and transformation tools such as Xceptor and Alteryx is highly desirable. Understanding of prompt development for AI tools.

**Education:**

+ Bachelor's/University degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Business, or a related field. A Master's degree is a plus

title: Commercial Banking: Mid Corporate Relationship Manager - Senior Vice President
description:
The Mid-Corp Relationship Manager is a strategic professional who closely follows latest trends in own field and adapts them for application within own job and the business. Typically a small number of people within the business that provide the same level of expertise. Excellent communication skills required in order to negotiate internally, often at a senior level. Developed communication and diplomacy skills are required in order to guide, influence and convince others, in particular colleagues in other areas and occasional external customers. Accountable for significant direct business results or authoritative advice regarding the operations of the business. Necessitates a degree of responsibility over technical strategy. Primarily affects a sub-function. Responsible for handling staff management issues, including resource management and allocation of work within the team/project.
  
  
**Responsibilities:**

* Calls on clients to deepen relationships and proactively owns, responds to, uncovers and anticipates future needs, roadblocks or risks and expectations
* Introduces solutions to clients in building and strengthening an effective portfolio;
* Works with product specialists and subject matter experts to structure innovative and customized solutions that meet clients’ individual needs
* Works closely with Case Manager on the on-boarding and retention of clients, ensuring the appropriate “Know Your Client” (KYC) and other compliance deliverables are met;
* Identifies cross-sell opportunities to deepen and increase share of wallet;
* Maximizes client experience by proactive sharing markets updates, trend and intelligence
* Drives innovation in the solutions we provide clients and further developing our business where necessary and appropriate
* Execution of strategic initiatives launched centrally at all levels (Group, Bank, commercial market and EIB)
* Networks with clients to identify avenues for new business opportunities;
* Administrate the credit relationship of the client, coordinating and supervising the entire process, ensuring the proper application of policies and institutional processes
* Ensures compliance with regulatory requirements and Citi's policies / guidelines at all time
* Appropriately assess risk when business decisions are made, demonstrating particular consideration for the firm's reputation and safeguarding Citigroup, its clients and assets, by driving compliance with applicable laws, rules and regulations, adhering to Policy, applying sound ethical judgment regarding personal behavior, conduct and business practices, and escalating, managing and reporting control issues with transparency.

**Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience
* Sound knowledge of banking and investment products and process as well as a track record of providing sound banking and financial advice and solutions to clients
* Demonstrates intermediate to advanced credit skills; structures more complex deals, including global transactions
* Demonstrates an expert level of Early Warning Detection skills
* Demonstrates expert level credit skills; capable of structuring all credit deals and guiding staff through the credit deal approval process
* Demonstrates advanced Citi’s credit-process and credit-appetite knowledge
* Ability to work effectively in team setting
* Ability to coordinate multi-functional teams to provide an exceptional client experience.
* Excellent interpersonal, communication and influencing skills (e.g. negotiation, consultative skills, leadership)
* Ability to work under pressure while making sound decisions
* Highly focused, able to rapidly identify key priorities, clearly communicate the priorities
* Accountable for significant direct business results or authoritative advice regarding the operations of the business.
* A proactive approach in looking for ways in strengthening business relationship with clients, delivers a simple, secure and seamless client experience
* Ability to embrace new technology and understand the role digital plays in the experience we deliver for our clients
* Able to quickly adapt priorities based on the latest data insights

title: SAP FI - FSCM Manager
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**Position Title: FSCM - Manager**
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
As an SAP FSCM Manager, you will lead the financial supply chain management initiatives within the organization, driving improvements in cash flow, credit management, and collections processes. This role offers the chance to oversee the implementation and optimization of SAP FSCM solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives and enhancing overall financial performance.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Leadership: Manage the FSCM team, providing guidance and support to ensure effective execution of financial supply chain strategies.
* Implementation: Oversee the configuration and deployment of SAP FSCM solutions to meet organizational needs.
* Process Improvement: Identify and implement best practices to optimize credit management, collections, and dispute resolution processes.
* Data Analysis: Analyze financial data to provide insights and drive strategic decision-making.
* Collaboration: Work with cross-functional teams to align financial processes with overall business objectives.
* User Training: Develop and deliver training programs for end-users on FSCM functionalities.
* Troubleshooting: Address and resolve issues related to the FSCM module, ensuring system reliability.
* Reporting: Generate and present reports on financial performance and process efficiency to senior management.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Should be aware S4HANA credit management functionalities.
* Must have at least 2 end-to-end implementation experience in SAP FSCM Credit Management, Collection Management and Dispute Management, cash application-High Rad Integration.

**Ideally, you’ll also**

* Develop and deliver training programs for end-users on FSCM functionalities.

**What We Look For**

* Resource must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance / Mcom.
* Should have minimum 7-11 years of experience on SAP S4 Hana Credit / Collection / Dispute Management.
* Must have at least 2 end-to-end implementation experience in SAP FSCM Credit Management, Collection Management and Dispute Management, cash application-High Rad Integration.
* Must have knowledge on 3rd party interface integration for credit management.
* Should have knowledge on credit score calculation.
* Should be aware S4HANA credit management functionalities.
* Should have hands on experience to prepare functional specifications.
* Should have knowledge in SAP FI Account Receivables.
* Should be able to independently handle complex technical PO requirements.
* Should be good in Communication both written and verbal.

**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Supervisor, Accounts Receivable
description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* We are seeking a dedicated and experienced Healthcare RCM Supervisor, Accounts Receivable, to oversee our accounts receivable department. The ideal candidate will possess strong leadership skills, a comprehensive understanding of healthcare revenue cycle management, and a proven track record of optimizing accounts receivable processes. The Supervisor will be responsible for managing a team of AR specialists, ensuring timely and accurate billing, claims processing, payment posting, and denial management.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Lead and manage a team of accounts receivable specialists, providing guidance, support, and coaching to ensure high performance and productivity.
* Develop and implement strategies to optimize the accounts receivable process, reduce aging of accounts, and improve cash flow.
* Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics related to accounts receivable, such as days in accounts receivable (AR days), denial rates, and cash collection ratios, and take proactive measures to address any deviations from targets.
* Oversee the billing and claims processing functions, ensuring that claims are submitted accurately and timely, and that any issues or errors are promptly addressed and resolved.
* Manage payment posting activities, reconciling payments received with billed charges, and identifying and addressing any discrepancies or variances.
* Coordinate denial management efforts, analyzing denial trends, implementing corrective actions, and appealing denials as necessary to maximize revenue recovery.
* Collaborate with other departments, such as coding, billing, and compliance, to ensure alignment and consistency in revenue cycle processes and workflows.
* Stay informed about changes and updates in healthcare regulations, payer policies, and industry trends related to accounts receivable management, and implement necessary changes to ensure compliance and optimization.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance reviews, providing feedback, recognition, and development opportunities to team members.
* Foster a positive and collaborative work environment, promoting teamwork, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Serve as a point of contact for escalated issues and inquiries from internal stakeholders, external partners, and patients related to accounts receivable matters.
* Keep accurate records of accounts receivable activities, performance metrics, and outcomes, and generate reports as needed to track progress and measure success.

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in any related field.
* Minimum of 6 years of experience in healthcare revenue cycle management, with a focus on accounts receivable.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Previous leadership experience, preferably in a healthcare setting.
* In-depth knowledge of medical billing processes, reimbursement methodologies, and regulatory requirements.
* Strong understanding of healthcare payer policies and claims adjudication processes.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to effectively lead and motivate a team.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, with a focus on driving results and achieving objectives.
* Proficiency in healthcare revenue cycle management software and systems.
* Certified Professional Coder (CPC) or Certified Revenue Cycle Representative (CRCR) certification is a plus.
* Willingness to stay updated on industry trends and best practices through continuing education and professional development opportunities.

* Base Compensation will be based on various factors unique to each candidate including geographic location, skill set, experience, qualifications, and other job-related reasons .

description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. **What you’ll be doing**
...
  
  
As a Consultant (Analytics) you will be a pivotal player in modernizing telecom financial operations. Bridging the gap between implementation and architectural strategy, you will design, develop, and deploy advanced AI/ML, Generative AI, and Agentic AI solutions tailored for the finance domain. Your work will transition complex financial workflows—such as Forecasting as a Service, Explainability framework, Funnel Forecasting, Customer Profitability etc., and also performing analyses that impact Bad Debt, Cash flow, Credit Score cut models, etc., among others—into automated, intelligent, and proactive systems.
  
  
You will own the end-to-end lifecycle of critical AI models while translating complex technical results into compelling business narratives for finance leadership.
  
  

* Design and deploy core AI/ML and Generative AI solutions to optimize financial operations.
* Build and orchestrate Agentic AI workflows to automate multi-step financial analysis and decision-making processes.
* Utilize foundational models and AI assistants (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot) to rapidly prototype, iterate, and deliver agile AI solutions to meet dynamic business needs.
* Engineer robust data pipelines and write complex SQL/BigQuery queries to extract and transform large-scale financial datasets using GCP and Python.
* Act as a data storyteller—synthesizing complex AI/ML model outputs into clear, actionable, and prescriptive insights for non-technical finance stakeholders.
* Design, develop, and optimize Artificial Intelligence, NLP, SLM/LLM solutions to diverse real-world problems.
* Implement MLOps best practices to ensure continuous integration, deployment, and monitoring of financial AI models in production environments.
* Driving data-derived insights across the business domain by developing advanced statistical models, machine learning algorithms and computational algorithms based on business initiatives.

**What We’re Looking For...**
Your primary focus will be transforming traditional financial operations into a proactive, AI-driven organization. You are a hands-on builder who thrives at the intersection of core ML, cutting-edge GenAI, and business strategy. You have a knack for rapid prototyping and possess the communication skills required to explain the "why" and "how" of AI to business leaders.
  
  
**You'll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field
* Three or more years of relevant professional work experience.
* Three or more years of experience practicing data science, AI engineering, or machine learning, with a strong focus on core AI/ML, GenAI, and Agentic frameworks.
* Experience with all phases of end-to-end Analytics project, such as (but not limited to): Ingestion, Munging, Model Building, Validation, Operationalization, Monitoring
* Strong programming proficiency in Python and advanced SQL.
* Proven experience working within cloud platforms (Teradata/ GCP) and using tools like BigQuery for large-scale data processing.
* Demonstrated experience in rapid prototyping and building solutions leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs) and AI tools (e.g., Claude, Copilot).
* Hands-on familiarity with specific Agentic AI and orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex).
* Exceptional data storytelling and communication skills, with a proven ability to translate complex technical concepts into confident financial business decisions.

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* Advanced degree (Master’s) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Prior experience in the telecommunications industry specifically dealing with financial data, billing systems, FinOps, revenue assurance.
* Experience in designing and deploying end-to-end MLOps and LLMOps pipelines.
* A strong understanding of financial forecasting models, anomaly detection algorithms, and time-series analysis.

title: Planning & Reporting CoE Senior Analyst
description:
**About Us**
We’re Reckitt, home to the world’s best loved and trusted hygiene and health brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
**About The Finance Planning & Reporting CoE**
Driving efficiency and standardization across our renowned consumer brands that enhance everyday lives—from nourishing meals to trusted household essentials—is the pivotal force of the Finance Planning & Reporting Center of Excellence (CoE). Fuelled by a culture of collaboration and innovation, the CoE is integral to our organization, championing financial excellence and strategic insight across our global landscape. We are a dynamic, agile team, relentlessly focused on enhancing our financial processes, harnessing advanced analytics, and delivering unparalleled value to every facet of our business.
  
  
We transcend traditional finance roles; we are a strategic partner where diverse talents converge to tackle intricate financial challenges, foster sustainable growth, and empower our mission to create a healthier, more sustainable world for all. By ensuring a clear line of sight between strategic goals and day-to-day financial activities, we enable efficient performance management and better business results through the collaboration of our people, processes, and systems.
  
  
Our CoE transforms finance from a traditional back-office function into a strategic powerhouse that drives business value, as talented individuals come together to solve complex challenges, shape future capabilities, and build a better business.
  
  
**About The Role**
As an Senior Analyst in the Finance CoE, you will report into a Finance Manager and be part of a team of analysts supporting a portfolio of markets. In this role, you will play a key part in executing financial planning and reporting activities across these markets. You will support the creation of standardized reports, development of initial forecasts/budgets, and analysis of financial performance to enable data-driven decision-making.
  
  
This position offers a unique opportunity to gain broad exposure to multiple markets while contributing to the centralization and improvement of Reckitt’s FP&A processes. If you are passionate about finance, data analysis, and continuous improvement, this role will allow you to grow and make a real impact on our global business.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* Produce and consolidate financial reports for monthly and quarterly results, ensuring key performance metrics (sales, profitability, costs, etc.) are accurately reported and delivered on time to global and regional stakeholders.
* Conduct variance analysis (actuals vs. forecast vs. budget) and clearly explain drivers behind the numbers, highlighting trends and insights that inform business decisions.
* Support the planning and forecasting cycles, including annual budgets and periodic forecasts: coordinate data collection from different markets, validate submissions, and align assumptions with global guidelines to create a cohesive financial outlook.
* Manage and enhance financial dashboards and reports (e.g. in Power BI or similar tools) to provide users with intuitive, up-to-date views of financial performance. Ensure that dashboards capture the right KPIs and that data is consistent across all reporting outputs.
* Participate in finance transformation initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline and improve existing FP&A processes. You’ll contribute to standardizing report templates, automating manual tasks, and sharing best practices that elevate our CoE’s efficiency and impact.
* Collaborate closely with market finance teams and other CoE members to ensure data integrity and one-source-of-truth in our financial systems. You will act as a liaison, helping local teams understand CoE processes and troubleshooting data or reporting issues to maintain accuracy.
* Assist with ad-hoc analysis and projects as needed, such as deep-dives into specific expenses or trends, scenario modeling for strategic projects, or financial deck preparation for senior leadership meetings. Your ability to turn data into actionable insights will be key in these projects.
* Adapt and excel in a dynamic environment – our CoE is continually evolving. You’ll be expected to handle last-minute changes or requests, work under tight deadlines especially during key reporting periods, and maintain a high standard of quality. In doing so, you’ll demonstrate agility, teamwork, and a proactive approach to problem-solving.

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* 4+ years of experience in finance, analytics, or a related field, ideally within the CPG sector.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in Excel and familiarity with reporting tools (e.g., Power BI).
* Excellent attention to detail and ability to work with large datasets.
* Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset.

The skills for success
  
  

* Financial Analysis & Reporting
* Strategic Planning
* Business Partnering
* Process Improvement
* Data Visualization Skills
* Project Management
* Team Leadership
* Cross-functional Collaboration
* Change Management
* Continuous Improvement Mindset

What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way. We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Senior Analyst, Deal Desk Operations and Pricing Strategy - CPD
description:
**Company Overview**
Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.
  
  
Financial technology is a high-growth industry as change and innovation continue to disrupt the status-quo and prompt major transformation. Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities. We value intellectual curiosity, proactive ownership, and collaboration with colleagues, and we empower you to meaningfully contribute from day one and accelerate your professional development.
  
  
Arcesium seeks an experienced Senior Analyst to join the Deal Desk within the Client and Partner Development (CPD) business, with a focus on pricing strategy and analytics. The role is focused on running deal pricing while building up the pricing strategy and analytics function, influencing how we price, how we manage costs, and how we strengthen our competitive position in the market. The person will work closely with Sales, Presales, Solution Architects, Finance, Product, and Technology functions.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Analyze pricing and margin across deals, products, and client segments to identify where we are gaining pricing strength and where there are opportunities to change pricing, packaging, or discounting, and bring clear recommendations to leadership.
* Manage the product and pricing catalog, working with Product, Technology, and Financial Operations to establish and maintain pricing models for all standard solution sets.
* Create, maintain, and refresh the rate cards used across the business so rates reflect current costs, market positioning, and the approved pricing approach.
* Oversee pricing governance, including pricing policies, approval matrices, and discount controls. Run the deal approval process and track exceptions so patterns are visible to leadership.
* Maintain approved costs, revenue assumptions, and margin inputs, partner with Finance on deal revenue and margin views, and respond to audit requests on pricing with clear approvals, rationale, and records.
* Build pricing for live deals across SaaS, managed services, implementation, and professional services. Handle nonstandard requests such as custom scope, ramp pricing, and multi-year terms, escalating exceptions where needed.
* Agree reporting needs with stakeholders, then build and maintain reports on deal desk metrics such as turnaround time, discount trends, margin by deal type, and win and loss patterns. Follow market and competitor pricing trends and recommend changes to our approach.
* Document the pricing process, definitions, FAQs, and worked examples, and support pricing transformation initiatives including changes to tooling and approval workflows, with a goal of automating repeatable work.

**What You'll Need**

* 4 to 6 years of experience in a deal desk, pricing, pricing analytics, commercial finance, or sales operations role, ideally at a FinTech firm, fund administrator, SaaS company, or similar business.
* Strong Excel, financial modeling, and analytical skills, with the ability to turn pricing and margin data into insights and recommendations.
* Solid understanding of pricing models including subscription pricing for SaaS, managed services (FinOp) pricing, time and materials (T&M) pricing, and consumption-based pricing, and how to combine them in a single deal.
* Hands-on experience with Salesforce and CPQ, including quote creation, approval workflows, and pipeline reporting. Experience with Salesforce RevCloud is required.
* Good understanding of asset managers and financial services providers, and the technology and managed services that are valuable to them.
* Experience tracking and reporting KPIs to stakeholders, and clear, concise communication with senior leadership.
* Willingness to run specific deals hands on, with fast turnaround and strong attention to detail, while balancing longer term analytical projects.
* Sound judgment and discretion, given the proximity of this role to revenue, margins, and sensitive prospect information.

**Recruiting Security**
Emails from genuine Arcesium recruiters who are employees of the company will always come from the @arcesium.com domain. In some cases, you may also be contacted by independent search firms engaged to recruit on our behalf; emails from their employees should always come from their firm's applicable domain. We'll never ask for your banking information or any payment as part of the recruiting process. If something seems off or you're contacted by an unexpected third party, please reach out to us at careers@arcesium.com (US/UK), careers-india@arcesium.com (India) or careers-europe@arcesium.com (Portugal/Sweden).
  
  
*Arcesium is an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Budget Manager
description:
**Position Summary**
The Manager, R&D Business Operations - Budget Management & Execution is responsible for leading the end-to-end budget planning, forecasting, execution, and reporting processes for one or more R&D functions. The role serves as a trusted business partner to functional leadership, R&D Finance, and cross-functional stakeholders, ensuring financial plans accurately reflect portfolio priorities, operational requirements, and evolving business needs.
  
  
The Manager provides financial analysis, decision support, and operational oversight to enable effective resource allocation and financially responsible execution. This role also drives consistent application of budget management processes, systems, controls, and reporting standards across the supported organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the end-to-end budget management and execution process for one or more VP-level R&D functions.
* Coordinate annual budget planning, long-range planning, quarterly forecasts, leadership updates, and periodic financial exercises.
* Own the budget-management cadence, including complete line-item visibility for planned spend, commitments, actuals, forecast and closed-with-Finance status.
* Translate business strategies, portfolio priorities, resource plans, and operational assumptions into actionable financial forecasts.
* Partner with functional leadership and R&D Finance to ensure budgets and forecasts reflect the latest business priorities and anticipated spend.
* Lead recurring budget reviews with RAEs, functional leads and Finance. Identify variance, unused funds, forecast risk, engagement funding needs and required actions.
* Provide timely financial reporting, variance analysis, trend analysis, and identification of financial risks and opportunities.
* Develop financial scenarios and business cases to support investment, resource allocation, portfolio, and operating-model decisions.
* Maintain accurate alignment between planned activities, financial forecasts, commitments, and actual transactions within applicable planning and reporting systems.
* Oversee and coordinate budget execution activities, including purchase orders, accruals, cost entries, invoice resolution, funding transfers, and financial coding.
* Set operating standards, SLAs and escalation pathways for MyBuy/Ariba, supplier onboarding, PO, invoice, ePayment, accrual, transfer and closeout workflows.
* Monitor financial performance and proactively recommend corrective actions to address forecast variances, emerging risks, or execution challenges.
* Resolve escalated budget, procurement, transaction, and financial process issues in partnership with Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and business stakeholders.
* Prepare clear and concise financial updates for functional leadership, including key assumptions, decisions required, risks, opportunities, and recommended actions.
* Serve as a subject-matter expert for budget planning, forecasting, financial systems, and budget execution processes.
* Establish and maintain effective relationships across R&D functions, Finance, Global Strategic Sourcing, Supplier Management, and transactional support teams.
* Ensure budget processes and documentation comply with applicable Amgen financial controls, procurement requirements, policies, and operating procedures.
* Drive simplification, standardization, automation, and continuous improvement of budget management processes, tools, and reporting.
* Provide guidance, coaching, and work direction to Budget Management team members or business partners, as applicable.
* Complete people-management responsibilities, including performance and development activities, when the role includes direct reports.
* Oversee direct report(s) workflow execution and resolve escalated procure-to-pay, supplier, payment, coding, scope and policy issues in partnership with Finance, GSS, Procurement, Legal and suppliers.

**Decision-Making Authority**

* Advises functional leaders on budget priorities, forecast assumptions, financial risks, and resource trade-offs.
* Challenges financial assumptions and recommends adjustments based on business priorities, actual performance, and emerging trends.
* Determines appropriate analytical approaches and reporting required to support business decisions.
* Prioritizes budget execution activities and coordinates resolution of issues affecting financial deliverables.
* Escalates material financial risks, control concerns, and unresolved execution issues to appropriate leadership.
* Supports consistent interpretation and application of budget management processes and standards.
* Evaluate material forecast variances, questionable costs, supplier redlines, payment discrepancies and control concerns. Determine corrective action or escalate to the appropriate owner.

**Key Deliverables**

* Accurate and timely annual budgets and quarterly forecasts.
* Functional financial reporting and leadership decision support.
* Act as the financial steward and trusted advisor to RAEs, Finance, Procurement and vendors. Translate data into clear budget decisions, trade-offs and next steps.
* Variance, trend, risk, and opportunity analyses.
* Financial scenarios and business-case analyses.
* Timely completion of accruals, purchase-order maintenance, and other finance-driven activities.
* Accurate mapping of transactions and commitments to planned activities.
* Documented financial assumptions, decisions, and required actions.
* Standardized and compliant budget management processes and controls.

**Basic Qualifications**
**One of the following:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree and 8 - 12 years of business operations, finance, accounting, or related experience; or

**In addition:**

* Experience leading complex projects, processes, programs, or cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated experience with budget planning, forecasting, financial analysis, or financial operations.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience working with financial planning or enterprise resource planning systems, including Anaplan, SAP, Ariba, OPTS and other financial tools.
* Strong written, verbal, and executive-level communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting financial planning and execution within the biopharmaceutical, life sciences, or R&D environment.
* Knowledge of R&D operating models, portfolio planning, resource planning, and financial governance.
* Experience managing budgets for complex, global, or matrixed organizations.
* Experience with financial planning, procurement, purchase-order, reporting, and analytics platforms.
* Demonstrated ability to develop business cases, financial scenarios, forecasts, and management reporting.
* Strong understanding of accruals, commitments, actuals, cost centers, financial coding, and variance management.
* Experience working with Finance, Procurement, suppliers, and shared-service organizations.
* Experience with process improvement, automation, digital reporting, or dashboard development.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive outcomes without direct authority.
* Prior experience coaching or developing employees or less-experienced team members.

**Core Competencies**

* Financial and business acumen
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Sound judgment and decision support
* Budget planning and forecast management
* Ability to manage competing priorities and deadlines
* Project and process management
* Continuous improvement and change agility
* Attention to detail and commitment to data quality
* Accountability for high-quality, timely results
* Executive communication and presentation
* Ability to operate effectively within a global, matrixed organization

**Department:**
Finance & Accounts

**Location:**
Mumbai Head Office

**Position Grade:**
Manager / Senior Manager

**Reporting To:**
Lead – Finance & Accounts and CFO

**Experience:**
3–5 years post qualification

**Qualification:**
Chartered Accountant (CA)

Job Summary

We are looking for a qualified Chartered Accountant to join the Finance & Accounts team as a Team Member – Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A). The role will be responsible for monthly and consolidated financial statements, group reporting, management information systems (MIS), budgeting, financial variance analysis, regulatory reporting, and coordination with auditors.

The candidate will also support accounts payable processes and guide the payables team on TDS and GST applicability.

Key Responsibilities

* Ensure timely preparation of monthly financial statements, including consolidated financial statements.
* Prepare group reporting and related MIS as required by the headquarters.
* Prepare standalone and consolidated financial statements for December and March, coordinating with external auditors.
* Calculate net worth and prepare the necessary details and documentation required by the regulator.
* Assist in preparing annual budgets for group companies.
* Conduct periodic variance analysis of revenue and expenses and report key findings.
* Support accounts payable processes, including vendor payments and employee reimbursements.
* Guide the payables team on TDS and GST applicability for various payouts.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Qualified Chartered Accountant (CA).
* 3–5 years of post-qualification experience.
* Strong understanding of financial statement preparation, consolidation, and group reporting.
* Experience in budgeting, financial analysis, MIS reporting, and variance analysis.
* Knowledge of regulatory reporting and coordination with auditors.
* Understanding of TDS and GST applicability on vendor and employee payments.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Knowledge of Oracle is preferred.
* Strong analytical, organizational, and coordination skills with attention to detail.

title: Manager - Distribution Strategy
description:

Title:
**Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Leveraged Finance Research**
Function:
**Investments**
Sub Function:
**Investment Research**
Reports to:
**Vice President – Private Markets Research**
Location:
**Mumbai**
**Overall Job Purpose**
This role is part of the front-office investments team and involves working closely with the onshore M&G Leveraged Finance Research team. This is a dual role and includes both team management and analytical contributions. The responsibilities include evaluating investment opportunities across leveraged loans & private corporate credit opportunities in the UK and Europe. The role has four primary areas of focus: 1) underwriting and recommending primary and secondary investment opportunities, 2) monitoring existing portfolio exposures and identifying emerging risks, 3) conducting thematic and sector research to support investment decision-making and 4) managing, mentoring and developing junior team members. The successful candidate will combine rigorous fundamental analysis and intellectual curiosity to develop differentiated credit views, challenge assumptions and provide actionable investment recommendations to portfolio managers and senior analysts.
  
  
**Accountabilities/Responsibilities**

* Play a pivotal role across teams in fostering analytical excellence, intellectual rigour and effective knowledge sharing.
* Work closely with onshore front-office leveraged finance analysts covering leveraged loans, private corporate credit opportunities, high yield bonds and other related opportunistic credit investments.
* Support the underwriting of primary and secondary opportunities, assessing business quality, industry dynamics, management execution, sponsor behaviour, financial performance and capital structure risk.
* Build and maintain detailed financial models covering earnings, cash flow, liquidity, debt capacity, leverage, covenant headroom and deleveraging pathways.
* Review credit agreements, bond indentures and intercreditor arrangements to assess security, guarantees, covenants, baskets, portability, structural subordination and lender protections.
* Participate actively in management meetings, lender presentations, sponsor discussions and due diligence calls, confidently challenging assumptions and testing the investment thesis.
* Prepare concise, decision-useful investment memos that clearly articulate the thesis, catalysts, key risks, downside protection, relative value and recommendation.
* Monitor portfolio investments continuously and act as the first line of defence in identifying deteriorating credit quality, liquidity pressure, covenant monitoring and refinancing risk.
* Conduct sector and thematic research to identify structural trends, vulnerable business models and attractive risk-adjusted opportunities ahead of consensus.
* Assess investments through an ESG lens, evaluating governance, sustainability and reputational factors that may affect long-term credit performance.
* Drive automation and enhancement of research tools and processes using Excel, Python, VBA, Power BI or other analytical technologies.
* Train, mentor and develop junior analysts through technical review, constructive challenge and continuous coaching.

**Key Stakeholder Management**
Internal:
  
  

* Head of Investment Research
* VP – Private Markets Research

External
  
  

* Onshore leveraged finance analysts
* Portfolio managers
* Issuers, management teams, arranging banks, financial sponsors and external advisers

**Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Educational Qualification:**
**Knowledge & Skills:**

* Deep understanding of leveraged finance, corporate credit and capital structures, including leveraged loans, high-yield bonds and private credit instruments.
* Good financial-statement analysis and modelling capability, including the ability to normalise EBITDA, identify adjustments and distinguish accounting earnings from sustainable cash generation.
* Strong understanding of credit agreements, bond indentures, covenant packages, security structures, intercreditor terms and restructuring or recovery mechanics.
* Proven ability to synthesise complex quantitative and qualitative information into decisive, well-supported investment recommendations.
* An investigative mindset, with the confidence to challenge management narratives, sponsor assumptions, market consensus and internal views constructively.
* Ability to build trusted relationships, understand stakeholder priorities, communicate proactively, and align offshore delivery with onshore business expectations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to defend recommendations under rigorous scrutiny from senior stakeholders.
* High ownership, attention to detail and resilience, with the ability to deliver high-quality work under tight transaction timelines.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor junior analysts and raise analytical standards across a research team.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in Bloomberg and corporate credit research platforms. Python, VBA and Power BI are desirable.

**Experience:**

* 9 - 12 years of relevant experience in leveraged finance, high-yield or loan research, private credit, credit underwriting, investment banking, rating advisory or a related discipline.
* Prior experience in managing highly effective teams is preferred.
* Demonstrable track record of underwriting complex credits and influencing investment, underwriting or risk decisions.
* Experience analysing sponsor-backed borrowers and event-driven transactions across multiple sectors and jurisdictions.
* Prior experience working directly with portfolio managers, investment committees or senior credit professionals is strongly preferred.

**Educational Qualification:**

* MBA, CA or equivalent postgraduate/professional qualification from a recognised institution.
* CFA charter, active CFA candidacy or FRM qualification is desirable; demonstrated investment judgement and technical excellence will be weighted more heavily than credentials alone.

**M&G Behaviours relevant to all roles:**
**Tell it like it is:**
Respectfully speaking up to create better ways forward – both direct and empathetic
  
  
**Own it now:**
Putting your name on things with confidence to drive progress and results quickly
  
  
**Move it Forward Together:**
Forming cross-functional teams to seize the right opportunities and solve real problems.
  
  
Note: \*We are in Hybrid working with min. three days’ work from office (subject to policy change)
  
  
We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

description:

**-**
Senior Manager - F&B Controls

Worli, Mumbai

**A. Food & Beverage Cost Control**

• Monitor food and beverage costs against approved budgets and established cost benchmarks.

• Track actual food cost, beverage cost, consumption, wastage, and cost variances.

• Analyse recipe costing, portion control, yield, and menu profitability in coordination with the culinary team.

• Identify cost leakages and recommend corrective measures to improve gross margins.

• Monitor food cost percentages across outlets, banquet events, and catering operations.

• Oversee inventory planning, stock movement, consumption, and reconciliation.

• Ensure regular physical stock counts and reconciliation with system records.

• Monitor expiry, spoilage, breakage, wastage, and stock discrepancies.

• Establish controls for stock transfers, material requisitions, returns, and inter-location movements. • Ensure appropriate stock levels and adherence to FIFO/FEFO practices.

• Review purchase prices, vendor rates, and procurement practices to identify cost-saving opportunities.

• Monitor purchase price variances and compliance with approved vendor and procurement policies.

• Coordinate with procurement, stores, culinary, and operations teams to control material costs.

• Review receiving procedures, quality checks, and quantity discrepancies. D. Banqueting & Catering Costing

• Prepare and review food and beverage cost sheets for banquets, weddings, corporate events, and large scale catering assignments.

• Validate event-wise consumption against planned menus, guest counts, and production quantities.

• Analyse actual versus estimated event costs and identify deviations.

• Monitor contribution margins and profitability by event, venue, and business vertical.

• Establish post-event cost reconciliation and variance reporting processes.

**E. Budgeting, MIS & Financial Analysis**

• Prepare monthly F&B cost reports, inventory reports, and variance analysis.

• Track food cost percentage, beverage cost percentage, gross margins, wastage, and inventory holding levels.

• Develop dashboards highlighting cost trends, exceptions, and corrective actions.

• Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and cost-saving initiatives.

• Provide actionable insights to senior management on profitability and operational efficiency.

**F. Audit, Compliance & Process Improvement**

• Conduct periodic operational audits across kitchens, stores, outlets, and banquet locations.

• Ensure adherence to inventory, procurement, billing, consumption, and stock reconciliation SOPs. • Identify control gaps, irregularities, and potential pilferage.

• Implement standardised F&B control processes across all operating locations.

• Coordinate with internal audit and finance teams to ensure accurate reporting and compliance.

**Experience:-**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in F&B cost control, hospitality finance, inventory control, or food and beverage operations.
* Prior experience in hotels, premium restaurants, large-scale catering, banqueting, central kitchens, or multi-outlet F&B businesses.
* Experience in handling multi-location operations and high-volume food production will be preferred.

Job Description:
  
  
**About The Role**
Russell Investments is seeking a highly analytical, technology-minded Portfolio Implementation Analyst to join our Mumbai-based team supporting the fast-growing Personalized Managed Accounts (PMA) business. This role sits within a global portfolio management team responsible for implementing systematic, tax-aware and personalized investment strategies across client accounts.
  
  
You will support daily portfolio implementation, optimization, trade preparation and data validation while helping improve the systems and processes that make the business scalable. The strongest candidates will be comfortable working across multiple systems, investigating issues, using data to form a view, and translating problems and enhancement ideas into clear recommendations for portfolio managers, business partners and developers.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Support daily portfolio implementation, including account optimization, trade creation and review, compliance checks, cash management, data validation and exception resolution.
* Analyze optimizer results and portfolio data to identify unusual outcomes, data-quality issues, system defects and opportunities to improve decision rules or workflows.
* Work across investment, trading, risk, data and operational systems; determine whether breaks originate from data, configuration, process or technology and drive issues toward resolution.
* Use SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to query, reconcile and validate data, support root-cause analysis, and reduce manual checks where practical.
* Identify and help implement automation opportunities that improve accuracy, control, speed and scalability, including thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies.
* Translate business problems into clear requirements: articulate the issue, impact, evidence and recommended enhancement to peers, managers and developers; support testing and implementation.
* Coordinate with global portfolio management, trading, operations, research and technology teams on trades, cash activity, account events and implementation issues.
* Interpret and process security corporate actions and help resolve security master, pricing and other market-data exceptions across a large security universe.
* Document procedures, controls, recurring issues and findings; manage multiple priorities, execute directions accurately, and escalate material issues with concise analysis and recommended next steps.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 3-5 years of experience in investment management, portfolio operations, trading, investment technology, data analysis or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. A master’s degree, CFA progress/designation or other relevant qualification is beneficial but not required.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, investment portfolios, asset classes and/or performance measurement, combined with rigorous analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated comfort working with multiple systems and large data sets, including the ability to recognize when something does not look right, investigate why, and recommend a practical response.
* Working knowledge of SQL and strong Excel skills. Experience with Python, Power BI or other data/automation tools is a plus.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a problem, its business impact and a recommended solution to both investment professionals and technology teams.
* Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively; a self-starter who takes ownership, asks questions early and is candid when a concept, process or requirement is unclear.
* Strong organization, attention to detail and time management, with the ability to execute instructions consistently and accurately in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, documenting the rationale, and adjusting as new information becomes available.
* Curiosity, strong work ethic and a continuous-improvement mindset; willing to challenge the status quo constructively and look for better ways to work.

**Preferred Experience**

* Retail or institutional trading, portfolio management, portfolio implementation or portfolio optimization.
* Axioma Portfolio or another portfolio optimization/risk platform; Bloomberg or similar market-data tools.
* Security-level corporate actions, security master/reference data, pricing data and exception resolution across a broad security universe.
* System testing, requirements gathering, process design, workflow automation or partnership with software developers and technology teams.
* Using AI or emerging technologies to streamline analysis, documentation, controls or investment workflows.
* Tax-managed investing, direct indexing or separately managed accounts is helpful, but prior U.S. tax-management experience is not required.

How You’ll Work
  
  
This is a hands-on role in a rapidly growing business. You should be comfortable moving quickly, learning continuously and taking ownership from the outset. We value people who are direct, curious and dependable; who ask good questions rather than make silent assumptions; who can make a reasonable decision with incomplete information and explain their reasoning; and who actively look for opportunities to make the portfolio-management process more efficient, scalable and robust.
  
  
Why Join PMA?
  
  

* Join one of Russell Investments’ strategic growth businesses and help shape how a scaled, technology-enabled portfolio-management platform evolves.
* Gain exposure to global portfolio management, trading, optimization, risk, investment operations and technology while working with experienced investment professionals across regions.
* Build a career at the intersection of investing, data and technology, with meaningful opportunities to take ownership as the business and platform expand.
* Have visible impact: strong ideas, thoughtful analysis and effective automation can improve client outcomes and the way the team operates from day one.Portfolio Implementation Analyst

* Develop forecasts and scenarios. Help clients assess growth plans, hiring decisions, funding needs, and changes in business performance
* Advise finance leaders. Explain assumptions, challenge inconsistencies, and recommend approaches that improve planning and decision-making

title: Treasury Analyst
description:

The position collaborates closely with Finance, Commercial, Trade Finance, Operations, and external banking partners to drive efficient treasury operations and informed financial decision-making.

**Cash & Liquidity Management**

* Optimize cash utilization to maximize interest income
* Monitor bank charges and identify opportunities to improve banking cost efficiency
* Ensure timely execution of treasury transactions and adherence to internal controls and policies.

**Cash Forecasting**

title: Senior Analyst - Finance Operations
description:
**Main purpose**

Finance Operations (STF) is an independent function responsible for the end-to-end operational management of Trafigura's structured finance portfolio, from transaction onboarding and pre-disbursement control through to ongoing transaction monitoring, debt servicing, exposure reporting, and portfolio analytics.

The function plays a critical control and governance role in the structured finance lifecycle — owning the verification and disbursement process, managing covenant and conditions subsequent compliance, administering debt service and financing arrangements, and providing regular exposure reporting to Credit, Accounting, and senior management. Finance Operations (STF) works in close coordination with STF Regional teams, Treasury, Credit, Legal, Distribution, and Accounting, while maintaining independent oversight of operational risk and process integrity across the portfolio.

 

**Key responsibilities**

**Pre-Disbursement Management**

Perform pre-disbursement verifications prior to any disbursement under a loan or prepayment transaction, covering credit limit confirmation, disbursement request validation, legal review sign-off, Conditions Precedent satisfaction, pricing consistency against the Credit Memo, and settlement of pre-disbursement costs; where applicable, additional verifications are performed covering security perfection, independent valuation, credit insurance binding, syndication confirmation, and funding availability.

Upon completion of all verifications, coordinate all required system entries across Trafigura's internal systems and instruct Treasury to disburse with all required supporting documentation.

**Transaction Management**

Transaction Management covers the lifecycle of each active facility from disbursement through to final repayment

* **Covenant Monitoring**

* + Setup a process to maintain a comprehensive covenant register and monitoring calendar
  + Proactively flag covenant stress or potential breaches to relevant stakeholders as defined in SOP’s, and maintain audit-ready records of all confirmations and supporting materials

* **Conditions Subsequent (CS) Monitoring**
  + Setup a process to maintain a register of all post-disbursement conditions subsequent across active transactions, tracking deadlines and fulfilment status and escalating outstanding items to the relevant stakeholders
  + Coordinate with counterparties and internal legal to obtain and file evidence of CS satisfaction, ensuring the document management system is kept up to date
* **Performance Monitoring Against Contractual Documentation**
  + Monitor counterparty performance — including delivery schedules, repayment profiles, offtake volumes— against the terms set out in each transaction's contractual documentation
  + Manage principal and interest repayment schedules across the portfolio, raise invoices for fees and interest to counterparties
* **Financing Facilities**
  + Coordinate all financing activities including cash and interbank funding requests and external loan facility management, ensuring timely and accurate execution of all debt service payments by coordinating with Treasury team.
  + Provide regular updates to funding banks / risk participating institutions on delivery performance, loan rollovers, and offer notices for bank facilities supporting insurance-backed prepayment transactions

**P&L Inputs:**

* Provide monthly inputs to Deals Desk on the financing P&L for every transaction.

 

 

**Required qualifications**

* **Experience & Qualifications**
  + 4–8 years of relevant work experience in structured trade finance, commodity finance, or lending portfolio management at a bank or commodity trading house; experience in the middle office of a commodity-focused bank is particularly relevant
  + MBA in Finance; an undergraduate degree in Engineering is desirable
  + Familiarity with pre-export finance, prepayment facilities, risk participations, ECA structures, and tolling facilities is a strong advantage
* **Technical Skills**
  + Ability to interpret legal agreements and term sheets across a range of structured finance products, with an understanding of security arrangements and limited recourse constructs
  + Solid financial analysis skills including covenant monitoring (financial ratios, coverage ratios)
  + Proficiency in Excel; familiarity with covenant monitoring solutions is an advantage
* **Behavioural Competencies**
  + Meticulous attention to detail with a strong control mindset
  + Proactive and innovative, with an ability to identify and implement process
  + Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage multiple simultaneous deadlines
  + Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English
  + Collaborative team player who builds effective working relationships across geographies and functions

 

**Department overview**

STF is a fast growing department, which sources, structures, arranges and syndicates Finance solutions for Trafigura’s clients. The STF portfolio is around ~USD 6 bln and consists of around 120+ Pre-export Finance facilities, Pre-payment facilities, Reserve based Lending facilities etc.

The STF team is made up of around 30 staff members, who are based on Montevideo, Houston, Geneva, Johannesburg, Mumbai, Singapore and Shanghai

**Key Relationships**

* **External –**
  Counterparties, Banks / Financial Institutions, Insurance Brokers
* **Internal**
  - SF Regional Managers, Deals Desk, Physical Traders, Operators, Trade Finance, Treasury, Corporate Funding, Accounting, Legal, Credit

title: Senior Credit Analyst
description:
**Job Requirements**
**Role/Job Title: Senior Credit Analyst**
- Supply Chain Finance
  
  
**Function/Department: Wholesale Banking Risk**
- Supply Chain Finance
  
  
**Job Purpose:**
The role holder will be responsible for credit appraisal and risk assessment of Supply Chain Finance customers, including anchor-led and ecosystem-based financing programs. The incumbent will evaluate onboarding proposals, assess creditworthiness of anchors, dealers, distributors, vendors and borrowers under SCF programs, and recommend new as well as existing relationships for approval. The role will also be responsible for portfolio monitoring, risk containment, delinquency management, program reviews, and coordination with business, product, operations, legal, compliance, and other internal stakeholders.
  
  
The role holder will provide industry insights, monitor emerging risks, and support portfolio quality through proactive review and risk mitigation measures.

Conduct detailed credit appraisal and risk assessment of Supply Chain Finance proposals in line with the Bank's credit policies and regulatory guidelines.
  
  
Evaluate anchor programs, dealer/vendor/distributor ecosystems, transaction structures, and cash-flow based financing solutions. Review, recommend, approve/reject credit proposals based on risk assessment, portfolio considerations, program viability, and business sustainability.
  
  
Assess and monitor early warning indicators, portfolio triggers, concentration risks, and delinquency trends across SCF programs. Ensure adherence to credit policies, risk appetite framework, underwriting standards, and regulatory requirements.
  
  
Perform periodic program reviews and portfolio monitoring to identify emerging risks and recommend corrective actions. Engage with business teams to structure deals while maintaining prudent risk controls. Facilitate regular asset quality reviews and provide analytical insights to improve portfolio performance.
  
  
Support implementation of risk monitoring frameworks and strengthen portfolio governance across the SCF business. Capture and share best practices, market intelligence, and industry developments within the team.

10+ years of experience in Credit Risk Underwriting, Supply Chain Finance, Working Capital Financing, Trade Finance, Commercial and Wholesale Banking (Candidates with relevant SCF underwriting experience will be preferred)
