title: Finance & Accounting Lead - Business Central Setup, AI Agents & Latvian Tax
description:
**Location:**
Fully remote
  
  
**Company:**
Latvia-based startup
  
  
**Compensation:**
We operate on a startup budget. Compensation will be discussed transparently during the hiring process and paid monthly in USD.
  
  
**Engagement type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Working hours:**
Flexible
  
  
**About Us**
We are a Latvia-based startup building a finance function that combines accurate accounting, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central and practical AI automation.
  
  
We are looking for a finance professional who can personally manage our accounting, configure the systems supporting it and use AI agents to carry out the work more efficiently.
  
  
**Job Description**
You will personally perform and take ownership of our accounting and financial operations, using AI agents to support your work. Your responsibilities will cover daily bookkeeping, reconciliations, closing, financial reporting, cash planning and applicable Latvian tax reporting.
  
  
You will personally carry out the complete migration from QuickBooks to Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, using AI agents to support your work. You will be responsible for all implementation tasks, from planning and data preparation through configuration, import, validation and go-live. No external implementation partners will be involved. As part of preparing and importing the data, you will review the complete accounting records for the past five years, identify gaps and errors, and reconcile the migrated data to the source records. You must be comfortable both doing the accounting and setting up the accounting system.
  
  
AI agents will assist with document processing, transaction preparation, matching, reconciliation and reporting. You will define their tasks, supervise their execution, investigate exceptions and verify their outputs. You remain responsible for the accuracy and completeness of the work.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Perform day-to-day bookkeeping, accounts payable and receivable, invoicing, expense accounting and bank reconciliations.
* Complete month-end and year-end closing, balance sheet reconciliations, accruals and supporting documentation.
* Set up, configure and maintain Business Central, including the chart of accounts, posting groups, dimensions, VAT setup, bank accounts, accounting periods and relevant financial workflows.
* Personally execute the complete migration from QuickBooks to Business Central, including data extraction, account and tax mapping, cleansing, system configuration, trial imports, reconciliation and go-live. Review all accounting records for the past five years during migration preparation and import, investigate missing or incorrect entries, document corrections and preserve supporting documents and a traceable audit trail.
* Prepare and manage applicable Latvian tax and statutory reporting, including VAT, corporate income tax, payroll-related obligations and VID/EDS processes.
* Handle international customers, suppliers, contractors, foreign currencies and cross-border transactions.
* Manage cash-flow forecasts, budgets, runway monitoring and management reporting.
* Prepare payments and administer payroll and contractor payments within agreed approval controls.
* Configure, instruct and supervise AI agents supporting accounting workflows; improve their performance through clear instructions, reliable source data and systematic verification.
* Maintain traceability from original documents to accounting entries, resolve exceptions and protect confidential financial information.
* Identify practical opportunities to reduce costs, improve financial controls and apply lawful tax efficiencies.

**Required Qualifications**

* Proven experience personally performing the full accounting cycle for companies in one or more European countries.
* Practical experience with accounting, taxation and statutory reporting in one or more European countries, and the ability to apply and verify Latvian requirements. Direct Latvian accounting and VID/EDS experience is an advantage.
* Hands-on experience independently setting up and configuring Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central for real accounting operations, with the ability to personally execute a complete accounting-system migration.
* The ability to translate business requirements into appropriate accounting configuration and verify that postings, reconciliations and reports work correctly.
* Practical experience using AI agents or AI-supported automation in finance or accounting, including supervising outputs and handling errors.
* Strong spreadsheet and analytical skills, with the ability to investigate incomplete records and reconcile inconsistent data.
* Independent working habits, ownership of deadlines and clear communication with the founder.
* Professional working proficiency in English and the ability to work effectively with Latvian-language financial documents and reporting requirements.
* A relevant accounting or finance qualification, or equivalent substantial practical experience.

**Especially Valuable Experience**

* Building or improving the accounting function of a startup or small international business.
* QuickBooks to Business Central migrations, Business Central implementations and comprehensive reviews and correction of historical accounting records.
* Configuring integrations with banks, payment platforms, document systems and Microsoft 365.
* Power Automate, Power BI, APIs or comparable tools used in practical finance workflows.
* Accounting for digital services, subscriptions and international contractor relationships.
* Preparing financial information for funding discussions or due diligence.

**What We Offer**

* A fully remote role with direct collaboration with the founder.
* Responsibility for both the accounting work and the systems supporting it.
* The opportunity to shape how Business Central and AI agents work together in a startup.
* A practical environment where reliable execution, sensible automation and cost awareness matter.

**Remote Working Arrangement**
You will organize your work independently, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed accounting and reporting deadlines. Financial systems and confidential information must be handled securely.
  
  
This is a full-time role with flexible working hours. You will organize your schedule around agreed accounting and reporting deadlines.
  
  
**How To Apply**
Please submit your CV and briefly describe:
  
  

* The European countries in which you have personally handled accounting and tax reporting, and your specific responsibilities.
* A Business Central implementation or accounting-system migration you personally executed, including the setup, data migration and validation you performed yourself, and any experience with QuickBooks or historical accounting reviews.
* How you have used AI agents or automation to perform accounting work and verify its accuracy.

Use anonymized examples and clearly distinguish your own work from work delivered by others.

title: Treasury Business Analyst
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

We are hiring a Business Analyst to translate Treasury's needs into well-defined, workflow-driven

systems. The Group runs a large investment book and a diversified borrowing programme, so Treasury depends on accurate deal capture, approvals, limits, cash and liquidity visibility, and reporting.

You will sit between the Treasury desk (front, mid and back office), Finance, Risk, Compliance and

Technology. Your job is to turn how Treasury actually works into clear requirements, automated

workflows and reliable data, and to see those changes through to go-live.

Role Expectations:

● Requirements and process analysis

○ Gather and document business requirements (BRD / FRD / user stories) for treasury

processes across investments, borrowings, liquidity, cash management and collateral.

○ Map current and target-state processes, spot manual hand-offs and control gaps, and

propose automation.

● Workflow design

○ Design end-to-end workflows for deal capture, multi-level approvals, limit checks,

confirmations, settlement and reconciliation, with clear roles, maker-checker controls

and audit trails.

○ Define business rules, SLAs, escalations and exception handling inside each workflow.

● Investment and borrowing operations

○ Support requirements for investment instruments (G-secs, T-bills, CPs, CDs, bonds,

mutual funds) and borrowing instruments (bank lines, NCDs, CPs, term loans), including

interest accruals, maturities, repayments and covenant tracking.

○ Work with Treasury on liquidity and cash-flow forecasting, exposure and

counterparty-limit views.

● Treasury product and platform

○ Build deep functional knowledge of the treasury product in use: the deal lifecycle

(capture, validation, approval, confirmation, settlement, accounting, maturity),

instrument and counterparty masters, limit and rate set-ups, and user roles.

○ Run fit-gap analysis between product capabilities and Treasury requirements, and agree

with Technology and the vendor what is configuration, customisation or a workaround.

○ Own the product backlog with Treasury: prioritise enhancements, review vendor release

notes, assess impact before upgrades and coordinate regression testing.

○ Document and maintain product configuration: product parameters, workflow rules,

templates, report formats and access matrices.

○ Specify product integrations with banks (payment files, statements), market data,

depositories and the general ledger.

○ Act as first-line functional expert for production issues: reproduce, find the root cause

and work with vendor support to resolve.

● Delivery and change management

○ Partner with Technology and vendors (including treasury product vendors) to translate

requirements into specifications, review designs and track delivery.

○ Plan and run UAT, write test cases, manage defects and sign-offs, and support go-live and

post-go-live stabilisation.

○ Prepare training material and user guides for Treasury and Finance teams.

● Reporting and data

○ Define MIS, dashboards and regulatory or management reports (liquidity, investment

portfolio, borrowing profile, interest cost, limit utilisation).

○ Ensure data integrity between the treasury system, general ledger, bank statements and

other source systems.

● Governance

○ Keep documentation, change logs and process controls audit-ready; support internal and

statutory audit queries.

Qualifications:

● 4–6 years of total experience, of which 2–3 years as a Business Analyst or functional consultant

on treasury, capital-markets, banking or NBFC systems.

● Hands-on experience with a treasury product or platform (implementation, configuration,

support or functional ownership), covering the deal lifecycle for investments and borrowings.

● Hands-on experience designing and documenting workflows (approval chains, rule-based

routing, maker-checker, exception handling) on that platform.

● Experience taking requirements through the full cycle: elicitation, specification, UAT and go-live.

● Working knowledge of treasury products and processes: money market and debt instruments,

borrowings, liquidity management and interest computation.

● Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Engineering or a related field; MBA (Finance), CA, CFA or FRM is

a plus but not mandatory.

Good to Have

● Working knowledge of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials, especially General Ledger and Cash

Management, plus Payables and Receivables where treasury flows touch them

● Understanding of how the treasury product posts to Oracle Fusion: accounting entries, GL and

account mapping, period close and bank reconciliation.

● Ability to write functional specifications for file-based or API-based integrations between the

treasury product and Oracle Fusion, and to run UAT on the accounting flows.

● Comfortable working with Finance and the Oracle Fusion team to resolve posting and

reconciliation breaks.

Skills

1. Treasury Domain - Investments, borrowings, liquidity and cash-flow management, counterparty

and exposure limits, interest accruals, accounting touchpoints

2. Business Analysis - BRD / FRD / user stories, process mapping (BPMN or flowcharts), gap

analysis, traceability, UAT planning, change management

3. Workflow and Systems - Workflow engines, rule configuration, approval matrices, integrations

between treasury, Oracle Fusion / GL, banks and market data

title: Senior Risk Analyst – Data Science & Analytics
description:
**Company Description**
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.
  
  
**Job Description**
We are looking for a Senior Risk Analyst – Data Science & Analytics to join our Commercial Bureau Analytics & Pre-Sales Consulting team, with a dedicated focus on MSME bureau analytics. This is a senior hands-on role for an experienced credit-risk data scientist who can independently structure complex MSME lending problems, design bureau-led analytical solutions and translate modelling results into client-ready recommendations. You will lead scorecard and model development, portfolio and early-warning analytics, bureau-based proofs of concept and pre-sales solutioning for banks, NBFCs, fintechs and other MSME lenders. The role requires deep Python / SQL capability, strong credit-risk modelling judgement, substantial experience with MSME / SME or commercial bureau analytics, and the ability to guide other analysts while remaining deeply hands-on with data and code.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead end-to-end MSME bureau analytics engagements across acquisition, underwriting, risk segmentation, portfolio monitoring, early warning and collections, from problem definition through validation and delivery.
* Own the analytical design for complex use cases, including outcome / bad definition, observation and performance windows, sample construction, segmentation, treatment of class imbalance, benchmark / challenger design and validation strategy.
* Design advanced bureau variables from longitudinal business-entity and facility / tradeline histories, including repayment behaviour, delinquency patterns, exposure and utilisation, enquiries, account vintage, product / lender mix and changes in credit behaviour over time.
* Develop, benchmark and validate MSME credit-risk scorecards and predictive models using interpretable statistical approaches and machine-learning challengers, making explicit trade-offs between predictive gain, stability, explainability and ease of implementation.
* Lead portfolio diagnostics including vintage, cohort, roll-rate, risk migration, concentration, delinquency-flow and early-warning analysis, and translate findings into actionable credit-risk recommendations.
* Quantify the incremental predictive and business value of bureau variables, scores and analytical constructs through robust benchmark and proof-of-concept designs.
* Lead client and pre-sales discussions to diagnose the problem, assess data feasibility, frame the analytical solution, scope proofs of concept, present methodology and respond to technical questions.
* Convert recurring MSME lender needs into reusable bureau features, analytical frameworks or product enhancements, and work with Product / Technology teams on UAT, implementation and monitoring requirements.
* Review code, model methodology and analytical outputs from other analysts; mentor junior team members for statistical rigour, coding quality, reproducibility and documentation.
* Ensure all analytical work meets applicable data-security, model-governance, documentation and compliance requirements.

**What Success Looks Like**

* MSME bureau solutions are methodologically defensible, stable, interpretable and clearly linked to a lender decision or portfolio outcome.
* Proofs of concept and client solutioning demonstrate measurable analytical value and materially strengthen opportunity conversion or product adoption.
* Reusable bureau variables and frameworks improve speed-to-solution while complex work is delivered with clear documentation, governance and implementation considerations.
* Team capability improves through strong technical review, mentoring and standardisation of modelling and coding practices.

**Qualifications**
**What you'll need to bring**

* Approximately 5-8 years of relevant experience in credit-risk analytics, data science, decision science or statistical modelling, including at least 3 years of substantial experience in MSME / SME / commercial credit-risk or commercial bureau analytics.
* Advanced hands-on proficiency in Python and strong SQL, with demonstrated ability to build efficient, modular and reusable analytical code for large and granular credit datasets.
* Demonstrated end-to-end ownership of credit-risk scorecard or model development, from target and sample design through feature engineering, modelling, validation and implementation / monitoring considerations.
* Deep practical knowledge of scorecard and risk-model development, including binning, WoE / IV, logistic regression, variable selection, multicollinearity, reject-inference considerations where relevant, calibration, segmentation and score scaling, together with experience evaluating tree-based / gradient-boosting challengers.
* Strong command of validation and monitoring concepts including KS, Gini / AUC, lift / gains, calibration, out-of-time validation, back-testing, PSI / CSI, stability and challenger comparisons.
* Strong MSME credit-risk and bureau-data expertise: delinquency / default definitions, underwriting and segmentation, vintage / cohort and roll-rate analysis, early-warning indicators, and conversion of facility / tradeline histories into robust entity-level risk features.
* Experience delivering analytics for banks, NBFCs, fintechs or other business lenders, with the judgement to distinguish statistical results from commercially usable risk solutions.
* Strong client-facing and pre-sales capability, including discovery, solution framing, proof-of-concept design, methodology presentation and handling technical questions from senior risk / analytics stakeholders.
* Experience reviewing analytical work, coaching less-experienced analysts and improving team standards for code quality, validation, documentation and reproducibility.

**Good to have**

* Direct experience developing or validating commercial credit bureau scores, bureau-based MSME risk models or other bureau-led decisioning solutions.
* Experience across multiple MSME lending products or lifecycle stages, such as business loans, working-capital facilities, secured / unsecured MSME credit, acquisition, underwriting, monitoring and collections.
* SAS or another statistical programming environment in addition to Python.
* Git, peer-review practices, Spark / Databricks or other tools used for large-scale analytical development.
* Experience taking risk models or analytics from proof of concept into production, including monitoring and challenger frameworks.
* Working knowledge of model-governance, credit-information and regulatory expectations relevant to lending in India.
* Experience shaping analytical propositions, reusable solutions or product enhancements from repeated client use cases.

**Additional Information**
Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
  
  
**Benefits/Perks**

* Great compensation package and discretionary bonus plan
* Core benefits include pension, health Insurance and term life Insurance, Sharesave scheme and more!
* 25 days annual leave with 13 bank holidays and 3 volunteering days. You can also purchase additional annual leave.
* You will report to Senior Analytics Consultant.

You will contribute directly to how we create high‑quality products and solutions for our customers.

Your day-to-day
  
  

* Main Responsibilities:
* Planning
* Monitor and direct the implementation of business plans.
* Manage funding requirements and ensure acceptable financing.
* Supporting digitization initiatives in line with the sustainability goals of the Group.
* Operations

**Accounting**

* Managing any third parties to which functions may have been outsourced.
* Managing funding related to Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR).

* Weekly Cash Forecast and investment of surplus cash.
* Maintaining updated documentation for signatories with the banks.

* Rationalizing the banking limit requirements for the legal entity.
* Monitoring banking transactions on a day-to-day basis.
* Engage with Finance department for closure of outstanding items with banks.

* Monitor the implementation of reliable control systems.

Solid progressively responsible experience working for a large corporate with hands on exposure in finance, treasury and reporting.

University degree in accounting or finance - Chartered Accountant or equivalent qualification.
  
  
Proficiency in English (both written and oral)

Effective Communication is very important in this role. Multifaceted, result oriented, high performing individual with a collaborative style of working..

We design differentiated career paths that empower our talent to thrive.**

* Demonstrate ability to understand and analyze business issues and leverage technology to solve them
* Preferred experience of engaging in strategic issues with senior-level clients including C-Suite executives
* Exposure to working in non-India geographies (preferably US) and / or interacting with global stakeholders
* Exposure around building dynamic Excel models and macros for market sizing, forecasting, and automation of repetitive analysis and reporting tasks
* Ability to craft structured generative research prompts and use tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Claude or MS Copilot in Excel/PowerPoint) to streamline research, create slides, synthesize interviews, or simulate models
* Experience in developing and deploying LLM tools to accelerate research, generate summaries, and support slide creation

* Good client presence – Interact and build relationships with clients and other team members
* Analytical thinking – Comfortable with managing large data sets, ability to perform detailed, quantitative analysis and research (primary and secondary), synthesize and present insights and recommendations from data through configurable dashboards; familiarity with Python, and Excel Macro scripting is nice to have
* Logical structuring - Structured approach to problem solving and ability to perform root cause analysis of client problems
* Deadline-oriented and quality focused – Support team in development of deliverables, manage specific work-thread, develop plans for components of engagement, manage and mentor junior resources

description:

Ecolab is seeking a highly motivated, customer-focused, and detail-oriented professional to join the Distributor Finance organization as a Pricing & Support Associate. The associate will be responsible for managing distributor and sales support requests, resolving inquiries, performing data maintenance and sales corrections, and ensuring accurate execution of distributor finance processes. **Key Responsibilities**
**Distributor & Sales Support Operations**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for distributor partners, sales representatives, and internal stakeholders regarding support-related requests.
* Handle inbound and outbound communications through shared support mailboxes and ticketing systems.
* Resolve inquiries related to:

+ Account alignments and maintenance.
+ Customer agreement eligibility.
+ Sales territory and ownership corrections.
+ Missing sales investigations.
+ Sales split setup and maintenance.
+ Distributor disputes and inquiries.
+ Data corrections and transactional support activities.

* Support Lean and continuous improvement initiatives that improve productivity, quality, and customer experience.

**Knowledge Management & Process Documentation**

* Create, update, and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), desktop procedures, and process documentation.
* Support knowledge management activities to drive process consistency and business continuity.
* Participate in training, cross-training, and capability-building initiatives across the team.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration, Economics, or a related discipline. (MBA, M.Com, B.Com, CA Inter, CMA Inter, Engineering, Science, or equivalent professional qualification.)

+ Finance Operations
+ Shared Services / Global Business Services (GBS)
+ Distributor Finance
+ Accounts Receivable / Accounts Payable
+ Customer Financial Services
+ Order-to-Cash (OTC)
+ Procure-to-Pay (P2P)
+ Supply Chain Finance
+ Billing, Collections, or related operational finance functions

* Minimum 1 year of experience working in a Shared Services, GBS, or GCC environment.
* Experience supporting North America business operations.
* Understanding of financial controls, audit requirements, reconciliations, and compliance frameworks.
* Exposure to reporting and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, ThoughtSpot, Business Objects, or similar platforms.
* Strong customer service and stakeholder management orientation.
* Ability to analyze large data sets and derive meaningful business insights.
* Experience driving process improvement, automation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* High degree of ownership, accountability, and attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively in a global, matrixed, and multicultural environment.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.
* Experience working with ERP platforms such as SAP or equivalent financial systems.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in English.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently while effectively collaborating across global teams.

**What Success Looks Like**
The ideal candidate will demonstrate:
  
  

* Strong customer and stakeholder focus.
* Exceptional attention to detail and process accuracy.
* Ability to handle high-volume transactional and support activities.
* Effective problem-solving and issue-resolution skills.
* Ownership mindset with a bias for action.
* Commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement.
* Ability to influence outcomes through collaboration and strong communication.

**Work Environment**

* Shift Timing: 4:00 PM to 1:00 AM IST.
* Hybrid work model (3 days office / 2 days remote).
* Company-provided transportation facility.
* Opportunity to collaborate with North America Finance, Sales, Credit, Pricing, Distributor Operations, and other business functions.

This role offers an opportunity to build expertise in distributor finance operations while working directly with North America stakeholders. description:
**About AkzoNobel**

Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. Let’s paint the future together.

For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com

© 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved.

**Job Purpose**
---------------

**Role –**

* Deliver accurate and timely product costing analysis and reporting for the ISC Profit Center portfolio, supporting margin transparency and informed business decisions.
* Support budgeting, quarterly rolling forecast (QRF) and monthly close processes by analyzing cost drivers and explaining variances under defined governance.
* Contribute to standardization, control compliance and digitalization initiatives within the ISC Profit Center CoE.

**Key Activities**
------------------

* **Cost Performance & Analysis**

* Prepare monthly cost trend, variance and benchmark analyses for material and conversion costs.
* Identify abnormalities and support root-cause analysis with BU and ISC stakeholders.

* **Planning & Reporting**

* Support Budget and QRF cycles through data preparation, validation and variance analysis.
* Prepare inputs for MEC/Flash reports in line with timelines and quality standards.

* **FMC & Tariff Recovery Analysis:**

* Review under-recovery and over-recovery positions across plants and legal entities.
* Analyze inventory revaluation impact linked to tariff recovery differences.
* Validate assumptions and drivers with ISC BN and ISC BU Heads.
* Support initiatives to improve accuracy and predictability of tariff recovery.

* **Inventory Revaluation Review:**

* Review inventory revaluation entries and assess impact on P&L and balance sheet.
* Analyze gaps between Actuals and Forecast and provide clear explanations for variances.
* Ensure revaluation impacts are accurately reflected in management reporting.

* **ICD Price Difference, Margin & Markup Analysis:**

* Coordinate ICD price difference analysis across intercompany flows.
* Validate pricing, margin, and markup calculations to ensure accuracy.
* Identify key drivers of margin leakage and pricing inconsistencies.
* Recommend corrective actions in collaboration with Pricing and Business teams.

* **Governance & Controls**

* Execute product costing controls including material ledger checks, inventory revaluation support and reconciliations.
* Maintain SOPs and ensure compliance with costing and reporting policies.

* **Continuous Improvement & Digitalization**

* Support automation and reporting enhancements using SAP, CFIN and Power BI.
* Participate in CI projects aimed at reducing manual effort and improving data quality.

**Experience**
--------------

* *5–8 years of experience in FP&A, product costing or manufacturing finance.*
* *CA/CMA or equivalent professional qualification (or advanced stage).*
* *Working knowledge of SAP product costing/material ledger and financial reporting tools.*
* *Strong analytical skills with advanced Excel; exposure to Power BI preferred.*

**Competencies**

* *Analytical thinking and attention to detail.*
* *Ability to interpret data and explain cost movements clearly.*
* *Process discipline and control orientation.*
* *Collaborative mindset and learning agility.*

**Performance Measures**

* *Accuracy and timeliness of monthly costing reports and analyses.*
* *Quality of variance explanations and stakeholder feedback.*
* *Adherence to controls and audit requirements.*
* *Contribution to CI initiatives and reduction in manual effort.*

**Organisation & Interfaces**

* *Reports to ISC PC Team Lead (MM3/MM4 depending on structure).*
* *Interfaces with BU Finance, Accounting Controllers, R2R and CI teams.*

title: Analyst
description:
Role Overview

The role will provide senior-level research, analytical, and due diligence support to a US wealth management business. The primary focus is investment research and product due diligence, complemented by advisor management support and suitability oversight. The individual will independently review investment product information, assess relevant risks and disclosures, identify exceptions or information gaps, and prepare clear, evidence-based findings for review by authorized stakeholders. The role requires strong wealth management domain knowledge, sound analytical judgment, high attention to detail, and effective collaboration with onshore teams.

Key Responsibilities

1. Investment Research and Product Due Diligence (Core Responsibility)

* Conduct initial and periodic due diligence reviews of investment products using approved documentation and information sources.
* Research product structures, investment objectives, underlying assets, risk factors, fees, liquidity, disclosures, and available performance information.
* Compare products and assess relevant features, risks, costs, and other decision-useful attributes.
* Identify information gaps, inconsistencies, material changes, and potential risk indicators; document evidence and findings for stakeholder review.
* Prepare structured product assessment summaries, research reports, and supporting materials that enable informed review and decision-making.
* Support ongoing product monitoring and maintain complete, traceable due diligence records.

2. Suitability Oversight Support

* Support reviews of investment recommendations and transactions against documented suitability requirements and review frameworks.
* Assess relevant client investment objectives, risk profiles, product characteristics, and disclosures where these are available and within the assigned review scope.
* Identify potential mismatches, exceptions, or deviations from established criteria and escalate them through the agreed governance process.
* Document review rationale, evidence, findings, and follow-up actions to maintain a clear audit trail.

3. Advisor Management Support

* Provide analytical and documentation support for advisor management activities related to investment products and review requirements.
* Review advisor-related records and supporting documentation for completeness, consistency, and adherence to defined procedures.
* Track open items, resolve information gaps with relevant stakeholders, and maintain accurate status reports and supporting records.
* Support consistent application of established policies, procedures, and review standards.

4. Risk, Controls, and Governance

* Perform assigned activities in line with documented procedures, confidentiality requirements, internal controls, and applicable compliance guidelines.
* Recognize and escalate potential risks, control gaps, exceptions, or incomplete evidence through established channels.
* Maintain review documentation and records to support quality checks, audit readiness, and governance reviews.
* Track findings and remediation actions through closure, coordinating with relevant stakeholders as required.
* Contribute to process standardization, documentation improvements, and quality and efficiency initiatives.

5. Stakeholder Engagement and SME Contribution

* Partner with onshore stakeholders to clarify requirements, discuss complex findings, and respond to research and due diligence requests.
* Communicate analysis and findings clearly, objectively, and within agreed turnaround times.
* Provide subject-matter expertise, support knowledge transfer, and contribute to process documentation or training where required.
* Manage assigned deliverables independently while meeting agreed service levels and quality expectations.

Required Skills and Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Banking, or a related discipline.
* 10–12 years of relevant experience in wealth management, investment research, investment product due diligence, suitability oversight, or related financial-services risk and control functions.
* Strong hands-on experience in investment research and due diligence; exposure to advisor support and suitability reviews is also required.
* Working knowledge of wealth management products such as equities, mutual funds, fixed-income securities, and other relevant investment products.
* Ability to interpret product documentation, disclosures, risk information, fees, and performance data and translate findings into clear written assessments.
* Strong analytical, critical-thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the confidence to identify gaps and escalate concerns.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint for analysis, reporting, and presentation of findings.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly for working with onshore stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, strong documentation discipline, and ability to handle confidential information.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate, high-quality outputs within agreed SLAs.

Preferred Skills

* Experience supporting a US-based wealth management firm, private bank, trust company, or investment advisory business.
* Familiarity with investment product disclosures, suitability frameworks, product governance, and periodic due diligence practices.
* Experience preparing management reports, research summaries, and stakeholder-ready presentations.
* Advanced Excel capability; experience with VBA or reporting automation is an advantage.

Key Performance Indicators

* Accuracy, completeness, and quality of investment research and due diligence assessments.
* Timely completion of assigned reviews and requests within agreed SLAs.
* Quality and clarity of written analysis, evidence, and supporting documentation.
* Timely identification, documentation, and escalation of exceptions and potential risks.
* Adherence to client procedures, confidentiality requirements, and internal controls.
* Stakeholder feedback and contribution to process quality and continuous improvement.

Role Expectations and Decision Rights

The individual is expected to operate as an experienced offshore subject-matter expert, independently conducting assigned research and review activities and presenting well-supported findings. The role supports oversight and decision-making; it does not independently confer authority to approve investment products, make investment recommendations to end clients, or provide final suitability decisions unless specifically authorized under the client’s governance framework. Final approvals, investment decisions, and formal escalations remain with the designated authorized stakeholders.

title: Senior Executive – Finance
description:
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Senior Executive to join our Finance team. The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of accounting, SaaS revenue recognition, subscription billing, and statutory compliance. The role involves managing revenue and billing operations, maintaining accurate financial records in Tally, ensuring tax compliance, and improving finance processes through reporting and automation.
  
  
Experience in a SaaS or technology-driven company will be an added advantage.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**SaaS Revenue Recognition and Billing**

* Manage subscription-based revenue recognition in line with applicable accounting principles, including Ind AS 115
* Track subscription revenue, renewals, cancellations, and customer billing data
* Manage billing and invoicing cycles through internal subscription management tools and ensure timely and accurate invoicing
* Reconcile subscription revenue with customer contracts, billing records, and accounting entries
* Coordinate with Sales and Customer Success teams to resolve billing discrepancies and maintain accurate customer records

**Accounting and Financial Management**

* Record day-to-day financial transactions and maintain accurate accounting records in Tally
* Maintain and reconcile general ledgers, journals, and other financial accounts
* Assist in preparing profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and other financial reports
* Ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial records in accordance with company policies and applicable accounting standards

**Taxation and Statutory Compliance**

* Manage GST, TDS, e-invoicing, and other applicable statutory compliance requirements
* Prepare and support timely filing of monthly, quarterly, and annual tax returns and statutory reports
* Assist with internal and external audits by maintaining supporting documents, reconciliations, and schedules
* Track changes in taxation laws and regulatory requirements relevant to the business

**Financial Reporting and Analysis**

* Prepare periodic financial and management reports to support business decisions
* Assist with budgeting, forecasting, and variance analysis
* Monitor revenue performance and key financial metrics
* Identify opportunities for cost optimisation, improved profitability, and greater operational efficiency

**Systems, Automation and Process Improvement**

* Maintain accurate financial and customer-related data in internal finance and subscription management systems
* Generate reports and dashboards to monitor billing, revenue, and financial performance
* Identify opportunities to automate recurring finance activities and improve reconciliation and reporting processes
* Support improvements in the integration of internal systems with accounting records

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
* 3–5 years of relevant experience in finance and accounting, preferably in a SaaS or technology-driven organisation
* Working knowledge of Tally and accounting principles
* Understanding of subscription-based revenue models and Ind AS 115
* Practical knowledge of GST, TDS, e-invoicing, and statutory compliance
* Experience with financial reporting, reconciliations, and audit support
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities
* Good communication skills and the ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment

**Preferred:**
CA Inter, CMA, or other relevant professional qualifications; experience in SaaS revenue reporting, finance process automation, and statutory audits
  
  
Additional Information
  
  
Why Join Zimyo?
  
  

* Be Part of a Growing SaaS Company: Work in a technology-driven environment where finance plays a key role in business growth
* Make an Impact: Take ownership of revenue management, financial reporting, and compliance while contributing to important business decisions
* Drive Automation & Innovation: Explore opportunities to streamline finance processes, improve reporting, and build operational efficiency
* Collaborate Across Teams: Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, and other teams to strengthen financial operations
* Grow Your Expertise: Gain hands-on exposure to SaaS revenue recognition, subscription billing, taxation, and financial analysis

title: Senior Associate - GT Regulatory Reporting
description:
Join our GT Regulatory Reporting Team in Group Finance and you will have an opportunity to work in a dynamic and collaborative environment. Our team is responsible for driving change across systems, ensuring optimal solution design for risk calculations.
  
  
We are a global financial services group operating in 30 markets with 57 years of unbroken profitability. At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that is fulfilling and creates value. You will bring your insights and expertise to the task at hand and feel supported as you make your own kind of impact for a better future.
  
  
**What role will you play?**
In this role, you will be responsible to run the capital/credit risk process to generate exposures for credit risk, Related Party exposures, Risk weighted assets, Leverage ratio, large exposures, regulatory Returns, Pillar 3 disclosures based on the guidance issued by regulators and performing UATs for all regulatory & system driven changes. Additionally, you will play a pivotal role in creating & running the controls over the reporting processes and ensuring that control design is in line with Macquarie’s control framework and complies with all requirements. You will also contribute in responding to internal and external audit queries and ad hoc requests and queries from the regulators.
  
  
**What You Offer**

* CA fresher
* Knowledge of regulatory reporting requirements / developments, fundamental of accounting and consolidation. Previous experience in a Regulatory Reporting role is added advantage.
* Knowledge on financial instruments and products offered by investment banks
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Self-motivated and capable of working in a team environment
* Good analytical ability. Ability to work under pressure, report to tight deadlines and deal effectively with issues.

We love hearing from anyone inspired to build a better future with us, if you're excited about the role or working at Macquarie we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**What We Offer**
**Benefits**
At Macquarie, you’re empowered to shape a career that’s rewarding in all the ways that matter most to you. Macquarie employees can access a wide range of benefits which, depending on eligibility criteria, include:
  
  

* 1 wellbeing leave day per year
* 26 weeks’ paid maternity leave or 20 weeks’ paid parental leave for primary caregivers along with 12 days of paid transition leave upon return to work and 6 weeks’ paid leave for secondary caregivers
* Company-subsidised childcare services
* 2 days of paid volunteer leave and donation matching
* Benefits to support your physical, mental and financial wellbeing including comprehensive medical and life insurance cover, the option to join parental medical insurance plan and virtual medical consultations extended to family members
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, a robust behavioural health network with counselling and coaching services
* Access to a wide range of learning and development opportunities, including reimbursement for professional membership or subscription
* Hybrid and flexible working arrangements, dependent on role
* Reimbursement for work from home equipment

**About Financial Management, People and Engagement**
Financial Management, People and Engagement (FPE) provides a single interface for Macquarie’s businesses across key areas of people, strategy, communications and financial management. Comprising two pillars – Financial Management, and People and Engagement – it is responsible for managing the Group’s financial, tax and treasury activities and strategic priorities, fostering our culture through people and community engagement strategies, and engaging with stakeholders to protect and promote Macquarie’s reputation globally.
  
  
**Inclusion at Macquarie**
We are committed to providing an inclusive environment for all, where different experiences, skills and perspectives are valued and respected. Macquarie provides access to opportunities for all individuals regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetic information, marital status, gender identity or any other characteristic or circumstance.
  
  
We provide reasonable adjustments to individuals who may need support during the recruitment process and employment. If you require an adjustment, please let us know during the application process.

title: Head of Finance and FP&A, India
description:
****Role Description****
The Head of Reporting will lead the Group management reporting agenda within the FP&A Finance team, ensuring senior leaders have a clear, accurate and timely view of financial performance. The role is responsible for delivering Group management reporting and flash results, supporting consistent regional reporting, leading flash review meetings with functions and regional teams, and overseeing Group pro forma calculations for actuals and forecasts. The role will partner closely with Group Financial Control, regional finance teams, functional finance leaders and Finance Systems to strengthen reporting quality, data integrity and insight.
  
  
This is a senior finance leadership role suited to a qualified finance professional with more than 10 years’ experience, including significant exposure to FP&A, management reporting, financial control, performance analysis and team leadership in a complex, international organisation.
  
  
The role will require to work closely with Group Financial Control, Finance Systems, Finance Business Partners, functional Finance leaders and regional finance teams across the organisation. The role will directly manage a team of three based in India.
  
  
****Specific Role Responsibilities****
Group Management Reporting and Flash Results
  
  

* Lead the end-to-end delivery of Group management reporting, ensuring outputs are accurate, timely, consistent and focused on the key drivers of performance.
* Own the preparation and delivery of flash results, providing an early and reliable view of monthly financial performance.
* Develop clear analysis of actual performance against budget, forecast and prior periods, highlighting material variances, risks, opportunities and emerging trends.
* Work closely with the Planning team to ensure budget and forecast bases are aligned with actuals reporting requirements.
* Maintain a robust reporting timetable, governance framework and quality-assurance process across the monthly reporting cycle.

Regional Reporting and Performance Insight
  
  

* Support regional finance teams in delivering high-quality management reporting that is aligned with Group definitions, timelines and performance measures.
* Drive consistency in reporting across regions and functions while recognising relevant local business drivers and requirements.
* Work with HR to ensure consistency in headcount reporting.
* Work with Commercial teams to capture new business and pipeline activity in management reporting.
* Translate complex financial results into concise, decision-useful commentary and insights for senior management, Executive and Board-level audiences.
* Continuously improve the relevance, clarity and efficiency of management information, focusing reporting on the measures that best explain business performance.

Flash Meetings and Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Plan, coordinate and lead monthly flash meetings with functional and regional teams, ensuring clear understanding of performance and the actions required.
* Provide constructive challenge on reported results, supporting commentary, forecast movements and the underlying operational drivers.
* Build strong relationships with regional Finance, functional Finance, Finance Business Partners and senior leadership to improve accountability and reporting quality.
* Present Group performance clearly and confidently, adapting the level of detail to the needs of different senior stakeholders.

Pro Forma Reporting, Controls, Systems and Team Leadership
  
  

* Own and run Group pro forma calculations for actuals and forecasts, maintaining clear methodologies, assumptions, controls and audit trails.
* Provide inputs into quarterly lender reporting, including P&Ls, exceptional costs and pro forma EBITDA.
* Work closely with Group Financial Control throughout month-end to align reported results, resolve issues and ensure management reporting is reconciled to the underlying financial records.
* Partner with Finance Systems and data teams to strengthen data integrity, resolve recurring data issues and improve the reliability and automation of reporting processes.
* Lead, coach and develop a team of three based in India, setting clear priorities, maintaining effective controls and building strong reporting and analytical capability.

****Required Qualifications And Experience****

* Qualified accountant or finance professional, ideally ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent. Financial Services or Technology experience is preferable.
* 10+ years’ experience in Finance, including substantial experience in FP&A, management reporting, financial control or performance analysis.
* Proven experience delivering Group management reporting and flash results in a complex, multi-entity or international organisation.
* Strong understanding of month-end close, management reporting controls, reconciliations and the relationship between statutory and management reporting.
* Experience producing pro forma or adjusted financial information for actuals and forecasts, supported by clear methodologies and controls.
* Advanced Excel and analytical capability, with experience using ERP, EPM, consolidation, reporting or BI tools and working with Finance Systems teams.
* Experience managing and developing geographically dispersed or offshore finance teams.

****Experience Required****

* Excellent command of management reporting, with the ability to connect financial outcomes to operational and commercial drivers.
* Highly analytical and detail-oriented, with a strong commitment to accuracy, control and data integrity.
* Clear and confident communicator who can distil complex results into concise messages for senior audiences.
* Credible and collaborative stakeholder manager, able to challenge constructively and drive timely resolution of reporting issues.
* Strong leadership capability, with a focus on developing talent, setting clear standards and building an effective cross-border team.
* Outcome-focused, organised and resilient, with the ability to manage competing deadlines during month-end and forecast cycles.

****About FNZ****
FNZ is a global FinTech firm, transforming the way financial institutions serve their wealth management customers. We partner with banks, insurers and asset managers to help people achieve their financial goals through our unique combination of technology leadership, innovation and asset servicing.
  
  
Our services enable our clients to provide best-in-class wealth management solutions to financial advisers, end-investors and the workplace. We pride ourselves on creating solutions that are flexible, transparent and scalable, reflecting the latest market, demographic and regulatory trends worldwide.
  
  
FNZ has experienced exceptional growth in the past decade, both in terms of assets-under-administration and also through the substantial expansion of our international footprint.
  
  
Today, we are responsible for over £2.4 trillion in assets-under-administration, held by around 30 million customers of some of the world’s largest financial institutions, including Aviva, Barclays, BNZ, Generali, HSBC, Lloyds Banking Group, National Australia Bank (NAB), Quilter, Santander, UOB, Vanguard, and Zurich.
  
  
In total, FNZ partners with over 650 financial institutions across Europe, Asia Pacific, South Africa and North America and we employ around 7,000 people worldwide.
  
  
The company is owned by a combination of CDPQ-Generation, the unique sustainable equity partnership and FNZ employee shareholders.
  
  
***About FNZ***
*FNZ is committed to opening up wealth so that everyone, everywhere can invest in their future on their terms. We know the foundation to do that already exists in the wealth management industry, but complexity holds firms back.*
*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end-to-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2.5 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
  
  
Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

title: Independent Consultant, Market Shaping - Lead Exposure
description:
WJCF is an Indian non-profit organisation committed to saving lives by reducing the burden of disease and strengthening government-owned, high-quality health systems. Since 2007, WJCF has combined data-driven approaches and deep public health expertise with strong government partnerships to design, implement, and scale solutions across India’s national and state health programmes. We work for and at the service of governments — supporting the Ministry of Health & Family Welfare and State Departments of Health to build systems that are strong, sustainable, and led by Indian institutions.
  
  
As an Indian organisation, WJCF brings an unmatched depth of contextual understanding of India’s health system architecture, policy landscape, and implementation realities across diverse geographies and population groups. This local institutional credibility, combined with global technical rigour, is central to WJCF’s effectiveness as a partner to governments and donors.
  
  
Our work is built around four complementary roles as a Trusted Government Partner, co-designing programmes and strengthening health system architecture; as an Operational Partner, translating strategies into effective on-the-ground delivery; as a Market Shaper, improving the availability and affordability of health commodities; and as an Ecosystem Catalyst, convening governments, development partners, academia, and the private sector to drive solutions at scale.
  
  
WJCF’s programme portfolio spans thematic areas like hepatitis, HIV/AIDS, tuberculosis, vector-borne diseases), syphilis, cervical cancer, diabetes, maternal and childhood anaemia, immunisation, under-5 diarrhoea and pneumonia, sexual and reproductive health, Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri - Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY), Ayushman Bharat Digital Mission (ABDM), hypoxemia and oxygen, safe drinking water, sickle cell disease, presbyopia, lead poisoning, and cross cutting thematic areas like AI and Health, integrated disease surveillance, and climate and health. We currently support programmes across 19 states and union territories, with teams working at national, state, district, and sub-district levels.
  
  
Our people are our greatest asset. WJCF brings together a talented, diverse team of professionals from public health, analytics, consulting, healthcare, the development sector, and academia, all united by a shared commitment to improving health outcomes for the people of India. We are entrepreneurial, action-oriented, and deeply grounded in the communities and systems we work in. Our field teams collectively bring hundreds of years of experience managing public health programmes across the country.
  
  
WJCF collaborates with a range of international and domestic partners and donors to advance its mission, including an affiliation with the Clinton Health Access Initiative (CHAI), a global health organisation with which WJCF shares a common mission and values.
  
  
Programme Overview
  
  
Lead (Pb) exposure is a silent yet devastating global health crisis, particularly in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). Research from UNICEF and other partners estimates that 1 in 2 children in LMICs have elevated blood lead levels, contributing neurological damage, reduced cognitive development, and a variety of health impacts.
  
  
Lead exposure in India arises from multiple sources, with leaded decorative paints and used lead-acid batteries (ULABs) representing the two most significant. Despite a regulatory limit of 90 ppm for lead in decorative paints, widespread non-compliance among SME manufacturers means lead chromate pigments continue to enter the paint supply chain. ULABs are the single largest source of secondary lead in India, with approximately 1.1 million metric tonnes generated annually across the automotive, telecom, inverter, and UPS sectors; informal recycling of spent batteries releases lead into surrounding communities, disproportionately affecting children.
  
  
WJCF has launched a new Lead Exposure Program, building on its proven market shaping capabilities and experience partnering with governments to address large-scale and cross-sectoral health challenges. Program priorities include
  
  

* Devising and implementing strategies to support paint SME manufacturers in transitioning from lead inputs to safer and sustainable alternatives (organic pigments)
* Scoping gaps and intervention areas for market-shaping opportunities across the lead exposure program, spanning diagnostics (pXRF), treatment (chelating agents), and source-side mitigation (plastics, other sources)

The incumbent will support across multiple market shaping workstreams as detailed below.
  
  
Position Details
  
  
We are seeking an analytically rigorous and entrepreneurial individual to support the design, implementation, and monitoring of WJCF’s market shaping interventions. The role involves market assessment, value chain analysis, stakeholder interviews, policy analysis, and financial modelling. It spans government, private sector, and civil society actors, and sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, environmental health, and government engagement.
  
  

* Location New Delhi, with domestic travel to pilot states.
* Duration Up to 6 months, extendable based on performance
* Market Strategies to Transition Paint SMEs to Safer Alternatives

**Transition to Lead-Free Paints**

* Support the scoping and implementation of targeted pilot interventions to enable industry transition to lead-free paints, including addressing SME barriers to transition, supply chain solutions, and related market-shaping measures.

**Pilot Planning & Design**

* Develop detailed pilot blueprints for selected interventions implementation plans, resource requirements, partnerships, budgets, timelines, risk assessments, and mitigation strategies.
* The intervention hypotheses under consideration are

+ Aggregate raw material demand Test the feasibility of aggregating demand from medium-sized paint manufacturers to secure lower-cost lead-free inputs and incentivize greater reformulation of paints to lead-free alternatives.
+ Leverage institutional procurement Identify high-volume institutional paint buyers and work with them to adopt lead-free procurement commitments, creating demand-side pressure for manufacturers to reformulate their products.

* Prepare implementation toolkits and support materials for roll-out as needed.

**Exploring Lead-Free Pigment Transitions in Non-Paint Sources**

* Mapping lead and lead-free pigment supply chains, assess switching barriers, and evaluate the feasibility of lead-free alternatives in other sources (plastics, turmeric)
* Identify opportunities and support concept to proposal writing, including defining and prioritizing intervention areas.
* Market Shaping for Portable XRF (pXRF)

**Accelerate access to affordable pXRF for research and routine government environmental testing**

* Conduct a supplier and distribution landscape of pXRF devices
* Assess device availability and pricing across suppliers
* Map demand with stakeholders, including current pXRF use and unmet needs
* Understand procurement pathways and regulatory frameworks
* Assess end-user needs to evaluate product-market fit
* Market shaping for Chelating Agents

**Enable access to affordable oral chelation therapy**

* Expanding access to chelation drugs through improved sourcing and procurement to reduce costs and enable addition in essential drug lists
* Assessing alternative formulations or delivery approaches that could improve affordability and feasibility in low-resource settings
* Cross-cutting

**Stakeholder Engagement and Reporting**

* Support proposal development, including concept notes, funding proposals, and progress reports.
* Support stakeholder management across donor, government, private sector, and civil society partners.
* Maintain programme tracking tools and contribute to milestone monitoring.
* Scope can potentially evolve basis developing understanding of the above lead exposure program areas
* Bachelor’s degree in business administration, economics, public policy, or a related field; a postgraduate degree is preferred.
* Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with a strong analytical focus, such as market assessment, supply chain analysis, commercial strategy, or policy analysis. Strategy consulting experience is preferred.
* Experience in primary research, such as stakeholder interviews, value chain mapping, or market assessments in complex, multi-stakeholder settings.
* Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical skills, and comfort building unit economics or financial models.
* Strong strategic thinking, with the ability to identify and pursue high-impact opportunities in complex, uncertain, and changing environments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to produce high-quality reports, briefs, and presentations for government, donors, and technical audiences.
* An entrepreneurial mindset, with the ability to work independently, lead workstreams end-to-end, and to propose and carry out new initiatives.

title: Procurement & Costing Manager - Interiors & Turnkey Execution
description:
**Location:**

Delhi NCR

**Company:**

Hub and Oak Interiors

**About Hub and Oak Interiors**

Hub and Oak Interiors is an established commercial interior design and turnkey fit-out company based in Delhi NCR. We specialise in designing and delivering offices and commercial workspaces for startups, corporates and established businesses across Delhi, Gurgaon, Noida and Faridabad. 

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an Procurement & Costing Manager to take end-to-end ownership of BOQs, project estimates and cost planning for office interiors and turnkey projects. The role involves working closely with the Interior Design Head, Business Development Manager and Project Manager to ensure proposals are accurately costed, commercially viable and submitted on time.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. **BOQ Preparation and Quantity Take-Offs:**

   Prepare detailed BOQs by reviewing layouts, working drawings, specifications and site measurements. Identify missing information, scope gaps and discrepancies before finalising estimates.
2. **Project Estimation and Costing:**

   Prepare item-wise estimates covering materials, labour, installation, transport, wastage, site overheads and contingency allowances. Cover all relevant trades, including civil works, partitions, ceilings, flooring, furniture, joinery, electrical, HVAC, plumbing, fire safety and IT infrastructure.
3. **Vendor Quotations and Rate Analysis:**

   Obtain quotations from vendors and contractors, prepare comparison statements, assess scope completeness and negotiate rates to establish reliable project costs.
4. **Commercial Proposals and Tender Support:**

   Prepare priced BOQs, quotation inputs, inclusions, exclusions and assumptions. Coordinate with business development to ensure client proposals reflect the approved scope, costs and margins.
5. **Budget Planning and Value Engineering:**

   Develop execution budgets and recommend alternative materials, specifications or construction methods to meet client budgets while maintaining design intent, functionality and quality.
6. **Design and Execution Coordination:**

   Work with the design and project teams to validate quantities, specifications, site conditions and execution requirements. Hand over approved costing sheets and budgets to the Project Manager before execution.
7. **Variation Costing and Cost Monitoring:**

   Estimate additional work and scope changes, maintain variation records and support approval before execution. Compare actual and committed costs against budgets with the project and accounts teams, highlighting overruns and margin risks.
8. **Cost Database and Documentation:**

   Maintain updated material and labour rates, vendor quotations, standard BOQs and historical project costs. Ensure estimates are version-controlled, traceable and supported by clear calculations and approvals.

**Candidate Requirements**

* Preferably 5–8 years of relevant experience in estimation, costing or quantity surveying, with hands-on experience in commercial office interiors and turnkey fit-outs.
* Degree or diploma in Civil Engineering, Quantity Surveying, Construction Management or a related discipline. Candidates with equivalent practical experience may also be considered.
* Ability to read architectural, interior and services drawings and independently prepare quantity take-offs and detailed BOQs.
* Strong understanding of interior materials, construction methods, labour productivity and vendor pricing.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and AutoCAD for drawing review and measurement; familiarity with estimation software is an advantage.
* Strong commercial judgement, attention to detail and ability to manage multiple estimates within deadlines.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with designers, project managers, vendors and the business development team.

**Success in This Role**

Accurate and timely estimates, complete BOQs with minimal scope omissions, reliable execution budgets, prompt costing of variations and clear visibility of expected project margins.

.

for its offices across multiple locations. Also will be responsible for managing employee queries and their timely resolution, and related daily/monthly closing and reporting activities.
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**

+ Submitted expenses are in compliance with the respective BCG office’s Travel and Expense policy
+ Submitted expenses match with the receipts provided
+ Proper approval has been obtained for expenses incurred outside of the policy

* Resolve expense claims related queries via effective collaboration with various stakeholders to ensure the highest user satisfaction

* Provide regular updates to local finance for any expense trends, abnormal behaviour, improvement action plan, and audit procedure changes
* Partner and maintain relationships with local finance teams to address travel expense policy and audit questions as they arise

* Complete ad hoc requests and perform other duties as needed with minimal oversight
* Active participation in the organization-wide projects and initiatives

* Translate/localize routine reports, reminders, and policy communications between English and Japanese for the Japan office
* Interpret and apply Japan-specific T&E policy nuances (e.g., local tax treatment of allowances, statutory receipt/documentation norms) alongside global BCG policy
* Act as the primary point of contact for Japan-side escalations requiring language and cultural fluency
* Support onboarding and training of new hires or approvers in Japan on T&E tools and policy, in Japanese where needed

What You'll Bring
  
  
**Experience & Qualifications**

* Minimum qualification B.Com with prior experience of working in a global finance operations team
* 2-4 years of relevant experience in travel and expense processing, reporting, query management
* MS Excel, Word proficiency and adaptable to several software applications
* Preferably exposure to ERP systems and T&E Workflow solutions like Concur, Chrome River etc.
* Business-level proficiency in Japanese (reading, writing, and speaking) is mandatory – JLPT N2 or above preferred; ability to draft professional business communication in Japanese
* Working proficiency in English to collaborate with global stakeholders and internal teams

Who You'll Work With
  
  
We pride ourselves on a collaborative working environment and utilize digital tools to foster that collaborative environment across a global company. The Global Finance Operations Centre aims at providing best in-class operational excellence and execution through partnership, building trust and credibility. It provides a foundation to ensuring smooth finance operations, coordinating change and ensuring performance of individual processes with high service levels.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
**YOU'RE GOOD AT**

* Ability to prioritize and manage workload
* Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills – strong attention to details
* Strong initiative and willingness to take on projects in a proactive manner
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment; excellent time management skills and ability to meet tight deadlines
* Excellent oral and written communication skills & effective listening skills
* Relationship building, partnering and collaboration
* Committing to improvement through feedback and self-reflection,learning new topics & skills
* Strong customer orientation and flexible to business needs
* Utilizes sound judgment in dealing with work flow and uncertain situations
* Handles situations with confidence, understanding and tact
* Ability to respect all BCG information as personal and confidential
