title: Senior Manager– Strategic Finance
description:
Sr. Manager– Strategic Finance

**Location:**
Noida

**About the Role**

We're hiring an Sr. Manager to be the senior voice in the room for Finance Business Partnering — the person functional leaders turn to when a budget number, a headcount ask, or a business case needs a real answer, not just a report. This is not an execution role. We already have operational coverage; what's missing is someone with the judgment to independently run a leadership conversation, push back on a weak assumption, and turn analysis into a recommendation the CFO or a functional VP will actually act on.

You'll manage one Manager, partner directly with R&D, GTM, Customer Success, and G&A leadership, and work closely with the Director – Strategic Finance on budget cycles, strategic deep-dives, and leadership-facing analysis. This is the clearest growth path in the team into a future Director-level seat.

**What You'll Own**

**Finance Business Partnering**

* Embedded partnership with R&D, GTM, Customer Success, and G&A — budget discussions, headcount planning, spend optimization, resource allocation
* Own business cases and project economics for new initiatives, and defend them in front of functional and finance leadership
* Independently run recurring budget and performance conversations with functional heads — not just prepare the materials for someone else to present

**Strategic & Analytical Judgment**

* Unit economics and profitability analysis to support initiative evaluation and ROI decisions
* Translate variance and performance data into a point of view, not just a readout
* Flag risks and challenge assumptions proactively, before they reach the Director or CFO

**Team Leadership**

* Manage the Manager – Business Finance: set priorities, review output quality, and coach them toward handling more senior conversations independently
* Act as the quality bar between operational output and what's fit to put in front of leadership

**Cross-Coverage**

* Stay close enough to MIS, performance reporting, and forecasting to step in during close or budget-season crunch — this role is expected to flex across both pillars, not stay siloed in business partnering

**What We're Looking For**

* 6–8 years in FP&A, Strategic Finance, or business partnering roles, ideally in SaaS or high-growth tech
* CA / CFA / MBA (Finance) or equivalent
* Demonstrated ability to run a budget, headcount, or spend conversation directly with a functional leader and hold your ground on the numbers
* Some people-management experience, or clear readiness to manage and develop a direct report
* Strong modeling and analytical skills; comfort working with AI/automation tools for first-pass analysis so your time goes to judgment, not production
* Calm, direct communication style — able to deliver an unwelcome number without softening the substance

**Why This Role**

This is the seat built for someone who's outgrown pure execution but hasn't yet had the platform to lead leadership conversations independently. You'll get real stakeholder ownership, a direct reporting line to the Director, and a defined path toward a future Director-level role as the team scales.

title: Finance & Accounts
description:
Job Description – Assistant Manager/Deputy Manager, Finance & Accounts

Department: Finance, Accounts, MIS

Location - Noida

Job Type - Full-Time

Job Summary:

To manage and oversee finance and accounting operations for the Media & Digital business,

ensuring accurate financial reporting, timely billing and collections, effective cost control,

statutory compliance, cash-flow management and strong financial governance.

The role will also act as a finance business partner to business teams by providing timely

MIS, commercial insights, project profitability analysis and financial support for business

decisions.

The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in accounting, taxation, financial reporting,

receivables/payables management, budgeting, MIS, audits (Internal & Statutory), and

internal controls, along with the ability to independently manage finance operations and

coordinate with internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Operations

\* Manage day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate and timely recording of

financial transactions.

\* Prepare and review ledgers, reconciliations, provisions, accruals and accounting

adjustments.

\* Ensure proper maintenance of books of accounts in accordance with applicable

accounting standards and company policies.

\* Oversee month-end and year-end closing activities.

\* Review balance sheet schedules and ensure timely reconciliation and resolution of

outstanding items.

2. Accounts Receivable & Payable

\* Monitor customer receivables, outstanding payments and ageing.

\* Drive timely collection of outstanding invoices and coordinate with business/sales team

for payment recovery.

\* Review vendor invoices, payment requests and ensure timely processing of vendor

payments.

\* Monitor advances, debit/credit notes and other outstanding balances.

\* Maintain an effective receivables and payables tracker.

3. MIS & Financial Reporting

\* Prepare and review monthly financial MIS, management reports and business dashboards.

\* Provide analysis of revenue, expenses, profitability & cash flow.

\* Provide meaningful financial insights to management to support business decisions.

4. Commercial Finance & Contract Review

\* Review financial and commercial aspects of client agreements, POs, contracts and

business proposals.

\* Validate billing terms, payment milestones, credit periods and financial commitments.

\* Highlight commercial and financial risks before execution of contracts.

\* Support business teams in negotiations from a financial perspective.

\* Monitor contract-wise revenue, cost and profitability.

5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

\* Review GST/TDS reconciliations and ensure timely resolution of discrepancies.

\* Maintain proper documentation for statutory compliance and audits.

6. Audit & Compliance

\* Coordinate with internal, statutory and tax auditors.

\* Provide required schedules, supporting documents and information for audits.

\* Ensure timely closure of audit observations and implementation of corrective actions.

\* Strengthen internal financial controls and ensure compliance with company policies.

7. Internal Controls & Process Improvement

\* Establish and monitor effective financial controls and approval mechanisms.

\* Identify process gaps and implement improvements to increase efficiency and accuracy.

\* Automate and streamline finance processes wherever possible.

\* Ensure proper segregation of duties and adherence to financial policies.

8. Banking & Treasury

\* Monitor & Manage fund requirements and support cash-flow planning

\* Coordinate with banks for foreign inward collections and payments & other banking

requirements.

9. Business Partnering

\* Work closely with business, procurement, sales, legal and other departments on finance-

related matters.

\* Provide financial guidance on contracts, commercial arrangements, pricing and business

proposals.

\* Support management in evaluating financial implications of business decisions.

\* Act as a finance partner to business teams while ensuring financial discipline.

10. Team Management

\* Lead, guide and develop the finance and accounts team.

\* Allocate responsibilities and monitor team performance.

\* Ensure timely completion of monthly, quarterly and annual finance activities.

\* Build a culture of accuracy, accountability and continuous improvement.

Key Deliverables / KRAs

\* Timely and accurate monthly financial closing.

\* Accurate and timely MIS and management reporting.

\* Reduction in outstanding receivables and improved collection efficiency.

\* Timely vendor payments and effective payable management.

\* 100% timely statutory and tax compliance.

\* Timely completion of audits with minimum observations.

\* Improved financial controls and process efficiency.

\* Reduction in accounting errors and unreconciled balances.

\* Successful implementation of finance process improvements and automation.

Required Qualifications

\* CA Inter / MBA (Finance) / M.Com / B.Com or equivalent qualification.

\* 6–8 years of relevant experience in Finance & Accounts, preferably with experience in a

managerial role.

\* Strong knowledge of accounting, taxation, financial reporting and statutory compliance.

\* Experience in managing audits, MIS, budgeting and working capital.

\* Good understanding of ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel.

Preferred Skills

\* Financial accounting and reporting

\* GST, TDS and Income Tax

\* MIS and variance analysis

\* Receivables & collections management

\* Payables and vendor management

\* Cash-flow management

\* Audit and internal controls

\* ERP / accounting software

\* Advanced MS Excel

\* Team management

\* Process automation and improvement

Key Competencies

\* Strong analytical and problem-solving ability

\* High level of accuracy and attention to detail

\* Ownership and accountability

\* Strong communication and negotiation skills

\* Ability to work under deadlines

\* Leadership and team-management capability

\* High integrity and confidentiality

\* Process-oriented and proactive approach

* Good numerical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Ability to maintain financial records and handle documentation systematically.

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Consultant, Business Process Controls Advisory, Audit and Assurance**
**About**
At Deloitte, we do not offer you just a job, but a career in the highly sought-after risk Management field. We are one of the business leaders in the risk market. We work with a vision to make the world more prosperous, trustworthy, and safe. Deloitte’s clients, primarily based outside of India, are large, complex organizations that constantly evolve and innovate to build better products and services. In the process, they encounter various risks and the work we do to help them address these risks is increasingly important to their success—and to the strength of the economy and public security.
  
  
By joining us, you will get to work with diverse teams of professionals who design, manage, and implement risk-centric solutions across a variety of domains. In the process, you will gain exposure to the risk-centric challenges faced in today’s world by organizations across a range of industry sectors and become subject matter experts in those areas.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
You will have the opportunity to work on multiple projects across industries that help organizations manage and mitigate risk, improve operational performance, and maximize enterprise value. In this role, you will build on your foundation to design, implement, assess and support risk management; provide advisory services; and assist in restructuring programs, reengineering processes, and frameworks to address the growing challenges and risks our clients face. You would have an opportunity to gain experience in:
  
  

* Providing extensive range of accounting and reporting services in addition to enhancing the overall value on financial reporting, technical and operational excellence related services delivered to the client.
* Assisting companies to understand, assess impact, and operationalize complex accounting and reporting changes resulting from shifting regulations, new accounting standards, corporate actions and capital market transactions.
* Driving operational efficiencies in the financial close and reporting process through providing efficient, sustainable, and technology-enabled solutions aligned with accounting and financial reporting requirements.
* Support risk assessment for clients to identify prioritized list of risk/audit and helping plan the audit approach and scope, preparing the audit program, determining auditing procedures, seeing the audit process through completion, and applying internal audit standards
* Create internal control documentation for the engagement including narratives, process and data flows, and other supporting work papers
* Conduct/lead client interviews, communication and follow-ups
* Support various internal audit activities, including scoping, planning procedures, issuing requests, coordinating collection and examination of documentation, review and discussion of draft conclusions, management action plan and issuance of report to the client
* Mergers & Acquisitions related analysis of income statement trends to identify any one-time, non-cash or non-recurring items that may impact normalized earnings; analysis of normalized working capital, seasonality, cash and financial debt positions and potential adjustments for deal purposes and impact on free cash flow as well as evaluating the liabilities including any off-balance sheet items or contingent liabilities.
* Providing financial consulting services relating to business valuation for various classes of liabilities

and assets, including intangible asset; real and personal property; and various complex securities, including fixed-income securities, equities, derivatives, etc., using different valuation techniques models in accordance with US GAAP. Also, creating financial models, conducting industry research, and writing reports
  
  

* Apply a general knowledge of the technologies used to build complex IT environments and facilitate use of technology-based tools or methodologies to review, design, and implement products and services
* Demonstrate understanding of business processes, internal control risk management, IT controls, and related regulatory and compliance standards
* Exercise professional skepticism, judgment and adhere to the code of ethics while on engagements

**Required Skills**

* Experience — 0 to 1 year
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills (written, verbal, and presentation), positive attitude, and willingness to go the extra mile
* Strong analytical, critical thinking/problem-solving skills and executive presence
* Experience with working in an ambiguous environment. Business mindset to understand the rationale behind the transactions, process workflow and ability and willingness to dive deeper into industry issues and bring greater insights for our clients
* Knowledge of accounting standards, financial management and technical concepts, strong working knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
* Ability to work both independently and as part of a team with professionals at all levels
* Willingness to expand skillset and work on other related areas

**Preferred Skills**

* Big 4 Articleship experience

**Qualification**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) - Rank Holder in CA Final will be preferred

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

**Company Overview**
Synchrony (NYSE: SYF) is a leading consumer financing company that has been at the heart of American commerce and opportunity for nearly a century. For more information, visit www.synchrony.com.
  
  
**Organizational Overview**
Credit Team decisions credit actions across the lifecycle of a customer – from acquisition to account management to collections and recover – we work towards managing credit and fraud losses and elevating customer experience through powerful and proprietary insights on customer risk and credit behaviors. The actionable insights are driven by access to numerous alternative data sources, new age technologies, focused strategies, emerging algorithms, and predictive precision. Spread across 10 pillars the credit team in India caters to the entire gamut of decision sciences, from data management to model development to strategy design, and bringing it all to life through technology, and managing within the guardrails of our regulatory requirements. As part of the team, you will have access to some unique product propositions, functional and leadership training, interaction with executive leadership team and a myriad of diverse perspectives.
  
  
**Role Summary/Purpose**
The
*Manager , Collections Strategy Delivery Build*
role is responsible for implementation of Collection strategies as they relate to Pre-Delinquent, Delinquent (pre-charge off) & Recovery accounts utilizing SAS, Experian Power Curve (Strategy Manager) and Fiserv Rules. The Analyst leads solution development with build team, direct manager and change requestor for new projects, new clients and Strategy Change Initiatives within Strategy Delivery Team. Analysis of collection strategies and development/ enhancement of Phone and Alternate channel implementation processes are key elements to the success of the Strategy Delivery Team. Participates on multiple initiatives as Build SME for SAS, Strategy Manager application and Fiserv Rules Platform. As a Manager, you are required to be proficient in handing projects and engaging with stakeholders independently.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Implements Collections and Operational Strategy initiatives for all delinquent accounts and Strategy designated Pre-Delinquent & Recovery accounts leveraging leading edge technology to enhance customer experience.
* Partner with collections contact strategy team, collection operations and process owners to determine strategy implementation requirements and develop / ensure streamlined approaches to coding, unit testing and queuing process
* Works independently to provide Level of Effort for scoping and scheduling the change requests
* Project Manager / SME for collections projects involving Alternate channel strategies (SAS) and Phone channel strategies (Strategy manager processes)
* Provides recommendations for process enhancements based upon Design Reviews
* Develop and monitor dashboards including analysis, action plans and identification of process improvements support simplification strategies including life-cycle tools and treatments specific to champion/challenger strategies that include digital channels, and other outbound correspondence
* Partners with process owners in establishing procedures and requirements to ensure accurate and timely delivery with regulatory and compliance standards
* Partners with Collections Data Warehouse team and Enterprise Data Lake teams for issue resolution
* Provide account level research for understanding of Collection processing
* Work independently with minimum to moderate supervision
* Perform other duties and/or special projects as assigned

**Required Skills/Knowledge**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience
* Minimum 2 + years of hands-on experience with SAS or knowledge of SAS programming
* Minimum 2 + years of experience with design, test and control environments working with large amounts of data
* Minimum 1+ years analytical and decision-making experience.

**Desired Skills/Knowledge**

* 1 year of experience with FISERV/FD Rules/ Strategy Manager Development (batch mode)
* 1 year of Project Management Experience
* Ability to effectively prioritize and manage multiple projects concurrently with commitment to deadlines.
* Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate and present business results to management

**Eligibility Criteria**

* Bachelor’s degree with 2 + years of experience, or in lieu of a degree 4 + years of relevant work experience

**Work Timings: 02:00 PM – 11:00 PM IST**
(WORK TIMINGS: This role qualifies for Enhanced Flexibility offered in Synchrony India and will require the incumbent to be available between 06:00 AM Eastern Time – 11:30 AM Eastern Time (timings are anchored to US Eastern hours and will adjust twice a year locally). This window is for meetings with India and US teams. The remaining hours will be flexible for the employee to choose. Exceptions may apply periodically due to business needs) We are proud to offer flexibility at Synchrony. Our way of working allows you the option to work from home or workspaces in our Regional Engagement Hubs—Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Pune, Kolkata, or Delhi/NCR. Occasionally you may be required to commute or travel to Hyderabad or one of the Regional Engagement Hubs for in person engagement activities such as business or team meetings, trainings, and culture events.

description:
Ventra is a leading business solutions provider for facility-based physicians practicing anesthesia, emergency medicine, hospital medicine, pathology, and radiology. Focused on Revenue Cycle Management, Ventra partners with private practices, hospitals, health systems, and ambulatory surgery centers to deliver transparent and data-driven solutions that solve the most complex revenue and reimbursement issues, enabling clinicians to focus on providing outstanding care to their patients and communities.
  
  
**Come Join Our Team!**

* As part of our robust Rewards & Recognition program, this role is eligible for our Ventra performance-based incentive plan, because we believe great work deserves great rewards

**Help Us Grow Our Dream Team — Join Us, Refer a Friend, and Earn a Referral Bonus!**
**Job Summary**

* The Bank Reconciliation Specialist is responsible for performing the initial steps in the payment posting process. Daily assignments are provided by the supervisor, and the specialist must develop a plan to complete assigned worklists by the end of each day. The Bank Reconciliation Specialist must comply with applicable billing standards and operate effectively in a team-oriented environment, delivering superior service to providers across the country.

**Essential Functions And Tasks**

* Create monthly reconciliations for individual clients. (Monthly)
* Log into bank portals to download bank statements using Month-to-Date filtering and save them to the designated client folder for the current month. (Daily)
* Download Lockbox and Correspondence files. (Daily)
* Rename Lockbox and Correspondence files according to standard file naming conventions and upload them to the document management system. (Daily)
* Input new daily deposit totals from the previous business day for dashboard reporting. (Daily)
* Place prior day deposits on the client's monthly reconciliation log. (Daily)
* Update post logs daily for current and prior month reconciliations to ensure alignment with the bank statements. (Daily)
* Research and upload any missing remits for posting. (Daily)
* Investigate and resolve posting variances found in the bank statement. (Daily/Weekly)
* Perform daily checks to identify any remits not posted within 3 days and coordinate with the posting team for timely completion. (Daily/Weekly)
* Investigate and coordinate with relevant teams to resolve any variances identified in the reconciliation logs. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Monitor daily ERA checks to ensure they are posting automatically; notify the supervisor if any ERAs are not being received. (Daily/Weekly)
* Provide insurance and check details for ERA setups when necessary. (Weekly/Monthly)
* Review and compare reported deposits against Bank Statement totals to verify that all data is accurate, reconciled, and up-to-date. (Weekly)
* Identify Ventra and Non-Ventra payments.
* Ensure all daily, weekly, and monthly tasks are completed accurately and do not require rework or cross-checking. (Daily/Weekly/Monthly)

**Education And Experience Requirements**

* High School Diploma or GED.
* At least one (1) year of experience reconciling bank account deposits.
* Knowledge of payor portals is preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities**

* Ability to read, understand, and apply state/federal laws, regulations, and policies.
* Ability to communicate with diverse personalities in a tactful, mature, and professional manner.
* Ability to remain flexible and work within a collaborative and fast paced environment.
* Basic use of computer, telephone, internet, copier, fax, and scanner.
* Basic touch 10 key skills.
* Basic Math skills.
* Understand and comply with company policies and procedures.
* Strong oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
* Strong time management and organizational skills.
* Strong knowledge of Outlook, Word, Excel (pivot tables), and database software skills.

Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
  
  
In this role we are looking for an experienced
**SAP FI Senior Consultant**
to join our growing SAP Finance team. In this role, you will lead and support SAP FI design, configuration, and implementation activities across a range of projects. You will work closely with business stakeholders to deliver innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions within the SAP FI landscape
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* The primary function of this position is to work as a team member in different phases of various ongoing SAP Implementation Projects and contribute effectively to the area of SAP FI General Ledger, Accounts Payables, Accounts receivable, Bank Accounting Taxation, and Fixed Assets functionalities with a preferred background in the relevant industry.

* Interface and communicate with the onsite coordinators.
* Completion of assigned tasks on time and regular status reporting to the manager/lead

* You’ll build and nurture positive working relationships with teams and clients with the intention to exceed client expectations.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to gather and analyse business requirements independently (Mandatory skill)
* Ability to drive design workshops independently with the client (Mandatory skill)
* Must be able to prepare the materials for the design workshops independently (Mandatory skill)
* Must send out the Meeting Minutes of the Workshop post each workshop that he/she leads (Mandatory skill)
* Follow‑up on the action items from the workshops
* Knowledge of SAP – BPC (Consolidation), Special purpose ledger, SOX, US GAAP, Various of Exits, Background on the Technical and Functional upgrade, Report painter, Report writer etc.
* Experience on FIORI APPS, BO-DS, BW, HANA and other reporting tools.
* Prior client facing consulting experience.
* SAP Finance/Controlling Certification is a plus

**What We Look For**

* Candidate must be a qualified CA / ICWA / MBA Finance in a reputed institution with a sound industry/domain experience and SAP relevant experience with 3-7 years
* Experience should be in End-to-end Implementation, Rollout, Support, upgrade, enhancements in the below areas.


+ SAP Finance – FI- New General Ledger & Profit Center Accounting, FI-Accounts Payable, FI-Bank accounting and FI-Asset Accounting.
+ Exposure on SAP Simple Finance – GL Accounting, Asset Accounting and CO – Overhead Cost Controlling & Profitability Analysis.
+ SAP Finance – Taxation and Withholding Taxes.
+ SAP Finance – Closing activities, Validations and Substitutions & Reporting.
+ Controlling- CO-Cost element accounting CO-Cost Center Accounting and CO-Internal Orders.
+ Knowledge on CO-PA & Product Costing (Planning and cost object controlling).
+ FI integration with MM, SD, HR & PS.
+ Excellent business communication skills

* Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
* Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
* People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
* Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
* How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.

title: Pricing Analyst - US Mortgage
description:
**Pricing Analyst - US Mortgage**

Job Description:
Pricing Analyst - US Mortgage

**Job Summary**

The Pricing Analyst manages mortgage rate lock requests, pricing, lock changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations according to company policies, investor guidelines, and market pricing. The role involves coordinating with Loan Officers (LOs), Loan Processors (LPs), Secondary Marketing, underwriting, and investors to ensure accurate pricing, timely lock execution, and compliance with established procedures. The analyst also reviews daily investor rate sheets, maintains pricing accuracy in mortgage systems, investigates and resolves pricing discrepancies, and supports the smooth functioning of the mortgage lock desk.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Mortgage Rate Lock Management:

Process rate lock requests from Loan Officers (LOs) and Loan Processors (LPs), verify loan details (amount, program, interest rate, LTV, FICO, occupancy, property type, and lock period), ensure eligibility and compliance with company policies and investor guidelines, and accurately process new locks, changes, extensions, relocks, and cancellations on time. Monitor lock expirations, communicate confirmations, rejections, and required corrections, and maintain accurate records in the loan origination system.

2. Mortgage Pricing and Rate Sheet Management:

Download and review daily investor rate sheets for dates, pricing adjustments, product availability, and lock periods. Upload and maintain rate sheets and pricing data in the pricing engine. Compare investor pricing with internal systems to identify differences. Review base pricing, loan-level price adjustments (LLPAs), margins, concessions, discount points, and lender credits. Calculate and verify final borrower or broker pricing according to company policies. Provide accurate pricing information to Loan Officers for eligible loan scenarios.

3. Lock Extensions, Relocks, and Pricing Exceptions:

Review and process lock extensions, relocks, and pricing exceptions according to company policies. Calculate extension fees, relock fees, and pricing adjustments. Check lock history, expiration dates, previous extensions, and available free extension days. Process pricing concessions and exceptions only after obtaining the required approvals. Verify approval authority and maintain supporting documents. Communicate applicable fees, pricing impacts, and processing restrictions to the requesting teams.

4. Investor Guidelines and Product Eligibility:

Review investor guidelines and product eligibility before processing lock requests. Verify delegated and non-delegated lending channels, where applicable. Confirm product availability based on loan program, credit score, occupancy, LTV, loan purpose, and other applicable criteria. Identify investor-specific restrictions and escalate exceptions when needed. Coordinate with investor representatives to resolve pricing, eligibility, and lock-related issues. Ensure all pricing and lock activities follow investor requirements and internal policies.

5. Communication and Issue Resolution:

Respond to inquiries from Loan Officers, Loan Processors, Secondary Marketing, and other internal teams. Explain pricing differences, lock rejections, extension fees, and investor restrictions clearly. Follow up on pending lock requests, pricing exceptions, and unresolved system issues. Escalate complex pricing and eligibility concerns to the appropriate manager or authorized approver. Maintain professional communication and meet established service-level agreements (SLAs).

6. Quality Control and Reporting:

Maintain accurate records of lock requests, confirmations, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and pricing exceptions. Check loan details and pricing for accuracy. Prepare daily or periodic reports on lock activity, expiring locks, pending requests, and pricing issues. Follow internal controls, audit requirements, and documentation standards.

**Required Qualifications**

A Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related field is preferred.

At least 1 year of experience in U.S. mortgage operations, Secondary Marketing, or mortgage rate lock desk operations is preferred.

Knowledge of mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, relocks, cancellations, and Conventional, FHA, VA, USDA, and applicable Non-QM products is required, along with Excel, Microsoft Office, and pricing analysis skills.

Strong analytical, numerical, problem-solving, and communication skills, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple requests under tight deadlines are essential.

**Key Competencies & Performance Metrics**

• Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills.

• Accuracy in mortgage pricing, rate locks, extensions, and relocks.

• Good time management, prioritization, and attention to detail.

• Effective communication, teamwork, and knowledge of investor guidelines and compliance requirements.

• Timely processing of lock requests, quick resolution of pricing issues, and adherence to company policies and service-level agreements (SLAs).

• Accurate documentation, audit readiness, and reduction of processing errors.

**Work Schedule & Location**

Must be available to work according to U.S. mortgage business hours, including the applicable U.S. time zone and market-related deadlines.

Shift Time: 7:30pm to 4:30am IST

Location: Inforpark Phase 2, Kochi

Candidates from Kerala and Tamil Nadu are preferred.

title: Contract and Claims Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.
  
  
This Position reports to:
  
  
Global Division Contracts & Claims Manager
  
  
  
  
  
In this role, you will have the opportunity to define contract management strategy and contract formulation. Each day, you will ensure that all contract management activities are tendered, negotiated, and executed in accordance with the contract negotiations handbook / contract management framework and relevant group/division/business directives and instructions, including company procedures. You will also showcase your expertise by reviewing and commenting on contract terms and conditions and annexes to the contract/frame agreement.
  
  
The work model for the role is # LI - Hybrid.
  
  
This role is contributing to the to the Energy Industries in Process Automation business based in Bangalore, India.
  
  
**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Support Contract Managers in delivering contract management services and ensuring compliance with contractual obligations across projects, divisions, and business lines.
* Collaborate with Project Managers and stakeholders to ensure contract requirements, flow-down obligations, purchase orders, and subcontract agreements are effectively implemented.
* Assist in contract kick-off activities, including contract reviews, preparation of contract summaries, deliverables tracking, risk identification, responsibility matrices, and contract awareness sessions for project teams.
* Provide support in managing contractual and commercial matters throughout the project lifecycle, ensuring alignment with company policies, procedures, and governance requirements.
* Prepare, maintain, and administer contractual documentation, correspondence, records, notices, communication logs, guarantees, insurance documents, and other project-related contract deliverables.
* Support risk management, change management, and variation order processes, including the preparation of commercial proposals, claims, and contractual assessments.
* Contribute to project reporting and closeout activities by ensuring accurate contract and commercial status reporting, while supporting global initiatives and other ad-hoc contractual or commercial assignments as required.

You will join a talented team, where you will be able to thrive.
  
  
**Qualifications for the role:**

* Minimum 7 yrs. Experience, with EPC energy/process plants related projects background.
* Has experience / background in contract management, engineering and construction contracting in EPC environment, system and package equipment contracts, contract lifecycle management.
* Contractual and commercial knowledge with strong governance awareness to ensure contract compliance, and overall commercial integrity.
* Good technical background and knowledge of engineering, procurement and construction project management.
* Ability to multi-task, with excellent organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
* Bachelor 's degree, preferably quantity surveyor or engineering background with master level in law/contract management.

**More About Us**
ABB a provides a comprehensive range of integrated automation, electrical and digital systems and services for customers in the process, hybrid and maritime industries. These offerings, coupled with deep domain knowledge in each end market, help to optimize productivity, energy efficiency, sustainability and safety of industrial processes and operations.
  
  
The Energy Industries Division serves a wide range of industrial sectors, including hydrocarbons, chemicals, pharmaceuticals, power generation and water. With its integrated solutions that automate, digitalize and electrify operations, the Division is committed to supporting traditional industries in their efforts to decarbonize. The Division also supports the development, integration and scaling up of new and renewable energy models. The Division’s goal is to help customers adapt and succeed in the rapidly changing global energy transition. Harnessing data, machine learning and artificial intelligence (AI), the Division brings over 50 years of domain expertise delivering solutions designed to improve energy, process and production efficiency, as well as reduce risk, operational cost and capital cost, while minimizing waste for customers, from project start-up and throughout the entire plant lifecycle.
  
  
Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.
  
  
Ready to make an impact? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

title: Audit and Compliance Specialist
description:
**Overview**
**JOB DESCRIPTION: Audit and Compliance Specialist - Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* JOB IDENTIFICATION

**APTEAN JOB TABLE: Information Security**
**APTEAN JOB LEVEL: B**
**APTEAN JOB TITLE: Audit and Compliance Specialist - Governance, Risk & Compliance**
**REPORTS TO**
Full line: Director, Information Security
  
  
Dotted line: Lead Audit and Compliance Specialist
  
  

* GENERAL JOB SUMMARY

The Audit and Compliance Specialist - Governance, Risk & Compliance performs the assurance activities of the Aptean Information Security Office: testing whether security controls are designed adequately and operating effectively, producing the evidence that demonstrates it, and assessing third parties, products and AI systems against Aptean control requirements. The role supports external audits and certification assessments, coordinates technical security assessments, authors security policies, standards and department handbooks, and administers the exception and control registers.
  
  

* SCOPE

**Knowledge**
Possesses extensive experience and deep expertise in the field. Effectively resolves a broad range of challenges using sound judgment, creativity, and practical knowledge. Recognized as a fully proficient professional who can operate independently within their area of specialization.
  
  
**Complexity**
Manages diverse and complex assignments that require thorough analysis and evaluation of multiple factors. Demonstrates strong decision-making skills in selecting appropriate methods, techniques, and solutions. Regularly collaborates and builds relationships with senior internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Supervision**
Works with a high degree of autonomy and receives minimal day-to-day supervision. Typically requires only general direction for new or unique assignments while independently managing routine responsibilities.
  
  

* ORGANIZATION

**Full Line**

* Director, Information Security

**Dotted Line**

* Lead Audit and Compliance Specialist
* PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
* Executes control testing against the information security control framework on the defined cycle, including sampling, test procedures and documented conclusions on operating effectiveness.
* Assesses control evidence for sufficiency, records findings with severity, root cause and accountable owner, and validates remediation evidence before closing findings raised by the function.
* Supports external audits, certification assessments and customer-driven assessments through evidence preparation, request tracking, auditor liaison and follow-up submissions.
* Coordinates technical security assessments: defines scope against control, certification and contractual requirements, manages independent assessors, reviews deliverable quality, and registers resulting findings for tracking.
* Conducts pre-engagement and periodic third-party security and privacy due diligence assessments, reviews vendor assurance artefacts and contractual security requirements, and issues documented risk opinions.
* Assesses AI systems against applicable security control requirements, performs AI audit and assurance activity, and provides security input to AI risk categorisation and operator role determination undertaken by the governance function.
* Drafts and maintains security policies, standards and department security handbooks, working with subject matter experts to define applicable controls, expected evidence and accountable owners.
* Administers the exception and risk registers, monitors expiry, produces recurring compliance and control reporting for management and governance committees, and performs other related duties as assigned.
* JOB SPECIFICATIONS

Education
  
  
**Preferred Required**
**Required Preferred Degree/Certification**
☒ ☐ Bachelor’s degree
  
  
☐ ☐ Master’s degree
  
  
☐ ☐ Ph.D.
  
  
☐ ☐ J.D. (law)
  
  
☐ ☒ Certification: ISO 27001 Lead Auditor/Lead Implementer, CISA, CCSK
  
  
☐ ☐ Registration
  
  
☐ ☐ Licensure:
  
  
☐ ☐ Other
  
  
**Work Experience**
4 years of experience in information security in a dedicated governance, risk and compliance, security compliance or IT audit role.
  
  
**Knowledge**

* Information security control frameworks - SOC1, SOC 2, SOC3, ISO 27001, ISO 42001 and NIST 800-53 or NIST CSF - including control interpretation and evidence requirements.
* Audit and assessment practice, including sampling, evidence sufficiency, finding classification and corrective action tracking.
* Third-party and vendor security risk assessment methodology, contractual security requirements and assurance artefact review.
* Artificial intelligence governance and AI security requirements, including risk-tiering under the EU AI Act, operator role concepts, ISO 42001, and how AI systems are assessed against security controls.
* Security documentation hierarchy - how policy, standards, baselines, procedures and department handbooks relate to one another.
* Cloud security concepts across at least one major provider, sufficient to interpret cloud control requirements and assess supporting evidence.
* Data protection principles and regulatory obligations, including GDPR and privacy assessment processes.

**Skills And Abilities**

* Writes clearly and precisely in English. A substantial part of the role produces documentation that non-security teams must follow and auditors must rely on; writing ability is assessed during selection.
* Reaches supportable conclusions from incomplete evidence, and states limitations rather than overstating assurance.
* Distinguishes an isolated control failure from a systemic control weakness and escalates accordingly.
* Scopes, commissions and challenges assessments delivered by specialist third parties without performing the technical work.
* Works effectively with technical teams without owning their work - asks precise questions, obtains attributable answers, and escalates where accountability is declined.
* Manages concurrent assurance activities against defined cycles and reports slippage when it occurs rather than at the milestone date.
* Maintains accuracy and traceability in registers, evidence records and reporting.
* Applies professional scepticism and maintains an independent position under commercial or delivery pressure.

**DISCLAIMER**
*The preceding job description has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees within this classification. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications required of employees assigned to this job.*

title: Legal and Secretarial Associate
description:
**About Kapiva**

At Kapiva, we're on a mission to bring the wisdom of Ayurveda into the everyday lives of modern consumers. We combine time-tested Indian wellness traditions with scientific innovation to create nutrition-led health solutions that are natural, effective, and convenient.

Our portfolio spans multiple wellness categories including digestion, weight management, diabetes, cholesterol, skin & hair, immunity, and more. Kapiva has built a strong presence across leading e-commerce platforms such as Amazon, Flipkart, Nykaa and BigBasket, while rapidly expanding its offline footprint through leading retail partners including Reliance Retail, Nature's Basket and Noble Plus.

Backed by leading consumer-focused investors including OrbiMed, Fireside Ventures, Vertex Ventures, 3one4 Capital, Sharp Ventures and Jetty Ventures, Kapiva is entering an exciting phase of scale. As we continue to grow, we are building people practices that are as innovative, agile and consumer-centric as the business itself.

**About the Role:**

This role demands a candidate with a strong foundation in legal principles, excellent drafting and negotiation skills, and the ability to assist in managing contracts, litigation, regulatory compliance, and intellectual property matters effectively in a dynamic business environment.

**Roles and Responsibilities:**

* Prepare and review a variety of commercial contracts, including NDAs, manufacturing agreements, vendor agreements, service agreements, and other business-related documents.
* Assist in drafting and reviewing responses to legal notices, plaints, written statements and support dispute resolution processes. Coordinate with external counsels on litigation matters and ensure timely updates and follow-ups and maintain the litigation tracker.
* Support the filing and management of trademarks, copyrights, and patents to ensure all intellectual property of the company are safeguarded.
* Provide legal support on new product launches, collaborations, and campaigns, ensuring compliance with applicable laws (FSSAI, AYUSH, ASCI, Consumer Protection, etc.).
* Maintain organized and updated records of executed contracts, legal opinions, and other relevant documents.
* Assist in researching and reviewing new legal and regulatory developments to ensure compliance.
* Liaise with authorities for compliance queries, show-cause responses, and regulatory submissions.
* Lead periodic training sessions for internal teams on compliance and contractual awareness.
* Manage end-to-end company secretarial compliance under the Companies Act, 2013 and applicable Secretarial Standards, including convening and minuting Board, Committee and General Meetings, maintaining statutory registers, and ensuring timely ROC/MCA filings.
* Support fundraising and other capital transactions (private placements, preferential allotments, rights/bonus issues, ESOP grants and share transfers), including term sheet and SHA/SSA review, investor due diligence, closing documentation, allotments, cap table maintenance and FEMA/RBI reporting (FC-GPR, FC-TRS).
* Track and operationalise investor rights under the Shareholders’ Agreement and Articles of Association, including reserved matter/affirmative vote approvals and investor information rights.

**Basic Qualifications and required skill-set**

title: Sr. Associate Contract Specialist
description:

Join the leader in global work. Vialto helps leading organizations identify, develop, and execute their workforce priorities with confidence. Our practice areas include global tax, immigration, rewards, advisory and Vialto private and our team is the gold standard in navigating the complexities of cross-border compliance, and workforce strategies. We look for people our clients and assignees can count on to thoughtfully deliver clear solutions to complex problems.
  
  
To be the best in the business, we cultivate a dynamic, highly collaborative culture that fuels the growth of our people. We invite you to inquire boldly, learn deeply, and grow endlessly with us. You’ll work alongside recognized experts, shaping people-first, technology-driven solutions that drive the future of work. We help our clients achieve their goals and imagine new possibilities. And we can do the same for you. Whatever your aspirations, Vialto can help you find your way.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking a highly skilled Privacy Counsel with 3 to 5 years of global privacy experience to support our organization’s data protection and privacy compliance program. In this role, you will work closely with both client-facing teams and internal teams - including technology, security, risk and legal - to ensure Vialto handles personal data lawfully, transparently and in alignment with global regulatory standards. This position offers a unique opportunity to shape and strengthen privacy practices across a complex and fast-moving global organization.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Draft, review, and negotiate privacy-related contract terms (including DPAs) for commercial and vendor relationships.
* Conduct and review Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), Transfer Impact Assessments (TIAs) and Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs).
* Support responses to RFPs, client privacy questionnaires and due diligence requests.
* Advise on international data transfers and related compliance mechanisms, including EU SCCs, UK transfer mechanisms, adequacy decisions, and regional data localization requirements.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure maintenance and accuracy of Vialto’s record of processing activities (ROPA).
* Assist with privacy incident investigations, notification analyses and related documentation.
* Provide general support on other privacy-related matters and initiatives as needed, including data subject requests, policy updates, special projects and ad-hoc requests from business teams.

**Qualifications Required**

* Juris Doctor (JD), LLB, or equivalent legal degree; licensed to practice in at least one jurisdiction.
* 3 - 5 years of experience focused on privacy in a law firm, in-house legal department, or regulatory agency.
* Demonstrated experience advising on global privacy laws, particularly GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, PIPL, PIPEDA and LGPD.
* Strong experience with reviewing, drafting and negotiating data privacy agreements and privacy-related commercial terms.
* Experience conducting and advising on DPIAs, TIAs and LIAs.
* Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple tasks in a fast‑paced environment.

**Preferred Skills**

* IAPP certification (CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM, CIPT).
* Experience supporting a global professional services firm or multinational organization providing technology-enabled services.

Work Location: Bangalore
  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer that does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected status.

title: Managed Services Governance Advisor
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Advisor , Managed Services will act as the primary governance lead for Managed Services engagements, ensuring contractual commitments, service performance, commercial obligations, and change activities are effectively governed. Drive continuous improvement, transparency, risk mitigation, and value realization across managed service partnerships.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  
**Managed Services Governance & Performance Management**

* Own overall performance and partnership management through an integrated governance model across contract, financial, and change management.
* Partner with CSSP, FP&A, DT&D, and supplier teams to operate governance cadences at operational and executive levels.
* Oversee supplier performance against SLAs, KPIs, XLAs, contractual commitments, milestones, and transformation roadmaps; drive corrective actions and SIPs through the governance forums

**Commercial Governance, Financial Management & Pricing**

* Govern commercial commitments, contractual obligations, pricing constructs, budget utilization, forecasts, savings, and value realization.
* Validate invoices against contracts, pricing schedules, approved changes, service volumes, consumption data, and resource rates.
* Monitor commercial risks, COLA increases, financial exposures, penalties/credits, pricing inefficiencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Support benchmarking, renewals, pricing negotiations, and commercial impact assessments.

**Change Management Governance & Invoice QA**

* Govern managed services changes through established CAB and approval processes, including review of scope, cost, risk, impact, and contractual alignment.
* Ensure documentation and approvals for changes, track implementation success and cumulative impacts on service performance and costs.
* Perform invoice QA before payment, identify billing discrepancies, track recurring issues, and drive root cause resolution.

**Risk, Issue, Tool Enablement & Data Insights**

* Maintain centralized issue and risk registers; track remediation actions, mitigation plans, supplier dependencies, and delivery risks.
* Escalate critical operational, commercial, security, and compliance concerns; provide concise leadership risk summaries.
* Drive adoption of governance tools and platforms such as ServiceNow, Power BI, Power Automate, SAP/Ariba, Beeline, Jira, SharePoint, and CLM platforms.
* Improve governance dashboards, scorecards, automated reporting, data quality, workflow automation, and governance repositories.

**Continuous Improvement & Value Realization**

* Identify opportunities to improve service quality, governance maturity, automation, process optimization, and commercial outcomes.
* Track contracted benefits, savings, efficiencies, and value realization; conduct lessons learned reviews and maturity assessments.
* Promote best practices consistently across managed services suppliers.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Engineering, Business, Finance, Supply Chain, or related field.
* 8+ years of experience in Supplier Governance, Vendor Management, Managed Services Governance, IT Service Management, Commercial Management, or Outsourcing Governance.
* Demonstrated experience managing supplier performance, governance forums, SLAs/KPIs, contract compliance, commercial obligations, and risk management activities.
* Experience with managed services engagements across Application, Infrastructure, End User, Cloud, or Digital Workplace services.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen with experience in invoice validation, pricing analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and value realization.
* Proficiency with governance and reporting tools such as ServiceNow, Power BI, SAP/Ariba, Jira, SharePoint, and workflow automation platforms.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.
* ITIL, SIAM, PMP, Lean Six Sigma, or Vendor Management certifications preferred.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification preferred.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: Manager - Compliance
description:
**About CoinSwitch**
CoinSwitch is one of India's leading crypto investment platforms and is registered with FIU-IND as a Virtual Digital Asset Service Provider (VDA SP).
  
  
Our Compliance team works across AML/CFT controls, transaction monitoring, blockchain investigations, customer due diligence, regulatory reporting and engagement with FIU-IND and law enforcement agencies. We work closely with internal teams to strengthen controls, address emerging risks and meet our regulatory obligations.
  
  
We are looking for a Compliance Manager who brings strong AML/CFT experience, sound judgement and a hands-on approach to managing compliance operations in a fast-evolving virtual digital asset ecosystem.
  
  
What you'll do
  
  
Transaction Monitoring and AML Investigations
  
  

* Lead the review and investigation of transaction monitoring alerts across fiat and virtual digital asset transactions, including complex and high-risk cases.
* Assess suspicious activity, determine appropriate escalation and reporting, and prepare high-quality Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) with clear, evidence-based narratives.
* Review transaction monitoring scenarios, thresholds and red flags to improve detection effectiveness and reduce false positives.
* Identify emerging typologies, unusual transaction patterns and potential misuse of the platform, and translate findings into actionable control improvements.

Blockchain Analytics and Travel Rule Compliance
  
  

* Conduct blockchain investigations using analytics tools to trace fund flows, assess wallet exposure and investigate links to illicit activity, including scams, darknet services, mixers and sanctioned entities.
* Review virtual asset deposits and relevant wallet exposure alerts, document findings and take appropriate action in line with internal policies and regulatory requirements.
* Support Travel Rule compliance, including information exchange with counterparty VASPs, and review cases involving unhosted wallets in accordance with applicable requirements.

Regulatory Compliance and FIU-IND Reporting
  
  

* Ensure timely and accurate filing of STRs and other applicable regulatory reports in accordance with PMLA, the PML Rules and FIU-IND requirements.
* Oversee compliance with customer due diligence, beneficial ownership identification, risk categorisation, periodic KYC updates and enhanced due diligence requirements.
* Ensure appropriate maintenance and retrieval of KYC, transaction and investigation records in accordance with applicable record-retention requirements.
* Monitor regulatory circulars, advisories, notifications and emerging AML/CFT typologies, and assess their impact on existing policies, controls and procedures.
* Support the Designated Director and Principal Officer in meeting applicable regulatory obligations, including independent AML/CFT audits and remediation of audit observations.

KYC, Screening and Enhanced Due Diligence
  
  

* Oversee customer screening against applicable sanctions lists, PEP databases, adverse media and other relevant watchlists.
* Review screening matches, ensure appropriate disposition of potential matches and support timely action on applicable sanctions and freezing requirements.
* Review high-risk customers and transactions, including complex fund flows, high-value activity and cases requiring enhanced due diligence.
* Strengthen customer risk assessment and ongoing monitoring processes based on customer profiles, transaction behaviour and emerging risk indicators.

Law Enforcement and Regulatory Engagement
  
  

* Manage responses to requests from law enforcement agencies, FIU-IND and other competent authorities, including information requests, notices and account-related directions.
* Coordinate the collection, validation and submission of relevant customer, transaction and investigation records within prescribed timelines.
* Support regulatory inspections, compliance reviews, audits and information requests, ensuring that responses are accurate, complete and appropriately documented.
* Track regulatory observations and agreed action plans through to closure, working with relevant stakeholders where required.

Compliance Governance, Reporting and Team Management
  
  

* Prepare management updates and periodic compliance reports covering key risks, suspicious activity trends, control effectiveness and regulatory developments.
* Contribute to enterprise-wide AML/CFT risk assessments and periodic reviews of policies, procedures and internal controls.
* Work with Product, Engineering, Data and Operations teams to strengthen monitoring capabilities, improve investigative workflows and address identified control gaps.
* Maintain clear investigation records, case documentation and audit trails to support regulatory scrutiny and internal reviews.
* Guide analysts on case investigations, STR quality, screening decisions and escalation standards, while supporting ongoing training and capability development.

What we're looking for
  
  

* Mandatory: CAMS certification from ACAMS.
* 5–8 years of overall professional experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience in a VDA platform, bank, NBFC, payments company, brokerage or a comparable regulated financial services environment.
* Strong working knowledge of PMLA, 2002, the Prevention of Money-laundering (Maintenance of Records) Rules, 2005, and FIU-IND's AML/CFT requirements for VDA SPs.
* A sound understanding of FATF Recommendations, particularly Recommendations 15 and 16, and their relevance to virtual asset activities.
* Practical experience in transaction monitoring, suspicious transaction investigations and STR preparation and filing.
* Experience handling law enforcement requests, regulatory information requests and time-sensitive compliance matters.
* The ability to analyse transaction data, identify patterns and draw meaningful conclusions using Excel and, preferably, SQL or similar data analysis tools.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare clear investigation reports, regulatory responses and management updates.
* Good judgement, attention to detail and the ability to independently manage complex cases while guiding junior team members.

Good to have
  
  

* Hands-on experience with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis Reactor/KYT, TRM Labs or Elliptic.
* Experience working with transaction monitoring, screening or case management systems, including rule configuration, threshold optimisation and control testing.
* Exposure to Travel Rule implementation and interactions with counterparty VASPs.
* Experience with virtual asset regulatory frameworks outside India, including VARA (Dubai) or CBB (Bahrain).
* Additional certifications such as CCAS, CFE or ICA qualifications.

**Location:**
Bengaluru (Hybrid)
  
  
**Experience:**
5–8 years, including at least 3 years of hands-on AML/CFT experience
  
  
**Certification:**
CAMS (ACAMS) – Mandatory

title: Senior Solicitor
description:
**SENIOR SOLICITOR | REAL ESTATE & LEGAL STRATEGY**

Hyderabad | Full Time | Leadership Role

**An opportunity to bring experience, judgement and legal excellence to real estate leadership.**

MPM Group, a Hyderabad based real estate development company, is seeking an exceptionally experienced legal professional to head its legal function and serve as Principal Counsel to the Chairman & Managing Director.

This is a senior strategic position for a distinguished legal professional with deep expertise in real estate transactions, property law, litigation strategy and complex legal documentation. This is a full-time, advisory and strategic role at our Hyderabad corporate office. Court appearances remain with external counsel.

Retired judges and highly experienced legal professionals with a strong background in real estate and property law are particularly encouraged to apply.\*

**THE ROLE**

**Real Estate Transactions & Legal Documentation**

* Structure and negotiate land acquisitions, Joint Development Agreements, development cum GPA arrangements and revenue sharing agreements.
* Draft and vet Sale Deeds, Agreements of Sale, GPAs, lease deeds, RERA compliant buyer agreements and project financing documents.
* Lead legal negotiations with landowners, investors, lenders and buyers.

**Title Due Diligence & Risk Assessment**

* Conduct comprehensive 30-year title searches and chain of title verification.
* Examine Encumbrance Certificates, Pahani, ROR, Sethwar and Bhu Bharati records.
* Identify and assess legal risks involving assigned lands, Inam lands, land ceiling restrictions, endowment properties and prohibited lands.
* Provide robust title opinions suitable for institutional financing and investor due diligence.

**Regulatory & Revenue Matters**

* Advise on land mutation, conversion under NALA, stamp duty and registration.
* Guide compliance with Telangana RERA and applicable HMDA and GHMC regulations.

**Litigation Strategy & Legal Advisory**

* Develop legal strategies for property disputes, title suits, writ petitions, arbitration and RERA proceedings.
* Brief and supervise external advocates and review pleadings before filing.
* Undertake legal research and provide strategic opinions on complex matters.

**Legal Leadership & Governance**

* Establish and lead an effective in house legal function.
* Develop standardized legal documentation, review protocols and matter tracking systems.
* Leverage AI and legal technology to improve the efficiency and quality of legal drafting, research and review.

**THE IDEAL CANDIDATE**

* 15+ years of relevant experience in real estate and property law, including at least five years in a leadership role.
* Experience with a real estate developer, reputed law firm or institutional legal panel.
* Strong command of property transactions, litigation strategy, title verification and legal drafting.
* LL.B. from a recognized university. LL.M. preferred.
* Fluency in English and Telugu.
* Distinguished legal professionals with substantial judicial or advisory experience and a strong understanding of real estate law are encouraged to apply.
* Compensation will be commensurate with experience and seniority. For the right candidate, compensation will not be a constraint.

MPM Group values diversity in leadership. Women legal professionals are strongly encouraged to apply.

**INTERESTED IN THIS OPPORTUNITY?**

**Please send your CV and a cover letter explaining your suitability for the role to:**

**hr@mpm.in**

title: Senior Risk Analyst
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Senior Risk Judgment & Advisory**

* Serve as the senior analytical authority for complex, high-tier risk cases — including Cyber Risk, AI risk, cross-jurisdictional privacy complexity, and novel technology types not clearly addressed by existing framework
* Provide risk advisory support to IT leadership, BISOs, Legal/Privacy, and business stakeholders — translating complex risk landscapes into clear, actionable guidance
* Own the integrity of the risk determination record for high-profile or sensitive programs; provide independent review where risk signals are ambiguous or where determinations carry material business or regulatory consequence
* Guide analysts on when to accept, challenge, escalate, or override risk outputs — serving as a calibration resource and quality anchor for the team

**Framework Stewardship & Continuous Monitoring**

* Monitor patterns across risk assessments — override rates, exception volumes, flag frequencies — to identify systematic accuracy issues, framework gaps, or emerging risk themes
* Support continuous monitoring initiatives and contribute to the evolution of BMS's integrated risk framework (Scope Screening → Regulatory Classification → Risk-Tiered Controls) as the operating model matures
* Identify where the risk tiering model, control library, or assessment logic may need refinement; articulate improvement recommendations with supporting evidence to Risk Leads and leadership
* Contribute to periodic reviews of auto-approved projects, leading structured assessments where findings may have broader programmatic implications

**Stakeholder Leadership & Cross-Functional Engagement**

* Lead engagement with senior project sponsors, IT architects, Legal/Privacy SMEs, and Compliance teams on high-risk or high-complexity assessments
* Represent the IT Risk function in cross-functional forums; provide subject matter expertise on regulatory risk implications (GDPR, EU AI Act, GxP, NIST frameworks)
* Build and maintain strong partnerships across IT, Legal, Privacy, Cybersecurity, and Business functions; act as a trusted advisor rather than a compliance gatekeeper
* Support escalation resolution between Risk Leads, BISOs, Privacy SMEs, and project teams; facilitate closure on disputes involving risk determinations and framework interpretation

**Operational Excellence & Governance**

* Ensure audit-ready documentation standards across the team; review and validate complex SNOW and GRC records for accuracy, completeness, and audit defensibility
* Contribute to or lead training initiatives for analysts on evolving framework components, updated risk tiering logic, and operational workflow changes
* Support governance reporting; prepare executive-quality risk summaries, trend analyses, and control attestation packages for senior leadership and compliance audiences
* Provide UAT support for framework and tooling updates — including validating that risk outputs align with expected SME-level determinations

**Mentorship & Team Development**

* Provide mentorship and guidance to junior analysts; support calibration, quality review, and professional development within the team
* Model the expected analyst behavior in an automation-enabled environment: review-first, judgment-driven, override with rationale, and escalate with clarity

**Required**
**Qualifications & Experience**

* 5–10 years of progressive experience in IT risk management, cybersecurity risk, IT audit, privacy compliance, or a closely related field
* Demonstrated track record of independent, senior-level risk judgment — including experience handling complex, ambiguous, or high-stakes risk determinations
* Deep knowledge of NIST Cyber Risk Management Framework, NIST 800-53 controls library, and at least one major privacy regulatory framework (GDPR, EU AI Act, GxP, CCPA)
* Experience working with GRC platforms at an advanced level (ServiceNow GRC or equivalent); ability to review, validate, and ensure quality of records produced by others
* Strong executive communication skills; experience preparing and presenting risk findings to senior leadership or audit/compliance audiences
* Experience with AI/ML, automation, or emerging technology risk programs — including digital transformation and data privacy risk governance

**Desired Candidate Characteristics**

* Highly developed risk judgment — able to form defensible, well-reasoned positions on complex determinations and explain them clearly to any audience
* Advisory mindset: seen as a trusted partner by stakeholders, not just a process owner
* Comfortable with automation and system-generated risk signals as primary inputs — focused on interpreting and acting rather than manually gathering data
* Strategic thinker with an eye on where the risk function is heading, not just where it is today
* Strong influencer and collaborator; able to drive alignment across Legal, Privacy, IT, and Business without formal authority

Passion for healthcare and the belief that excellent risk management enables better science and better patient outcomes
  
  
We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
  
  
**How We Work**
Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities.
